article.articleHeadline: Ebola vaccine trial begins in Democratic Republic of Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, the worst to date, has surpassed 9,700 cases and 4,600 deaths. The first clinical vaccine trial in the country began Oct 23 in Bunia, Ituri province, with Ervebo (Zaire strain) used to test cross-protection while two Bundibugyo-specific candidates advance. The Tumaini trial, a ring-vaccination framework, aims to assess safety, efficacy and immunogenicity of multiple vaccines, including two candidates: ChAdOx1 adenoviral vector (Oxford) and Moderna's mRNA vaccine, both CEPI-funded and expected to enter the trial soon. The study will include pregnant women and children 12 years and older. If successful, it could yield the first clear evidence of Bundibugyo vaccine protection and transform outbreak response and preparedness. WHO declared the 17th Ebola outbreak in May, with a PHEIC two days later; Ebola spreads via bodily fluids causing haemorrhagic fever.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチン治験開始
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した過去最悪規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクであり、死者4,600人超・症例9,700件超と深刻。新規ワクチン治験開始という動きもあり国際的関心が高く、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOは2026年5月に第17次エボラ流行を宣言、2日後にPHEICを宣言。CEPI資金によるOxford社・Moderna社のワクチン候補を含むTumaini治験（リング接種方式）が進行中。既存の死亡者数・症例数は過去最大規模であり、継続的な監視と支援が必要。

article.articleHeadline: PHP爆重大漏洞全球網站急下線　非洲伊波拉蔓延4國 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PHP reveals a major vulnerability as global websites go offline worldwide; Ebola spreads to four countries in Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-24, Ebola outbreaks have extended to four African countries: the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. Kenya's health ministry confirms a second Ebola-related death, a household contact of a previously diagnosed patient. Nigeria reports its first confirmed case in more than a decade, with genomic sequencing showing the Nigerian virus is highly related to the Kenyan case, prompting intensified cross-border surveillance and public health response. Authorities are investigating infection sources and expanding laboratory confirmation to prevent further spread. The widening geographic footprint underscores ongoing regional risk and the need for rapid containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: PHPに重大な脆弱性、世界のウェブサイトが緊急停止　アフリカでエボラが4カ国に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国から複数国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）へ国境を越えて拡大しており、ナイジェリアでは10年以上ぶりの症例確認、ゲノム解析でケニア株との関連が示されるなど、国際的拡大・重症度・異常性の観点でIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは発生起点として記事主題に含まれるため記載。

article.articleHeadline: Biến chứng nguy hiểm do cúm A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Serious complications due to influenza A.
article.articleSummary: Two elderly patients with influenza A complications in Hanoi, Vietnam: at the National Hospital for Tropical Diseases, a 72-year-old man with long-standing hypertension and prior stroke developed fever, progressive dyspnea, and severe pneumonia with lung injury, requiring oxygen at 40–50% and non-invasive ventilation. After three days, fever subsided but pulmonary injury remained severe, prolonging respiratory support. A second patient, a 73-year-old man with COPD and heavy smoking history, presented with cough, increasing shortness of breath and fever; he tested positive for influenza A at a local clinic, and on admission developed rapid respiratory failure, necessitating endotracheal intubation and critical care, but his condition deteriorated. Clinicians emphasize that flu severity cannot be judged by fever alone; COPD and airway inflammation worsen ventilation and gas exchange during influenza. Preventive measures include hand hygiene, masking, ventilation, social distancing, and annual vaccination for high-risk groups.

article.articleHeadline: Vandalur zoo to reopen tomorrow after bird flu scare
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza detected in water birds at Arignar Anna Zoological Park (AAZP) in Vandalur, Tamil Nadu, prompting closure for disinfection and precautionary measures. ICAR-NIASD, Bhopal confirmed infection in water birds; bird enclosures remain cordoned off while birds are closely monitored and reported healthy. Health Department screened 26 animal care staff on Oct 22; all 26 tested negative by RT-PCR. Comprehensive disinfection and biosecurity measures have been implemented, with reopening planned for Sunday, Oct 25, 2026. No human infections reported. A 13-year-old tiger captured in Gudalur on Oct 22 was brought to the Vandalur Rescue and Rehabilitation Centre for ongoing veterinary care and monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ騒動後、ヴァンダルール動物園が明日再開

article.articleHeadline: Woman, 65, becomes second patient to die of Ebola in Kenya
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second Ebola death during its first outbreak, a 65-year-old woman who was a close family member of the first patient and died in quarantine. The initial case, a man who fell ill in September after travelling from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and treated in DR Congo hospitals, arrived in Nairobi and died on Oct 5. Seven other Ebola patients remain in treatment at two isolation facilities. All cases are within one cluster with no evidence of community spread. Across Africa, more than 4,000 deaths have occurred since Ebola was confirmed in May in DR Congo. The Bundibugyo strain is rare, with no approved vaccine or treatment (trials under way). Transmission is via contact with infected bodily fluids. Kenya has boosted screening for travellers from DR Congo and nine high-risk countries (Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Burundi, Angola, Zambia, Ethiopia, South Sudan, Central African Republic) with digital forms and QR codes; enhanced aircraft screening. Nigeria reports one confirmed case genetically linked to a Kenyan strain; investigations ongoing; some results negative or pending; possible Entebbe route.

triage.headline_ja: 65歳女性、ケニアでエボラにより死亡した2人目の患者に
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初のエボラアウトブレイクが発生し複数の死亡者・入院患者が確認され、ナイジェリアへの遺伝的関連症例も報告されるなど国際的拡大の兆候があり、渡航スクリーニング強化など貿易・渡航制限的措置も取られているためフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolavaksine testes i Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola vaccine tested in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing the country’s worst Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo virus variant, with about 9,700 confirmed cases and over 4,600 deaths. In Bunia, the World Health Organization launched a vaccine trial on Friday named Tumaini (Swahili for 'hope') to test protective strategies against Bundibugyo. The study will evaluate Ervebo, a vaccine approved for the Zaire strain, for potential cross-protection, while efforts aim to determine if any existing vaccines can mitigate this strain. The first participants were vaccinated in Bunia, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, who emphasized that the trial seeks answers and lives saved. Over time, Tumaini will also include two Bundibugyo-focused vaccine candidates under development.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラワクチンが試験される

triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおける過去最悪規模のエボラ流行とBunia市でのWHO主導ワクチン試験（Tumaini試験）についてのもの。国際的拡大や渡航制限に関する具体的記述はないため不明と評価。

article.articleHeadline: Reported Echinococcosis in Xinjiang Peaked in 2017 and Fell to a 2022 Low,
article.articleSummary: Xinjiang, China reported 20,302 echinococcosis cases from 2010–2024, peaking in 2017 and declining to a 2022 low, based on the China Infectious Disease Surveillance and Reporting System. Joinpoint regression showed an APC of 8.91% (2010–2017) followed by -12.56% (2017–2024); overall AAPC was -2.42% (CI -5.80 to 0.83%), with results sensitive to model specification. Monthly notifications shifted over time. In forecasting, five time-series methods were evaluated for 2020–2024 using 2010–2019 training data under a fixed-origin setup and four error metrics: RMSE, MAE, MAPE, sMAPE. In fixed-origin, LSTM yielded the lowest errors (RMSE 47.08, MAE 39.24, MAPE 105.91%, sMAPE 46.07%). Under expanding-window rolling-origin, SARIMA delivered the best RMSE/MAE/sMAPE, with LSTM comparable. Conclusion: forecast performance depends on the evaluation framework, not just epidemiology.

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل الوفاة الثانية لمصاب بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records the second death of an Ebola virus patient.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Kenya reports the second Ebola virus–related death in an outbreak linked to Democratic Republic of Congo clusters. Nine confirmed cases have been recorded in Kenya, with two fatalities; seven cases remain in isolation facilities, and health authorities say there is no evidence of sustained community transmission. The deceased is a 65-year-old woman who had direct, close contact with the family of the first fatal case and developed symptoms after entering quarantine on 13 October. The Kenya Ministry of Health notes all recorded cases belong to a single outbreak cluster. The outbreak began after a case who traveled from Congo to Nairobi and died in hospital on 5 October, signaling a cross-border element. Infections have been detected in Uganda and Nigeria.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラウイルス感染者の2人目の死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国由来のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクがケニアに越境し、死亡例・確定例が複数発生。ウガンダ・ナイジェリアにも拡大しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの死亡例増加だが、ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。アウトブレイクの起源とされるDRCのみを対象国として記載。越境伝播の懸念が高く、国際的な監視と支援が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Kaltim ingatkan risiko penyakit hepatitis B akut dan kronis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Kalimantan Health Office warns of the risks of acute and chronic hepatitis B
article.articleSummary: East Kalimantan's Health Office warns of acute and chronic hepatitis B (HBV) risks in Samarinda, urging awareness of transmission via contaminated blood from shared needles and non-sterile tattoo tools, perinatal transmission from infected mothers, unsafe sex, and sharing personal items such as toothbrushes, razors, and nail scissors. Symptoms include nausea, vomiting, reduced appetite, mild fever, right upper quadrant pain, jaundice, and dark urine; many patients may be asymptomatic early. Prevention emphasizes CEGAH: complete vaccination, personal hygiene, safe/protected sex, and avoiding shared items, with early detection through periodic blood testing. For H1 2026, the province reports 100% coverage of DDHBC across all 10 districts/cities, 83.08% average coverage among at‑risk populations, 61.34% DDHB coverage among pregnant women, and 770 new hepatitis B cases detected province‑wide.

article.articleHeadline: Swiss Officials Point to Uganda in Nigeria Ebola Case Investigation | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: One case of Bundibugyo virus disease (EVD) confirmed in Abuja, Nigeria, on Oct. 20, with 44 contacts monitored. The patient, a woman in Nigeria, had traveled after a business trip to eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo; Uganda’s Ministry of Health had said she transited through Uganda symptom-free before illness. The Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs contests Uganda’s account, stating neither the patient nor her husband visited the DRC and viewing the Uganda period as the probable exposure source. Uganda’s MOH says exposure location remains under investigation, describing eastern DRC travel followed by symptom-free transit through Uganda. The World Health Organization notes the DRC Ebola outbreak is its 17th since 1976 and the largest on record. Investigations continue into exposure location and potential imported risk to Nigeria.

triage.headline_ja: スイス当局、ナイジェリアのエボラ症例調査でウガンダを指摘
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブジョ型）の輸入症例がナイジェリアで確認され、感染経路を巡り複数国（DRC・ウガンダ・スイス）で見解が対立しており、DRCでは過去最大規模の流行が進行中であることから、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: ナイジェリアとウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは記事中で『1976年以降17回目、過去最大規模』の進行中の流行として明記されているため含めた。感染経路（DRC起源かウガンダ起源か）については各国間で見解が対立しており未確定。

article.articleHeadline: Proef ebolavaccin van start in Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola vaccine trial begins in Congo.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola vaccine clinical trial underway in the Democratic Republic of Congo as WHO reports. The outbreak is the worst in the country, with over 9,700 cases and more than 4,600 deaths. The trial, named Tumaini (Swahili for 'hope'), tests several candidate vaccines against the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists. The study also includes a broader assessment of Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV), approved for the Zaïre (Zaire) variant, to determine whether it offers cross-protection against Bundibugyo. The trial marks a milestone in vaccine development for the Bundibugyo variant. Results should clarify whether cross-protection is possible.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラワクチンの治験開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最悪規模（症例9,700件超、死者4,600人超）のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続しており、承認ワクチンが存在しない中での治験開始という公衆衛生上重大な事案のため。
triage.notes: WHOが関与する大規模アウトブレイクであり、ブンディブギョ株に対する承認ワクチン・治療法が存在しない点が特に懸念される。症例数・死者数から見て既にフルリスク評価が実施されている可能性が高いが、新規治験開始という動きも注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: WHO announces start of Ebola vaccine clinical trial in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: On 24 October 2026, the WHO announced the first Ebola vaccine clinical trial in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), focusing on the Bundibugyo strain. In Bunia, Ituri province, participants are vaccinated with Ervebo (Zaire strain) to assess cross-protection against Bundibugyo. The DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, declared in May, has surpassed 9,700 cases and 4,600 deaths, with the WHO declaring a public health emergency of international concern. The outbreak now spans four countries across eastern, central and western Africa, the widest geographic spread in Africa to date. The Tumaini trial uses a ring vaccination framework to test the safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity of multiple vaccines, including two Bundibugyo-specific candidates: the ChAdOx1 vaccine from Oxford and Moderna's mRNA vaccine, funded by CEPI. The study includes pregnant women and children aged 12 and older.

article.articleHeadline: Κένυα: Και δεύτερος ασθενής με Έμπολα πέθανε στο Ναϊρόμπι
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya: A second patient with Ebola died in Nairobi.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a second Ebola death: a 65-year-old woman who developed symptoms while in quarantine as a close contact of a Kenyan man who died earlier this month. The first Kenyan case was a man who travelled from the Congo to Nairobi and died on Oct 5. Total confirmed Kenyan cases stand at 9, with 2 deaths and 7 patients in isolation. On Monday, the U.S. State Department issued a Kenya travel advisory urging Americans to reconsider travel for health reasons. Nigeria became the fourth African country to report an Ebola case: a Swiss woman, wife of a Swiss embassy official in Abuja, who had recently travelled to Uganda; 44 close contacts identified, including her husband in isolation. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with no approved treatment or vaccine. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, nearly 10,000 cases and about 4,600 deaths have been recorded.

article.articleHeadline: WHO Begins Ebola Vaccine Trial in Congo Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo hosts the first Ebola vaccine trial, Tumaini, in Bunia, Ituri province, amid the 17th and worst Ebola outbreak since May. WHO reports more than 9,700 cases and over 4,600 deaths; PHEIC declared. The trial tests cross-protection of Ervebo (Zaire strain) against Bundibugyo. It uses ring vaccination, immunising high-risk contacts; includes pregnant women and children 12 and older. Two Bundibugyo-specific candidates enter soon: ChAdOx1 adenoviral vector from Oxford and an mRNA vaccine from Moderna, funded by CEPI. Tumaini is a single framework to assess safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity of multiple vaccines. The outbreak has spread to four countries across eastern, central, and western Africa—the widest Ebola geographic spread on the continent to date. The trial is underway in Bunia; vaccines will enter shortly.

article.articleHeadline: "치명률 최대 90%" 에볼라 공포...미국, 콩고 방문 확인 의무화
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Fatality rate as high as 90%" Ebola fear... U.S. requires verification of Congo visits.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 23, 2026, the U.S. CDC tightened Ebola-related border controls: all international air travelers must prove they have not visited or stayed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo within the previous 21 days, with the rule taking effect on Nov 3. U.S. citizens who have stayed in Uganda or South Sudan must enter via designated airports for enhanced screening; the measure expands an earlier restriction on boarding following Congo visits. Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic fever; four of six known Ebola viruses have infected humans: Zaire, Sudan, Bundibugyo, and Tai Forest. The current outbreak is the rapidly spreading Bundibugyo strain; in 2018, Zaire reached 1,000 cases in 235 days, Bundibugyo in 40 days. Fatality rates range 25–90% by virus and setting; Congo’s current fatality is 45.7%, with concern it could rise due to variants. No Korean cases; WHO PHEIC declared; five African countries—DRC, Uganda, South Sudan, Ethiopia, Rwanda—are designated focus quarantine regions.

triage.headline_ja: 「致死率最大90%」エボラ恐怖…米国、コンゴ訪問の確認を義務化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクによりWHOがPHEICを宣言、米国が入国規制を実施するなど国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威となっており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで発生中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクを主題とし、米国・韓国・ウガンダ・南スーダン・エチオピア・ルワンダは渡航制限や検疫対象国として言及されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。WHO PHEIC宣言済みでフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Δεύτερος νεκρός από τον ιό Εμπολα στην Κένυα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second death from the Ebola virus in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Ebola virus disease (EVD) surveillance shows spread across four African countries, with Kenya reporting its second death. A 65-year-old woman died after presenting symptoms while in quarantine as a close contact of a Kenyan man who had fallen ill and died earlier in October; Kenya has confirmed 9 cases, including 2 deaths, with 7 patients in isolation and 135 close contacts in quarantine. The first Kenyan case was a man who traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Nairobi and died Oct 5. In Nigeria, the fourth African country to report a case, a Swiss woman—wife of a Swiss embassy partner in Abuja—tested positive; the couple had traveled to Uganda, not DRC. 44 close contacts identified; husband in isolation; patient hospitalized in Abuja. The outbreak is attributed to the Bundibugyo strain; no approved vaccine or treatment. DRC records about 10,000 cases and 4,600 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラウイルスによる2人目の死者
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCから少なくとも4カ国（DRC、ケニア、ナイジェリア、関連してウガンダ渡航歴）へ国際的に拡大しており、死亡例・隔離例が多数発生。IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCを起点とする多国間アウトブレイクを報じているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。DRCは約10,000症例・4,600死亡と流行の中心地として主題に含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: 一名 65 岁肯尼亚女性成为该国第二例因埃博拉病毒去世的患者Australia ChinaTown News 中文华人新闻 - NEWS.CHINA.COM.AU 这里是生活在墨尔本咱自家人的地盘！把客场当主场，视异乡为故园。澳洲唐人街 - 中华澳网 China Town News澳洲唐人街;澳大利亚华人社区和主流新闻媒体
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 65-year-old Kenyan woman becomes the country's second person to die from Ebola virus disease.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Kenya confirms its second Ebola virus disease death: a 65-year-old woman, a direct relative of a male patient from Democratic Republic of the Congo, who died after isolation. Seven other Ebola patients are treated across two isolation facilities; all cases are in one cluster with no community transmission. Symptoms include vomiting and diarrhea. Since May, Ebola in the DRC has caused over 4,000 deaths, making this Africa’s second deadliest outbreak. The latest Kenyan victim developed symptoms on 13 October; the first death occurred 5 October after illness in DRC, followed by travel to Nairobi. Ongoing treatment includes three relatives of the first patient, three health workers. Kenya has tightened border screening for travelers from DRC and nine high-risk countries, with electronic forms, QR codes on arrival, and enhanced airline screening. Nigeria reports a linked case; investigations ongoing; both cases may have passed through Entebbe, Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 65歳のケニア人女性、同国で2人目のエボラ出血熱による死者に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続く大規模エボラ流行（4000人超の死者）がケニア・ナイジェリアへ越境拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大、渡航制限）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ（エンテベ経由）での症例・関連が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは流行源として記事の主題に直接関連するため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Announces Second Ebola Death, Cites No Community Spread
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a second Ebola death in a quarantined relative of a Kenyan man who died earlier this month; seven cases are receiving treatment in two isolation facilities, all within one cluster with no evidence of community spread. The latest patient is a 65-year-old woman who developed symptoms during quarantine. Kenya’s first case was a man who traveled from the DRC and died in Nairobi on Oct 5. Following contact tracing of 135 contacts, nine cases have been confirmed, including the two deaths. DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak, declared in May, has lately surpassed 9,000 cases and 4,600 deaths; the outbreak has spread to four countries in eastern, central and western Africa. Nigeria reported a related case; Uganda barred transit for travellers with DRC history, and has seen 20 infections and two deaths before being declared Ebola-free in August. No Kenyan community spread detected.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ出血熱による2人目の死亡を発表、市中感染はないと説明
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準を複数満たす重大感染症であり、DRC由来の大規模アウトブレイク（9000例超、4600人超死亡）が既に複数国に拡大し、ケニアでも二次感染死亡者が発生している。国際的関心・対応の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの感染拡大だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、アウトブレイクの起源であり9000例超・4600人超死亡という甚大な被害が報告されているDRCは対象国リストに含まれ、記事内で実質的に主題として扱われているため verified_locations に含めた。ナイジェリア・ウガンダも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo indleder vaccineforsøg midt i historisk ebolaudbrud
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo launches vaccine trials amid historic Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo has begun a vaccine trial to curb the Bundibugyo-ebola variant, the driver of the worst outbreak in the country’s history, with more than 4,600 deaths and about 9,700 infections since mid-May. There is currently no approved vaccine specific to Bundibugyo. The first participants were vaccinated today in a new trial vaccine named Tumaini, Swahili for hope, as announced by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. In the meantime, two Bundibugyo-targeted vaccines are in early clinical trials, while DR Congo plans to use Everbo, a vaccine approved for other Ebola variants, in the interim. WHO supports the DR Congo-led initiative and says the Everbo trial will yield useful data on whether vaccines developed specifically for Bundibugyo may work. A potential Bundibugyo vaccine is from Moderna, and another from researchers at the University of Oxford. Ebola symptoms include severe fever and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、歴史的なエボラ流行の最中にワクチン試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最悪規模のエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）流行であり、死者4,600人以上・感染者約9,700人と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、国際的な対応（WHO支援、ワクチン試験）も行われているためフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が自らワクチン試験開始を発表しており、国際的な関心・支援が高いことが示唆される。致死率や地理的拡大の詳細情報は記事中にないため不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Un essai de vaccin contre Ebola débute en République démocratique du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A vaccine trial against Ebola begins in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization announced the first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, launched on Friday amid the country’s ongoing Ebola outbreak. The effort comes as the DRC reports the death toll surpassing 4,600 from the disease. This outbreak marks the 17th Ebola outbreak to strike the country. The vaccine trial represents a pivotal step in the response, aiming to expand preventive options in a setting with active transmission. The development underscores the urgent public health need within the outbreak and the international commitment to testing and deploying vaccines as part of containment efforts. This development reflects ongoing international efforts to address Ebola in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチンの臨床試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行による死者数が4,600人を超えるという重大な公衆衛生影響があり、WHOがワクチン治験を開始するなど国際的対応が強化されているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: DRCにおける17回目のエボラ流行で、死者数4,600人超という非常に高い致死状況。WHOによるワクチン治験開始は国際的な封じ込め努力の一環であり、既存アウトブレイクの深刻化を示す重要な続報。

article.articleHeadline: نيجيريا تعلن رصد رابط جيني بين إصابة بفيروس إيبولا وحالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria announces detection of a genetic link between Ebola virus infection and a case.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports a single confirmed Ebola case with a genetic link to a Kenyan strain, marking the first genomic connection between outbreaks in Nigeria and Kenya. Nigeria says there is no evidence the Kenyan patient traveled to Nigeria or direct contact between patients; authorities are tracing contacts and quarantining them, with several contacts testing negative and others awaiting results. The Nigerian case involved a traveler who had visited Uganda, and Uganda remains Ebola-free but has tightened border controls and requires traveler-location forms for all arrivals, including a ban on entry for those who visited the Democratic Republic of Congo. Regional coordination among Nigeria, Kenya, and Uganda is emphasized, with laboratories ready to process samples and a commitment to transparent lab reporting. International health bodies monitor cross-border movement in East and West Africa as surveillance and containment efforts continue.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラウイルス感染症例とケニアの症例との間に遺伝的関連を検出したと発表
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリア・ケニア間でエボラウイルスの遺伝的関連が初めて確認され、ウガンダも国境管理を強化するなど、複数国にまたがる国際的拡大リスクが懸念されるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生国はナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダであり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは渡航制限の対象として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地としては確認できないため verified_locations には含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases decline in Doda as winter sets in
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Doda district shows a downward trend as winter begins. More than 200 dengue cases have been reported since June 2026, the highest in the district this year, with no new cases reported in recent days. Officials attribute the decline to cooler temperatures that curb mosquito breeding and transmission. CMO Dr Vinod Sharma urged continued prevention, highlighting the need to eliminate stagnant water around homes—breeding sites include water in pits, flower pots, coolers, discarded containers and old tyres. Residents should wear full-sleeved clothing and use repellents, especially at dawn and dusk. A special ICMR–NIV, Pune team visited Doda on Oct 14 to assess spread, review surveillance and strengthen control measures; discussions with the CMO and district teams occurred, and hospital/diagnostic facilities were inspected. Public awareness and cooperation remain essential to limit transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ドダ地区でのデング熱症例、冬の到来とともに減少
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の減少傾向を報じる内容で、地域の通常のデング対策活動の範囲内であり、国際的拡大や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱は例年発生するインドの風土病であり、本記事は症例の減少とICMR-NIVによる通常のサーベイランス強化活動を報じるもの。

article.articleHeadline: Xẹp phổi do di chứng lao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lung Collapse Due to Tuberculosis Sequelae.
article.articleSummary: In Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, 27-year-old Anh Thanh presented with cyanosis, cough, and shortness of breath. CT revealed severe airway disease with complete collapse of the right lung due to scarring and obstruction of the right main bronchus from sequelae of treated pulmonary tuberculosis three years earlier. TB-induced bronchial fibrosis can trap mucus and impair airflow. After multidisciplinary discussion, surgeons performed an end-to-side bronchial anastomosis rather than the standard end-to-end resection; they created an opening in the healthy bronchus to attach the obstructed segment, reestablishing ventilation and preserving lung tissue. The operation required meticulous dissection near major vessels and one-lung ventilation during anesthesia. Three days post-op, the patient was extubated; within a week his oxygenation normalized and symptoms resolved, and he was discharged. The team urged TB survivors to monitor respiratory symptoms after treatment and seek timely care if dyspnea, wheeze, or chest pain occur.

triage.headline_ja: 結核後遺症による肺虚脱
triage.triage_reason: これは個別患者の症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や集団感染、国際的拡大リスクを示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果展开首个针对伊波拉疫情的疫苗临床试验
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo launches the first vaccine clinical trial targeting the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) launches the first vaccine clinical trial aimed at the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak, centered in Bunia in the northeastern DRC. The country is amid its worst Ebola outbreak on record, with over 9,700 confirmed cases and more than 4,600 deaths. The trial tests Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) to determine if it can prevent Bundibugyo ebolavirus infection, though the vaccine is primarily used against Zaire ebolavirus. Researchers will prioritize close contacts at high risk and include pregnant women and children aged 12 and older; later, two additional Bundibugyo-targeted vaccine candidates are planned. First participants have already been vaccinated. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus calls the trial a crucial step in controlling the current outbreak and strengthening future outbreak responses.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで初めてのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクを標的としたワクチン臨床試験が開始

article.articleHeadline: WHO Urges Regional Ebola Response As Bundibugyo Virus Cases Reported In Three Countries | Naija247news
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyro Ebola virus disease has been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Kenya and Nigeria, prompting WHO to call for intensified regional surveillance and coordinated emergency measures. In the DRC, 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths were recorded as of Oct 20 across 66 health zones in eight provinces, with a crude case fatality ratio of 48.3% and 482 deaths since Oct 8 (307 in communities, 175 in treatment centres). Kenya reports nine cases, including one death, after confirming its first imported case on Oct 6; eight additional cases were identified among known contacts, with no evidence of wider community transmission as of Oct 20. Nigeria confirms an imported case on Oct 20 in Abuja, a traveler from Uganda currently in isolation; investigations continue to establish travel history and possible exposure sources. WHO urges cross-border surveillance, entry-point monitoring, and avoidance of travel restrictions to contain spread.

article.articleHeadline: CHDC Congo bắt đầu thử nghiệm vaccine Ebola chủng Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo begins testing Ebola vaccine against Bundibugyo strain.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo began the Tumaini Phase 2/3 trial on October 23 in Bunia, Ituri Province, to evaluate Ebola vaccines against the Bundibugyo strain amid the country’s largest recorded outbreak. Funded by CEPI, the adaptive platform study tests safety, immune response, and efficacy using a ring vaccination approach for contacts of confirmed cases. The first vaccine tested is Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine), licensed for Zaire ebolavirus but not proven for Bundibugyo. Two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are to join: one from Moderna and another developed by the University of Oxford with the Serum Institute of India. WHO officials call Tumaini a key step in identifying protective options and strengthening outbreak response. As of Oct 20, Congo reported 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths (CFR 48.3%), with the outbreak declared May 15 and PHEIC on May 17; Africa CDC noted a continental health emergency. This remains the largest Ebola outbreak in DRC and the second largest globally since 2014–2016.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ、エボラ出血熱ブンディブギョ株に対するワクチン試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴで記録史上最大規模のエボラ流行（確定9,704例、死亡4,687例、致死率48.3%）が継続中でPHEICが宣言されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWHO/Africa CDCの国際的対応が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRコンゴにおけるエボラ・ブンディブギョ株に対するワクチン臨床試験（Tumaini試験）の開始を報じている。インド（Serum Institute of India）や英国（オックスフォード大学）はワクチン開発関係者として言及されているのみで、発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。既に5月15日に流行宣言、5月17日にPHEICが宣言されている既知の大規模流行であり、継続的なフルリスク評価・モニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bé trai đồng nhiễm ba vi khuẩn, virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Boy co-infected with three bacteria and a virus.
article.articleSummary: In Hanoi, a 2-year-old boy, Sơn, presented with high fever, cough, tachypnea, and chest indrawing. Initial testing showed respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection with radiographic signs of bilateral bronchovascular thickening, diagnosed as RSV pneumonia and acute nasopharyngitis. Subsequent PCR revealed co-infection with Bordetella parapertussis, Haemophilus influenzae, and Streptococcus pneumoniae. The child developed fast breathing (56 breaths/min) and SpO2 92% on room air, required oxygen via face mask, and intensive respiratory monitoring; six days later he recovered from cough, no respiratory distress, and was discharged. The report notes rising pediatric respiratory illness in autumn at Tam Anh General Hospital Hanoi, with September counts of 792 respiratory cases and 362 hand‑foot‑mouth disease; early October estimates show about 25% more respiratory cases (~990) and 40% more hand‑foot‑mouth (~507) than September. Parents are advised to monitor breathing, fever, feeding, and alertness, seek care for red flags, and avoid self-prescribing antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: 男児が3種の細菌とウイルスに重複感染
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例report（単一小児の回復例）であり、季節性呼吸器疾患の増加傾向を示すのみで、国際的拡大や渡航制限等のリスクは見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola vaccine trial begins in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: First Ervebo shot administered in Bunia, Ituri, as the Tumaini trial—DRC-led—opens to test cross-protection against Bundibugyo Ebola. DR Congo’s worst outbreak has surpassed 9,700 cases and 4,600 deaths. The ring vaccination trial will assess safety, efficacy and immunogenicity of multiple vaccines, including two Bundibugyo-specific candidates: ChAdOx1 (University of Oxford) and Moderna’s mRNA shot, funded by CEPI, which are due to enter the trial shortly. In addition to Ervebo, the study will generate evidence for Bundibugyo protection and help prepare future responses; pregnant women and children aged 12+ are enrolled. WHO emergencies director and CEPI emphasize potential to transform outbreak response if efficacy against Bundibugyo is demonstrated. Ebola spreads via bodily fluids; DRC declared its 17th outbreak on May 15; WHO declared PHEIC two days later.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでエボラワクチン治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模のエボラ流行（9,700例超、死者4,600人超）が継続中でWHOがPHEICを宣言しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事自体はワクチン治験開始の報道だが、背景としてDRCの第17次エボラ流行がWHO PHEIC宣言下にあり、既存の重大な公衆衛生危機であることが確認される。PHEICに伴う渡航・貿易制限の有無は記事中に明記されていないため不明と評価。

article.articleHeadline: Κένυα: Δεύτερος νεκρός από τον ιό Έμπολα στο Ναϊρόμπι
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya: Second person to die from the Ebola virus in Nairobi.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a second Ebola death in Nairobi, a 65-year-old woman who developed symptoms while in quarantine. She was a close contact and relative of first Kenyan fatality on 5 October after returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo. Kenya has isolated 135 contacts of the index case, with nine confirmed infections to date; seven survivors remain in isolation wards. The outbreak now spans four African countries, the widest spread for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The U.S. State Department issued a travel advisory for Kenya. In the DRC, authorities report about 10,000 cases and 4,600 deaths. Nigeria joined as the fourth country with infections: a Swiss woman, wife of a Swiss embassy colleague in Abuja, tested positive after travel to Uganda; the couple had not visited DRC. 44 close contacts, including her husband, were traced; he remains in isolation. Patient is being treated at a clinic in Abuja, confirmed by Swiss authorities.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア：ナイロビでエボラウイルスによる2人目の死者
triage.triage_reason: DRCを起源とするエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクがケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへ拡大し、IHR4基準すべてに該当する重大な国際的公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生国はケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ（いずれも対象国リスト外）だが、アウトブレイクの起源かつ最大規模の被害（約1万症例・4600人死亡）を報告しているDRCを対象国として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: 借鏡美印防疫經驗：麻州籲接種 喀拉拉邦推日曆抗季節病毒 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drawing on U.S.–India pandemic prevention experiences: Massachusetts urges vaccination; Kerala promotes a calendar-based approach to counter seasonal viruses
article.articleSummary: Autumn–winter seasonal viruses prompt actions in Massachusetts and Kerala. Massachusetts Public Health Department urges vaccination against influenza and COVID-19 for most residents; influenza vaccine for all six months+, RSV vaccine recommended for adults 75+ and pregnant individuals; adults 50–74 with high-risk factors should discuss RSV vaccination with a clinician. Infectious disease physician Adam Weston states vaccines are the most effective preventive measure; immunity lasts about six to twelve months, with annual updates to match circulating strains. Beyond vaccination, hand hygiene, masking when ill, and staying home when sick are advised. In Kerala, the Keralam Health Department released an Infectious Disease Prevention Calendar on Oct 23 to outline seasonal disease trends, symptoms, transmission, and prevention, highlighting rabies, Nipah virus, Japanese encephalitis, and West Nile fever. The calendar will be on the department website; chair S.S. Lal says it aims to raise awareness and encourage timely medical care.

triage.headline_ja: 米印の防疫経験を参考に：マサチューセッツ州がワクチン接種を呼びかけ、ケララ州は季節性ウイルス対策カレンダーを発表
