article.articleHeadline: Lab study finds extremely low salivary transmission of Oropouche virus in
article.articleSummary: Oropouche virus, the cause of Oropouche fever across Latin America and the Caribbean, is transmitted mainly by the biting midge Culicoides paraensis, with occasional evidence for mosquitoes. A 2024 surge in cases spread beyond the Amazon Basin, linked to a reassortant strain, 240023. A laboratory vector-competence study tested Culex quinquefasciatus and Aedes albopictus for replication and transmission of BeAn 19991 and 240023. In Cx. quinquefasciatus, the outbreak strain replicated less efficiently at low doses, but overall vector competence was extremely low (0-1% shed infectious virus in saliva), arguing against sustained transmission. Aedes albopictus showed higher infection with 240023, but overall transmission remained limited (0-6.4% in legs or saliva). Differences by mosquito genotype: Salvador City vs Houston lines; infectious saliva detected only in Salvador line (up to 20%), never in Houston. Conclusion: the 2024 expansion is unlikely due to adaptation in these mosquitoes; other vectors or field dynamics may be involved.

triage.headline_ja: 実験室研究、オロプーシュウイルスのネッタイシマカおよびチカイエカにおける唾液伝播率が極めて低いことを発見
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は実験室でのベクター媒介性研究結果の報告であり、新規の流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は米国（ヒューストン、テキサス州）とエルサルバドルの蚊系統を用いた実験室研究であり、対象国リストに該当する国（ブラジル等）での実際の症例発生を報告するものではない。ブラジルは背景情報としてのみ言及されている可能性が高く、主題はラボ実験のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Woman, 65, becomes second patient to die of Ebola in Kenya - VANNY RADIO
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports the second Ebola death in the country: a 65-year-old woman. The US warns citizens against travel to Kenya as regional alerts rise in Uganda, Ethiopia, and Somalia. Ebola is caused by the Bundibugyo species, is rare, and can progress to vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure, and possible internal/external bleeding; transmission occurs via contact with infected bodily fluids. No approved vaccine or treatment exists, though trials are ongoing. With more than 9,500 cases in DR Congo, Kenya faces cross-border risk; the International Rescue Committee notes ongoing spillover and supports containment. Kenya has enhanced screening for travellers from DR Congo and nine high-risk countries (Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Burundi, Angola, Zambia, Ethiopia, South Sudan, Central African Republic), requiring a digital surveillance form and a QR code on arrival, plus heightened aircraft screening, public messaging, and hygiene measures to encourage early reporting and care.

triage.headline_ja: 65歳の女性、ケニアでエボラ出血熱による2人目の死亡者に
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでのエボラ死亡例発生に伴い、米国の渡航警告や近隣国（ウガンダ、エチオピア、ソマリア）での警戒レベル上昇など、国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクが明確に認められるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのエボラ死亡例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため直接の verified_locations には計上していない。DRCは9,500例超の既存流行の文脈で言及され、越境リスクの根源地として明示的に記述されているため含めた。ザンビア等はスクリーニング対象の高リスク国として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: OPS informó de incremento de casos de chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PAHO reported an increase in chikungunya cases.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya cases are rising in the Americas from late 2025 into 2026, with autochthonous transmission reappearing in countries and territories after years without viral circulation, according to the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO). From 2025 through 2026, intense transmission has been documented across all provinces of Cuba, the central-west and southeast regions of Brazil, the southern region of Bolivia, and a resurgence in the Guiana Shield and Central America. In the period from epidemiological week 1 (Jan 4–10) to week 38 (Sep 20–26), PAHO recorded 213,919 suspected chikungunya cases, 78,481 laboratory-confirmed cases, and 88 deaths. Although totals are lower than the same period in 2025, the approaching chikungunya season and El Niño–related climate changes may broaden transmission to new areas with Aedes aegypti, extend transmission duration, and yield more severe clinical forms. In El Salvador, 19 suspected cases were reported in week 41 (Oct 11–17). Symptoms include sudden high fever, severe joint pain, muscle pain, headache, fatigue, and rash.

triage.headline_ja: PAHO（汎米保健機構）がチクングニア熱症例の増加を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大の3基準に該当し、ブラジルを含む複数国で自然感染の再燃と重症例・死亡が報告されているため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はPAHO（汎米保健機構）による米州全体のチクングニア熱動向報告。ブラジル中西部・南東部で強い感染拡大が明記されているため対象国として含めた。キューバ、エルサルバドル、ボリビア、スペイン（カナリア諸島）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。El Niñoによる気候変動がAedes aegypti媒介地域の拡大・重症化リスクを高める可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Arranca ensaio clínico de vacina contra Ébola na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola vaccine clinical trial kicks off in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 24 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo launched a vaccine trial in Bunia, Ituri Province, to combat the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola amid an outbreak that has surpassed 9,700 cases and killed over 4,600. The Tumaini study uses Ervebo, a vaccine approved for the Zaire strain, to evaluate cross-protection against Bundibugyo and began vaccinating first participants in Bunia on Friday. The trial will later add two Bundibugyo-specific candidates: an Oxford University adenoviral vector vaccine and a Moderna mRNA vaccine, funded by the Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI). Kenya reports its second Ebola death with nine confirmed cases; Nigeria records its first Bundibugyo case; Uganda had already declared the end of its outbreak on Aug 26 with 20 cases and two deaths. Additional cases have been linked to the DRC outbreak in France and the Netherlands.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチンの臨床試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,700例超・死者4,600人超の大規模エボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が続き、ケニア・ナイジェリア・欧州にも症例が波及しており、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランス・オランダへの症例拡大が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: BJMC, Sassoon to use advanced sequencing to detect drug-resistant TB
article.articleSummary: Pune-based BJ Medical College (BJMC) and Sassoon General Hospital (SGH) will for the first time conduct targeted next-generation sequencing (tNGS) to identify drug-resistance mutations in tuberculosis (TB) patients. The initiative aims to improve diagnosis and enable doctors to tailor treatments for drug-resistant TB (DR-TB). tNGS sequences selected gene regions connected to resistance, delivering rapid, multi-gene mutation profiles and addressing limitations of phenotypic drug-susceptibility testing and narrower molecular tests. The study will start next month, with 48 samples isolated, including both drug-sensitive TB patients and DR-TB patients at SGH. WHO has recommended tNGS to detect drug resistance and guide clinical decisions. BJMC participates in the Indian Tuberculosis Genomic Surveillance (InTGS) Consortium. Findings will be shared with the governments of India and Maharashtra. tNGS can test multiple drugs in a single assay and may be more cost-effective for comprehensive DST, especially depending on drugs tested.

triage.headline_ja: BJMCとサッスーン病院、薬剤耐性結核検出に高度シーケンシング技術を導入
triage.triage_reason: 新しい診断技術導入に関する研究的取り組みの紹介であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の診断技術（tNGS）導入に関する医療機関の取り組みを報じたものであり、アウトブレイクや新規感染拡大の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Indoor mosquito breeding driving Pune's dengue surge
article.articleSummary: Indoor mosquito breeding is fueling Pune’s dengue surge, with Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) reporting 526 suspected dengue cases in October (38 confirmed) and 508 suspected (18 positive) in September. A nine-year-old girl from Lohegaon died with suspected dengue; authorities say indoor breeding sites may go undetected, raising concerns about routine outdoor surveillance. Breeding spots include flowerpot saucers, money plants, uncovered water-storage containers, terrace areas, elevator ducts, and parking lots, with water stored inside homes identified as the primary source and under-construction buildings also implicated. PMC has detected 2,664 breeding spots this year, issuing notices and penalties totaling ₹6.30 lakh. Health chief Nina Borade recommends releasing guppy fish into containers that cannot be emptied; free diagnostic facilities for dengue and malaria are available at civic health facilities. Officials urge eliminating stagnant water to curb dengue and the spread of chikungunya.

triage.headline_ja: 屋内での蚊の繁殖がプネーのデング熱急増を助長
triage.triage_reason: 国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクはないがIHR基準は満たさないものの、蚊媒介性疾患の継続的曝露・流行しやすさ（WPRO基準）に該当し、自治体（PMC）が積極的に対策・罰金措置を講じるなど行政的関心が高いためフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: プネー市（マハーラーシュトラ州）における季節性のデング熱・チクングニア熱の増加を報じるローカルニュース。1名の小児死亡例が報告されているが、全体として既知の媒介蚊由来疾患の例年的流行であり、国際的な拡大・渡航制限等のIHR基準には該当しない。自治体による繁殖源対策（通知・罰金、グッピー放流推奨等）が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Proef ebolavaccin van start in Congo, tweede dode gemeld in Kenia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola vaccine trial starts in Congo, second death reported in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: On 24 October 2026, Congo launches the Tumaini Ebola vaccine trial to address the Bundibugyo variant, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists. The study tests several candidate vaccines and includes Ervebo, approved for the Zaire (Zaïre) variant, to assess potential cross-protection against Bundibugyo. The Congo outbreak—the worst Ebola outbreak there—has surpassed 9,700 cases and over 4,600 deaths. In Kenya, the Ministry of Health reports a second Ebola death, bringing total Kenyan cases to nine with two fatalities. The Kenyan cases are linked to a relative of a patient who died in early October; that patient had lived in Congo and traveled via Uganda to Kenya. Uganda and Kenya share borders, with Uganda previously reporting a short-lived outbreak that was considered over.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラワクチン試験開始、ケニアで2人目の死者報告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴで過去最悪規模のエボラ流行（9700例超・死者4600人超）が続き、国境を越えてケニアへの感染拡大（死者2名含む9症例）が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境感染が報告されているが、両国は評価対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。主たる発生国であるコンゴ（DRC）のみを計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Phòng chống sốt xuất huyết: Đi từng ngõ, gõ từng nhà, rà từng vật dụng chứa nước
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever prevention: Going through every alley, knocking on every door, inspecting every water-holding container
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreaks in Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, persist despite vector-control efforts. Beginning Oct 1 in Cam Trung commune’s Vinh Loc village, the first dengue case was followed by 49 cases there by Oct 23, with 9 more reported on Oct 23 alone. Across Tan Duc and Van Mieu–Trung Thuong in Ky Hoa commune, two outbreaks have accumulated 123 cases and remain uncontrolled after more than two months. Overall, Ha Tinh Province has recorded 493 dengue cases in 2026, with 443 locally acquired and 50 imported; five outbreaks have been identified, two controlled and three ongoing. Health authorities urge aggressive environmental sanitation: identify and remove water-holding containers, eliminate larval habitats (lăng quăng, bọ gậy), and conduct house-to-house vector spraying. Despite chemical campaigns, persistent environmental gaps fuel transmission. Officials stress intensified community surveillance, prompt medical testing for fever, and avoidance of self-treatment.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱予防対策：路地ごとに、家ごとに、貯水容器を隈なく点検
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ハティン省における季節性・地域流行性のデング熱であり、媒介蚊対策という通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内で、国際的拡大や異常性を示す兆候はない。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで毎年流行する風土病であり、記事はハティン省の地方自治体による通常の媒介蚊対策活動を報じるもの。死亡例の報告はなく、地元行政が主体的に対応している。国際的な懸念や渡航制限の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: As malaria, dengue cases persist, doctors say only community-level interventions can help
article.articleSummary: Malaria and dengue persist in Mumbai, with Neelam Singh’s 19-year-old son diagnosed with malaria and a platelet count of 40,000, spending four days at Kokilaben Hospital before recovery. Across Criticare Asia Multispeciality Hospital chains in Mumbai, more than 20% of 550 beds are occupied by malaria and dengue patients. Doctors note dengue risk during the day from mosquitoes breeding in stagnant water and malaria risk at night, underscoring the need for community-level state action rather than individual measures. Construction sites have created stagnant puddles that fuel mosquitoes; BMC says fogging is ongoing and workers are being trained to identify breeding sites, though some residents fault hygiene and garbage in slums. Officials report a drop in vector-borne disease cases in the first half of October versus September. Separately, worsening air pollution (PM2.5/PM10) aggravates respiratory symptoms; wearing an N95 and limiting outdoor activity during peak smog is advised.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア・デング熱の発生が続く中、医師らはコミュニティレベルの対策だけが有効と指摘
triage.triage_reason: ムンバイでマラリア・デング熱の症例が継続しているが、これは毎年季節的に発生する既知の媒介性感染症であり、当局によれば10月前半には症例数が減少傾向にあるため、緊急のフルリスク評価を要する新規異常事象とは言えない。
triage.notes: 毎年繰り返されるムンバイの季節性マラリア・デング熱に関する地域報道。BMCが対策（防疫・訓練）を実施中であり、症例数は減少傾向。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'essai clinique du vaccin Tumaini contre Ebola démarre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Clinical Trial of the Tumaini Ebola Vaccine Begins.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola strain, first identified in Uganda, remains less common than Zaïre but raises concern in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where no vaccine is approved specifically for Bundibugyo. In the DRC, authorities bolster vigilance and pursue multiple vaccine candidates to broaden protection against Ebola variants. Tumaini is highlighted as a potential tool in the fight, reflecting a strategy to hedge against several Ebola strains rather than rely on a single product. Transmission occurs via contact with contaminated body fluids; early symptoms resemble a viral fever: fatigue, pain, vomiting, with elevated risk where healthcare access is limited. Tumaini is undergoing clinical trials to assess safety and efficacy, with steps including research, validation, regulatory review, and potential deployment if approved. Public health measures—case detection, isolation, contact tracing, and community outreach—remain essential in a context of insecurity and fragile infrastructure in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: Tumainiエボラワクチンの臨床試験開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）に対する新規ワクチン（Tumaini）の臨床試験開始を報じるものであり、新規アウトブレイクや症例急増の情報は含まれていない。コンゴ民主共和国における継続的なエボラ警戒状況の文脈として留意すべきだが、現時点で緊急のシグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事は新規アウトブレイクではなくワクチン臨床試験開始のニュース。ウガンダは記事主題の発生国ではなくブンディブギョ株の初発見地として言及されているのみのためverified_locationsから除外。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ警戒継続状況として経過観察を推奨。

locations.name: Independent State of Papua New Guinea

article.articleHeadline: Sungai Tercemar Aktivitas Tambang, Kasus ISPA dan Malaria Melonjak di Distrik Towe Keerom
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: River polluted by mining activities, acute respiratory infections (ARI) and malaria cases surge in Towe District, Keerom
article.articleSummary: Keerom Regency, Papua, Indonesia: As of 24 October 2026, Acute Respiratory Infections (ARIs) and malaria are high in Towe District. River water pollution from gold mining/tailing activities is cited as a key infection source, with communities relying on contaminated sources. The Towe Hitam Community Health Center conducts monthly Mobile Clinic (Puskesmas Keliling) reaching Kampung Towe Atas, Jember, Towe Hitam, Bias, Tefalma 2, and Kampung Neliti, staffed by 23 health workers. Kampung Jember and Kampung Neliti are especially hard to reach; nurses sometimes traverse roads when passable or travel by foot and motorized river boats (motor jonson) for up to a full day. No specific case or death counts are provided. Ongoing ARIs and malaria burdens are attributed to climate change and limited access to clean water; the pollution underscores urgent public health and water-supply challenges in the border region.

triage.headline_ja: 鉱山活動で川が汚染、ケロム県トウェ郡でARI（急性呼吸器感染症）とマラリア症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・パプア州の一地域における地方風土病的なマラリア・ARI増加の報告で、具体的な症例数・死亡数は不明。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、環境汚染と医療アクセスの課題により継続的な観察が必要。
triage.notes: パプアニューギニアは発生地域に含まれているが、記事本文はインドネシア・パプア州ケロム県の事例のみを扱っているため除外した。具体的な症例数・死亡者数のデータが欠如しており、続報の確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Abuja: The facts, emerging controversies and public health implications
article.articleSummary: Imported Ebola virus disease case confirmed in Abuja, Nigeria on 20 October 2026, the first since the 2014 outbreak. The patient is a woman who arrived in Abuja on 3 October, developed symptoms around 7 October, and presented at a private facility on 11 October; laboratory confirmation followed on 20 October. The causative agent is Bundibugyo ebolavirus. At least 44 contacts have been identified for investigation and 21‑day monitoring, though this does not indicate transmission. The case has sparked controversy over the infection source: Ugandan officials say she traveled to eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo for business before passing through Uganda, while Africa CDC descriptions cite her as the wife of a Nigerian diplomat who spent about two and a half weeks in Kampala. Reconstructing travel and exposure history is crucial given Ebola’s 2–21 day incubation. Any symptomatic contacts must be isolated and tested; one imported case does not imply sustained community transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アブジャでのエボラ出血熱：判明している事実、浮上する論争、公衆衛生上の影響
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリア・アブジャで2014年以来初となる輸入エボラ症例が確認され、感染経路（DRC/ウガンダ経由）を巡る論争もあり、国際的な注目度と拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 確定症例はナイジェリア・アブジャで発生。DRCやウガンダは渡航歴・感染源を巡る論争の文脈でのみ言及されており、これらの国での確定症例発生は記事内で示されていないため対象国リストに該当する国として計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: New Ebola vaccine trial launched in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo launched the Tumaini Ebola vaccine trial targeting Bundibugyo virus among contacts of confirmed cases, with initial vaccinations in Bunia, Ituri province. WHO calls it a major step as Bundibugyo strains spread across borders. The study will evaluate candidate vaccines against Bundibugyo; no Bundibugyo-specific vaccine is currently approved. Coordinated by CEPI and supported by WHO, the Congolese Health Ministry, and partners, the trial emphasizes ethical principles, informed consent, transparency, and community engagement. Since the outbreak began, Congo has reported more than 9,700 confirmed cases and over 4,690 deaths across eight provinces: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, South-Ubangi, and North Ubangi. Kenya has nine confirmed cases (two deaths); Nigeria reported its first case imported from Congo. In August, Congo received 70,000 Ervebo vaccines from the global stockpile for outbreak use (Zaire Ebola virus).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で新たなエボラワクチン治験開始
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行が既にケニア・ナイジェリアへ越境拡大しており、感染者9,700人超・死者4,690人超という大規模アウトブレイクであるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（8州にわたる大規模流行）でのワクチン治験開始を主題とする。ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大が言及されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya announces 2nd Ebola death, close relative of first patient
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a second Ebola death: a 65-year-old woman, close relative of the first patient, died Oct 23, 2026 after symptoms developed in Nairobi quarantine. She began showing symptoms 10 days earlier; seven patients remain in two facilities, with no new infections. Kenya’s first case was a Kenyan man who lived in Congo and traveled to Kenya via Uganda, arriving Oct 3 and testing positive Oct 5 at Nairobi Hospital, where he died. 135 contacts identified; 118 in quarantine, eight positives (four health workers, four relatives). Some contacts completing the 21-day quarantine will be released Oct 24. Nigeria’s first patient, a Nigerian woman returning from Uganda to Abuja, is believed to have contracted the virus in Uganda. The U.S. enacted travel declarations for arrivals and blocks Congo-exposed travelers. Ebola spreads via bodily fluids and contaminated materials; Congo’s outbreak has caused at least 4,000 deaths since May.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラによる2人目の死亡、最初の患者の近親者
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がケニア・ナイジェリアで輸入症例から二次感染を引き起こし、医療従事者への感染や国際的な渡航制限（米国）も発生しており、IHR基準の複数に該当するため。
triage.notes: 主な発生国であるケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。コンゴ(DRC)は本流行の発生源として2026年5月以降4000人以上の死者を出しており、輸出症例の起点であるため対象国として記録。続報でDRC国内の最新状況確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Un essai de vaccin contre Ebola débute
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola vaccine trial begins.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the first human trial of an Ebola vaccine began amid the country’s 17th Ebola outbreak, with more than 9,700 cases and over 4,600 deaths. No vaccine or treatment is approved for the Bundibugyo strain responsible for this outbreak. The Ervebo vaccine, approved for the Zaïre strain, has begun a large-scale trial in DRC to test possible cross-protection against Bundibugyo. The Tumaini trial, conducted in Bunia, Ituri Province—the outbreak’s epicenter since mid-May—aims to assess safety and efficacy of multiple vaccines and will eventually include Bundibugyo-specific candidates. Early-stage vaccines include the Oxford University ChAdOx1 adenoviral-vector vaccine and Moderna’s mRNA vaccine, funded by Cepi, with integration into the trial planned soon. The study will enroll pregnant women and children aged 12 and older. Health authorities emphasize robust data to curb the outbreak and bolster future preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラワクチン治験がコンゴ民主共和国で開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で続く第17次エボラ流行（症例9,700件超、死者4,600人超）は公衆衛生上深刻であり、承認済みワクチンのないブンディブギョ株による異常な事態であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例は2026年5月中旬からイトゥリ州ブニアを震源地とする第17次エボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）であり、既存のエルベボワクチン（ザイール株用）の交差防御効果を検証する大規模治験が開始された。致死率の高さと承認薬剤不在という点で深刻度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Jaktim tingkatkan pencegahan DBD-TBC lewat lomba puskesmas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Jakarta City Government strengthens dengue fever and tuberculosis prevention through a community health center competition.
article.articleSummary: East Jakarta City Government intensifies dengue fever and tuberculosis prevention through a cross-sector community health center competition, featuring Kampung Bebas Jentik (KBJ) and Kampung Siaga Tuberkulosis (KST). Ten sub-district health centers from Jakarta Timur’s 10 districts participate with Jumantik cadres and RT/RW representatives. The two-day event runs KBJ on October 23 and KST on October 26, with the top three KBJ teams undergoing field verification to represent East Jakarta at the Jakarta Province level. Officials stress multi-sector community engagement beyond health services. Dengue fever cases rose January–March 2026, then declined April–May, and again decreased July–August 2026, with 48 cases in August 2026 and 11 dengue inpatient cases (Aug 20–26, 2026). Tuberculosis in East Jakarta from January–October 2026 totals 11,575 cases, with 8,992 patients already on treatment, highlighting ongoing TB control needs in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 東ジャカルタ市、保健所対抗コンテストを通じてデング熱・結核の予防を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の公衆衛生予防活動・啓発イベントに関する記事であり、異常な増加や新規アウトブレイクを示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: デング熱症例数は2026年を通して減少傾向、結核は通常の地域医療管理の範囲内であり、既存の予防プログラム・コンテストの紹介記事。

article.articleHeadline: Cúm A gia tăng, cảnh giác biến chứng nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A on the rise; be vigilant for serious complications.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is rising in Hanoi with serious complications risk, especially among the elderly, people with underlying conditions, and children. In Hanoi, 200–300 influenza cases are treated weekly. At the National Institute of Infectious and Tropical Diseases, 72-year-old H.X.T. with hypertension and prior stroke was admitted with fever, cough, escalating dyspnea, and respiratory failure; rapid testing confirmed Influenza A. Pneumonia and lung injury required oxygen therapy (40–50%) and intensive respiratory support, with impaired cough contributing to secretion retention. At Thanh Nhàn Hospital, two weeks saw a surge in influenza patients, averaging 20 inpatients daily, with 90% Influenza A and 10% Influenza B; many had diabetes, hypertension, heart failure, COPD, asthma, or dialysis-dependent kidney disease. Caution against self-medication with Tamiflu; treatment timing and dosing must be clinician-guided, especially with renal impairment. Dengue co-infection is possible; seek testing. Prevention focuses on vaccination, hand hygiene, ventilation, and medical evaluation for worsening symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAが増加、重篤な合併症に警戒
triage.triage_reason: ハノイで季節性インフルエンザAの症例増加と重症化事例が報告されているが、通常の季節性流行の範囲内とみられ、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは示唆されていない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAの流行で高齢者・基礎疾患患者における重症化事例が報告されているが、新型株や異常な変異の言及はなく、通常の季節性流行パターンとみられる。デング熱との同時感染リスクにも言及あり。

article.articleHeadline: 肯亞65歲婦染伊波拉慘死！　奈及利亞「感染源成謎」爆擴散隱憂
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya: 65-year-old woman dies after contracting Ebola! Nigeria: 'Source of infection remains a mystery' raises concerns about further spread.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second Ebola death, a 65-year-old woman related to the first fatality, a man who entered from DR Congo. Onset Oct 13; she died in isolation. Seven other confirmed cases remain in care; no community transmission yet. Kenya has intensified screening at ten high-risk countries, with pre-flight digital forms and on-arrival QR codes; US issued a travel advisory. Nigeria reports its first case in over a decade; the patient is the wife of a Swiss diplomat in Abuja, born in Uganda; infection source under investigation. Africa CDC says the virus is genetically related to the Kenyan strain; contact tracing is ongoing. Both patients reportedly visited Entebbe Airport on Oct 3. WHO and Marion Koopmans doubt airport exposure proves transmission. Bundibugyo Ebola; no vaccine or treatment yet. Since May, DR Congo’s outbreak has infected 9,500 with about half dead, making it the second-deadliest since 2014–2016.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで65歳女性がエボラ感染で死亡！ナイジェリアでは『感染源不明』で拡散の懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当し、複数国（ケニア、ナイジェリア、DRC）にまたがるエボラ出血熱の拡大事例で、渡航制限や国際的懸念も生じているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアとナイジェリアでのエボラ感染拡大だが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは感染源および同時進行中の大規模アウトブレイク（9,500人感染、致死率約50%）として言及されており対象国として含めた。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Orders Ebola Entry Checks Enforced After Security Concerns | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: Nigeria orders Ebola entry checks after security concerns; an Oct 22 circular directs agencies to screen travelers, collect health declarations, maintain surveillance, coordinate information-sharing, and report breached or attempted breaches, with no disclosed lapses or locations. Nigeria confirmed an Ebola case in the Federal Capital Territory on Oct 20, involving an individual who arrived on a flight from Uganda; symptoms began Oct 7, sought care Oct 11, and lab-confirmed infection with Bundibugyo virus on Oct 20; 44 contacts are being monitored while investigations review travel and exposure history. The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths as of Oct 20, with the outbreak declared May 15; authorities should maintain entry-point surveillance to prevent cross-border spread. Uganda's Health Ministry said on Oct 20 it would strengthen entry screening following Nigeria's case.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、治安上の懸念を受けエボラ出血熱の入国時検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当し、DRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（9,704症例・4,687死亡）に加えナイジェリアへの越境輸入例が確認されており、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限措置が明確なため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアとウガンダでの輸入症例・入国対策だが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは進行中のアウトブレイク本体として記載されており対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に計上した。

article.articleHeadline: 450 people in Gorakhpur receive anti-rabies shots after consuming charanamrit made from suspected rabid cow's milk; Hyderabad doctor explains whether rabies can spread through milk and when vaccination is necessary
article.articleSummary: About 450 people in Gorakhpur district, Uttar Pradesh, received anti-rabies vaccinations after consuming charanamrit prepared from milk of a cow that showed unusual behavior and died following a suspected stray-dog bite. Hyderabad-based physician Dr Sudhir Kumar said rabies transmission through milk has not been demonstrated in humans and that drinking milk or milk products alone does not typically require post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). Rabies is usually transmitted via animal saliva entering the body through bites, scratches, or contact with broken skin or mucous membranes; exposure to saliva calls for assessment and possible PEP. The Gorakhpur drive is precautionary and does not prove milk transmitted the virus, nor confirm that the cow was rabid. Heat can inactivate the virus, so properly boiled or pasteurized milk is safer than raw milk. If exposure is uncertain, consult a doctor and wash any affected area with soap and running water for 15 minutes.

triage.headline_ja: ゴーラクプルで狂犬病疑いの牛の乳から作られたチャラナムリットを摂取した450人が抗狂犬病ワクチンを接種、ハイデラバードの医師が乳を介した狂犬病感染の可能性とワクチン接種が必要な場合について解説
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病が疑われる牛の乳を介した感染という異例の状況で地域的な予防的ワクチン接種が実施されたが、感染の科学的根拠はなく、人への感染確定例もないため情報不足としてWATCH。
triage.notes: 乳を介した狂犬病感染は医学的に証明されておらず、本件は予防的措置であり確定症例ではない。続報で感染確定の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Bác sĩ chỉ ra 2 triệu chứng điển hình của não mô cầu, phụ huynh cần lưu ý
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two Typical Symptoms of Meningococcal Disease That Parents Should Be Aware Of
article.articleSummary: Five meningococcal disease cases among students in Ho Chi Minh City in the week of 14–20 October 2026, including one death. A Gia Dinh People’s Hospital physician warns the disease is highly lethal with rapid progression. The two most typical symptoms are sudden high fever and a widespread necrotizing purpuric rash; other features include severe headache, vomiting, and neck stiffness. Transmission is mainly via respiratory droplets from an infected person or asymptomatic carrier. Even non-fatal cases can result in lifelong sequelae such as brain injury, deafness, or limb loss. Parents should seek urgent care promptly rather than waiting for all classic symptoms or rash. Prevention centers on vaccination; experts advise that ACWY vaccination recipients should also receive MenB (and vice versa) to broaden protection, since vaccines cover different serogroups and are not interchangeable.

triage.headline_ja: 医師が指摘する髄膜炎菌感染症の典型的な2つの症状、保護者が注意すべきこと
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市の学生間で1週間に5例（死亡1例含む）のクラスターが発生しており、IHR基準の重大性・異常性の2項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 学生間での短期間クラスター発生かつ死亡例があり、致死率・後遺症リスクの高い疾患であるため注視が必要。今後の症例数推移や当局の対応状況の続報を確認すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Mystery over source of Ebola infection in Nigeria fuels concern about spread of virus - AOL
article.articleSummary: The current Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo virus, involves Nigeria’s first case in more than a decade, with infections expanding from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Uganda and Kenya before Nigeria. The Nigerian patient is the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat in Abuja; Swiss authorities say she did not travel to DR Congo and may have contracted Ebola while traveling with her husband in Uganda, though Uganda disputes this. WHO investigations continue to identify the likely source, including possible contact with a Kenyan Ebola patient after both travelers left Entebbe on Oct 3. Nigeria officials report the case contained and contact tracing ongoing. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved treatment or vaccine. Globally, more than 9,500 infections and nearly half deaths have occurred in this outbreak, the largest and deadliest in DR Congo’s history and second only to 2014–16.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでのエボラ感染源不明が、ウイルス拡大への懸念を高める
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生した過去最大級のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが複数国に拡大し、感染経路不明のまま国境を越えた感染が続いており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで発生したエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模アウトブレイクがウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへ拡大した事例。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCが発生源かつ最大の被害国として対象国リストに該当するため含めた。治療薬・ワクチン未承認の株であり、感染経路特定が困難な点も国際的懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: केन्या में इबोला संक्रमण के कारण दूसरी मौत | IBC24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second death due to Ebola infection in Kenya | IBC24
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola-related deaths reported in Kenya as of October 24, 2026. The index case was a 40-year-old Kenyan national living in Congo who arrived in Kenya via Uganda; infection was confirmed on October 5 and the patient died the same day in Nairobi. Kenya's health ministry later confirmed the first Ebola case in the country on October 6. The second death is a 65-year-old woman, a close relative of the index patient, who developed Ebola symptoms about 10 days earlier and died in isolation at Nairobi’s Infectious Diseases Treatment Unit on October 23. Seven other patients infected with Ebola remain hospitalized in two isolation centers; no new cases have been reported. Contact tracing identified about 135 contacts, with 118 isolated; eight contacts tested positive. The outbreak location is Nairobi, Kenya, linked to cross-border exposure from Congo, with ongoing monitoring and response.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ感染による2人目の死亡 | IBC24
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱によるケニアでの2例目の死亡が確認され、国境を越えた感染拡大（コンゴ→ウガンダ→ケニア）と濃厚接触者の陽性確認があり、国際的拡大リスクが高い重大事案である。
triage.notes: 指標症例はコンゴ（DRC）在住のケニア人でウガンダ経由でケニアに入国したとされるが、記事内でDRC国内での確定症例や現地発生の記述はなく、実際の発生・死亡例はいずれもケニア（対象国リスト外）で確認されている。そのためverified_locationsは空とした。ただしDRCからの越境感染リスクがあるため、今後DRC国内での症例確認がないか継続的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la propagation transfrontalière complique la riposte en Afrique malgré les progrès dans la recherche vaccinale (PAPIER GENERAL)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Cross-border Spread Complicates the Response in Africa Despite Advances in Vaccine Research (General Article).
article.articleSummary: Ebola cross-border spread in Africa intensifies with four countries affected. In the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), the outbreak totals 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths across eight of 26 provinces as of Oct 20. Kenya reports a second Ebola death among nine confirmed cases; a 65-year-old woman, quarantined after exposure to the initial patient who traveled from the DRC via Uganda, died in Nairobi. Eight secondary cases (four family members, four health workers) are in isolation; 135 contacts have been identified and quarantined; authorities report no evidence of community transmission beyond the household. Nigeria confirms its first case, a Abuja patient with Bundibugyo lineage, who arrived Oct 3 and tested positive Oct 20; genomic data show close similarity to Kenya’s index case, with a single mutation. Uganda tightens transit restrictions for travelers with recent RDC exposure and reintroduces traveler forms; a major vaccine trial was launched Friday in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ワクチン研究の進展にもかかわらず、国境を越えた拡大がアフリカの対応を複雑化（総合記事）
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,704例・4,687死亡の大規模流行が継続し、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへ越境拡大、医療従事者感染や渡航制限も発生しておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが流行の起点かつ主要被害国として記事の主題となっている。

article.articleHeadline: 筑牢食品安全防线 守护幼儿健康成长 -- -- 东溪街道中心幼儿园开展食物中毒应急演练活动_科教_永州站
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fortify the line of defense for food safety, safeguard children's healthy growth — Dongxi Street Central Kindergarten conducts a food poisoning emergency drill | Science & Education | Yongzhou Station
article.articleSummary: On Oct 22, Dongxi Street Central Kindergarten in Yongzhou conducted a food poisoning emergency drill to strengthen campus food safety responsibilities and response to suspected foodborne illness among preschoolers. In the simulated scenario, after breakfast, a child in Class Four developed nausea and severe vomiting, followed by several peers with abdominal pain and malaise. Teachers promptly comforted students, monitored symptoms, and reported to the school health officer, who documented cases and meal histories. The principal activated the emergency plan; administrators and kitchen staff traced ingredients, checked breakfast retained samples, procurement records, and processing logs to identify potential hazards. Environmental staff disinfected affected areas to prevent cross-contamination. A post-drill debrief refined processes, coordination, incident reporting, and food-traceability practices, with emphasis on ongoing education and routine safety measures to safeguard children’s health.

triage.headline_ja: 食品安全の防線を築き、幼児の健やかな成長を守る——東溪街道中心幼稚園が食中毒緊急対応訓練を実施
triage.triage_reason: これは実際の感染症・食中毒事例ではなく、幼稚園における食中毒対応の訓練（演習）に関する記事であり、実際の公衆衛生事象ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の疾病発生ではなく、幼稚園での食中毒対応訓練（シミュレーション演習）の報告である。実際の患者発生はない。

article.articleHeadline: Tập trung triển khai đồng bộ, quyết liệt, hiệu quả các giải pháp phòng, chống bệnh Dịch tả lợn Châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Focusing on the coordinated, decisive, and effective implementation of prevention and control measures against African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: ASF outbreaks are widespread in Vietnam, with 1,294 outbreaks in 3,541 villages across 31 provinces, causing 167,755 pigs to be culled. In Thanh Hóa Province, since the start of 2026, outbreaks affected 463 households across 162 hamlets in 26 communes, resulting in 8,585 culled pigs and 543,126 kg of total carcass weight. The province, home to about 1.3 million pigs, faces high risk of further spread due to rapid transmission, multiple transmission routes, and prevalent smallholder farming with weak biosafety. In response, Chairman of Thanh Hóa People’s Committee issued Directive 08/CĐ-UBND on 23 Oct 2026 to implement synchronized, decisive, and effective prevention and control, including vaccination as a key measure, rapid outbreak detection, and culling to curb spread. Emphasis is placed on information campaigns, farm biosecurity, and prohibiting disposal of dead animals in the environment. Commune authorities will oversee surveillance, support affected farmers, enforce safe restocking only at compliant farms, and tighten transport/slaughter/trade controls, especially at border areas; Month 2 cleaning/disinfection per plan 333/KH-UBND (3 Sep 2026).

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱の予防・防除対策を同期的・果断・効果的に集中実施
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでASF（アフリカ豚熱）が広範囲に発生し経済・畜産への影響は大きいが、ヒトへの健康影響はなく、IHR基準の核心（公衆衛生への深刻な影響）には該当しないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ASF（アフリカ豚熱）は人獣共通感染症ではなく、ヒトの健康に直接影響しないため公衆衛生上のIHR基準には該当しにくい。ただし大規模な畜産被害・貿易規制の可能性があり、農業・経済的観点からの監視継続が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Kecamatan Cengkareng Catat Kasus DBD Tertinggi di Jakarta Barat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cengkareng District records the highest dengue fever cases in West Jakarta.
article.articleSummary: Cengkareng District records the highest dengue fever (DBD) cases in West Jakarta, with 655 cases from January 1 to October 15, 2026. Kalideres follows with 400; Kebon Jeruk 191; Kembangan 129; Palmerah 128; Tambora 117; Grogol Petamburan 112; and Taman Sari 74. The West Jakarta Health Office says high numbers reflect population size and density. To curb spread, all puskesmas monitor cases and risk; vector-control includes Aedes aegypti larval checks and intensified health education. Epidemiological investigations accompany each reported case, while the 3M Plus program is reinforced. Cengkareng also deploys Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes, distributing containers with Wolbachia eggs or larvae in high-risk Kapuk. Cross-sector coordination and community involvement (Jumantik, PKK, RT/RW, Dasawisma) bolster efforts, with PSN cleanups to reduce breeding sites and standing water. Free health checks at RPTRAs support public awareness.

triage.headline_ja: 西ジャカルタでチェンカレン郡がデング熱症例数最多を記録
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はインドネシアで毎年発生する地域流行性疾患であり、既存の対策（ワクチン、Wolbachia蚊、PSN等）が実施されている定例的な公衆衛生報告であるため、国際的拡大や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱は同地域で季節的に発生する既知の風土病であり、既存の保健当局により通常の対策が講じられている。死亡者数や重症度に関する情報は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya reports second ebola death as outbreak raises regional concerns
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a second Ebola-related death: a 65-year-old Nairobi woman, a close relative of the first patient, died in quarantine after symptoms began about 10 days earlier. Seven other Ebola patients are treated at two isolation facilities; no new infections were reported. Kenya’s first case, a 40-year-old man who travelled from Congo via Uganda, tested positive on October 5 in Nairobi and died the same day. About 135 contacts were identified, with 118 in quarantine; eight later tested positive, including four healthcare workers and four relatives. Some contacts completing a 21-day quarantine will be released starting Saturday. Nigeria’s first Ebola patient, a woman who returned to Abuja from Uganda, has unclear infection origin; the Nigerian case is not linked to Congo per the FDFA, though Uganda travel is suspected. Africa CDC notes initial cases passed through Entebbe Airport on Oct 3. The US tightened screening for international travelers, requiring a Congo-exposure declaration within 21 days; those with Congo exposure may be barred from boarding. Congo has reported at least 4,000 Ebola deaths since May.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱による2人目の死亡者、アウトブレイクが地域的懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国発のエボラ出血熱がケニア・ナイジェリアへ国際的に拡大し、医療従事者感染や渡航制限措置（米国の入国審査強化）も発生しておりIHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: 記事の主な舞台はケニア・ナイジェリアだが、両国とも対象国リストに含まれない。感染源かつ4000人以上の死者を出している継続的流行地であるコンゴ民主共和国（対象国）のみverified_locationsに計上した。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）一关键性埃博拉疫苗临床试验启动接种
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A pivotal Ebola vaccine clinical trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo begins vaccination.
article.articleSummary: On Oct 23, 2026, the pivotal Ebola vaccine trial named 'Hope' began in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the first participant vaccinated. Led by the DRC's National Institute of Biomedical Research and the University of Antwerp, the trial will assess safety, immunogenicity, and efficacy of multiple candidate vaccines against Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV). The initial candidate is Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV), approved for Zaire ebolavirus, but its protection against BDBV is unproven. Two BDBV-specific vaccines funded by CEPI will soon enter clinical testing. The study targets high-risk groups, including close contacts of confirmed cases. DRC declared an Ebola outbreak in May caused by BDBV; as of Oct 20, 2026, the outbreak has 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths. No authorized vaccines or specific therapies exist for BDBV to date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で重要なエボラワクチン臨床試験の接種が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のBDBVエボラアウトブレイクが9,704例・死亡4,687例（致死率約48%）に達しており、既存ワクチンの効果も未確認という深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念があるため、フルリスク評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Vaccination vital for rabies in Bali
article.articleSummary: Rabies is endemic in Bali, Indonesia, highlighted by the June 2026 death of Ni Ketut Sari, 38, after a stray cat bite. She developed hydrophobia and fever; autopsy confirmed rabies. Bali authorities report about 30,000 suspected rabid-animal bites from January–May 2026 (roughly 207 per day) with five deaths, and last year about 66,000 bites capable of transmitting rabies. About 90% of bites come from dogs amid an estimated half-million to one million stray/free-roaming dogs on the island. The World Health Organization has declared Bali an endemic rabies zone, underscoring vaccination, including pre-exposure for travelers. In Western Australia, travelers can access rabies vaccination at clinics or some GP/pharmacies; costs per dose range 120-190 AUD, with two doses pre-travel, or full post-exposure regimens if not vaccinated. First exposure steps: wash wound 15 minutes, seek hospital; avoid contact with stray animals; consider Bali Animal Welfare Association and avoid Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary.

triage.headline_ja: バリ島における狂犬病、ワクチン接種が重要
triage.triage_reason: バリ島は既知の狂犬病流行地であり新規性は低いが、死亡例・多数の咬傷事例が継続しており、ヒト-ヒト感染ではないものの流行継続性と重症度の観点から注視が必要。社会的関心の高まりや新規支援要請は記事からは確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事は旅行者向けワクチン接種の注意喚起が主旨で、バリ島の狂犬病はWHOにより既にエンデミックと認定済み。新規アウトブレイクではなく既知の継続的リスクの報道。オーストラリア（西オーストラリア州）は渡航先情報として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Epidemie - Kenia meldet zweiten Todesfall
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak - Kenya reports second death
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports second Ebola death: An infected woman, a close family member of the first Ebola patient, died after being in quarantine since October 13. Kenya has confirmed nine Ebola infections to date. Nigeria announced its first Ebola case this week, while Uganda declared its outbreak over in August. The current Ebola outbreak was officially identified in mid-May in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where more than 9,000 cases have been reported and about 4,400 deaths. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals, with symptoms ranging from fever to internal bleeding and organ failure. This update is dated October 24, 2026 and was broadcast by Deutschlandfunk.

article.articleHeadline: Khẩn trương khoanh vùng, dập dịch sốt xuất huyết tại phường Hạc Thành
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urgently cordon off the area and contain the dengue fever outbreak in Hac Thanh Ward
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak in Dơi Cung 2 Street, Hạc Thành Ward, Thanh Hóa Province, Vietnam, with 4 cases reported between 19 September and 23 October. Authorities urgently cordon off the area, conduct vector surveillance, and deploy insecticide spraying within a 200-meter radius to contain the cluster and prevent spread. The Hạc Thành Center for Disease Control (CDC Thanh Hóa) and the Hạc Thành Health Center are investigating vector transmission, assessing risk, and coordinating control measures. Local health stations will perform daily health surveillance of households around the outbreak, provide treatment guidance, and report suspected cases promptly. The Ward People’s Committee has launched an environmental sanitation and larval source reduction campaign, mobilizing communities to remove standing water and breeding sites and to raise public awareness. Interventions will be evaluated to identify remaining high-risk areas and halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ハックタイン区でのデング熱流行を緊急に封じ込め、終息させる
triage.triage_reason: 症例数4件の小規模なデング熱クラスターであり、ベトナムでは地域内風土病として通常の媒介蚊対策・環境衛生キャンペーンで対応されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られず、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: Poliomielite, quanti casi nel mondo e i progressi raggiunti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Poliomyelitis: How many cases worldwide and the progress achieved
article.articleSummary: Poliomyelitis remains not eradicated despite a >99% global decline since 1988, with wild poliovirus now confined to Afghanistan and Pakistan (type 1). Since the Global Polio Eradication Initiative, vaccination has prevented roughly 20 million paralyses; 3 billion children have been vaccinated over 30 years. Two wild serotypes have been eradicated (type 2 in 2015, type 3 in 2019). As of 21 October 2026, Afghanistan reported 42 wild poliovirus cases in 2026, up from 2025’s 21, while Pakistan had 6 cases by 5 October 2026. Vaccine-derived poliovirus outbreaks have emerged in Chad, DR Congo, Nigeria, South Sudan, and Togo, reflecting transmission in under-vaccinated areas. Poliovirus infection can cause paralysis; about 1 in 200 infections leads to irreversible paralysis, with 5–10% of paralysed cases dying from respiratory failure. No cure exists; vaccination remains essential, with strategies to reduce OPV doses in low-risk settings and ongoing immunization to prevent importations.

triage.headline_ja: ポリオ：世界の症例数と達成された進捗
triage.triage_reason: 世界ポリオデーに合わせた進捗報告記事であり、DRCでのワクチン由来ポリオウイルス流行への言及はあるが新規の具体的な症例数や急激な変化は示されておらず、既知の継続的な状況として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は世界ポリオデーに関する全体的な進捗報告であり、DRCは『ワクチン由来ポリオウイルス流行が発生している国』として言及されているが、具体的な症例数や新規情報は示されていない。他の言及国（パキスタン、スーダン、トーゴ、チャド、アフガニスタン、ナイジェリア）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 肯雅65岁妇染伊波拉身亡 尼日利亚"感染源成谜" - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenyan woman, 65, dies after contracting Ebola; Nigeria: 'source of infection a mystery' - International - Live International
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak expands across Africa: Kenya reports its second Ebola death, a 65-year-old woman, linked to the initial Congo (DRC) case; seven confirmed cases remain in isolation (the first patient’s three relatives, three healthcare workers, and a hospital cleaner) within a single household cluster with no community transmission yet. Kenya has boosted public health screening for flights from DRC and Uganda (ten high‑risk countries), requiring digital health forms and QR codes on entry. Nigeria records its first confirmed Ebola case in more than a decade—the wife of a Swiss diplomat stationed in Abuja, born in Uganda—whose infection source remains unclear; genome data suggest relation to the Kenyan strain, with contact tracing underway. Both Kenyan and Nigerian cases reportedly visited Entebbe International Airport on Oct 3. WHO and Dutch virologist Marion Koopmans doubt that mere airport co-location proves transmission. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus; no licensed vaccines or treatments exist. Since May, DRC’s outbreak has infected over 9,500 with nearly half fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで65歳女性がエボラで死亡、ナイジェリアでは『感染源不明』
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当する国際的なエボラ出血熱の拡大事例であり、DRCを起点に複数国へ感染が拡大し渡航制限措置も取られているため、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: WHO urges stronger regional response as death toll in DRC rises to 4687
article.articleSummary: EBOLA in DRC: WHO reports as of Oct 20, 2026: 9,704 confirmed Ebola cases caused by Bundibugyo virus, 4,687 deaths (CFR 48.3%) across 66 health zones in eight provinces. The Bundibugyo virus has spread to Kenya (9 cases, 1 death) and Nigeria (imported case in Abuja), with first imported case in Kenya on Oct 6 from a traveler from DRC via Uganda; eight related cases in Kenya; no evidence of wider community transmission as of Oct 20. In DRC transmission remains high; many community deaths point to challenges with early detection and access to care; 482 deaths since Oct 8; 307 in communities, 175 in treatment centers. Nigeria patient is under isolation; travel history under investigation; Kenya's cases are contacts of the initial case. WHO urges strengthened regional surveillance, cross-border coordination, monitoring points of entry, and preparedness; advises against travel/trade restrictions to avoid hindering response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：DRCでの死者数が4687人に増加、WHOが地域的な対応強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,704例・死者4,687人（致死率48.3%）の大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、既にケニア・ナイジェリアへ越境伝播しておりIHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア（Abuja）とケニアへの越境伝播が確認されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。主たる流行地はDRCであり、WHOは地域サーベイランス強化と越境調整を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola se extiende a Nigeria y deja casi 4.700 muertos en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads to Nigeria and leaves nearly 4,700 dead in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus Bundibugy o continues to spread beyond the Democratic Republic of the Congo, now affecting eight provinces. As of Oct 20, 2026, the DRC reports 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths, with Nord-Ubangi bordering the Central African Republic. Nigeria confirms its first Bundibugyo infection: a woman who traveled from Uganda; symptoms began Oct 7, diagnosis confirmed Oct 20; 44 contacts under monitoring; genomic sequencing planned to assess relation to Congo’s strain. The international picture includes France, Uganda, and Kenya reporting cases; Kenya records nine cases and one death (ECDC, Oct 22). Response is hampered by violence and displacement, delaying case finding and isolation; about 60% of deaths occur outside health facilities. There is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo; Ervebo targets Zaire, and cross-protection is unproven. EU risk remains very low; surveillance continues.

article.articleHeadline: Toiraena calls for action on medicines, TB and rising HIV cases
article.articleSummary: On 24 Oct 2026, Solomon Islands' Health Minister Morris Toiraena urged action on access to medicines, tuberculosis targets, and rising HIV at the WHO Regional Committee for the Western Pacific RC77 in Manila. He endorsed the RC78 agenda as aligned with national health priorities and Pacific challenges, noting Solomon Islands as a Small Island Developing State with a dispersed population and a need for reliable access to essential health products. He called for faster progress on regional TB targets, and highlighted rising HIV cases and the burden of diabetes and other non-communicable diseases across the Pacific. Emphasized equitable HIV prevention, testing, treatment and care, and the value of reliable health data for policy-making. Supported climate-resilient health systems and health security amid increasing climate-related health risks. Solomon Islands welcomes continued country-focused refinement of RC78 and ongoing WHO partnership to strengthen health systems.

article.articleHeadline: Uganda remains Ebola-free as Health ministry probes Nigerian traveller infected with virus
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Uganda reports no active internal Ebola outbreak and remains Ebola-free. An imported Bundibugyo Virus Disease case is under investigation after a female traveller tested positive in Nigeria, with the infection linked to travel from Uganda. Initial findings indicate she did not show symptoms at departure from Uganda; timing of symptom onset and exposure remain under review. Uganda and Nigeria are tracing the traveller's travel history and exposure routes, with genomic sequencing requested where available. International partners (Africa CDC, US CDC, WHO) are providing technical support. To strengthen health security, Uganda reinstated traveller locator forms for all arrivals, tightened border screening, and restricted transit for travellers with recent DR Congo travel. Public health authorities urge vigilance; no domestic cases are confirmed. Contact details for alerts provided by the Ministry of Health.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダはエボラ発生なしを維持、ナイジェリアで感染確認されたナイジェリア人渡航者についてウガンダ保健省が調査

article.articleHeadline: Kenya bevestigt tweede eboladode in groeiend cluster gelinkt aan Congo-uitbraak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya confirms second Ebola death in a growing cluster linked to Congo outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Kenya has confirmed its second Ebola death in a growing cluster linked to the Congo outbreak. A 65-year-old woman, a close relative of the initial Kenyan patient, died in quarantine. She was the third confirmed case in Kenya and developed symptoms on 13 October while isolated. The first Kenyan case traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo, passing through Uganda, then flew from Entebbe to Nairobi in early October. All infections in Kenya belong to a single cluster connected to that patient, with authorities now tracing and quarantining all contacts. The Bundibugyo strain circulating in Congo has reached Nigeria, its first case there in ten years. Congo’s outbreak has over 9,700 confirmed infections and 4,700 deaths, making it the second-largest on record; seven remaining patients in Kenya are receiving care in isolation facilities.

article.articleHeadline: கோவை: 4 வயது சிறுவன் டெங்கு காய்ச்சலால் உயிரிழப்பு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Coimbatore: 4-year-old boy dies of dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever caused the death of a 4-year-old boy in Tamil Nadu. The child from Palladam near Kungumampalayam in Tiruppur district had been suffering from fever for several days and was taken to a private hospital in Palladam, where dengue was confirmed. He was subsequently shifted to Coimbatore Government Medical College Hospital and admitted to the intensive care unit, but died late Friday night despite aggressive treatment. The loss has sent shock waves through the Palladam and Kungumampalayam area, with residents urging health authorities to bolster mosquito control and sanitation measures. The report notes a lab-confirmed dengue infection and the ongoing risk of dengue in the region, reflecting the public health imperative to curb vector breeding and protect vulnerable children. No details on vaccination or travel-related cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: コインバトール:4歳の少年がデング熱で死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドのタミル・ナードゥ州における単発のデング熱死亡例であり、デングは同地域で季節性・地域流行性の既知疾患であるため、国際的拡大や異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Испытания вакцины против одного из штаммов вируса Эбола начались в Демократической Республике Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trials of a vaccine against one of the Ebola virus strains have begun in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Clinical trials of a vaccine against the Ebola virus Bundibugyo strain have begun in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Bloomberg reported on 24 October 2026 that the DRC launched the first human testing of this vaccine candidate. The article provides no details on trial phase, participant numbers, sponsor, safety data, sites, or timelines, and no Ebola case counts or deaths are cited. The report emphasizes ongoing vaccine development against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola as part of broader efforts to address future outbreaks. The published piece is dated 24 October 2026. London-based Interfax reporting is cited. No additional context or sources are provided.

triage.triage_reason: 記事はエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）ワクチンの臨床試験開始を報じる内容であり、実際の感染拡大や症例報告ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事はワクチン開発・臨床試験に関する報道であり、実際のエボラ症例や発生状況についての情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Uji Coba Vaksin Ebola Dimulai, WHO Dukung Upaya RD Kongo Selamatkan Nyawa Rakyatnya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Vaccine Trial Begins, WHO Supports the DRC's Efforts to Save Its People.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola vaccine trial targeting Bundibugyo Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo began Oct 23, 2026, in Bunia, Ituri Province. The DRC’s outbreak is the worst on record for the country, exceeding 9,700 cases and more than 4,600 deaths. Because existing vaccines (Ervebo) target Ebola Zaire, Ervebo will be tested for potential cross-protection against Bundibugyo, while a new vaccine candidate, Tumaini (Swahili for “hope”), launches a ring vaccination trial to assess safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity. The study vaccinates contacts at high risk. Two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines at early-phase trials are also planned: an Oxford University adenovirus vector ChAdOx1 candidate and an Moderna-based mRNA vaccine. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus underscored global support to answer key questions and save lives.

triage.headline_ja: エボラワクチン治験開始、WHOがコンゴ民主共和国の人命救済の取り組みを支援
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で同国史上最悪のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続中（9,700症例超、死者4,600人超）であり、深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性が認められるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・イトゥリ州ブニアでの新規ワクチン治験（Tumaini、ChAdOx1、mRNA候補、Ervebo交差防御試験）開始を報じており、発生地域はDRCのみ。国際的拡大・渡航貿易制限に関する直接的記載はないため不明と評価。

article.articleHeadline: Efter ebolautbrottet - vaccin testas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the Ebola outbreak - vaccine tested.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has begun the first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine in connection with the outbreak that has afflicted the country, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The trial tests a vaccine previously approved for use against a different Ebola variant to determine whether it can provide protection against the variant driving this outbreak in the DR Congo. The country has experienced the worst Ebola outbreak in its history, with more than 4,600 deaths reported. The study is being conducted in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in response to the outbreak, marking a key step in evaluating vaccine effectiveness. The report does not provide efficacy results.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行後 - ワクチン試験実施
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模（死者4,600人超）のエボラ流行が継続しており、新規ワクチン臨床試験開始という重大な公衆衛生上の動きがあるため、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Pune Dengue Cases: डेंग्यूने चिमुकलीच्या मृत्यूनंतर महापालिकेला जाग! आठ मृत्यूंबाबत तपासणी सुरू
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pune Dengue Cases: Dengue puts the municipal corporation on alert after the death of a toddler girl! Investigation into eight deaths underway.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 Oct 2026, Pune reports eight suspected dengue deaths since January, with final laboratory conclusions pending; an eight-year-old girl from Lohgaon died, and Ruby Hall Hospital confirmed dengue after several days of fever and abdominal pain before deterioration and death. Two dengue deaths were reported in recent days, signaling ongoing transmission and governance gaps. Pune Municipal Corporation’s health department convened an urgent meeting and ordered intensified anti-dengue measures across malaria, encroachment, construction, and education departments, with strict action if implementation falters. Preventive actions include insecticide spraying, fogging, covering water storage tanks, and cleaning container interiors, with prompt reporting of larvae. In the Khadakwasla-Sinhgad Road area (Nanded, Kirkatwadi), 112 dengue cases have been recorded across four wards; authorities have initiated large-scale cleanups and vector-control drives, with local officials urging a dedicated war room for rapid response.

triage.headline_ja: プネーのデング熱症例：幼女の死亡を受け市当局が警戒！8件の死亡例について調査開始
triage.triage_reason: プネー市内でのデング熱による複数死亡と112症例が報告され自治体が対策強化を行っているが、季節性の局地的流行であり国際的拡大・渡航貿易制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: プネー市内（Khadakwasla-Sinhgad Road地域）での局地的なデング熱流行。インドでは季節性のデング熱が例年発生しており、現時点では自治体レベルでの対応にとどまっている。死亡例増加や症例数の推移を継続観察する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Rotarians, NMIMR deepen collaboration to enhance polio surveillance
article.articleSummary: Polio surveillance in Ghana is being strengthened through a hands-on Rotary-Ghana partnership with NMIMR's National Polio Reference Laboratory at Legon, Accra, ahead of World Polio Day on 24 October 2026. Rotarians from the Ghana National PolioPlus Committee and Rotaractors visited NMIMR labs to understand polio monitoring and evaluation, reinforcing collaboration with Rotary International, GPEI, WHO, UNICEF, and the Ghana Health Service. NMIMR Director Prof. Dorothy Kyerewah Yeboah-Manu highlighted 48 years of polio work and called for improved wastewater treatment, noting wastewater surveillance as an early warning system for poliovirus, including shedding in stool by infected or OPV recipients. The Global Polio Eradication Initiative stressed continued surveillance for emerging strains. Ghana remains wild poliovirus-free since 2015 but has faced cVDPV2 outbreaks in 2019, 2022, and late 2024, with nationwide nOPV2 campaigns and routine immunizations to protect under-fives.

triage.headline_ja: ロータリアンとNMIMR、ポリオサーベイランス強化のため協力を深化
triage.triage_reason: 新規症例や発生の報告ではなく、世界ポリオデーに合わせたサーベイランス体制強化・啓発に関する活動報告であり、現時点で緊急性のある公衆衛生上の脅威は示されていない。
triage.notes: ガーナは2015年以降野生株ポリオフリーだが、2019年・2022年・2024年後半にcVDPV2の発生歴あり。本記事は新規アウトブレイクではなく監視体制強化の取り組みを報じるもの。

article.articleHeadline: وزير الصحة النيجيري: حالة الإصابة بإيبولا في نيجيريا مرتبطة بأول إصابة بالفيروس في كينيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigerian health minister: An Ebola case in Nigeria linked to the first Ebola virus case in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Nigeria reports a single confirmed Ebola virus disease case in a traveler who had visited Uganda. Genetic analysis shows the Nigerian case is closely related to the strain identified in the first Ebola case in Kenya, marking the first genetic link between the Kenyan and Nigerian outbreaks. Authorities say there is no evidence the Kenya patient traveled to Nigeria or had a direct link to the Nigerian case. Contact tracing is underway; exposed individuals are being quarantined and tested, with some results negative and others pending. Uganda, which borders the Democratic Republic of the Congo and has previously faced Ebola, says it remains Ebola-free but is tightening preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア保健相:ナイジェリアのエボラ感染例はケニアの最初のエボラ感染例と関連
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病がウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア間で遺伝的に関連した形で複数国に拡大しており、IHR基準の複数項目（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダでのエボラ発生であり、DRCは『ウガンダがDRCと国境を接する』という文脈でのみ言及され、実際の発生国ではないため対象国リストに該当するverified_locationsはなし。対象国リスト外の複数国にまたがる重大なエボラアウトブレイクであり、国際的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Uganda Blocks DRC Transit Travellers, Tightens Border Controls After Nigeria Case
article.articleSummary: Uganda tightened Ebola controls after an imported case in Nigeria and a Bundibugyo outbreak in the DRC. The Ministry of Health barred travellers with a history of travel to the DRC from transiting through Uganda, and reinstated traveller locator forms for all passengers to aid contact tracing. Border, airport and health facility infection-prevention measures were strengthened, and nationwide surveillance intensified. Nigeria confirmed an imported Bundibugyo Ebola case on October 20; sequencing shows it is highly similar to Kenya’s first imported case, differing by only one mutation, prompting questions about common exposure during regional travel. The Nigerian case’s traveller reportedly showed no symptoms when leaving Uganda; investigations are ongoing to establish timing of symptom onset and exposure, with Uganda requesting detailed travel records and sequencing results from Nigeria. Uganda says no Ebola cases have been confirmed in country and urges compliance with screening and reporting unauthorised crossings.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ウガンダ、ナイジェリアでの症例確認後にDRC発のトランジット旅行者を禁止し国境管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRC（ブンディブギョ型）由来のエボラがナイジェリア・ケニアへ国境を越えて輸出されており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限）を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため、感染拡大の文脈としては重要だがverified_locationsには含めていない。DRCのブンディブギョ型アウトブレイクが発生源であるためDRCのみ列挙。

article.articleHeadline: Przełomowy moment. Ruszyły testy szczepionki na straszny wirus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A breakthrough moment. Ebola vaccine trials have begun.
article.articleSummary: 9,700 Ebola cases and over 4,600 deaths have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the worst Ebola epidemic in its history is centered in Bunia, Ituri Province. With no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, researchers have begun human trials of Ervebo, licensed for the Zaire ebolavirus, to test any cross-protection against Bundibugyo. A new trial vaccine, Tumaini (Swahili for 'hope'), has been introduced in Bunia, with the first doses given as part of a ring-vaccination approach targeting high-risk contacts. Two Bundibugyo vaccine candidates are entering early-stage trials: ChAdOx1, an adenoviral-vector vaccine from Oxford University, and an mRNA vaccine developed by Moderna; both are CEPI-funded and anticipated to start soon. The Tumaini study will include pregnant women and children aged 12 and older to assemble evidence across populations often excluded from trials.

triage.headline_ja: 画期的な瞬間。恐ろしいエボラウイルスのワクチン治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最悪規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続中であり、9700症例・4600人超の死亡という深刻な公衆衛生インパクトと異常性が確認されるため、IHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスに対する複数のワクチン候補（Ervebo, Tumaini, ChAdOx1, mRNAワクチン）の治験開始を報じており、DRC・イトゥリ州ブニアが震源地とされる、史上最悪規模の流行継続中である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Keňa oznámila druhé úmrtie na ebolu; ide o blízkeho príbuzného prvého pacienta - Svet SME
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya announced the second Ebola death; a close relative of the first patient - World SME
article.articleSummary: Kenya has reported a second Ebola death, a 65-year-old woman who was a close relative of the first patient; symptoms appeared during quarantine and she died Friday in Nairobi. Seven other Ebola patients remain in care in two isolation facilities; no new cases have been recorded in Kenya. The first case, a 40-year-old Kenyan who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo and travelled to Kenya via Uganda on Oct 3, died in Nairobi on Oct 5. Authorities identified about 135 contacts, with 118 quarantined; eight infections were confirmed during quarantine, including four health workers and four relatives. Starting Saturday, some asymptomatic contacts who completed a 21-day quarantine will be released. Vaccine trials began in DRC, testing Ervebo against the Bundibugyo strain; ring vaccination will be used, with Oxford and Moderna candidates; CEPI funding. Ebola spreads through bodily fluids; DRC’s outbreak prompted a WHO PHEIC.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアがエボラによる2人目の死亡を発表、最初の患者の近親者；DRCではワクチン治験開始
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ感染がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境し死亡例・複数感染者が発生しており、IHR基準の大半に該当し国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの二次感染死亡例だが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リスト対象外。DRCは発生源国かつワクチン治験実施国として言及されているため含めた。WHO PHEICが既に宣言されているDRCのエボラ流行に関連する国際拡大事例。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola gagne le Nigeria et le Kenya alors que l'épidémie s'étend au-delà de la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola hits Nigeria and Kenya as the outbreak spreads beyond DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first Ebola virus disease case caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in Abuja, confirmed Oct 20. The patient arrived from Uganda after illness onset on Oct 7 and was hospitalised Oct 11; 44 contacts identified and the NCDC activated its incident-management system; laboratory confirmation occurred nine days after admission. Kenya confirms its first imported case on Oct 6 and now records nine cases linked to a single household: the index patient traveled from Beni, Congo, via Kampala to Nairobi, where he died on Oct 5; at least three health workers infected, with 134 of 135 contacts in quarantine. In DR Congo, by Oct 18 (156th day), 9,552 confirmed cases and 4,602 deaths; 66 health zones across eight provinces affected, Nord-Ubangi latest; 97 new cases that day signal rising transmission. MSF warns against complacency, noting ongoing transmission and high frontline infections (~269), limited vaccination (e.g., only 322 of 7,105 frontline workers in Beni received Ervebo), and border restrictions around Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がナイジェリアとケニアに拡大、コンゴ民主共和国を超えて流行が広がる
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当する重大な国際的エボラ流行で、DRCから複数国への越境拡大が確認されており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア（アブジャ）とケニア（ナイロビ）でも症例確認されているが、両国は本トリアージ対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。DRCでは9,552例・4,602死亡、66保健地区に拡大中で、MSFがワクチン接種不足と感染継続への懸念を表明している。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: WHO begins Ebola vaccine trial in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: WHO began a first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Bunia, Ituri province, after vaccination of participants, amid Bundibugyo-strain outbreak. The Tumaini trial will assess whether vaccine candidates can protect against Bundibugyo and will also test the Everbo vaccine licensed for other Ebola disease. The first vaccine to enter the trial is Ervebo (licensed for Zaire strain); researchers will evaluate safety, immune response and effectiveness, using a ring vaccination approach targeting contacts of confirmed cases and other high-risk individuals. Two additional candidates—one from Moderna and one from the University of Oxford in collaboration with the Serum Institute of India—are expected to join. The trial is led by Congolese authorities with WHO support. As of Oct 21, DR Congo reported 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026; WHO declared PHEIC. Commencement does not prove vaccine effectiveness.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチンの臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ株によるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続中でPHEICが宣言されており、症例数・死亡者数ともに甚大であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: インドおよび英国は、ワクチン開発（Serum Institute of India、Oxford大学）に関連して記載されているのみで、実際のアウトブレイク発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。すでにWHOによりPHEICが宣言されている既知の大規模アウトブレイクであり、本記事はワクチン治験開始に関する続報。

article.articleHeadline: Cebu City clarifies ASF outbreak in Sapangdaku, sets up checkpoints
article.articleSummary: No confirmed ASF cases in Barangay Sapangdaku, Cebu City, as of Oct 24, 2026. The Cebu City DVMF clarified that the checkpoint and intensified surveillance are preventive; earlier reports claimed 10 hogs tested positive and died, but confirmation from a second batch is pending. To prevent spread, checkpoints regulate movement of live hogs, pork, and by-products without veterinary clearance or permits, intercepting consignments; negative results trigger a white slip. The measures aim to protect other hog-raising communities including Cambinocot, Lusaran, and Guadalupe. DVMF geotags sites and checks hog owners within 500 meters of reported cases, in coordination with barangay officials, PNP, and City Agriculture Office. Biosecurity advisories urge avoiding swill, disinfecting pens and vehicles, disposing of dead hogs, restricting traders/visitors, and reporting sick/dead hogs; fiesta-goers should bathe and change clothes before returning to pigpens.

triage.headline_ja: セブ市、サパンダクのASF発生を説明し検問所を設置
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例なし（未確認）で、動物(豚)の家畜疾病であり人の公衆衛生への直接的影響は報告されていない。予防的措置の段階であり社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚熱(ASF)は家畜(豚)の疾病であり人への感染症ではない。記事時点で確定症例なし、地域限定の予防的検問措置。経過観察の必要性は低いが、豚肉産業への影響があれば再評価を要する。

article.articleHeadline: October 24 Daily Briefing: State Police, JPMorgan and Ebola
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine Tumaini trial launches in Bunia, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the first participant vaccinated on October 23. The Phase 2/3 study will assess safety, immune responses and protection against Bundibugyo virus; no efficacy results are yet available. CEPI announced the vaccination and the World Health Organization confirmed the trial’s launch and enrolment. No vaccine is currently approved against Bundibugyo; Ervebo is the first candidate evaluated, but its existing Ebola licence does not establish effectiveness against Bundibugyo. Preparations continue for additional candidates; no efficacy results or availability in Nigeria were announced. Case detection, care and contact tracing remain part of the outbreak response alongside the research. The briefing also covers Nigeria’s state police approval and JPMorgan’s initial Nigerian banking approval, illustrating ongoing governance and financial activity alongside health developments.

triage.headline_ja: 10月24日デイリーブリーフィング：州警察、JPモルガン、そしてエボラ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスに対するワクチン治験（Tumaini試験）が開始されたことが報じられており、現地では症例探知・接触者追跡を含むアウトブレイク対応が継続中であることが示されている。重篤な疾患であり、国際機関（WHO、CEPI）が関与していることから、フルリスク評価の対象として妥当と判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン治験開始に関する報道が主であり、新規症例数や死亡者数など具体的な疫学データは記載されていない。ナイジェリアは発生地域として記載されているが、記事本文ではワクチンの有効性・供給が未確定であるとのみ言及され、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Eastern Visayas rolls out mass anti-rabies vaccination
article.articleSummary: Eastern Visayas launches mass anti-rabies vaccination led by the Department of Agriculture (DA-8) with 12,000 vials allocated to six provinces and five cities, targeting about 117,000 dogs and cats. The initiative aims to strengthen public health protection and promote responsible pet ownership, moving toward a rabies-free region. Distribution by province: Southern Leyte 2,215; Leyte 1,909; Samar 1,893; Eastern Samar 1,790; Northern Samar 895; Biliran 557 vials. The five cities—Tacloban, Ormoc, Catbalogan, Calbayog, and Borongan—receive 500 vials each to support citywide vaccination drives. Syringes and needles are supplied, and specialized spay/neuter kits are being provided to enable free sterilization, reducing the stray population and rabies transmission risk. Vaccination is free of charge and locally administered by veterinary officers and agricultural technicians.

triage.headline_ja: 東ビサヤ地方、狂犬病予防のための大規模ワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の予防的ワクチン接種プログラムの実施報告であり、異常な集団発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は狂犬病の発生報告ではなく、フィリピン東ビサヤ地方における動物向け予防接種キャンペーン（公衆衛生の予防活動）の実施を報じるもの。地域保健当局による通常の疾病予防プログラムであり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Rotary promove mobilização binacional de combate à poliomielite - Jornal A Plateia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rotary Promotes Binational Mobilization to Combat Poliomyelitis - Jornal A Plateia
article.articleSummary: On October 24, 2026, Rotary clubs from Sant'Ana do Livramento, Brazil, and Rivera, Uruguay, launch a binational mobilization for World Polio Day to raise vaccination awareness. The event features simultaneous walks starting at Praça General Osório in Sant'Ana do Livramento and Praça Artigas in Rivera, converging at Parque Internacional for a joint awareness and fundraising activity. Participants include Rotary, Rotaract, Interact, Casa da Amizade, and the Núcleo Rotary de Desenvolvimento Comunitário. At Parque Internacional, informational materials on poliomyelitis will be distributed; food sales, health services, and fundraising activities are planned to support polio-control efforts. Poliomyelitis is a viral disease that can cause paralysis, primarily in children; vaccination is the main prevention to protect children and prevent disease reintroduction. The event promotes End Polio Now! and invites residents of both cities to engage in the global effort to eradicate polio.

triage.headline_ja: ロータリーがポリオ撲滅に向けた二国間連携活動を推進 - Jornal A Plateia
triage.triage_reason: 記事は世界ポリオデーに関する啓発・募金活動を伝えるものであり、実際の症例発生や感染拡大を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルとウルグアイでの啓発イベントに関するもので、実際のポリオ発生を報告していない。また対象国リストにブラジル・ウルグアイの実症例報告は含まれず、ブラジルも主題として発生事例ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Begins First Ebola Vaccine Trial As DR Congo Death Toll Hits Over 4,600
article.articleSummary: DR Congo launches the Tumaini Ebola vaccine trial in Bunia, vaccinating the first participants as the Bundibugyo-strain outbreak surpasses 9,700 cases and 4,600 deaths. The epidemic, the country’s worst, is driven by the Bundibugyo virus, for which no vaccine or specific treatment exists yet. Tumaini will initially test Ervebo, the vaccine approved for the Zaire strain, to determine cross-protection against Bundibugyo; two additional vaccine candidates are expected to join later. One is an adenoviral-vector vaccine developed by the University of Oxford, and the other uses Moderna’s mRNA technology, both tailored for Bundibugyo. The trial is DR Congo–led with World Health Organization support, designed to evaluate safety and effectiveness across multiple vaccines under one program. WHO Director-General Tedros described the effort as a hopeful step, with the outbreak ongoing in the region.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがDRコンゴで初のエボラワクチン試験を開始、死者数4,600人超に
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴで史上最悪規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続し、9,700症例・4,600人超の死亡という深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株に対するワクチン（Ervebo含む3種）の臨床試験開始はWHO主導の国際支援事例であり、流行は同国史上最悪規模。国際的拡大・渡航貿易制限の有無については記事内に言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola hunt: How Kenya tracked 135 contacts
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Kenya: nine cases identified, including the index patient who died; eight survivors remain in Kenyatta National Hospital and Nairobi Hospital, stable. A multi-agency team led by the Kenya Defence Forces, with the National Intelligence Service and telecoms, located 135 contacts; one Ugandan who flew from Entebbe and crossed into Tanzania via Namanga was tracked after entering Kenya. No new cases in the 24 hours to Friday; 14 suspected samples were negative. Tracing in Nairobi proved challenging amid rapid movement; quarantine facilities struggled with isolation, prompting CCTV monitoring and briefings with families and leaders. Four healthcare workers and four family members were infected. Monoclonal antibodies and remdesivir used; PPE deployed in risk counties. Kenya requested 10,000 vaccine doses from WHO, though Zaire vaccines are not proven against Bundibugyo. All secondary cases were known contacts in quarantine; no sustained transmission. Index case traveled from DRC → Uganda → Nairobi.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ調査：ケニアはいかにして135人の接触者を追跡したか
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでエボラ出血熱の集団発生が確認され、死者・医療従事者感染・隔離対応・ワクチン要請など公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断した。
triage.notes: 指数症例はDRCからウガンダを経てケニアに入国したとされるが、実際の感染拡大・症例発生はケニア国内で起きており、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。DRCは渡航経路としてのみ言及されており、発生国としての確証はない。
