article.articleHeadline: मुंबईत दर तासाला १७ जणांना कुत्र्यांचा चावा; २०२१ च्या तुलनेत जवळपास दुप्पट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Mumbai, 17 people are bitten by dogs every hour; nearly double compared to 2021.
article.articleSummary: On RTI data accessed by health worker Chetan Kothari, Mumbai recorded 154,017 dog-bite incidents in 2025, about 421 bites daily and roughly 17 per hour, nearly double 2021's 79,252. Over five years, the city totaled 529,650 dog-bite cases (≈290 per day). Yearly figures show 2021: 79,252; 2022: 106,797; 2023: 61,332; 2024: 128,252; 2025: 154,017, with 2025 the peak. No deaths from dog bites or rabies were reported according to the RTI data. The rise has prompted scrutiny of the effectiveness of stray-dog sterilization and rabies vaccination drives run by the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC). Reports also highlight shortages of rabies vaccines, underscoring the need for proactive canine population control and vaccine supply to mitigate rabies risk amid high bite incidence.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイで1時間あたり17人が犬に噛まれる被害;2021年と比べほぼ倍増
triage.triage_reason: 犬咬傷件数の増加とワクチン不足が報告されているが、狂犬病による死亡例はなく、公衆衛生上の重大な影響は確認されていないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 死亡例は報告なしだが、ワクチン不足と咬傷件数増加は狂犬病リスク管理体制の脆弱性を示唆するため、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Health Minister Arunraj Reviews Dengue Prevention Measures in Otteri
article.articleSummary: Chennai, Tamil Nadu — Tamil Nadu Health Minister K.G. Arunraj inspected a monsoon medical camp at S.S. Puram, Otteri, to review fever cases and dengue prevention in ward 75 of Thiru.Vi.Ka. Nagar. He sought details from the city health officer on fever cases and dengue infections reported in S.S. Puram and asked whether mosquito-control workers were inspecting the area. The minister distributed pamphlets on dengue prevention and urged residents to remove discarded items that can collect rainwater. He inspected rooftops and advised keeping water storage containers covered and clearing unused articles to cut mosquito-breeding sites. A motor pump on First Cross Street to drain rainwater was reviewed, with orders to ensure street re-laying after the monsoon. He sampled pongal at Amma Unavagam and directed repairs to the purified drinking water unit. Accompanied by MLA M.R. Pallavi and other officials.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣アルンラージ氏、オッテリでのデング熱予防対策を視察
triage.triage_reason: 通常の行政視察・予防啓発活動の報道であり、異常な感染拡大や重症例の急増を示す情報はなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: デング熱は季節性のモンスーン時期の通常対策活動として報じられており、感染者数や重症度に関する具体的なデータは記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola menyebar ke delapan provinsi RD Kongo, warga terancam kelaparan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads to eight provinces in the DRC, residents at risk of starvation.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to eight of its 26 provinces, with nearly 3.5 million people in affected areas facing acute hunger (IPC Phase 3 or worse). Of those directly impacted, 97% still require food assistance. The World Food Programme says the outbreak has disrupted markets, livelihoods, and movement, worsening food insecurity amid ongoing armed conflict, forced displacement, and poor road conditions in eastern DR Congo. The agency requests $214 million for the next six months to provide emergency aid, including $78.6 million for ready-to-eat meals and dry rations for those affected and their families. The outbreak began in April 2026, and vaccines and treatments for the Bundibugyo strain have not yet received official licensing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国の8州に拡大、住民が飢餓の危機に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCの8州に拡大し、約350万人が深刻な食料不安に直面するなど公衆衛生・人道的影響が深刻であり、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認のBundibugyo株であることから国際的関心・支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: WFPが今後6か月で2億1400万ドルの緊急支援を要請。Bundibugyo株に対するワクチン・治療薬は未承認であり、武力紛争や道路事情悪化が感染拡大・対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Traveller had no symptoms before leaving Uganda -- Govt
article.articleSummary: Uganda’s Ministry of Health said the traveller who tested positive for Bundibugyo virus disease in Nigeria did not show symptoms when departing Uganda. Investigations are under way to determine when symptoms developed and the circumstances of infection. Uganda is working with Nigerian authorities to establish the traveller’s full travel history and movements; additional information including travel records and genomic sequencing results have been requested to support the inquiry. As a precaution, Uganda has reinstated traveller locator forms for all travellers and strengthened infection prevention and control at entry/exit points and health facilities, with ongoing nationwide surveillance. Travellers with a history of travel to the Democratic Republic of Congo will not be allowed to transit through Uganda. Public Health Act provisions will be enforced for breaches. Uganda remains Ebola-free; authorities urge vigilance, hygiene, and screening, with support from Africa CDC, US CDC, and WHO.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：渡航者はウガンダ出国時に症状なし ― 政府発表
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダ出国時無症状だった渡航者がナイジェリアでブンディブギョ・ウイルス病陽性となり、国境を越えた伝播の可能性と渡航制限措置が取られていることから、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大・渡航制限）に該当する。
triage.notes: 実際の発生国はウガンダおよびナイジェリアであり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。発生地域に含まれるDRCは、渡航制限の対象として言及されているのみで、感染発生地ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Tightens Ebola Screening After Nigerian Traveller Tests Positive -
article.articleSummary: Uganda tightens Ebola screening after a Nigerian traveller tests positive for Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease. A public statement dated 2026-10-23 says investigations are ongoing to establish the traveller’s movements, exposure, and infection circumstances; the traveller reportedly had no symptoms at Uganda departure. Uganda reinstates traveller locator forms for all arrivals, enhances screening at entry/exit points and in health facilities, and maintains nationwide surveillance. Transit restrictions bar travellers with recent travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo from transiting Uganda; Public Health Act provisions will be enforced for breaches, and unauthorised border crossers will be referred to authorities. Uganda stresses it remains Ebola-free and urges calm, hand hygiene, and adherence to screening. Nigeria continues monitoring contacts of a confirmed Ebola case in the Federal Capital Territory (Abuja). Genomic analysis shows the Nigeria virus is related to a Kenya case; epidemiological linkage is not yet established.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、ナイジェリア人渡航者の陽性判明を受けエボラ検疫を強化
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリア(アブジャ)で確認されたエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)患者に関連し、ウガンダが越境感染対応として検疫強化・渡航制限を実施。ケニア株との遺伝的関連も指摘され、複数国にまたがる国際的拡大懸念がありIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 主な発生国はナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア（いずれも対象国リスト外）。DRCは渡航制限対象として言及されているのみで、DRC国内での発生は記述されていないため verified_locations には含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola potvrđena kod švajcarske državljanke u Nigeriji
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola confirmed in Swiss woman in Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola case of the Bundibugjo strain has been confirmed in a Swiss citizen in Abuja, Nigeria, the Swiss Foreign Ministry announced. The patient, wife of a Swiss embassy employee, recently traveled with her husband to Uganda; neither had visited the Democratic Republic of Congo, epicenter of the current outbreak. She was hospitalized in a private Abuja clinic about a week ago with Ebola symptoms; her husband is in isolation but asymptomatic. Nigeria confirmed its first Ebola case; 44 contacts have been identified. The case is caused by Bundibugjo virus, linked to the Congo outbreak, for which there is no specific vaccine or therapy. Symptoms began Oct 7; she sought care Oct 11; tested positive Oct 20. The embassy has 25 staff; no quarantine for others. Switzerland considers transferring her for treatment; contact tracing continues. Nigeria is the fourth African country affected after DR Congo, Uganda, and Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでスイス人女性のエボラ出血熱感染が確認
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がウガンダ経由でナイジェリアに拡大し、スイス国籍者の感染が確認された。国際的拡大・重篤性・特効薬不在という点でIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 事例の発生地はナイジェリア（対象国リスト外）。DRCは流行の起源として言及されているが、本事例の患者はDRC渡航歴がなく、記事の主題はナイジェリアでの感染確認であるため、DRCはverified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: FG says Ebola case related to virus identified in Kenya
article.articleSummary: Genomic analysis by Nigeria CDC and IGH/Happi shows the Ebola virus detected in Nigeria is related to a virus identified in Kenya; however, this does not establish a direct transmission link, and investigations are ongoing to determine epidemiologic connection. Nigeria's first Ebola case was confirmed October 20 in a woman who had travelled from Uganda to Abuja; travel history remains contested. Ugandan authorities say she had journeyed to eastern DRC before Uganda; Swiss authorities say she did not visit DRC; WHO and Africa CDC have not verified travel to DRC, investigations continue. Authorities are examining a possible link with Kenya's first Ebola patient, who travelled via Entebbe; the Nigerian and Kenyan patients reportedly left Entebbe on October 3. Contacts from Abuja case are under monitoring; some have tested negative, others are pending. Nigeria strengthens surveillance, laboratories, case management, risk communication, and IPC; NCDC to issue updates from October 24, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア政府、エボラ症例はケニアで確認されたウイルスと関連していると発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスがウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア間で国境を越えて拡大している疑いがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 確認された症例はナイジェリア（アブジャ）とケニアで発生し、渡航歴にウガンダ・DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）が関与している可能性があるが、DRC渡航歴はウガンダ当局とスイス当局で見解が対立しており未確定（WHO・Africa CDCも未検証）。対象国リストにDRCが含まれるが、実際の発生国としては未確認のためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Old City to Rajendranagar, Hyderabad loses sleep to mosquitoes
article.articleSummary: Hyderabad's Tolichowki and other Old City localities report an evening-to-night surge in mosquitoes, prompting residents to rely on nets, coils, and electric devices as GHMC fogging struggles to curb biting. Officials warn mosquitoes may be developing resistance to insecticides; fogging targets adults, while larvae and pupae in drains persist. The spread affects Tolichowki, Shah Ali Banda, Falaknuma, Fateh Darwaza, Golconda, Mallepally, New Malakpet, Red Hills and Rajendranagar. Dengue fears persist: 266 dengue cases Jan 1–July 13, with 127 laboratory-confirmed, down from 570 (2025) and 821 (2024) for the same period. Aedes aegypti, the dengue/chikungunya vector, bites mainly by day; evening/night swarms are largely Culex, which can carry lymphatic filariasis and Japanese encephalitis. Weaker monsoon rains reduced stagnant-water pools. GHMC’s “one ward, one day” fogging/anti-larval drive covers 30 circles, 150 wards; the city has had no elected council since Feb 10.

triage.headline_ja: 旧市街からラジェンドラナガルまで、ハイデラバードが蚊により眠れぬ夜に
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例は前年・前々年より減少傾向にあり、季節的な蚊の増加と殺虫剤耐性への懸念を報じる地域ニュースであるが、重大な公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱症例数は前年・前々年比で減少しており、重症化や異常事態の報告はない。蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、チクングニア熱、リンパ系フィラリア症、日本脳炎）のリスク要因として殺虫剤耐性や行政の対応力低下（市議会不在）が懸念材料として挙げられている。続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Cần Thơ tập trung khoanh vùng dịch tả lợn châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can Tho focuses on cordoning off the African swine fever outbreak.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever continues to spread in Can Tho City, Vietnam, with 27 communes affected since the start of the year. Authorities have culled 1,479 pigs, totaling 85.1 tons, and are expediting compensation under Resolution 44/2025/NQ-HĐND at 40,000 VND per kg. Can Tho's Department of Agriculture and Environment urges transparent reporting, rapid outbreak detection, and strict controls on livestock entering abattoirs, while boosting supplies for disease prevention. In Dai Hai commune, 10 outbreaks since Sept 29 led to 291 culled pigs (19.1 tons). In Oct, Phu Loc, Ngoc To, Thanh Thoi An, and Tai Van reported 2–3 outbreaks each, totaling 333 culled pigs (14.6 tons). 21-day surveillance for these outbreaks has not yet elapsed. Officials urge restocking only after containment; vaccination is not mentioned.

triage.headline_ja: カントー市、アフリカ豚熱の発生区域封じ込めに注力
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（アフリカ豚熱）であり直接的なヒトへの公衆衛生影響は確認されないが、養豚業への経済的影響が続いており、拡大状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本疾患は動物（豚）のみに感染するウイルス性疾病でありヒトへの感染性はない。公衆衛生上のリスクではなく農業・経済上の影響が主。

article.articleHeadline: 两人在路边捡到受伤鹦鹉，好心带回家照顾，数日后接连发高烧查出肺炎，医生：没被啄伤也会感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two people who found an injured parrot by the roadside take it home to care for it; a few days later they both developed high fevers and were diagnosed with pneumonia, doctors say: infection can occur even without being pecked.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-24, two Guangzhou residents developed psittacosis pneumonia after rescuing an injured parrot. Chen and Lin, caring for the bird at home, soon presented with persistent high fever and severe headaches, progressing to bilateral pneumonia. Guangzhou Second Hospital Infectious Diseases confirmed Chlamydia psittaci infection. Both patients received targeted anti-infective therapy and were discharged with improving symptoms. Psittacosis is a zoonosis, not limited to bites; inhalation of dust from dried bird droppings or respiratory secretions can transmit the pathogen. Birds such as pigeons, sparrows, and other wild birds can harbor the organism, often without symptoms. Preventive guidance includes dampening droppings before cleaning, wearing masks and gloves, good ventilation, avoiding bedroom cages, thorough hand hygiene after contact with birds, quarantining new birds, and seeking veterinary or wildlife rescue assistance when handling injured birds.

triage.headline_ja: 道端で負傷したインコを拾い持ち帰って世話をした2人、数日後に高熱が続き肺炎と診断される。医師：啄かれなくても感染する可能性あり
triage.triage_reason: 散発的な2症例（鳥類からの感染）で、重症化なく回復・退院しており、ヒト-ヒト感染や地域拡大の兆候もないため、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: オウム病（Chlamydia psittaci感染）は人畜共通感染症だが、ヒト-ヒト感染はまれで、本事例は野鳥との接触による散発例。患者は回復しており、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。中国広東省広州市の個別事例であり、対象国リストには該当するが、事例の性質上シグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Don't Panic, prepare, experts urge Nigerians
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports a probable Ebola case after a woman arriving from Uganda tested positive in Abuja on Oct 20, 2026; 44 close contacts identified, with high-risk individuals quarantined and others monitored. The patient’s care at a private facility triggers expanded contact tracing including healthcare workers, patients and caregivers. This follows Nigeria’s 2014 outbreak, when 20 confirmed and probable cases and eight deaths were contained within three months and WHO declared transmission-free on Oct 20, 2014. Experts urge calm, accurate risk communication, and rapid contact tracing. Separately, the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak (May 2026) has surpassed 9,500 cases and 4,600 deaths as of Oct 19, 2026, caused by Bundibugyo Ebola, with no approved vaccine; Uganda has reported about 20 confirmed cases. Ebola spreads via direct contact with infected fluids, not airborne; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, bleeding; management relies on early supportive care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：パニックにならず備えを、専門家がナイジェリア国民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラアウトブレイク（9,500例超、死者4,600人超）が継続中であり、ウガンダからナイジェリアへの国際的な症例流入も確認されたため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアの疑い症例だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは大規模アウトブレイクの主体として記事内で実質的に扱われているため含めた。ワクチン未承認（Bundibugyo種）で管理困難な状況が継続している点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: ಕೀನ್ಯಾದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಬೋಲಾಗೆ 2ನೇ ಬಲಿ : 7 ಮಂದಿಗೆ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆ - Eesanje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kenya, second Ebola casualty: 7 people receiving treatment - Eesanje
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a second Ebola death as of Oct 24, 2026: a 65-year-old woman, a close contact of the first patient, died in quarantine after developing symptoms about 10 days post-exposure. She was admitted to Nairobi's Infectious Diseases Treatment Unit; seven other Ebola patients are receiving care in two separate isolation centers, with no new infections reported. The first case involves a 40-year-old Kenyan man living in Congo who arrived in Kenya via Uganda on Oct 3; he tested positive on Oct 5 and died the same day. About 135 contacts have been identified, with 118 in quarantine; eight quarantined individuals—four health workers and four family members—have Ebola. Quarantine lasts 21 days, with asymptomatic releases. Ebola spreads through bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the ongoing outbreak has caused at least 4,000 deaths since May.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ2人目の死者、7人が治療中
triage.triage_reason: DRCからの輸入エボラ症例がケニアに拡大し2例目の死亡者が発生、135人の接触者中8人の二次感染が確認されており、IHR基準の複数に該当する重大な公衆衛生イベントである。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入エボラ症例とその二次感染拡大だが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは進行中のアウトブレイク（5月以降4000人超死亡）として記事内で言及されているため含めた。感染源はDRC由来の患者。

article.articleHeadline: 衞生署HIV網站電郵疑遭不當使用　向市民發電郵稱收件人有感染風險 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Health HIV website emails suspected of being misused; emails to the public claiming recipients are at risk of infection | am730
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Hong Kong's Department of Health disclosed that email accounts tied to its HIV Testing Service website were suspected of misuse to send messages claiming recipients were at risk of HIV infection. The department states it did not issue such emails or texts and advises the public not to click links or provide personal data. Police have been notified and the Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data informed. The HIV Testing Service website is temporarily suspended while cybersecurity experts and the contracted provider conduct a full security review; no data loss or leakage has been detected. In the interim, the public can call the HIV hotline at 2780 2211 to book anonymous, confidential HIV antibody testing.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生署HIVウェブサイトのメールが不正使用された疑い　市民に「感染リスクあり」とするメールを送信
triage.triage_reason: これは感染症の発生事例ではなく、HIV検査サービスのメールアカウントが不正利用されたというサイバーセキュリティ・個人情報関連の事案であり、公衆衛生上の感染拡大リスクには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本事案はHIV感染症の発生・拡大に関する情報ではなく、ウェブサイト・メールの不正利用（フィッシング詐欺の可能性）に関するもの。感染症疫学的シグナルではないため対象国の疾病発生としては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: 4-year-old boy dies of dengue fever in Coimbatore
article.articleSummary: 4-year-old boy dies of dengue fever in Coimbatore, India. He was initially admitted to a private hospital in Palladam, where dengue fever was confirmed. As his condition deteriorated, he was shifted to Coimbatore Government Hospital and admitted to the intensive care unit. He died on Friday night despite treatment. Following the incident, residents urged health authorities to intensify mosquito-control measures and sanitation work in the locality, underscoring concerns about dengue transmission in Palladam and the wider Coimbatore region and the need for enhanced vector-control efforts. The report does not indicate any other confirmed cases or outbreak status at the time. The case highlights dengue as an acute illness affecting children and the ongoing public-health demand for rapid surveillance and response in the area.

triage.headline_ja: コインバトールでデング熱により4歳男児死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一の死亡例報告であり、他の確定症例やアウトブレイクの状況は示されていない。デング熱はインドで地域流行している既知の疾患であり、IHR基準・社会的関心ともに高まりは確認できない。
triage.notes: 地元住民が蚊対策強化を求めているが、アウトブレイクとしての確認はなく、単発の重症死亡例の報告にとどまる。デング熱はインドの流行地域で季節的に発生する既知の感染症であり、新規性・異常性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: ಪ್ರತೀ ಅಮೂಲ್ಯ ಜೀವಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಎರಡು ಹನಿ; ಇದು ಪೋಲಿಯೋ ಮಹಾಮಾರಿ ವಿರುದ್ಧದ ಹೋರಾಟ | Udayavani - Latest Kannada News, Udayavani Newspaper
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two drops for every precious life; this is the fight against the polio outbreak
article.articleSummary: World Polio Day 2026 highlights polio eradication with the theme 'One day. One goal: End Polio Forever,' emphasizing protection of every child and stronger surveillance. Poliomyelitis is a viral disease that can devastate the nervous system. India has been polio-free since 2014 (WHO). Through the Pulse Polio program, the government vaccinates about 174 million children under five during campaigns, while the Universal Immunisation Programme vaccinates around 26.7 million newborns annually. Campaigns rely on OPV and IPV, with community education and household visits in rural, tribal, and underserved areas, plus emphasis on sanitation, clean drinking water, and handwashing to prevent fecal-oral transmission. Globally, wild poliovirus remains active in Pakistan and Afghanistan, but polio cases have fallen by over 99% since 1988, from about 350,000 annually. No cure exists; vaccination prevents paralysis and safeguards communities.

triage.headline_ja: すべての尊い命のために二滴を；これがポリオという大流行病との戦いである
triage.triage_reason: 世界ポリオデーの啓発記事であり、インドは2014年以来ポリオフリーであることを強調する内容。新規の発生や異常事態の報告はなく、既知の流行国(パキスタン・アフガニスタン)の状況も変化なし。
triage.notes: インドはポリオフリーであり本記事の主題国ではないため対象国として含めない。パキスタン・アフガニスタンは対象国リストに含まれず、本記事はキャンペーン啓発広報であり新規感染事例の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Tshopo : la marche initiée par le gouverneur en pleine épidémie d'Ebola suscite des inquiétudes | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Tshopo: the march initiated by the governor amid an Ebola outbreak raises concerns | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Kisangani, Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, faces an Ebola outbreak as Governor Paulin Lendongolia Lebabonga's call for a popular march raises health concerns. The plan, announced Oct 20, envisions a rally at Lumumba Stadium and a city march this Saturday, with supporters framing it as national sovereign unity behind the FARDC against dissent and misinformation. Critics warn the gathering could fuel transmission of Ebola; they reference a July 9 provincial decree suspending assemblies. The province has recorded dozens of Ebola cases and more than 30 deaths, fueling public debate over risk and timing. In response, the governor's spokesperson, Michel Biambe, says health measures will be in place, including hydroalcoholic solutions and adherence to physical distancing to mitigate spread during the event.

triage.headline_ja: ツショポ州：エボラ流行の最中に知事が呼びかけたデモ行進が懸念を招く | mediacongo.net
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱流行（数十例・30人超の死亡）に加え、大規模集会開催による感染拡大リスクと社会的・政治的関心の高まりが確認されるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラ流行下で大規模集会が計画されており、感染拡大リスクが地元で懸念されている。州当局は衛生対策を講じるとしているが、感染者数・致死率等の詳細データは記事に不足。

article.articleHeadline: Morning recap: Ebola updates, looming petrol price hike, Lagos building collapse, other top stories
article.articleSummary: Nigeria tightens Ebola entry-point screening after reported protocol breaches amid concerns of an imported Ebola case in Abuja; the Federal Government orders agencies to tighten surveillance and document actual or attempted breaches. The Ugandan Health Ministry says the traveller who tested positive for Bundibugyo virus disease in Nigeria showed no symptoms when leaving Uganda; investigations are ongoing to determine when symptoms developed and how infection occurred. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the World Health Organization has launched the first clinical trial of Ebola vaccines targeting the Bundibugyo strain, named Tumaini, with initial participants vaccinated in Bunia, Ituri province, to assess safety and potential protection; no vaccine has yet been approved for this strain. These updates illustrate ongoing Ebola risk in the region and international vaccine development as of 2026-10-24.

triage.headline_ja: モーニングリキャップ：エボラ最新情報、迫るガソリン価格高騰、ラゴスのビル崩壊、その他トップニュース
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダ由来のブンディブギョ・ウイルス病（エボラ関連株）症例がナイジェリアで確認され、国境を越えた伝播が発生。DRCではWHOが同株を標的としたワクチン臨床試験を開始しており、地域的な公衆衛生上の懸念と国際的対応が同時進行している。
triage.notes: 本事例の主な感染経路はウガンダからナイジェリアへの越境例であるが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCはブンディブギョ株を標的としたWHO主導のワクチン臨床試験（Tumaini）の実施国として記載されているため、verified_locationsに含めた。続報にて症例の感染経路・規模の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Baixa cobertura vacinal mantém Brasil em alerta para o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Low vaccination coverage keeps Brazil on alert for measles.
article.articleSummary: Measles remains a Brazil-wide alert as 2026 two-dose coverage stays below 95% in every state and nationally under 80%, despite Brazil having been recognized as measles-free in 2024. The country reports over 50 cases in 2026 (39 in 2025), with many imported; last autochthonous case occurred in June 2022 in Amapá. Vaccination efforts are intensified, especially near borders; top-performing states are Ceará (86.69%), Paraná (86.76%), and Minas Gerais (86.05%), while Amapá (63.59%), Pará (67.02%), Maranhão (69.66%), and Rio de Janeiro (69.74%) lag. The MMR vaccine yields about 94–96% protection after the first dose and >97% with the full schedule; doses are at 12 and 15 months. Symptoms include high fever, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, with Koplik spots as a diagnostic clue. Imported cases necessitate heightened surveillance and public health measures to prevent reintroduction and potential outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 低いワクチン接種率がブラジルを麻疹警戒態勢に維持
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全土でワクチン接種率が低く麻疹再流行リスクが続いているが、自国内伝播例は2022年以降なく、現状は輸入例中心で深刻な公衆衛生インパクトには至っていないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ブラジルは2024年に麻疹排除認定を受けたが、ワクチン接種率低下により輸入例からの再流行リスクが懸念されている。重症例や死亡の報告は記事中になし。

article.articleHeadline: تایید دومین مرگ ناشی از ابولا در کنیا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second Ebola death confirmed in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Kenya reports its second Ebola death, a 65-year-old woman who was a close relative of the first victim and died after isolation. The initial fatality was a man who traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo. Seven additional Ebola patients are in two isolation centers; all cases stem from a single cluster with no evidence of community transmission. Since the outbreak was confirmed in the DRC in May, more than 4,000 deaths have been recorded in Africa, making this outbreak the second deadliest. The United States has warned against travel to Kenya, while Uganda, Ethiopia, and Somalia are on alert. Ebola virus disease causes vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure, and sometimes bleeding. Transmission is via contact with infected bodily fluids. The Bundibugyo strain is relatively rare; no vaccine or approved treatment exists, though experimental therapies are underway.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱による2人目の死亡を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ流行がケニアへ越境伝播し死亡例・複数患者が発生、米国の渡航警告や周辺国の警戒も生じており国際的拡大・渡航制限の両基準を満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの死亡例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、DRCは本流行の確認地かつ4,000人超の死者を出す継続中の流行地として記載されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: ไข้ดินระบาดอีสานล่าง! ป่วย 538 ราย ดับ 40 ศพ เตือนช่วงน้ำท่วมเสี่ยงติดเชื้อ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leptospirosis outbreak in Lower Isan! 538 cases, 40 deaths; warns of infection risk during floods.
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis (soil fever) outbreak in Lower Isan, Thailand, with 538 cases and 40 deaths across Health Region 9 (Nakhon Ratchasima, Chaiyaphum, Buriram, Surin) from Jan 1 to Oct 17, 2026; Buriram has the highest incidence. Most cases are in people aged 65+, followed by 55–64 and 45–54. The region’s rainfall and flooding raise exposure to bacteria in soil and water. Transmission occurs via skin wounds, inhalation of dust, or ingestion of contaminated water/food. High‑risk groups include diabetics, kidney/liver/chronic lung disease patients, thalassemia, immunocompromised individuals, heavy drinkers, and farmers in frequent soil contact. Four preventive measures: avoid direct contact with soil/water; wear boots, gloves, long pants, and waterproof gear when exposure is necessary; wash and cover wounds immediately after exposure; drink clean water and ensure cooked food; seek medical care if fever persists after exposure or if respiratory symptoms/skin abscesses appear. Hotline 1422 for information.

triage.headline_ja: イサーン下部でメリオイドーシス（土壌熱）が流行！感染538人、死亡40人、洪水時の感染リスクに警告
triage.triage_reason: タイ東北部（イサーン下部）で538例・40人死亡という比較的高い致死率のメリオイドーシス流行が継続しており、雨季・洪水による曝露リスクが続く点と保健当局が注意喚起・ホットライン対応を行っている点から、WPRO基準（重症度・長期曝露）と社会的関心（政府対応）の両方に該当するためフルリスク評価への移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: メリオイドーシスはタイ東北部で季節性・土壌由来の風土病として知られ、ヒト-ヒト感染はしない。感染拡大は国際的ではなく国内の環境曝露（雨季・洪水）によるものであり、国境を越えるリスクは低いと考えられる。糖尿病患者や高齢者など基礎疾患保有者が重症化・死亡しやすい点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia confirma una segunda muerte por ébola entre los contactos del primer caso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya confirms a second Ebola death among the contacts of the first case.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a second Ebola death among contacts of the first confirmed case, bringing nine confirmed cases and two deaths in the country. The victim is a 65-year-old woman, a family contact who traveled from the DRC and died after arriving in Nairobi. She developed symptoms Oct 13 in quarantine and died Oct 23. Seven others remain in two isolation facilities. Authorities warn there is no evidence of community transmission and plan a safe burial per protocol. The first imported case was a 40-year-old man from the DRC, who traveled to Nairobi via Kampala and died Oct 5. By Oct 20, the DRC outbreak had 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths across eight provinces; cases linked to the outbreak have been detected in Nigeria, the Netherlands, and France. Bundibugyo strain has no specific treatment; two vaccines in human trials have shown safety, with months of development ahead.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ出血熱で最初の症例の接触者から2人目の死亡を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクがケニア、ナイジェリア、オランダ、フランスへ国際的に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため緊急のリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: DRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（9,704症例・4,687死亡、8州に拡大）が感染源であり、ケニア・ナイジェリア・オランダ・フランスへの越境伝播が確認されている。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola di Kongo Meluas, 3,5 Juta Orang Terancam Krisis Pangan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo spreads, 3.5 million people at risk of a food crisis.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to eight of its 26 provinces. Nearly 3.5 million people in affected areas face acute food insecurity (IPC 3 or higher), with 97% of those directly impacted still needing food assistance. Market disruption, movement restrictions, ongoing conflict, displacement, and poor roads worsen access to food. The World Food Programme seeks $214 million over six months to deliver emergency aid to the most vulnerable in eastern DR Congo, including $78.6 million for ready-to-eat meals and dry rations for affected communities and their households. The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak began in April 2026; no licensed vaccines or treatments for this strain are reported. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected body fluids, and early symptoms resemble severe flu, underscoring the need for strict infection control and rapid medical response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が拡大、350万人が食料危機に直面
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyo株エボラが8州に拡大し、ワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、350万人規模の食料危機と国際支援要請を伴う深刻な公衆衛生・人道危機であるため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラの流行は2026年4月開始、認可ワクチン・治療薬なし。WFPが6ヶ月で2.14億ドルの緊急支援を要請。食料不安と感染拡大が相互に悪化させる複合危機。

article.articleHeadline: in congo la prima sperimentazione clinica di un vaccino contro l'ebola. nel paese i morti sono...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, the first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine. In the country, the deaths are....
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine began amid an outbreak that has surpassed 9,700 cases and 4,600 deaths. Launched in Bunia, the Tumaini study marks the first human trial of a vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccines or treatments exist. Ervebo, a vaccine approved for the Zaire strain, will be tested in a large-scale study to determine whether it offers cross-protection against Bundibugyo. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the start of the trial on X. The initial participants were vaccinated today, as researchers seek to determine if a vaccine tailored to Bundibugyo or cross-protective immunity can help end the worst Ebola epidemic ever recorded in the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラワクチンの初の臨床試験開始。同国では死者が...
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で9,700例超・死者4,600人超という史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続しており、IHR基準の深刻性・異常性に該当するため。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の大規模エボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）に対するワクチン臨床試験開始を報じるもので、WHO事務局長が発表している。流行は史上最悪規模とされ、継続的な監視・フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola di RD Kongo Meluas ke 8 Provinsi, 3,5 Juta Orang Terancam Kelaparan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo spreads to eight provinces, 3.5 million people at risk of famine.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to eight of 26 provinces, triggering a humanitarian crisis with 3.5 million people at risk of famine. As of Oct 24, 2026, the World Food Programme reports about 3.5 million in affected areas facing acute hunger at IPC Crisis level or worse, with 97% of those directly impacted in dire need of food assistance. Movement restrictions to curb transmission are hindering access to food amid ongoing armed conflict, forced displacement, and poor road infrastructure. The UN agency seeks $214 million over six months, including $78.6 million for ready-to-eat meals and dry rations for those affected and their families. The outbreak, which began spreading in April 2026, is caused by the Ebola Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no internationally approved vaccine or treatment yet.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が8州に拡大、350万人が飢餓の危機に
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・治療法未承認）が8州に拡大し、人道危機・食料不足を引き起こしているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬未承認のブンディブギョ株による流行で、武力紛争・人口移動により感染拡大と人道危機が併発している。WFPが2.14億ドルの支援を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تدعو لتعزيز المراقبة الوبائية بعد رصد بؤر جديدة لـ"إيبولا" بالكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization calls for strengthened epidemiological surveillance after detecting new Ebola outbreaks in Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization calls for strengthened epidemiological surveillance after detecting new Ebola virus disease outbreaks in remote areas of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Katherine Smolwood, head of outbreak response, said the DRC has 9,765 confirmed Ebola cases, with about half resulting in death; health teams are tracing around 30,000 contacts daily, and recoveries exceed 2,600. Security and logistical challenges hinder access to some regions, complicating containment efforts. WHO urges increased funding and medical/logistical support, stronger local response capacity, and faster early detection, especially in conflict-affected, displaced, and food-insecure zones. It also urged regional nations to intensify surveillance and border health checks, while stressing that travel or trade restrictions with affected countries are not recommended.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関(WHO)、コンゴでエボラウイルス病の新たな発生地を検出後、疫学的監視の強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラウイルス病の確定症例が9,765件、致死率約50%に達し、新たな発生地も検出されている。WHOが国際的な資金・物資支援と監視強化を要請しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約50%、確定症例9,765件、1日あたり約30,000人の接触者追跡が行われている深刻な状況。紛争・避難民・食料不安地域でのアクセス困難が封じ込めを阻害。WHOは渡航・貿易制限は推奨しないとしているが、周辺国への監視強化と国境での健康チェックを要請しており、国際的拡大リスクが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Конго: дата прва експериментална вакцина против Бундибугјо вируса
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Date of the First Experimental Vaccine Against Bundibugyo virus
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo began a trial of multiple experimental vaccines against Bundibugyo Ebola virus; the first participant received the shot on Oct 23, 2026. The study tests several candidates in parallel, with no approved vaccine for this strain yet. The aim is to stop transmission and save lives while aligning research with frontline needs, per the national Ebola response coordinator and MSF. MSF stresses community engagement as essential to ensure vaccines reach those most in need. Since the May outbreak, Bundibugyo virus spread from DRC to Uganda, France, and Kenya, with Nigeria reporting its first case on Oct 20. Cross-border concerns grow as this rare Ebola lineage has infected over 9,000 people and caused more than 4,300 deaths. The article underscores ongoing vaccine development and international collaboration to address urgent public health needs.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：ブンディブギョウイルスに対する初の実験的ワクチン接種開始
triage.triage_reason: 希少なエボラ系統（ブンディブギョ株）が複数国に拡大し、9000人超感染・4300人超死亡という深刻な公衆衛生被害が生じており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのワクチン治験開始を中心に報じているが、ウガンダ、フランス、ケニア、ナイジェリアへの感染拡大にも言及。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみのため、verified_locationsはDRCに限定した。感染者数9000人超・死者4300人超という規模は極めて深刻であり、早急なフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Vi khuẩn não mô cầu hoạt động trong họng con người thế nào?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How do meningococcal bacteria behave in the human throat?
article.articleSummary: Neisseria meningitidis can colonize the human nasopharynx without symptoms (asymptomatic carriage) and persist for weeks to months. Immune control may prevent disease or cause only mild symptoms, but transmission to close contacts remains possible. If immunity wanes or mucosal injury occurs, meningococci can invade deeper tissues, reach the bloodstream, and release endotoxins that damage vessels and disrupt circulation, leading to meningococcal meningitis and/or septicemia; some patients develop both. Early treatment is critical due to rapid progression; survivors may have hearing loss, neurological impairment, or limb loss. The disease can occur year-round. In Ho Chi Minh City, five cases were reported recently, including one child death. Vaccination protects against serogroups A, B, C, Y, and W-135, using vaccines for B (ages 2 months–50 years), BC (ages 6 months–45 years), and A/C/Y/W-135 (two types, 6 weeks to any age); schedules may require combinations. Hygiene and prompt evaluation of close contacts are advised.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌は人間の喉でどのように活動するのか？
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市で髄膜炎菌感染症の5症例と小児1名の死亡が報告されているが、記事自体は病態解説が主で発生規模・経過の詳細情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は髄膜炎菌の病態生理に関する教育的解説が主で、ホーチミン市での5症例・小児死亡1例は言及されているのみで詳細な疫学情報（発症時期、血清群、感染経路等）が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Begins Ebola Vaccine Trial in DR Congo as Ebola Deaths Exceed 4,600 - Diaspora Digital Media (DDM News) - Nigeria Breaking News, Africa and World News and Updates
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in Ituri province's Bunia continues, with 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths recorded as of Oct 21, 2026; outbreak began May 15 and led WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The WHO-backed Tumaini vaccine trial started Oct 23 in Bunia to assess Ervebo (Zaire strain) for cross-protection against Bundibugyo, with two additional candidates—Moderna’s and ChAdOx1 (Oxford/Serum Institute)—to join later. The study uses ring vaccination among contacts and high-risk groups, and intends to evaluate safety, immune responses, and protection, including pregnant women and children aged 12 and older. Findings will inform vaccine deployment strategies and outbreak preparedness; efficacy must be demonstrated, and ongoing public health measures remain essential. The effort is a collaborative partnership among Congolese authorities, WHO, CEPI, and international partners to expand vaccine options if candidates prove safe and effective.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DR コンゴでエボラワクチン試験を開始、エボラ死者数は4,600人を超える
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラ流行（9,552症例、4,602死亡）であり、IHR基準の複数該当とワクチン臨床試験開始という重大な公衆衛生対応が報じられている。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEICを既に宣言済みの進行中の大規模アウトブレイクであり、CEPI・国際パートナーとのワクチン試験が開始されている。致死率は約48%と非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Три пациента умерли в Кении от вируса Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three patients died in Kenya from the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak affecting Kenya, Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Uganda and South Sudan. As of 24 October 2026, Kenya reports at least nine infections and three deaths; two fatalities were close relatives, and one death followed a return from the DRC. Seven other patients remain under treatment in two isolation wards, with no signs of further spread in Kenya. The first imported Ebola case and death in Kenya were confirmed in early October; the patient had lived in the DRC for seven years and died two days after returning home. The DRC declared the outbreak on 15 May, with additional cases reported in Uganda and South Sudan. Overall, the outbreak has recorded more than 9,700 cases and about 4,700 deaths attributed to Ebola virus disease.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラウイルスにより3人の患者が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCを起点に複数国（ケニア、ウガンダ、南スーダン）へ拡大しており、IHR基準の深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大の3項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでの死亡例を中心に報じているが、アウトブレイクの起点であるDRCが対象国リストに含まれるため含めた。ケニア・ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ডিআর কঙ্গোতে ইবোলার টিকা নিয়ে প্রথমবারের মতো ক্লিনিক্যাল ট্রায়াল শুরু
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First-ever clinical trial of the Ebola vaccine begins in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: First-ever Ebola vaccine clinical trial begins in DR Congo's Ituri province capital Bunia amid the nation’s worst Ebola outbreak to date, with over 9,700 infections and 4,600 deaths. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no licensed vaccine or treatment exists for this strain. The Ervebo vaccine (rVSV-ZEBOV), approved for Zaire ebolavirus, will be tested for cross-protection against Bundibugyo. The Tumaini trial launched on Oct 23, using ring vaccination to immunize contacts of confirmed cases; it will examine safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity, and will include pregnant women and those aged 12+. Two additional candidates—Oxford’s ChAdOx1 adenoviral vaccine and Moderna's mRNA vaccine—will be added. CEPI funds both vaccines, with the aim of generating robust evidence for outbreak control and future preparedness. May 15 marked DR Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern two days later.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチンの初の臨床試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で感染者9,700人超・死者4,600人超に及ぶ同国史上最悪のエボラ流行が継続中であり、WHOがPHEICを宣言済みという深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であるため。
triage.notes: 記事自体はワクチン臨床試験開始に関する報道だが、背景にある疾病事象はWHOが既にPHEICを宣言した大規模なエボラ流行（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス、承認済みワクチン・治療法なし）であり、継続的な監視・フルリスク評価の対象として扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: 尼日利亚埃博拉感染病例与肯尼亚病例关联密切
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infection cases in Nigeria are closely linked to Kenyan cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases in Nigeria and Kenya are genomically linked to the ongoing Congo (Kinshasa) Beni strain outbreak. Nigeria’s first infection, identified in Abuja this week, involves the spouse of a Swiss diplomat who flew from Uganda on Oct 3 and had not visited Congo; genome sequencing indicates close relation to Kenya’s index case. Kenya’s first case, a 40-year-old Kenyan man who previously lived in the DRC and transited via Uganda, arrived Oct 3 and was diagnosed Oct 5 in Nairobi, where he died the same day. Kenya reported a second Ebola death on Oct 23, a 65-year-old female relative of the index patient. Kenya has 9 cases and 2 deaths, with 7 in isolation; 8 close contacts tested positive (4 relatives, 4 healthcare workers). WHO notes a resurgence of the Congo (Kinshasa) Beni strain, the outbreak’s spread to other African countries, with over 9,700 infections and 4,690 deaths as of Oct 20; no approved vaccine or targeted therapy exists for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ感染例はケニアの症例と密接に関連
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ（キンシャサ）ベニ株由来のエボラ出血熱がケニア・ナイジェリアへ国際的に拡大しており、死亡例・医療従事者感染も確認されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダが含まれるが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。本事例の起源であるDRC（コンゴ・キンシャサ、ベニ株）のみをverified_locationsに記載。ワクチン・治療法が未承認である点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: DRC begins Ebola vaccine study as health officials seek protection against Bundibugyo strain - TV47 Digital
article.articleSummary: DRC launches the TUMAINI Ebola vaccine study to test whether an existing vaccine can protect against the Bundibugyo strain. First participants were vaccinated in Bunia, northeastern DRC. The trial examines Ervebo, approved for the Zaire strain, for cross-protection against Bundibugyo, though effectiveness remains uncertain; Bundibugyo has no approved vaccine. WHO supports the Congolese-led research, with Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announcing the start. The shared framework evaluates safety, immune response, and efficacy across several candidates. The study operates as the DRC endures a major outbreak declared in May, with infections exceeding 9,700 and deaths above 4,600; cases have been reported across parts of eastern, central and western Africa. WHO flagged the situation as a public health emergency of international concern. Results will guide which vaccines merit further development; this is not confirmation that Ervebo protects against Bundibugyo as of 2026-10-24.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、ブンディブギョ株への防御を目指しエボラワクチン臨床試験を開始 - TV47 Digital
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が続いており、感染者9,700人超・死者4,600人超、複数地域への拡大が報告されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン臨床試験開始の報告だが、背景に進行中の大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行とWHOのPHEIC宣言がある。治験の有効性は未確定。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle: Mapa atualiza medidas após foco confirmado em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease: Map updates measures after a confirmed outbreak in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak confirmed in a meat turkey breeding facility in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil. The Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock (Mapa) declared a zoosanitary emergency for 60 days in Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim. Mapa notified the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) and bilateral trade partners, sharing initial technical information and sanitary measures. Sanitary depopulation of the affected facility began on October 19 and completed on October 20. Cleaning and disinfection are underway according to applicable protocols. Epidemiological surveillance and monitoring continue within the restricted sanitary area, with movement controls on animals and other items subject to sanitary rules. The response is led by an integrated team including Cidasc, Mapa, the municipal government, Civil Police, and Icasa, aiming to prevent spread and preserve Brazil’s aviculture sanitary status.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病：サンタカタリーナ州での発生確認後、農務省（Mapa）が対策を更新
triage.triage_reason: 家禽(七面鳥)におけるニューカッスル病の発生であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への直接的影響は確認されていない。動物衛生・貿易管理上の対応が中心でWPRO基準もほぼ該当しない。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽疾患であり、ヒトへの感染は稀かつ軽症（結膜炎程度）。OIEへの通知や貿易相手国への情報共有は行われているが、これは動物衛生上の措置であり、公衆衛生危機としての基準には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Вирус лихорадки Эбола проник в Кению
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus has penetrated Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Kenya has confirmed at least nine Ebola virus disease cases, with three deaths, per the Ministry of Health. Two of the deceased were close relatives of another patient, and one death followed a return from the Democratic Republic of Congo. Seven patients are being treated in two isolation wards. No signs of further spread are detected at this time. The first imported Ebola case and death in Kenya were confirmed in early October, marking the start of the current outbreak in the country. Surveillance continues, with laboratory confirmation of cases and reinforced infection prevention and control measures as authorities monitor for additional cases linked to this cluster.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがケニアに侵入
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでコンゴ民主共和国からの輸入例を発端としたエボラウイルス病のクラスター（9例、死亡3例、うち家族内感染含む）が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例はケニア国内での発症が主題であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。コンゴ民主共和国は患者の渡航歴として言及されているのみで、記事の主題（現地での発生）ではないため除外した。ただし輸入元としてDRCでの継続的なエボラ流行の存在が示唆されており、今後の情報更新（DRC側の発生状況）に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Records Second Ebola-Related Death
article.articleSummary: Kenya records its second Ebola-related death on Oct 24, 2026, as the regional outbreak that originated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues with cases in Uganda and Nigeria. A 65-year-old Kenyan woman, who had been in close contact with the first patient’s family, developed symptoms on Oct 13 while in quarantine. The Ministry of Health says the death toll in Kenya has risen to two among nine confirmed cases, with seven patients receiving care at two designated isolation facilities. All cases in Kenya are linked to a single outbreak cluster, with no evidence of community transmission. Kenya had reported its first confirmed case earlier in October—a man who travelled from the DRC to Nairobi and died at a hospital in the Kenyan capital on Oct 5. The country remains on high alert.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで2人目のエボラ関連死を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCを起源とする地域的エボラアウトブレイクがケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリアへ拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの死亡例増加だが、アウトブレイクの起源はDRCであり、ウガンダ・ナイジェリアへの拡大も報告されている。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。地域全体での感染拡大状況の継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nhiều người quan tâm tiêm vắc xin phòng não mô cầu sau thông tin ca bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many people are interested in meningococcal vaccination after reports of a case.
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal disease due to Neisseria meningitidis prompted heightened vaccination interest in Ho Chi Minh City (TP.HCM) after reports of a meningococcal cluster. Parents and youths, including a 17-year-old student and a 19-year-old university student, actively researched signs and preventive measures and sought vaccination; a 35-year-old parent with a 5-year-old child reviewed immunization history to arrange immunization. Clinicians warn meningococcal disease can progress rapidly, with initial symptoms resembling flu—fever, headache, fatigue, myalgia—and deterioration within hours, potentially causing meningitis or septicemia. Preventive actions include good hygiene, well-ventilated environments, avoiding close contact, and not sharing personal items; consult a physician to determine age-appropriate vaccines. Antibiotic prophylaxis is used for close contacts when indicated; vaccines provide active immunity for future exposures. Key vaccines include MenB (serogroup B) and MenACWY (A, C, Y, W). Vaccination at reputable centers is encouraged.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌感染症の症例報告後、ワクチン接種への関心が高まる
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市で髄膜炎菌感染症のクラスター発生が報告され、住民のワクチン接種への関心が急速に高まっている。重症化リスクのある疾患でヒト-ヒト感染の可能性もあり、社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はクラスター発生後の市民のワクチン接種需要増加を主題としており、具体的な症例数・死亡者数・感染経路などの詳細情報は不明。続報で感染規模や公衆衛生当局の対応を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Vuelos desde Cuba: exigirán declaración por ébola para viajar a Estados Unidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flights from Cuba: an Ebola declaration will be required to travel to the United States.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola declaration will be required for all passengers from Cuba traveling to the United States, effective November 3, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET. The rule covers flights from any foreign country landing in the United States, including layovers, and doesn't apply to Cuban-to-non-U.S. routes without U.S. landings. Each passenger must sign a declaration that they have not been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in the past 21 days; the 21-day period counts layovers in DRC, with departure day as day zero. Airlines must verify declarations before boarding; digital or paper forms are acceptable. U.S. citizens and permanent residents face the same requirement. Exemptions are limited, and citizenship does not automatically grant one. Airlines must retain declarations for 42 days. The order remains in effect until December 18, 2026, unless amended, with extensions. The declaration does not replace immigration documents, medical testing, or vaccination requirements.

triage.headline_ja: キューバからの便:米国渡航にはエボラに関する申告が義務化へ
triage.triage_reason: 米国がコンゴ民主共和国(DRC)でのエボラ発生を理由に、外国発の全便乗客に申告義務を課す渡航制限措置を導入しており、IHR基準の複数（重大な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大・渡航制限）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで発生中のエボラ流行に対する米国の渡航制限（キューバ発便を含む）に関するものであり、実際の発生地はDRCのみ。米国・キューバは政策対応国であり発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: WHO begins Ebola vaccine trial in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: WHO has launched the Tumaini Ebola vaccine trial in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province city Bunia, amid the Bundibugyo-strain outbreak (declared May 15, 2026; PHEIC). The first participants were vaccinated in Bunia. Tumaini will assess safety, immune response, and effectiveness of vaccine candidates against Bundibugyo virus, for which no vaccine is approved. The Ervebo vaccine (licensed for the Zaire strain) will be tested for cross-protection, while the Everbo vaccine will also be evaluated. Two additional candidates—Moderna and a University of Oxford–Serum Institute of India collaboration—are to join the study. The trial employs a ring vaccination approach, targeting contacts of confirmed cases and other high-risk individuals. As of Oct 21, the DRC had 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths. Results will not imply immediate efficacy and are led by Congolese authorities with WHO support.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチン治験を開始
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクで、症例9,552人・死亡4,602人と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 既にPHEIC宣言されている既知のアウトブレイクに対するワクチン治験開始の続報記事。アウトブレイク自体は既存事案だが、死亡者数・症例数の規模から引き続き高リスク事案としてフルRRA対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya ghi nhận ca t‌ử von‌g thứ hai do Ebola, tăng cường kiểm soát dịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records its second Ebola-related death, steps up disease control measures.
article.articleSummary: Kenya records its second Ebola-related death, with 9 confirmed cases and 2 fatalities; seven patients remain in two isolation facilities, and authorities report no evidence of community transmission. The latest victim is a 65-year-old woman who had close contact with the first Kenyan case, the country’s third confirmed infection. Symptoms began on 13 Oct during quarantine; she died on 23 Oct after transfer to Nairobi’s infectious-disease facility. All infections are linked to the initial case, with 135 contacts identified, including four family members and four healthcare workers among eight subsequent cases. The first case involved a man who returned from Congo via Uganda; he arrived in Nairobi on 3 Oct and died on 5 Oct. WHO data as of 20 Oct show Congo with 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths (≈48% CFR). Since May 2026, related cases have appeared in Uganda, France, Kenya, and Nigeria. Ebola virus Bundibugyo; no licensed vaccine or specific treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ関連の2人目の死者を確認、感染対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模流行（致死率約48%）が続く中、ウガンダ・フランス・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の全項目該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ発の輸入例によるケニアでの二次感染拡大だが、ケニア・ウガンダ・フランス・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。流行の震源地であるDRCの状況（致死率約48%、9,704症例）が国際的拡大の根拠となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ebola se extinde în alte două ţări africane. Experţii evaluează riscul pentru Uniunea Europeană
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic is spreading to two other African countries. Experts assess the risk to the European Union.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-virus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has spread to Kenya and Nigeria via imported cases. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) assesses very low risk to the European Union, including Romania, while urging preparedness. In Kenya, nine cases have been confirmed, including one death; the index patient traveled from the DRC via Uganda. The remaining eight are contacts—four family members and four healthcare workers—under quarantine at symptom onset, with no evidence of transmission outside this group. In Nigeria, one imported case was confirmed in Abuja from Uganda; the patient is isolated and 44 contacts are monitored. WHO data up to Oct 20 report 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths in the DRC (CFR ~48%), across 66 zones in eight provinces; transmission continues. Bundibugyo Ebola has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment; control relies on rapid case finding, isolation, contact tracing, and supportive care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がアフリカの他の2カ国に拡大。専門家は欧州連合へのリスクを評価
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,704症例・CFR約48%の大規模アウトブレイクが継続し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的な感染拡大（渡航関連の輸入症例）が確認されており、IHR基準複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアは輸入症例の発生国だが対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。アウトブレイクの主体はDRCであり、同国が継続的な感染源となっている。

article.articleHeadline: CDC Tightens Screening as Record Ebola Outbreak Hits New Country
article.articleSummary: CDC tightens screening as record Ebola outbreak spreads from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri and Nord-Kivu epicenters) to Uganda, Kenya, Nigeria, and France. The Bundibugyo strain has caused 9,581 confirmed cases and 4,605 deaths since May; DRC accounts for 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths. Kenya reports 8 cases, 1 death; Uganda 20 confirmed, 1 probable, 2 deaths, 1 probable; France 1 imported case; Nigeria an imported case reported October 20. No vaccine or treatment exists. To curb US risk, starting November 3 all international travelers must attest they have not visited the DRC in the prior 21 days; airlines must verify before boarding; noncompliant passengers refused, with a 42-day record retention. Ituri and Nord-Kivu are level-4 travel notices; Haut-Uélé and Tshopo level-3; other DRC and Uganda level-2; Kenya level-1. Two American aid workers infected in the DRC; both treated in Germany; no US deaths.

triage.headline_ja: CDC、記録的なエボラ出血熱の流行が新たな国に拡大する中、スクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生した記録的規模のエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）がウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、フランスへ国際的に拡大しており、米国がCDCによる渡航制限措置を導入するなどIHR基準・WPRO基準の多数に該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、フランス、米国、ドイツも含まれるが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。アウトブレイクの主要発生国はDRC（Ituri、Nord-Kivu、Haut-Uélé、Tshopo）。

article.articleHeadline: Análisis muestran un vínculo genético entre el caso de ébola en Nigeria y un caso de Kenia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Analyses show a genetic link between the Ebola case in Nigeria and a case in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Genomic analyses show the Ebola virus detected in Nigeria’s confirmed case is genetically related to that identified in one of Kenya’s nine infections, though this does not prove direct transmission. The Nigerian case is an imported infection in Abuja, a Swiss citizen of Ugandan origin around 40, who returned from Uganda and is isolated under care; Swiss authorities say she did not recently visit the DRC. Kenya has nine cases linked to an index patient who arrived Oct 5 after living in the DRC; the man and another patient have died; seven others remain under care. All cases are from the same group; no community transmission yet. The DRC outbreak began May 15, affecting eight provinces, with 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths through Oct 20. Uganda’s outbreak ended Aug 26 (20 cases, 15 imported, 2 deaths). Bundibugyo strain has no specific treatment; vaccines are in early human trials.

triage.headline_ja: 分析により、ナイジェリアのエボラ症例とケニアの症例との間に遺伝的関連性があることが判明
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)がウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへ国際的に拡大しており、死亡例も多数発生。IHR基準を複数満たしフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はDRC由来のエボラ株がナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダへ国際的に拡散した事例の遺伝子解析。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダ・スイスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは5/15発生開始、8州で9,704例・4,687死亡（10/20時点）と大規模継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola scapă de sub control în Africa: aproape 4.700 de morți și mii de cazuri noi. Cât de mare este riscul ca virusul să ajungă în Europa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spirals out of control in Africa: nearly 4,700 deaths and thousands of new cases. How likely is the Ebola virus to reach Europe?
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spiraling in Central Africa and inching toward West Africa. The Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) hosts a major ongoing outbreak—the second-largest on record—driven by the Bundibugyo strain. Infections exceed 9,500 and deaths exceed 4,600 among residents and visitors; half of those infected have died. The outbreak is affecting Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Sud-Ubangi, Nord-Ubangi, and Tshopo provinces, and marks the 17th Ebola flare-up in the DRC. No approved treatments or vaccines exist for Bundibugyo. Nigeria has recorded its first imported case, with authorities attributing it to travel from Uganda and launching a crisis summit; the patient has 44 contacts. Kenya reports one patient; Uganda had 20 cases but declared no active cases by July; as of October there is concern for spread to West Africa and Europe is urged to stay vigilant. France reports one imported case.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ出血熱が制御不能に拡大：死者数約4,700人、新規症例数千件。ウイルスが欧州に到達するリスクはどの程度か
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目の規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが発生し、致死率約50%、ナイジェリア・ケニア・フランスへの越境感染例も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの大規模アウトブレイクを主題とし、ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダ・フランスへの輸入症例にも言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : lancement à Bunia de l'étude clinique du vaccin MATUMAINI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Launch in Bunia of the MATUMAINI vaccine's clinical trial.
article.articleSummary: In Bunia, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, the MATUMAINI Ebola vaccine clinical trial was officially launched on Oct 23, 2026, for six months and enrolling people who have had contact with Ebola patients under voluntary participation. MATUMAINI means "hope" in Swahili and aims to gather data on safety and immunogenicity for vaccines against the Bundibugyo strain causing the current outbreak in DRC. Principal investigator Dr. Hugo Kavunga said the study will evaluate several vaccine candidates targeting this Ebola lineage. Governor Gaby Kasongo Mulumba urged community leaders to raise awareness, counter rumors, and foster dialogue with health teams to facilitate voluntary participation and research activities. Separately, another study in Ituri uses the ERVEBO vaccine, designed against the Zaire strain, in the Bundibugyo outbreak context. Together, these efforts seek effective countermeasures against this Ebola strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:ブニアでMATUMAINIワクチンの臨床試験開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行を背景としたワクチン臨床試験開始の報道であり、既知の進行中アウトブレイクへの対応状況に関する情報。新規の異常事態ではないため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに対するワクチン臨床試験（MATUMAINI、ERVEBO）開始に関する内容であり、新規発生や症例数・死亡者数などの疫学情報は含まれていない。既存アウトブレイクの対応策として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Falso allarme Ebola a Palermo: paziente isolato, diagnosi in poche ore
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: False Ebola alarm in Palermo: patient isolated, diagnosis within a few hours.
article.articleSummary: False Ebola alarm in Palermo: A patient arriving from Congo with high fever at Palermo’s Civico hospital triggered the Ebola protocol, treated as an imported case. The man was isolated in the infectious diseases unit and blood drawn. The sample, handled in biocontainment, was transported by the 118 helicopter to Rome for microbiological testing, which within hours ruled out Ebola. The incident followed the regional Health Department’s organized response, and comes after a summer in which a group of Sicilian healthcare workers was trained to confront similar scenarios. No Ebola case was confirmed; the episode highlights rapid triage, isolation, and confirmatory testing to prevent unnecessary alarm and protect public health.

triage.headline_ja: パレルモでエボラの誤報：患者を隔離、数時間で診断
triage.triage_reason: イタリア・パレルモでのエボラ疑い患者はコンゴからの渡航者だが、検査の結果エボラは否定された誤報であり、実際の感染拡大や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイタリア（パレルモ・ローマ）での誤報事例であり、コンゴ（DRC）は患者の渡航元として言及されているのみで、同国内での発生事例ではないため verified_locations には含めない。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: OMS anuncia início de primeiro estudo clínico de vacina contra o Ebola no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization announces the start of the first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO announces the first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain driving the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. First participants were vaccinated with Ervebo (Zaire strain) in Bunia, Ituri Province, as researchers assess potential cross-protection against Bundibugyo. The DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, declared in May, is the worst in the country’s history with over 9,700 cases and more than 4,600 deaths; the World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The outbreak has spread to Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. The Tumaini trial advances to its second phase to evaluate safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity of two Bundibugyo-targeted vaccine candidates: Oxford University’s ChAdOx1 adenoviral vaccine and Moderna’s mRNA vaccine, funded by CEPI, including the World Economic Forum, the Indian and Norwegian governments, and the Gates Foundation. The study will enroll pregnant women and children aged 12 and older to determine protection for high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴでのエボラワクチン初の臨床試験開始を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は過去最悪規模（症例9,700超、死亡4,600超）でPHEICが宣言されており、複数国への拡大も確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）とワクチン臨床試験（Tumaini試験）に関するもの。発生地域にはナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアも含まれるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia anuncia una segunda muerte por ébola en el país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya announces a second Ebola death in the country.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a second Ebola death among nine confirmed cases, all within a contact cluster and with no evidence of community transmission. The 65-year-old woman, the third confirmed case, was a direct family contact of the first patient; she developed symptoms on 13 October 2026 and died on 23 October after treatment in an infectious diseases unit. The index case is a 40-year-old Kenyan who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and traveled by road via Kampala to Nairobi, arriving 3 October and dying 5 October. Seven other patients remain in two isolation facilities. The DRC’s Bundibugyo outbreak began in May and affects eight provinces; as of 20 October, 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths. Uganda reported 20 cases (15 imported) and two deaths; the outbreak has ended (26 August). Cases linked to Nigeria, the Netherlands, and France. Vaccines are in early human trials; no specific treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、国内で2人目のエボラ出血熱による死亡を発表
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでのエボラ死亡例の背景にDRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（9,704症例・4,687死亡）があり、国境を越えた拡大が確認されているためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる話題はケニアでの死亡例だが、感染源であるDRCのBundibugyo株アウトブレイク（5月発生、8州に拡大、9,704症例・4,687死亡）が詳細に記述されており対象国として含めた。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・オランダ・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تفشى إيبولا فى 66 منطقة فى الكونغو وإصابة 9704 أشخاص
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization reports Ebola outbreak in 66 regions of the Congo, with 9,704 people infected.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has expanded, with imported cases reported in Kenya and Nigeria and ongoing widespread transmission within DRC. Since the last update on 8 October 2026, the outbreak has grown to 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths, yielding a case fatality rate of 48.3%, across 66 health zones in 8 provinces. The high local mortality continues to reflect challenges in early detection and timely, appropriate care. As of 20 October 2026, transmission remains active inside the DRC, while Kenya and Nigeria report imported cases. The World Health Organization continues to monitor and report on the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola (BVD).

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、コンゴで66地域にエボラ流行拡大、感染者9,704人と報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が66保健地域に拡大し、致死率48.3%、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの輸出例も確認されており、深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクともに該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRC国内の流行拡大が主題。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشى إيبولا فى 66 منطقة فى الكونغو وإصابة 9704 أشخاص - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola outbreak in 66 regions of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 9,704 people infected - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has expanded to 66 health zones across 8 provinces, with 9,704 laboratory-confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths (case fatality 48.3%) reported through Oct 20, 2026. The mortality burden remains highest in communities, with 307 community deaths and 175 deaths in treatment centers since the previous update, underscoring challenges in early detection and timely care. Kenya confirmed its first laboratory-confirmed imported BVD case on Oct 6, 2026, in a traveler from DRC via Uganda; by Oct 20, Kenya had 9 Ebola cases (1 death), with eight others being known contacts and no evidence of sustained community transmission. Nigeria reported an imported case in Abuja from Uganda on Oct 20, 2026, currently isolated and under investigation to assess travel history and infection source. WHO advises against travel or trade restrictions and emphasizes border surveillance and cross-border preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が66地域に拡大、感染者9,704人
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）が66地域・8州に拡大し致死率48.3%に達しており、既にケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境感染例も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダは越境感染事例として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOは渡航・貿易制限を推奨していないが、既に複数国で越境感染が確認されており国際拡大リスクはYesと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola si v Keni vyžiadala druhú obeť, nové prípady zatiaľ nepribudli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has claimed a second victim in Kenya; no new cases have been reported yet.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Kenya has recorded a second Ebola death. A 65-year-old woman, a close relative of the first patient, developed symptoms during quarantine and died Friday evening in Nairobi after treatment in the infectious diseases department. Seven other Ebola patients remain in two isolation facilities; no new cases have been reported. Kenya's first case was a 40-year-old Kenyan who had lived in the DRC and traveled to Kenya via Uganda in early October; he died the same day he was confirmed. Authorities identified about 135 contacts of the first patient; 118 are in quarantine, and eight infections were confirmed during quarantine—four health workers and four close relatives. Beginning Saturday, some asymptomatic contacts who complete a 21-day quarantine will be released. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated objects. The DRC has the highest death toll, at least 4,000 since May.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、ケニアで2人目の死者が発生。新規症例は今のところ確認されず
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで国境を越えたエボラ出血熱の伝播が確認され、死亡例・濃厚接触者の隔離が継続中であり、IHR基準の複数（重大性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのエボラ出血熱発生であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。DRCは感染源・背景情報として言及されているのみで記事の主題ではないため除外した。ただし事象自体は国際的拡大を伴う重大な公衆衛生イベントであるためPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: 'Tumaini' Ebola vaccine trial starts as Kenya seeks 10,000 doses
article.articleSummary: DRC Bunia hosts the TUMAINI Ebola vaccine trial targeting Bundibugyo virus, with first participants vaccinated in Bunia, DR Congo. There is no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo virus; the Ervebo vaccine (Zaire ebolavirus) will be tested as part of the effort, but its effectiveness against Bundibugyo remains uncertain. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the trial will assess whether candidate vaccines can protect against Bundibugyo virus disease and generate evidence to help contain the outbreak. The World Health Organization is supporting the DRC-led initiative to generate life-saving data. Kenya seeks 10,000 vaccine doses for frontline healthcare workers via Africa CDC and WHO to bolster outbreak response. The vaccine trial name TUMAINI is Swahili for 'hope'. Findings will determine whether any candidates offer protection against Bundibugyo virus.

triage.headline_ja: 『トゥマイニ』エボラワクチン治験開始、ケニアは1万回分の確保を目指す
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyoウイルス型エボラのアウトブレイクに対するワクチン治験が開始され、WHOやAfrica CDCが関与する国際的対応が進行中であり、公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的関心の高さからフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・ブニアでのBundibugyoウイルス型エボラワクチン治験に関するもの。ケニアはワクチン確保を目指す立場であり発生国ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Falso allarme Ebola a Palermo: paziente isolato, diagnosi fatta in poche ore - ilSicilia.it
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: False Ebola Alarm in Palermo: Patient Isolated, Diagnosis Made Within a Few Hours - ilSicilia.it
article.articleSummary: False Ebola alarm in Palermo after a patient arriving from the Congo with high fever triggered Ebola protocols at the Civico hospital. The health department's response unit intercepted the case, the patient was isolated in the infectious diseases ward, and a blood sample was taken. Following protocol, the sample was placed in biocontainment and transported by the 118 helicopter to Rome for microbiological testing, which within a few hours ruled out Ebola. A Sicilian medical team had been trained during the summer to manage similar events. No confirmed Ebola case; ongoing preparedness measures in Sicily. The episode underlines Sicily's readiness for imported infections, with rapid isolation, biocontainment transport, and centralized laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: パレルモでエボラ出血熱の誤報：患者を隔離、数時間で診断確定 - ilSicilia.it
triage.triage_reason: イタリア・パレルモで疑われたエボラ出血熱は検査により否定され、実際の感染事例は確認されていない。コンゴ民主共和国での発生を示す情報もない。
triage.notes: 疑い患者はコンゴ民主共和国からの渡航者だが、記事の主題はイタリア（パレルモ）での誤報対応であり、検査でエボラは否定された。DRCでの実際の発生を示す記述はないため対象国として計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Why China and Pakistan Need a Cross-Border Animal Disease Notification Protocol
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease SAT1 outbreaks loom across China–Pakistan borders. Pakistan’s Punjab province reported FMD signals on Oct 17, with officials pledging zero tolerance for reporting delays. The cross-border gap is acute: formal WOAH reporting requires 24-hour notification but relies on a country’s detection and willingness to disclose. Iraq detected SAT1 in Jan 2025; by May 2025 it appeared in the WOAH database, and by Mar 2026 Iran was affected, with Pakistan and Afghanistan deemed likely entries—risk peaking around Eid al-Adha. Pakistan’s dairy sector had urged faster vaccine development since vaccines cover only serotypes O, A, Asia-1. In China, SAT1 outbreaks emerged in Xinjiang and Gansu by late March 2026, prompting culling, tighter border controls, and emergency vaccine approval. Vietnam warned of very high entry risk in April due to illegal movements. The piece advocates a China–Pakistan cross-border notification protocol to accelerate data sharing, complementing vaccines and trade, noting existing accords lack operational triggers.

triage.headline_ja: 中国とパキスタンに必要な越境動物疾患通知プロトコル
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫(FMD)SAT1系統が中国・パキスタン等で越境拡大しているが、家畜疾患であり人への直接的な公衆衛生影響は記載されておらず、ヒト感染症としての重症度情報も不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: FMD(口蹄疫)は家畜疾患であり、本記事は動物衛生・貿易リスクの観点から越境通知プロトコルの必要性を論じている。パキスタン・イラク・イラン・アフガニスタン・ベトナムも言及されるが、対象国リストに含まれるのは中国（新疆・甘粛）のみ。人への感染報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は現時点で確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: A plecat în vacanță în Asia, dar nu s-a mai întors acasă. O turistă de 24 de ani a murit după o înțepătură de țânțar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: She went on vacation in Asia, but never returned home. A 24-year-old female tourist died after a mosquito bite.
article.articleSummary: A 24-year-old French tourist, Inès, died from Japanese encephalitis contracted during a Southeast Asia trip planned to include Cambodia and Thailand. The viral disease, transmitted by mosquitoes, affects the brain and can cause fever, headache, confusion, seizures, and permanent neurological damage or death in severe cases. Inès’s condition worsened in Bangkok, Thailand, after weeks of treatment, and she was repatriated to France in a brain-dead state, dying shortly after arrival at the University Hospital of Nice. Her parents used social media to raise awareness and urge better pre-travel health information for Asia-bound travelers. The article notes that there is a vaccine for Japanese encephalitis; vaccination recommendations depend on destination, duration, and activities, and some countries mandate vaccination, France does not.

triage.headline_ja: アジア旅行に出かけたが、帰国できなかった。24歳の女性観光客が蚊に刺されて死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一のフランス人観光客の日本脳炎による死亡例であり、タイ・カンボジアは同疾患の流行地域として既知で、アウトブレイクや異常な増加を示す情報はない。ヒト-ヒト感染もなく公衆衛生上の深刻な拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は単発の個人症例報告であり、カンボジアは訪問予定地として言及されるのみで実際の感染地ではない可能性がある。タイ・バンコクで症状が悪化し治療を受けたため、発症地としてタイを計上。ワクチン接種の重要性を啓発する内容が中心で、公衆衛生上の新規アウトブレイクを示唆する情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يتفشى في 66 منطقة بالكونغو وإصابة 9704 أشخاص
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads across 66 regions in Congo, infecting 9,704 people.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, Ebola virus disease caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with 9,704 laboratory-confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths across 66 health zones in 8 provinces (case fatality 48.3%). Of 482 new deaths reported since the last update, 307 occurred in communities and 175 in treatment centers. Kenya reported its first imported Bundibugyo case on 6 October 2026; by 20 October there were 9 cases (1 death), with eight known contacts and no current evidence of wider community transmission; the index case traveled from the DRC via Uganda. Nigeria also reported an imported case in Abuja from Uganda; the patient is in isolation pending further investigations into travel history and possible infection source. WHO emphasizes sustained preparedness and border surveillance and advises against travel or trade restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴで66地域に拡大、感染者9,704人
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,704症例・致死率48.3%の大規模エボラ流行が継続し、既にケニア・ナイジェリアへ国際的な症例輸出が発生しているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアへの輸入症例が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHOは渡航・貿易制限を推奨しないとしているが、国際的拡大の実績があるためリスクは継続的に監視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: " Si la souche Bundibugyo avait frappé des pays occidentaux, les vaccins seraient déjà disponibles " (Jean Kaseya, Africa CDC)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: If the Bundibugyo strain had struck Western countries, vaccines would already be available
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak expands to three African regions. By 23 October 2026, the DRC reports >9,700 confirmed cases and 4,690 deaths, with Ituri, North Kivu, and Haut-Uélé hardest hit. Nigeria reports its first Bundibugyo case since 2014, detected 20 October in Abuja in a traveler from Uganda; 44 close contacts identified. Kenya records nine cases and one death in Nairobi among contacts of a traveler from DRC; Uganda remains at 20 cases with two deaths. Africa CDC will convene a virtual ministerial meeting on 28 October to coordinate response and seek emergency funding for Nigeria and support for DRC and Kenya; no vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo yet. Ervebo against Zaire strain is used only under a research protocol; several Bundibugyo vaccines are in early trials. Africa CDC collaborates with an Egyptian manufacturer to accelerate development; priorities: continental vaccine production, international coordination, and domestic financing. AU also approved a continental health data governance framework, to be finalized by Africa CDC in 2027.

triage.headline_ja: 「ブンディブギョ株が西側諸国を襲っていたら、ワクチンはすでに利用可能だっただろう」（ジャン・カセヤ、アフリカCDC）
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ株エボラ流行（9,700例超、死亡4,690人）がナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダに拡大し、ワクチン・治療薬が存在せずアフリカCDCが緊急閣僚会議を招集するなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当し社会的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCのみ対象国として該当。ワクチン・治療薬が未確立である点、国際的な緊急資金調達・会合招集が進行中である点から、フルリスク評価が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: У Кенії троє людей померли від Еболи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three people died of Ebola in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports at least nine Ebola cases and three deaths as of Oct 24, 2026. Two of the deceased were close relatives; a third died after returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo.
