Seven patients are hospitalized in two isolation units; no signs of further spread at present. Earlier in October, Kenya confirmed its first imported Ebola case and death: a man who had lived in the DRC for seven years, infected with the Bundibugyo strain. The DRC outbreak, declared May 15, 2026, is the deadliest in the country’s history, with spillovers in Uganda and South Sudan; globally, over 9,700 cases and about 4,700 deaths. Bundibugyo Ebola virus causes a highly lethal disease with about 90% fatality, transmitted from wildlife and between people via contact with blood, secretions, and contaminated surfaces. Early symptoms include sudden fever, weakness, muscle and headache, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, kidney and liver dysfunction, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラにより3人死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで宣言された史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（致死率約90%、9700例超・死亡4700人超）がウガンダ・南スーダンに続きケニアにも拡大し、現地で死者が発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの感染例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。流行の震源地であるDRCは対象国に含まれるため記載。ウガンダ・南スーダン・ケニアは対象国リスト外のため含めない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: بدء التجارب على لقاحين لفيروس إيبولا للتأكد من فعاليتهما - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Trials begin on two Ebola vaccines to determine their effectiveness - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola vaccine candidates have begun efficacy trials in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to determine protection against the Bundibugyo strain driving the outbreak there. World Health Organization Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the first participants have been vaccinated in the new study. There is currently no vaccine approved specifically for Bundibugyo. The trial will evaluate the two candidate vaccines for protection against this strain, while Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV-GP), the first globally licensed Ebola vaccine and WHO prequalified for prevention, will also be tested for use against Bundibugyo in the ongoing Congo outbreak. Led by the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the initiative seeks to establish vaccine effectiveness to save lives as the outbreak continues, with infections reported in Kenya and Nigeria.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラウイルスワクチン2種の有効性確認のための試験開始 - ユーム7
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクがケニア・ナイジェリアへ拡大したと報告されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWHOの関与による社会的関心の高さからフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事ではケニアおよびナイジェリアでの感染報告にも言及しているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。主たる発生国はDRCであり、Bundibugyo株に対する承認済みワクチンが存在しない点が特記事項。

article.articleHeadline: V Kongu testujú vakcínu proti ebole. Epidémia si vyžiadala tisíce obetí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Congo they are testing an Ebola vaccine. The epidemic has claimed thousands of victims.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo began the first clinical trial of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine in Bunia, capital of Ituri Province in the northeast, to assess protection against the Bundibugyo strain, for which no vaccine or treatment exists yet. The outbreak has claimed over 4,600 lives and more than 9,700 cases. The trial uses ring vaccination among contacts at high risk. Two vaccines specifically targeting Bundibugyo will be included: an adenoviral-vector vaccine from the University of Oxford and an mRNA vaccine from Moderna, both backed by CEPI. Pregnant women and children aged 12 and older will participate. WHO emergency director Chikwe Ihekweazu called the milestone significant; efficacy against Bundibugyo could alter outbreak response and preparedness for future hotspots. Ebola spreads via bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever; DRC declared its 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15, and WHO followed with a PHEIC two days later.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラワクチンの治験開始。流行は数千人の犠牲者を出している
triage.triage_reason: DRCでPHEIC宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行（死者4,600人超、症例9,700超）であり、新規変異株（ブンディブギョ株）への対応も含め国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 既にWHOがPHEICを宣言済みの進行中の大規模流行。ブンディブギョ株に対するワクチン治験（Ervebo、Oxford社、Moderna社製）が開始されたという続報的内容だが、流行自体が既にPICKUP相当の重大事案。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Opens Tumaini Trial to Test Ebola Vaccines Against Bundibugyo | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: DRC opens Tumaini trial to test Ebola vaccines against Bundibugyo virus amid an Ituri province outbreak, with vaccinations already in Bunia as WHO supports the initiative. The study aims to assess safety, effectiveness, and immune response for multiple vaccine candidates, beginning with Ervebo (approved for Zaire ebolavirus). WHO notes no proven protection against Bundibugyo yet. The trial vaccinates contacts of Ebola cases at elevated risk, enrolling pregnant women and children aged 12 and older. CEPI funds two Bundibugyo-specific candidates from the University of Oxford and Moderna, expected to join Tumaini soon. The outbreak was declared in May, with over 9,700 cases and more than 4,600 deaths reported; WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、ブンディブギョ株に対するエボラワクチンを試験する「トゥマイニ治験」を開始
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言した大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行であり、症例9,700人超・死亡4,600人超と深刻な公衆衛生インパクトを伴うため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOは2026年5月にブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行をPHEICとして宣言済み。記事に登場する英国（Oxford大学）は資金提供・研究協力のみで発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: DRC launches Ebola vaccine trial as death toll tops 4,600 - Malawi24
article.articleSummary: DRC's worst Ebola outbreak on record has over 9,700 cases and more than 4,600 deaths as of 2026-10-24. The first clinical vaccine trial began in Bunia, Ituri province, with an initial Ervebo dose (Zaire strain) under the Tumaini protocol to test cross-protection against Bundibugyo virus, the outbreak driver with no approved vaccines. Tumaini uses a ring vaccination design, immunising high-risk contacts of confirmed cases, to evaluate safety, efficacy and immunogenicity of multiple candidates. Two Bundibugyo-specific candidates are to join: a ChAdOx1 jab from Oxford and a Moderna mRNA vaccine, funded by CEPI. Pregnant women and children aged 12+ are included. If successful, this would yield the first clear evidence of vaccine efficacy against Bundibugyo and transform outbreak response. Ebola spreads via bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever; the DRC declared its 17th outbreak on May 15, with WHO PHEIC declared shortly afterward.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、死者4,600人を超える中エボラワクチン治験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで記録上最悪のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（症例9,700超、死者4,600超）が継続中であり、WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。新規ワクチン治験開始という動きもあり、国際的関心・支援の必要性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: WHOにより本アウトブレイクはPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として宣言済み。Bundibugyo株に対する承認済みワクチンが存在しない点が特に懸念材料。CEPI、Oxford、Modernaなど国際機関・企業が治験に関与しており、国際的な支援体制がすでに構築されている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Uganda bars travellers with recent DRC travel history from transiting
article.articleSummary: Uganda bars travellers with recent Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) travel history from transiting as Nigeria confirms the first imported Bundibugyo virus disease (Ebola) case linked to Uganda. The Nigerian patient, a woman who traveled from Uganda to Abuja on Oct 20, tested positive; investigators seek infection source and onset, while Uganda says there was no local transmission and she was asymptomatic when leaving Uganda. Uganda tightens screening at entry/exit points, reinstates locator forms for all arrivals, and strengthens infection prevention and control at borders and health facilities, warning violations under the Public Health Act. Uganda remains Ebola-free and urges calm and compliance with screening. The DRC outbreak, declared May 2026, has over 9,500 confirmed cases and more than 4,600 deaths; Kenya reports 9 cases and 2 deaths as of Oct 23, with all cases in a single cluster and no wider community transmission; the index case transited Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国からの渡航歴がある旅行者の通過を禁止
triage.triage_reason: DRCで宣言されたエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクが既にナイジェリア・ケニアへ国際的に拡大しており、IHR4基準すべてに該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアが含まれるが、いずれも対象国リストには含まれないため除外。根本的なアウトブレイク発生国であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。国境を越えた二次感染（ナイジェリア、ケニア）の発生は国際的拡大の重大な兆候であり、WHO通知基準に該当する可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Врачи выявили девять случаев лихорадки Эбола в Кении
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors identified nine cases of Ebola fever in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Nine Ebola virus disease cases have been identified in Kenya, with three fatalities and seven patients still receiving care in two isolation wards, according to Kenya's Ministry of Health via EFE. Two deaths were among close relatives; one patient died after returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The first Ebola death in this cluster was confirmed in early October; the patient was a man who had lived seven years in the DRC and died two days after returning home. The World Health Organization and partners are coordinating regional containment as the DRC outbreak—declared on May 15—has spread to Uganda and South Sudan. Globally, authorities have reported over 9,700 cases and about 4,700 deaths. No signs of further spread within Kenya were reported by officials.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱の症例9件を医師が確認
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクがウガンダ・南スーダンに続きケニアにも拡大し、死亡例を伴う国際的拡散が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの症例確認だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。発端となったDRCでのアウトブレイク（2026年5月15日宣言、ウガンダ・南スーダンへ拡大中）が主題の一部であるためDRCのみ記載。グローバルで9,700例以上、約4,700人死亡と報告されており、重大な国際的懸念事案。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya records second Ebola death as outbreak reaches nine cases
article.articleSummary: Nine confirmed Ebola cases and two deaths are reported in Kenya as of 24 October 2026. The latest victim, a 65-year-old woman, is a close relative of the first patient and died while in treatment after developing symptoms on 13 October during quarantine. Seven others are in two isolation facilities; all eight secondary cases are linked to the first imported case, with no evidence of wider community transmission. The first patient, a Kenyan man who had resided in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, traveled to Nairobi via Uganda on 3 October and died on 5 October after treatment in the DRC; a safe burial followed. Kenya has strengthened border screening and health declarations for travelers from DRC, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Burundi, Angola, Zambia, Ethiopia, South Sudan and the Central African Republic, and is enforcing quarantine, isolation and contact tracing to limit spread.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで2人目のエボラ死亡者、感染確認は9例に達する
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による死亡例を含む確定症例がケニアで報告され、複数国での国境対策強化が行われていることから、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限リスクが認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 最初の患者はDRC在住歴があり同国で治療後死亡したが、記事の主題は『ケニアでのアウトブレイク』であり、DRC自体でのエボラ発生を報じるものではない。対象国リストにケニアが含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。DRC、ウガンダ等複数国の国境警戒強化は地域的拡大懸念を示す重要情報として特記。

article.articleHeadline: В Кении трое человек умерли от Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kenya, three people died of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Nine Ebola cases have been identified in Kenya, with three deaths. Two of the deceased were close relatives; a third died after returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo. Seven patients are receiving treatment in two isolation wards; no signs of further spread. In October, Kenya reported its first imported Ebola case: a man who spent seven years in DRC and died two days after returning home; he was infected with the Bundibugyo strain. The DRC declared the outbreak on May 15, described as the deadliest in the country’s history, with cases also reported in Uganda and South Sudan. Globally, the outbreak has surpassed 9,700 cases and about 4,700 deaths. Bundibugyo ebolavirus is associated with very high mortality (~90%). Transmission occurs from wildlife to humans and person-to-person via blood, secretions, contaminated surfaces. Symptoms: abrupt fever, weakness, headache, later vomiting, diarrhea, kidney and liver failure, bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱により3人死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRC発の史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が既にウガンダ・南スーダン・ケニアへ国際的に拡大しており、致死率の高いBundibugyo株による深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はケニア・ウガンダ・南スーダンへの拡大に言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。流行の起点であるDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: New Tumaini Ebola vaccine trial launches in Bunia as DRC struggles
article.articleSummary: New TUMAiNi Ebola vaccine trial launches in Bunia, Ituri Province, DRC, as the country battles the deadliest and fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in its history. The trial will evaluate candidate vaccines against Ebola caused by the Bundibugyo virus among contacts of confirmed cases. It is led by the National Institute for Biomedical Research (INRB) with technical, scientific, and logistical support from the World Health Organization. Since the outbreak was declared in mid-May, the DRC has confirmed more than 9,000 Ebola cases; neighboring Kenya has nine cases, Nigeria confirmed its first case this week, and Uganda was declared Ebola-free in August after reporting 20 cases. Ituri Governor Major General Kasongo Gaby called the launch a significant moment in mobilising resources and fighting the threat.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなTUMAiNiエボラワクチン治験、DRCが苦境の中ブニアで開始
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪・最速拡大のエボラ流行で9000人超の感染者を確認、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの国際的拡大も報告されておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダでの症例も報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCの流行は史上最悪規模で国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Тревожна връзка: ебола в Нигерия произхожда от същия щам като в Кения
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming link: Ebola in Nigeria originates from the same strain as in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Nigeria: Genomic analysis of the country’s sole confirmed case shows the virus is closely related to the strain identified in Kenya’s initial case, though authorities say this genetic link does not prove direct transmission between outbreaks. The Nigerian patient was a traveler who had visited Uganda; there is no confirmed secondary spread to date. Ongoing contact tracing and laboratory testing remain the main public health tools as investigators work to clarify the infection’s route to Nigeria. Uganda reports no current Ebola cases but intensifies border controls as part of a regional response: reintroduced traveler-tracking forms for all arrivals, and transit through Uganda is blocked for travelers who have visited the Democratic Republic of Congo. The situation highlights regional coordination, with the genetic link established but the exact transmission pathway in Nigeria still unknown.

triage.headline_ja: 警戒すべきつながり：ナイジェリアのエボラはケニアと同じ株に由来
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダにまたがるエボラウイルスの遺伝的関連が確認され、感染経路が不明なまま国境を越えた拡大懸念があるため、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダでのエボラ発生であり、DRCは渡航制限措置の文脈で言及されているのみで、DRC国内での発生事例ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。対象国リストに該当する発生国は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda bars travelers with DRC travel history from transiting to curb Ebola spread
article.articleSummary: Uganda bars travelers with Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) travel history from transiting through Uganda to curb Ebola spread, Oct 24, 2026. Health Ministry notes cases where travelers with DRC links transited Uganda and later tested positive—one on arrival in Nigeria, another in Kenya in early October. Under the new measures, all travelers must complete locator forms to facilitate contact tracing, with strengthened infection and control measures at entry/exit points and health facilities; nationwide surveillance continues. Unauthorized border crossings may be prosecuted, and communities are urged to report suspected crossings to aid screening and follow-up. Uganda remains Ebola-free. Previously, the country reported 20 confirmed Ebola cases and 2 deaths; the outbreak was declared over by WHO and the Africa CDC on Aug 27 after 42 days without a new case.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ拡散抑制のためコンゴ民主共和国からの渡航歴を持つ旅行者の通過を禁止
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ感染者がナイジェリア・ケニアで確認されるなど複数国への越境拡大が実際に発生しており、ウガンダが渡航制限措置を導入するなど国際的な公衆衛生対応が進行中であるため。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダは渡航者の二次感染確認地点だが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。発生源はDRCであり、同国のみを対象国として計上。

article.articleHeadline: بدء التجارب على لقاحين لفيروس إيبولا للتحقق من فعاليتهما
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trials begin for two Ebola vaccines to determine their efficacy.
article.articleSummary: Trials have begun in the Democratic Republic of Congo to evaluate the efficacy of two Ebola vaccines against the Bundibugyo strain, with the first participants already vaccinated. There is currently no licensed vaccine specifically for Bundibugyo, which has driven substantial spread within the DRC and has infected people in Kenya and Nigeria. The study will also test Ervebo, the first globally licensed Ebola vaccine prequalified by the WHO, to assess its effectiveness against Bundibugyo. The objective is to obtain regulatory approval to use Ervebo to prevent Bundibugyo outbreaks circulating in the DRC. Led by the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the initiative aims to determine vaccine performance to save lives in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに対する2種類のワクチンの有効性を検証する治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がケニア・ナイジェリアへも拡大しているとの記述があり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン治験開始の発表が主旨だが、ブンディブギョ株エボラがDRC国内で顕著に拡大し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへも感染者が出ているとの記述があるため国際拡大リスクを評価に反映。ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية بدء التجارب على لقاحين لفيروس إيبولا للتأكد من فعاليتهما
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization begins trials of two Ebola vaccines to determine their effectiveness
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization begins trials of two Ebola vaccines to assess effectiveness against Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The trial vaccINates the first participants; there is currently no licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo, which has driven significant transmission in the DRC, with infections reported in Kenya and Nigeria. Researchers will evaluate whether two vaccine candidates designed for Ebola can protect against Bundibugyo. Simultaneously, the existing vaccine Ervebo, the first globally licensed Ebola vaccine and WHO prequalified, will be tested for its use in preventing Bundibugyo in the Congo outbreak. The initiative, led by the Democratic Republic of the Congo, seeks to determine vaccine effectiveness and save lives.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、エボラウイルスワクチン2種の有効性確認のため臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスの感染拡大（ケニア・ナイジェリアへの波及報告あり）を受け、WHO主導でワクチン試験が開始されており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアでの感染報告は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ブンディブギョ型エボラには現在承認済みワクチンがなく、既存のErveboおよび新規候補2種の有効性評価が行われている点がリスク上重要。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda bars travelers with DRC travel history from transiting to curb Ebola spread
article.articleSummary: Uganda barred travelers with a history of travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) from transiting through Uganda to curb Ebola spread. The Health Ministry, on Oct 24, 2026, said the measure targets individuals with recent DRC travel to prevent cross-border transmission as Ebola is spreading rapidly in the DRC. The decision follows a case involving a traveler suspected of DRC travel who transited Uganda, with testing conducted by authorities. The report did not specify the test result. The policy aims to reduce potential importation of Ebola into Uganda by restricting transit through the country for those with DRC exposure. The action reflects ongoing concern about Ebola outbreaks in neighboring DRC and the use of travel controls as a public health response.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ拡大を抑制するためDRC渡航歴のある渡航者の通過を禁止
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ急速拡大とそれに伴う渡航制限措置はIHR基準の複数（深刻性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当し、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。主題はDRCでのエボラ拡大とそれに対するウガンダの渡航制限措置。

article.articleHeadline: AI Model Reads Chest Scans to Tell Fungal Infection and Tuberculosis Apart
article.articleSummary: In HIV/AIDS patients with pulmonary infection in Southeast Asia and southern China, distinguishing Talaromyces marneffei from Mycobacterium tuberculosis is difficult due to overlapping symptoms. A Nanning study enrolled 380 patients (2018–2025): 203 TB and 177 T. marneffei, with etiologic confirmation by Xpert MTB/RIF, culture, histopathology; fungal cases by microscopy, culture, or molecular testing. A three-model approach included: (1) clinical predictors—fever, CD4 count, platelets, hemoglobin, diabetes, hypertension; fungal cases had median CD4 17 vs 127 cells/μL; RF AUC 0.856. (2) radiomics on 1,561 features (11 retained) with XGBoost AUC 0.866. (3) a 2.5D deep-learning model using seven CT slices and ResNet-18, achieving slice AUC 0.865 and patient-level AUC 0.885 (MIL strategies; SVM on aggregated features). The fusion model reached test-set AUC 0.931 and specificity 0.981. Grad-CAM visualizations showed network attention in representative cases.

triage.headline_ja: AIモデルが胸部CT画像から真菌感染症と結核を鑑別
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はHIV患者における真菌感染症と結核を鑑別するAI診断モデルに関する研究報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な発生を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 研究は診断技術の開発に関するものであり、アウトブレイクや新規の公衆衛生事象の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 63-year-old man dies of scrub typhus in Sundargarh
article.articleSummary: 63-year-old Harihar Patta of Ujjwalpur village, Tangarpali block, Sundargarh district, Odisha, died of scrub typhus after a mite bite while working in the fields. He developed illness, was brought to Sargipali Community Health Centre, then referred to Sundargarh for advanced treatment, and died around 1:00 PM on Friday. Laboratory tests confirmed scrub typhus positivity. The Health Department remains vigilant on scrub typhus; however, CDMO Suresh Chandra Mohanty stated he has not yet received formal information about the case. No details on additional cases or broader outbreaks are provided. Infection source: mite bite in an agricultural setting; the article confirms a lab-confirmed diagnosis of scrub typhus.

triage.headline_ja: 63歳男性がサンダルガル県でツツガムシ病により死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単発の死亡例であり、ダニ媒介性の風土病として既知の疾患。アウトブレイクや異常な拡大の兆候はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: ツツガムシ病はインド・オリッサ州で地域的に発生する風土病であり、本記事は単発の死亡例報告に留まる。保健当局も正式な報告を受けていない状況で、広域アウトブレイクの証拠はない。バングラデシュは記事本文で言及されておらず、発生地域リストに含まれるが主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Reports Second Ebola Death as Seven Patients Remain in Care | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second Ebola death in a Bundibugyo virus disease cluster. The Ministry of Health on Oct 23 confirmed nine cases within a single known-contact cluster, with seven patients still in care at two isolation facilities and no evidence of community transmission. The deceased is a 65-year-old woman; WHO identifies her as the virus’s third confirmed Kenyan case. She developed symptoms on Oct 13 while in quarantine and was moved to an infectious disease unit that day. The first confirmed patient—a man who returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo—died on Oct 5; the second death occurred Oct 23. Investigations traced 135 contacts as of Oct 22. The earliest monitored contacts are due to complete the 21-day observation period on Oct 25; those without symptoms may be released from quarantine if no new cases emerge.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラによる2人目の死亡を報告 ― 7人が治療継続中
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでDRC由来のエボラ(ブンディブギョウイルス)クラスターが発生し、死亡例が2名確認されており、IHR基準の複数(深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク)に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニア国内でのエボラ(ブンディブギョウイルス)クラスター発生であり、DRCは最初の患者の渡航歴として言及されているのみでDRC国内での流行は確認されていないため、対象国リストに含まれるDRCも含め verified_locations は空とした。ケニア自体は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل الوفاة الثانية بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records its second Ebola virus death
article.articleSummary: Kenya records its second Ebola-related death as of 24 October 2026, amid a Congo outbreak that has logged more than 9,000 confirmed infections and over 15,000 deaths since May. Uganda and Nigeria have also reported cases. The latest Kenyan fatality is a 65-year-old woman, a direct contact of the initial case, who developed symptoms on 13 October 2026 and was in isolation; fatalities rise to two among nine confirmed cases, with seven others in two isolation facilities and no evidence of community transmission. The first Kenyan case traced to travel from the DRC’s Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak; the man moved by land through Uganda and by air to Nairobi on 3 October. The United States warned against traveling to Kenya after eight cases were recorded. Nigeria’s single confirmed case’s virus is closely related to Kenya’s index case; Uganda remains Ebola-free since August but tightens borders. WHO notes a vaccine trial in Bunia named Tomaini and discusses the Ervebo vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラウイルスによる2人目の死者を記録
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国発のエボラアウトブレイクが9,000人超の感染・15,000人超の死亡に達し、ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアへ越境拡大、米国が渡航警告を発出するなど国際的関心が極めて高い深刻事案。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。発生源であるDRCのBundibugyoエボラウイルス株のアウトブレイクが本事案の中心であるためDRCのみ記載。死亡者数15,000超は極めて異例な規模であり、フルリスク評価が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Segona mort per Ebola a Kenya mentre l'epidèmia assola la RD del Congo - 3CatInfo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second Ebola death in Kenya as the epidemic ravages DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak extends from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to Kenya and Nigeria. Kenya confirms a second death: a 65-year-old woman who was a close contact of the first patient, with nine linked infections; authorities say spread is confined to that family cluster. Nigeria reports its first case, a diplomat from Uganda, who arrived in Abuja on October 7; 44 contacts identified and the patient is hospitalized, though multiorgan failure developed. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo the outbreak, declared May 15, spans eight provinces with 9,637 cases and 4,646 deaths (48.2%). Ituri accounts for about 75% of cases; North Ubangi borders the Central African Republic, hindering tracing. MSF warns that roughly one in four infected are children under five, with under-five mortality 60-70% and centers like Butembo above 80%; health facilities risk. Over 3.5 million people face extreme malnutrition due to disruption.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱による2人目の死者、コンゴ民主共和国では流行が猛威を振るう
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模流行（致死率48%超）に加え、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するため。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでの流行が本記事の主題であり、致死率48.2%、9,637症例、4,646死亡という深刻な状況。MSFは5歳未満児の死亡率60-70%と報告しており、人道危機（350万人が深刻な栄養不良）も併発。中央アフリカ共和国国境地域での追跡困難も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: संतकबीर नगर के बखिरा झील में उतरेंगे विदेशी परिंदे, बर्ड फ्लू के खतरे पर रहेगी नजर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Migratory birds to descend on Bakhira Lake in Sant Kabir Nagar; vigilance on avian influenza risk.
article.articleSummary: Bakhira Lake, a Ramsar site in Sant Kabir Nagar, Uttar Pradesh, faces avian influenza risk as migratory waterbirds arrive for winter. Uttar Pradesh expands avian influenza surveillance from 18 to 26 wetlands; Bakhira Lake inclusion is pending local confirmation. From September to March, monthly samples will be collected at each surveillance site to detect avian influenza during the migratory season, with extra attention to dead or abnormal birds. Immediate information sharing between the Forest Department and Animal Husbandry Department is emphasized. Monitoring, health checks, and sample collection will be coordinated by both departments, and samples of birds’ droppings are routinely sent to IBRI Bareilly for testing; no orders have been issued yet. If a dead or diseased bird is observed, do not touch or sample it and report to authorities for timely investigation and public health protection.

triage.headline_ja: サントカビールナガルのバキラ湖に渡り鳥飛来、鳥インフルエンザのリスクに警戒
triage.triage_reason: 現時点で鳥インフルエンザの実際の発生は確認されておらず、監視体制の拡充を伝える予防的な記事であるため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の感染事例ではなく、渡り鳥飛来シーズンに向けた予防的な監視体制強化（18か所から26湿地へ拡大）を報じるもの。鳥インフルエンザの確定症例は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda no permitirá el paso de personas que han viajado a la RD Congo por el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda will not allow entry of people who have traveled to DR Congo due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Uganda will not permit transit through its territory for travelers with a history of travel to the Democratic Republic of Congo amid Ebola outbreaks. The measure, enforceable under Public Health Law, includes reinstating traveler location forms, enhanced infection prevention at entry points and health facilities, and penalties for non-compliance, though porous borders may hinder enforcement. Nigeria reports a confirmed Ebola case—a Swiss citizen of Ugandan origin isolated in Abuja after returning from Uganda; she had no symptoms on departure, with ongoing investigations to determine symptom onset. Kenya has nine Ebola cases to date; the index patient, a Kenyan who lived in the DRC, died along with another patient, while seven remain in treatment. Genomic analyses link the Nigerian case to the Kenyan strain, though not proving direct transmission; AU notes possible cross-border movement at Entebbe airport. The DRC’s seventeenth Ebola outbreak affects eight provinces with 9,765 cases and 4,727 deaths (as of Oct 21). Related cases have been reported in the Netherlands and France. Uganda previously declared Ebola-free as of Aug 26.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ出血熱を理由にコンゴ民主共和国への渡航歴がある者の通過を許可せず
triage.triage_reason: DRCで第17次エボラ流行が進行中（9,765症例、4,727死亡）であり、ナイジェリア・ケニア・オランダ・フランスへの国際的な拡大が確認され、ウガンダが渡航制限を実施するなどIHR基準に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・ケニア・オランダ・フランスでの関連症例・渡航制限措置が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。アウトブレイクの主な発生源であるDRCのみを対象国として記載した。

article.articleHeadline: Cúm A tăng mạnh, bác sĩ cảnh báo nguy cơ biến chứng nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A surges, doctors warn of the risk of severe complications.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A surges in Hanoi, Vietnam, with weekly flu admissions around 200-300 cases and rising cases of pneumonia and respiratory failure. Severe influenza A is reported across hospitals, including the National Institute of Tuberculosis and Respiratory Diseases and Hanoi’s pediatric services. At Hanoi National Pediatric Hospital, influenza comprises about 50% of inpatients; around 100 children per day are tested for influenza, with 10-20% admitted. Thanh Nhàn Hospital reports a two-week surge, averaging about 20 flu admissions daily, with roughly 90% influenza A and 10% influenza B. Most inpatients are elderly with comorbidities (diabetes, hypertension, heart failure, COPD, asthma, kidney disease on dialysis) presenting pneumonia or respiratory failure. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, myalgia, and fatigue. Officials urge annual vaccination, hand hygiene, covering coughs, ventilated spaces, and early medical evaluation; avoid self-medicating with antibiotics. Severe cases require close respiratory monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型が急増、医師が重症合併症のリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの季節的増加であり、重症例や入院増加は見られるが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等IHR基準には該当しない。ハノイでの状況として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの流行であり、基礎疾患を持つ高齢者を中心に重症化例が報告されているが、新型株や異常な病原性変化の情報はない。ベトナム国内の医療機関からの報告にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: ಮಳೆಗಾಲದ ಜ್ವರ ಲಘುವಾಗಿ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಡಿ: ಒಂದೇ ಲಕ್ಷಣದ ಹಿಂದೆ ಅಡಗಿದೆ 3 ಸೋಂಕುಗಳು, ಡೆಂಗ್ಯೂ, ಚಿಕುನ್‌ಗುನ್ಯಾ, ಝಿಕಾ; ಗುರುತಿಸೋದು ಹೇಗೆ..?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't take monsoon fever lightly: Three infections lie behind a single symptom—Dengue, Chikungunya, and Zika; how to identify them?
article.articleSummary: Monsoon-season in Gurugram, India, brings Aedes mosquitoes breeding around homes in water-filled containers, boosting dengue, chikungunya, and Zika transmission. The three infections share fever, headache, and muscle pains in early days, making clinical distinction difficult. Dengue is often marked by severe body aches, retro-orbital pain, and a rapid drop in platelet count, with abdominal pain, vomiting, or bleeding in severe cases. Chikungunya features intense joint pain—especially in ankles, wrists, knees—that may persist for weeks or months, sometimes hindering movement. Zika typically causes milder illness with rash and red eyes; pregnant women face risks to fetal brain development, so prompt testing is advised. Diagnosis relies on clinical assessment and laboratory confirmation; treatment is supportive. Do not self-medicate with aspirin or ibuprofen until dengue is ruled out; maintain fluids. Seek urgent care for bleeding, persistent vomiting, or severe abdominal pain.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季の発熱を軽視しないで:1つの症状の裏に隠れる3つの感染症、デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱、見分け方は？
triage.triage_reason: 蚊媒介感染症（デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱）の一般的な啓発記事であり、特定の集団発生や異常事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインド・グルガオンにおける雨季特有の蚊媒介性疾患（デング熱、チクングニア熱、ジカ熱）の症状の見分け方に関する一般的な医療啓発記事であり、具体的な発生数・アウトブレイクの報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Конго: Дадена првата експериментална вакцина против ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: The first experimental vaccine against Ebola has been given.
article.articleSummary: First participant in the Democratic Republic of Congo received an experimental vaccine against Bundibugyo Ebola virus in a clinical study testing multiple vaccine candidates, led by the University of Antwerp and the Institute of Tropical Medicine. No approved vaccine exists for the Bundibugyo strain. The study aims to evaluate several vaccines concurrently, with community engagement emphasized by MSF's Bern-Thomas Nyangwa as essential for trust and uptake. Since May, Bundibugyo Ebola has spread from the DRC to Uganda, France, and Kenya, with Nigeria reporting its first case on 20 October. The outbreak has infected over 9,000 people and caused more than 4,300 deaths, heightening concerns about rapid spread of this rare Ebola strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ出血熱に対する最初の実験的ワクチンが接種された
triage.triage_reason: 希少なブンディブギョ株エボラが複数国に拡大し、9000人超の感染・4300人超の死亡という深刻な公衆衛生被害が確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはベルギー・フランス・ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアも含まれるが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。本記事はDRCでのワクチン治験開始を主題としており、アウトブレイク自体はDRC起源で複数国に拡大中。

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện mối liên hệ di truyền đầu tiên giữa các đợt bùng phát Ebola tại châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Discovery of the First Genetic Link Between Ebola Outbreaks in Africa
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Nigeria confirms a single Ebola case in a traveler who had visited Uganda, with genomic analysis showing a close relation to the strain from the first Kenyan Ebola case, marking the first genetic link between African Ebola outbreaks. Nigerian authorities report no evidence the Kenyan patient traveled to Nigeria or linked directly to the Nigerian case; contact tracing, isolation, and testing are ongoing, with some results negative and others pending. Kenya’s outbreak began with a first case on 10 June, a businessman from the Democratic Republic of Congo who traveled via Uganda to Kenya and died; seven more cases followed (contacts, healthcare workers, and support staff). Kenya now reports eight total cases; about 130 people are linked, of whom 128 have been traced and quarantined. Uganda reports no current cases but tightens entry declarations and transit rules for travelers from DRC. On 20 October, the US raised Kenya’s travel advisory to Level 3 due to health risks.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカにおけるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク間の初の遺伝的関連性が発見
triage.triage_reason: ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアにまたがるエボラ出血熱の遺伝的関連が確認され、米国がケニアへの渡航勧告をレベル3に引き上げるなど、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大・渡航制限）に該当するため。
triage.notes: DRC出身の渡航者（ケニアで死亡した指標症例）が言及されているが、DRC国内での感染確認はないため対象国リストには含めない。実際の発生国（ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア）は対象国リストに含まれず、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Đắk Lắk ghi nhận hơn 8.400 ca sốt xuất huyết, tăng 41,1% so với cùng kỳ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Đắk Lắk records over 8,400 dengue fever cases, up 41.1% year-on-year.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Dak Lak Province, Vietnam reached 8,457 cases by early October 2026, up 41.1% year-on-year, with 2 deaths and 376 outbreaks. Krong Bong commune reported 127 dengue cases and 3 outbreaks as of October 15, 2026; week 41 recorded 5 new cases (down from 10 in week 40), remaining at medium risk. Authorities strengthened surveillance and response: weekly risk assessments, case investigations, vector-control, and enhanced hygiene measures in schools and communities; villages urged to clean environments, eliminate standing water, and kill larvae. Dengue symptoms include sudden high fever, headache, myalgia, nausea, and rash; warning signs requiring hospital care include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, altered consciousness, and cold extremities. Home care emphasizes hydration, rest, and paracetamol; avoid aspirin or ibuprofen. Prevention focuses on covering water containers and eliminating mosquito breeding sites. Ongoing vigilance is essential to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク省、デング熱8,400例以上を記録、前年同期比41.1%増
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム国内の季節性デング熱流行であり規模増加が見られるが、IHR基準には該当せず、地方当局による通常の対応範囲内であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 死亡2例、症例数増加傾向だが、地方当局が監視・対応を強化しており、現時点で国際的懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya records second Ebola death as seven patients remain in treatment
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second Ebola virus disease (EVD) death as seven other patients remain in treatment across two isolation facilities; no new infections. A 65-year-old woman, a close relative of the first confirmed patient, developed symptoms about 10 days prior and died Friday in Nairobi after supportive care. The index case is a 40-year-old Kenyan man who lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo and travelled via Uganda; he tested positive on October 5 at Nairobi Hospital and died the same day, having arrived October 3. Authorities traced about 135 contacts, with 118 in quarantine; eight people tested positive while in quarantine—including four health workers and four family members. Those completing the 21-day quarantine without symptoms will be released starting Saturday. Nigeria reports genomic analysis showing the Ebola virus identified in Nigeria is genetically related to a Kenyan case, though epidemiological linkage remains unconfirmed.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ出血熱による2人目の死亡を記録、7人の患者が治療継続中
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による死亡例が複数発生し、国境を越えた感染連鎖（DRC・ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア）が疑われるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 指標症例はDRCに居住していたがウガンダ経由でケニアに入国し、実際の発症・死亡はケニアで発生しているため、対象国リストに該当する発生国はない。ナイジェリアでの遺伝子関連エボラウイルス検出も報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。続報でDRC等対象国内での症例確認があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola por el virus Bundibugyo supera ya los 9.700 casos en Congo y se extiende a Kenia y Nigeria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak has already surpassed 9,700 cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and is spreading to Kenya and Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues with intense transmission; as of Oct 20, 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths have been reported. The outbreak now affects Uganda, Rwanda, Kenya, and Nigeria after imported cases were detected in Kenya and Nigeria. In Kenya, the first imported case was on Oct 6 in a traveler from the DRC via Uganda; nine cases have been reported in total and a second death—the 65-year-old woman who developed symptoms during quarantine and was a direct relative of a Kenyan man who died earlier. In Nigeria, authorities confirmed an imported case in Abuja—the wife of a Ugandan-origin Swiss diplomat who had not traveled to Congo; she is isolated and under treatment. A Phase 2/3 Tumaini trial of Bundibugyo vaccines has begun in Bunia, with at least one participant vaccinated; Ervebo is being evaluated, and candidates from Moderna and the University of Oxford (with the Serum Institute of India) are expected to enter soon. No Bundibugyo vaccine is yet approved.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスの流行、コンゴ民主共和国で9,700人超の感染者となり、ケニアとナイジェリアにも拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で9,700例超・死者4,687人に達する大規模流行が継続し、既にケニア・ナイジェリアへの輸入例を含む国際的拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ルワンダへの拡大が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン臨床試験（Tumaini試験）がブニアで開始されており、国際的な公衆衛生対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Први становник Конга примио експерименталну вакцину против Бундибугјо вируса
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first resident of Congo received an experimental vaccine against Bundibugyo virus.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo begins experimental vaccination against Bundibugyo virus, an Ebola virus strain, with the first resident receiving the shot on Friday as part of a multicentre clinical study. The trial, led by researchers from the University of Antwerp and the Institute of Tropical Medicine, tests several experimental vaccines simultaneously, as no licensed vaccine exists for this latest strain. The response effort prioritizes stopping transmission and saving lives while coordinating with frontline teams. MSF local director Bernt-Tomas Nyangva stresses community engagement as essential to vaccine development. Since the May outbreak in the DRC, Bundibugyo has spread to Uganda, France, and Kenya, with Nigeria reporting its first case on October 20. In total, more than 9,000 people have been infected and over 4,300 have died, raising concerns about wider spread beyond the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの最初の住民がブンディブギョウイルスに対する実験的ワクチンを接種
triage.triage_reason: エボラ属ブンディブギョウ株の大規模アウトブレイクで9,000人以上感染・4,300人以上死亡、複数国への拡大が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダ、フランス、ケニア、ナイジェリアへの拡大が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。致死率が高く（4,300/9,000超）、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が強い事例。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch in zwei weiteren afrikanischen Staaten
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in two additional African countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains uncontrolled, with over 9,700 cases and more than 4,600 deaths since May 2026; eight of 26 provinces are affected, North Ubangi the latest near the Central African Republic border. It is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the worst to date, while about 3.5 million people in Congo face hunger as markets falter under fear and containment measures. In the region, Kenya reports its first imported Bundibugyo ebolavirus case, with a second death (65-year-old woman) among close contacts; seven more patients—three relatives, three health workers, and one cleaner—are in isolation, with no wider community spread. Nigeria confirms its first case this week, a Ugandan-born woman with Swiss citizenship treated in Abuja; infection linked to Uganda. A vaccine trial begins to test Ervebo for cross-immunity against Bundibugyo, per WHO remarks.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの2か国でさらにエボラ出血熱の流行が発生
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的な感染拡大も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・中央アフリカ共和国・ウガンダは記事に登場するが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。コンゴ民主共和国(DRC)のみが対象国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: 肯尼亚新增埃博拉死亡病例 乌干达加强跨境防疫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya reports a new Ebola death; Uganda strengthens cross-border epidemic prevention.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a third confirmed Bundibugyo ebolavirus disease (EVD) case with one new death on Oct 23, 2026: a 65-year-old woman, a relative and close contact of the first case. Kenya now has 9 confirmed cases, 2 deaths, with 7 still in isolation; all cases are linked to a single known contact, with no evidence of community transmission. Uganda tightens cross-border epidemic prevention after a Nigerian traveler who transited through Uganda and returned to Nigeria tested positive for Bundibugyo EVD. Uganda notes the traveler left Uganda asymptomatic; investigations into symptom onset and infection route are underway, and Nigeria’s travel records are being sought. Uganda restores entry-information registration, strengthens border and healthcare infection prevention and control, and maintains nationwide surveillance. Background: Congo (DRC) declared a Bundibugyo outbreak on May 15; there is no approved vaccine or specific therapy, and Uganda’s outbreak was declared over by WHO in August.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ死亡例が新たに確認、ウガンダは国境を越えた防疫体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア間で越境的に拡大しており、死亡例も発生していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア間での越境感染事例であり、DRC(203312)は5月に宣言された発生源としての背景情報に過ぎず、現時点の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めなかった。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Riscul de Ebola în România: ce recomandă ECDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The risk of Ebola in Romania: what the ECDC recommends.
article.articleSummary: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) advises EU/EEA health authorities to stay prepared to identify potential Ebola cases after new infections in Kenya and Nigeria, while stressing that the risk to Romania and other EU states remains very low. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo, which has reported 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths across eight provinces as of 20 October 2026. Kenya had 9 cases (1 death) by 23 October; Nigeria confirmed 1 case linked to travel from Uganda, with 44 contacts monitored. Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths since mid-May, last confirmed on 21 June. Romania has no confirmed cases. ECDC urges hospitals to prepare for imported cases by training staff, validating case-identification procedures, ensuring safe laboratory diagnostics, and maintaining isolation capacity; a practical guidance document is available, and this is not a special alert for Romania.

triage.headline_ja: ルーマニアにおけるエボラ出血熱のリスク：ECDCの勧告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続し、複数国への国際的拡大が確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス、9,704症例・4,687死亡）が感染拡大の中心であり、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの越境伝播が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。ルーマニアは確定症例なし。

article.articleHeadline: United Nations (UN), partners support cholera response in south-eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC)
article.articleSummary: Cholera is spreading in the south-eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with more than 55,000 suspected cases reported from January to October 2026, per national authorities. Tanganyika Province has recorded over 6,300 cases since January, about 1,000 more than the same period last year, and among the highest death counts. In Kalemie, the diarrheal-disease treatment centre is overwhelmed amid strained health services, limited access to safe water and sanitation. Some households are using untreated water from Lake Tanganyika and nearby rivers, increasing transmission risk. Displacement sites hosting more than 6,500 people have been affected; over 12,000 displaced are at risk of infection. The UN and partners, including UNICEF and WHO, are providing treatment, medical supplies and water chlorination, but urge expanded treatment capacity and urgent needs. Long-term, sustained investment in water and sanitation infrastructure is essential to prevent future outbreaks and ensure lasting access to safe water.

triage.headline_ja: 国連（UN）およびパートナー機関、コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）南東部のコレラ対応を支援
triage.triage_reason: DRC南東部で55,000人超の疑いコレラ症例と多数の死亡が報告され、医療体制が逼迫し水衛生インフラ不足で感染拡大リスクが高いため、WPRO基準に複数該当し社会的関心も高いと判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にCaliforniaやUnited Statesが含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC南東部（タンガニーカ州・カレミエ）のみであり、これらは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Poliomielite: especialistas alertam para queda na taxa de vacinação contra a doença no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Poliomyelitis: Experts warn of a decline in the vaccination rate against the disease in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: World Polio Day on Oct 24, 2026 underscores that polio was eradicated in Brazil in 1989, but vaccination coverage has fallen below the 95% herd-immunity target. National rates fluctuated from 71.04% in 2021 to 84.63% in 2023, raising concerns of renewed vulnerability. Experts attribute hesitancy to global misinformation about vaccines. Since 2024 Brazil has adopted the injectable inactivated polio vaccine (IPV, Salk), replacing the oral live vaccine (OPV) due to rare vaccine-associated poliomyelitis; the OPV had been used as a supplement prior to the switch. In Santos, poliomyelitis vaccination has been mandatory for school enrollment since 2018. The Zé Gotinha mascot continues campaigns against polio and other vaccines. Poliovirus can be asymptomatic but may cause acute flaccid paralysis by destroying motor neurons, with severe cases affecting respiratory muscles. A 2022 suspected case in Pará was later ruled not to be wild polio but linked to vaccine-derived poliovirus from OPV.

triage.headline_ja: ポリオ：専門家がブラジルでのワクチン接種率低下に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 実際のポリオ症例報告ではなく、ワクチン接種率低下に関する啓発記事であり、現時点での緊急性は低いが今後のアウトブレイクリスクとして注視が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルは1989年にポリオ根絶済みだが、ワクチン接種率が目標の95%を下回っており（2021年71.04%、2023年84.63%）、再流行の脆弱性が懸念される。2022年にパラ州で疑い例があったがワクチン由来株と判明し野生株ではなかった。実際の症例発生ではなく予防啓発記事のためPICKUPではなくWATCHと判定。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة ضحايا فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 4687 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 4,687.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 9,704 confirmed infections and 4,687 deaths (case fatality 48.3%), spreading to 66 areas across eight provinces. Transmission remains high, with most fatalities occurring outside treatment centers, underscoring challenges in early detection and access to care. Regional spillovers include nine cases in Kenya, with one death, all linked to a first imported case from the DRC and subsequent contacts. Nigeria reports its first imported case in Abuja, from Uganda; the patient is isolated and receiving treatment, with investigations ongoing to identify the infection source. WHO stresses strengthened cross-border surveillance, early detection, and regional preparedness, and reiterates that travel or trade restrictions are not recommended for affected countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルス感染症による死者数が4,687人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が9,704例・死者4,687人（致死率48.3%）に達し、8州66地域に拡大。ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境感染も発生しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準全般に該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき事案。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが主要発生国として該当。WHOは渡航・貿易制限を推奨していないと明記。

article.articleHeadline: WFP Palais Briefing note: Ebola spreads to eighth DRC province as WFP delivers food, builds treatment centres and keeps supplies moving
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to an eighth province, intensifying hunger and complicating containment. WFP says its two crucial roles are helping families access care without sacrificing food and providing the logistics backbone for the response. In Ituri’s Mungbwalu, Ebola’s epicenter, families like Francine Birungi Amoti face loss and food insecurity that threaten care; in North Kivu’s Butembo, patients benefit from regular meals to support recovery; Kisangani highlights that livelihoods drive risk. WFP reports over 744,000 hot meals in 60 treatment and isolation facilities and more than 3,000 metric tons of food to patients’ families. A six-month plan aims to provide dry rations to over 500,000 relatives. Musienene has the first Ebola Treatment Centre; Bunia is second, with four more including Goma in progress. Funding needs total USD 115 million, including USD 79 million for meals.

triage.headline_ja: WFPパレ報告:エボラ出血熱がDRC8番目の州に拡大、WFPは食料配布・治療センター建設・物資輸送を継続
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で8番目の州に拡大しており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と異常な拡大傾向が確認され、国際支援（1億1500万ドルの資金要請）も必要とされているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱がDRC国内で8番目の州（北キブ、イトゥリ等）に拡大。食料不足が治療・感染対策を複雑化させており、WFPは治療・隔離施設への食料支援と物流を担っている。国際的な資金拠出（USD115M）が必要とされている。周辺国への越境拡大については記事に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: "إيبولا" يحصد 4687 وفاة في الكونغو ويمتد إلى كينيا ونيجيريا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola claims 4,687 deaths in Congo and spreads to Kenya and Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo reaches 9,704 confirmed infections and 4,687 deaths (case fatality 48.3%), expanding to 66 areas across eight provinces. Transmission remains high, with most fatalities occurring outside treatment centers, indicating delays in early detection and care access. Regionally, Kenya reports nine cases, including one death, after an initial case imported from the DRC; eight additional cases are contacts of the index case. Nigeria records its first imported case in Abuja, a traveler from Uganda, currently isolated and receiving treatment, with investigations underway to identify the infection source. WHO emphasizes enhanced cross-border surveillance, rapid case finding, and regional preparedness, and states that travel or trade restrictions are not recommended for affected countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴで死者4,687人に拡大 ケニア・ナイジェリアにも波及
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（致死率48.3%）が国境を越えケニア・ナイジェリアに拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし国際的拡大の事実はリスク評価上重要な情報として記載。WHOは渡航・貿易制限を推奨していない。

article.articleHeadline: المركز الأوروبى لمكافحة الأمراض: وفاة مريض بإيبولا من ضمن 9 إصابات فى كينيا - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control: Death of an Ebola patient among 9 cases in Kenya - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports 9 Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo virus) cases, including 1 death, with eight linked to the initial infection that moved from the Democratic Republic of Congo through Uganda to Kenya, as of 23 October 2026. Nigeria reports 1 case; the source is under investigation. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) notes the overall risk of Ebola spreading to the EU/EEA remains very low and does not advise travel restrictions. ECDC urges European hospitals and laboratories to sustain readiness to detect and safely manage suspected imported cases, and to heighten health-worker awareness. The agency has been providing support since the outbreak began, deploying experts to DRC and Uganda for border screening and coordinating with African CDC, the European Commission, WHO, and Nigeria’s authorities. A readiness checklist for national authorities is being circulated, with risk to be reevaluated as new information emerges.

triage.headline_ja: 欧州疾病予防管理センター：ケニアで確認された9例のエボラ感染者のうち1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）がコンゴ民主共和国からウガンダを経てケニアへ越境拡大し死亡例も発生、ナイジェリアでも感染確認があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な国際公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCを起源としウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへ拡大したエボラ流行。対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるため、Uganda, Kenya, Nigeriaはverified_locationsから除外。ECDCはEU/EEAへのリスクは依然低いと評価し渡航制限は推奨していないが、国際的な越境拡大自体が重大な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya'da Ebola kaynaklı 2'nci can kaybı: 7 hastanın tedavisi sürüyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second Ebola-related death in Kenya: seven patients are still being treated.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a second Ebola-related death on 24 October 2026, with 9 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2 fatalities. A 65-year-old woman died while in isolation, elevating the death toll; seven other patients remain in quarantine in two separate isolation centers. Authorities say there is no evidence of sustained community transmission, with all cases within the same exposure cluster. The initial Kenyan case involved a traveler from the Democratic Republic of the Congo who arrived in Nairobi and died on 5 October. The DRC Ebola outbreak, ongoing since May, has recorded more than 9,000 cases and over 4,600 deaths, triggering heightened cross-border health checks and border measures in neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ関連の2人目の死者：7人の患者が治療継続中
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続く大規模エボラ流行（9,000例超、4,600人超死亡）が渡航者を介して国境を越えてケニアへ拡大し、複数の死者・確認例が発生していることから、国際的拡大・深刻な公衆衛生影響の両面でIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生国はケニアだが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、感染源であり大規模流行が継続中のDRCは具体的な症例・死者数データとともに記述されており、対象国として該当するため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Apa itu Gonore? Penyakit Kelamin yang Dialami Bocah 3,5 Tahun di Bandung Usai Dicabuli Ayah Kandung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is gonorrhea? A sexually transmitted disease experienced by a 3.5-year-old child in Bandung after being raped by the child's biological father.
article.articleSummary: Gonorrhea, caused by Neisseria gonorrhoeae, infected a 3.6-year-old child in Bandung, West Java, Indonesia, following sexual assault by the biological father, resulting in genital infection and inflammation. Gonorrhea is a sexually transmitted infection that typically affects warm, moist sites such as the genitals, rectum, or throat, and can be transmitted through vaginal, anal, or oral sex; it can also pass from mother to newborn during birth. Not all infections produce symptoms, allowing silent transmission. Reported risk factors for gonorrhea include unprotected sex, multiple partners, prior sexually transmitted infections, and being under 25 years old, though a child case is highlighted here. Prevention emphasizes safe sex practices and regular sexual health check-ups. The article does not provide case counts, ongoing outbreaks, or broader epidemiological details.

triage.headline_ja: 淋病とは何か？バンドンで実父に性的暴行を受けた3.5歳児が罹患した性感染症
triage.triage_reason: 個別の児童虐待事件に伴う単発の淋病感染例であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本件は性的虐待に起因する個別症例の報道であり、感染症アウトブレイクとしての性質を持たないため対象国の公衆衛生事象としては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya'da Ebola nedeniyle hayatını kaybedenlerin sayısı 2'ye yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in Kenya has risen to 2.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports Ebola-related fatalities rising to 2, with 9 confirmed cases. The Health Ministry announced the second death: a 65-year-old woman who had direct contact with the first deceased, died in a hospital while in isolation; seven other patients remain in isolation at two centers. All confirmed Kenyan cases are within the same exposure cluster, with no evidence of wider community transmission. The first Kenyan case was identified earlier this month in an individual who traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) to Nairobi and died on October 5. The DRC outbreak has persisted since May, with over 9,000 cases and more than 4,600 deaths, prompting enhanced border checks and health surveillance in neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでのエボラ出血熱による死者数が2人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続く大規模エボラ流行（9000例超、死者4600人超）が国境を越えてケニアに拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限）に該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入例によるエボラ発生だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRCの大規模流行（5月以降9000例超、死者4600人超）が本文で実質的に言及されているためDRCのみを検証済み地域とした。

article.articleHeadline: وفيات وإصابات جديدة بإيبولا في كينيا: وفاة مريض من 9 حالات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola deaths and infections in Kenya: One patient dies among 9 cases.
article.articleSummary: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) reports 9 Ebola virus infections in Kenya with 1 death, and 1 Ebola case in Nigeria. The Kenyan cluster includes a case linked to the initial infection that traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo through Uganda into Kenya. Nigeria's case is under investigation for its source. Updated risk assessment indicates that the likelihood of infection among people arriving from Europe or residents in affected Kenyan and Nigerian areas is low, provided recommended preventive measures are followed. Even with imported cases, the probability of sustained transmission after entry into Europe remains very low. The ECDC urges European member states to strengthen preparedness, raise awareness among healthcare workers, and ensure hospitals and laboratories can detect and safely manage suspected Ebola cases.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで新たなエボラ死亡例・感染例：9例中1人死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染がケニア・ナイジェリアで確認され、DRC由来の症例がウガンダ経由で国境を越えて拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし最初の感染者がDRCから発生しウガンダ経由でケニアに入国した経緯が記載されているため、DRCを発生関連国として含めた。ECDCによる正式なリスク評価が発表されており、欧州諸国への警戒強化要請がある点は国際的関心の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: How a disease discovered in 1976 has returned to Nigeria
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms an imported Bundibugyo virus disease case in Abuja on Oct 20, 2026—the patient, a woman with recent travel to Uganda, developed symptoms on Oct 7 and was lab-confirmed on Oct 20. Forty-four contacts are being monitored. The case surfaces amid a May 2026 outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Ebola spreads via direct contact with infected bodily fluids, underscoring the need for early detection, thorough contact tracing, and accurate public information. Bundibugyo virus was identified in Uganda in 2007; Ebola emerged in 1976 with outbreaks in the DRC and what is now South Sudan. The disease’s average case fatality rate is around 50%. Nigeria’s 2014 Lagos import linked to Patrick Sawyer prompted rapid isolation and public health measures; the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic infected over 28,600 people and killed about 11,325, illustrating transmission risks across borders.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：1976年に発見された疾病がいかにナイジェリアに帰ってきたか
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアでBundibugyo型エボラウイルスの輸入症例が確認され、致死率約50%の重篤な疾患であり、44人の接触者監視が行われている点でIHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の重症度・流行性が認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアにおける輸入エボラ症例（Bundibugyo virus）であり、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCの2026年5月のアウトブレイクは背景情報として触れられているのみで、記事の主題ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: RT-Duits: Ebola-Ausbruch in zwei weiteren afrikanischen Staaten
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RT German: Ebola outbreak in two more African states.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues to rage in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with more than 9,700 cases and over 4,600 deaths since May 2026. The outbreak now spans eight of 26 provinces, with North Ubangi near the Central African Republic border as the latest area affected; this is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the worst on record. The crisis compounds humanitarian distress, as approximately 3.5 million people in the DRC face hunger amid disrupted markets, fear-driven containment, and ongoing armed conflict. The cross-border threat has reached Kenya and Nigeria, with Kenya reporting its first imported Bundibugyo Ebola case on October 6, after the patient, a Kenyan citizen, contracted the disease in the DRC and traveled via Uganda; contacts have been traced and quarantined. Nigeria was noted in regional risk, underscoring the broader regional vulnerability.

triage.headline_ja: RTドイツ:エボラ出血熱がアフリカのさらに2か国で発生
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が過去最大規模（9,700例以上、死者4,600人超）に拡大し、国境を越えてケニアへの輸入例が確認されるなど国際的拡大リスクが顕著であり、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準も満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・中央アフリカ共和国・ウガンダは関連地域として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないか、主発生国でないため除外。狂犬病(Rabies)への言及は本文中になく、タグ付けのみと判断。

article.articleHeadline: 9704 إصابات و4687 وفاة.. حصيلة تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية - الأسبوع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths.. Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Weekly
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Ebola virus disease, BVD) outbreak persists in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with imported cases in Kenya and Nigeria. From 8 October 2026 to 20 October 2026, transmission remained widespread in DRC, totaling 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths across 66 health zones in 8 provinces (case fatality rate 48.3%). Since the previous update, 482 deaths were reported (307 in communities, 175 in treatment centers). Kenya reported its first laboratory-confirmed imported case on 6 October 2026; by 20 October there were 9 Ebola cases in Kenya, including 1 death; eight are known contacts, with no evidence of wider community transmission. Nigeria reported an imported case in Abuja from Uganda; the patient is isolated and investigations are ongoing. WHO emphasizes sustained regional preparedness, border surveillance, entry-point monitoring, early detection, and coordinated response, and advises against travel or trade restrictions on affected countries.

triage.headline_ja: 9,704例の感染と4,687人の死亡…コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行の集計
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続し、致死率48.3%、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的な輸出例も発生しておりIHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアは輸入症例の発生国であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCが流行の主体である。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ebola se extinde în Africa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is spreading in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-line Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) have spread geographically, with imported cases confirmed in Kenya (9 cases, 1 death) and Nigeria (Abuja). Kenya’s index patient traveled from DRC via Uganda; eight additional infections were among direct contacts (four family members, four healthcare workers), all in quarantine when symptoms appeared. Nigeria reports a single imported case from Uganda, with 44 direct contacts under observation. WHO data up to Oct 20 show 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths in the DRC (case fatality ~48%), across 66 health zones in eight provinces, with ongoing transmission in multiple regions. EU risk for Romania/EEA remains very low if precautions are observed; no travel restrictions are imposed. Bundibugyo Ebola lacks licensed vaccines or specific treatments; patient management is supportive, emphasizing rapid case finding, strict isolation, contact tracing, and sustained laboratory capacity with surveillance in collaboration with WHO and ECDC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がアフリカで拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行（致死率約48%、9,704例）がケニア・ナイジェリアへ越境拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ルーマニアは記事サマリー上言及があるが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。主たる発生地はDRCであり、輸出症例として他国へ拡大している点が国際的拡大リスクの根拠。

article.articleHeadline: В Кении зафиксирована вторая смерть от Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kenya, the second death from Ebola has been recorded.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second Ebola death, with nine laboratory-confirmed cases, seven patients still in hospital across two isolation units. The deceased is a 65-year-old woman who was a close relative of the first patient; she began showing symptoms around October 13 and died while in quarantine. The first Kenyan case was linked to a return from the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak has surged, with more than 9,700 confirmed Ebola infections and about 4,700 deaths. In early October, Doctors Without Borders warned of a sharp rise in Ebola activity in North Kivu province, eastern DRC, noting that the region accounts for nearly 40% of new confirmed cases in the country.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラによる2人目の死亡が確認される
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでエボラ死亡例が確認され、DRCでの大規模流行（9,700例超、死者約4,700人）とヒト-ヒト感染の国際的拡大が示唆されるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRC北キブ州での流行拡大が記事の主題であり、DRCのみを対象国として計上した。国境を越えた感染拡大（ケニアへの伝播）が確認されており、国際的拡大リスクは非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria, scorpioni e talebani: Annese, il Magellano di Molfetta che vuole portare la Guinea al Mondiale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria, Scorpions and Taliban: Annese, the Magellan of Molfetta who wants to take Guinea to the World Cup
article.articleSummary: Annese, a globe-trotting Italian coach from Molfetta, was appointed head coach of Equatorial Guinea in late August 2026, based between Malabo and Ciudad de la Paz, with the aim of guiding the national team to a World Cup. He is described as the only Italian to have coached on four continents. His career spans Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia, and Armenia, then China (Nike Academy) before moving to Africa and beyond. In Ghana, he led Bechem United (with a CAF Confederation Cup appearance) and endured malaria and a scorpion sting on an ankle, noting the country’s talent and challenges. He later coached in Palestine (Hebron, Ahli Al-Khalil), Indonesia (PSIS Semarang), Belize (national team during COVID disruptions affecting Gold Cup qualification), and India (Gokulam Kerala). The profile portrays a relentless, resourceful fixer whose latest mission is advancing Guinea’s World Cup ambitions.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア、サソリ、タリバン：モルフェッタのマゼラン、アネーゼが赤道ギニアをワールドカップへ導こうとしている
triage.triage_reason: サッカー監督の人物紹介記事であり、マラリアやCOVID-19は過去の個人的経験として言及されているのみで、公衆衛生上のイベントではない。
triage.notes: 記事はスポーツ人物紹介であり、ガーナでの罹患歴やベリーズでのCOVID混乱への言及は過去の個人的エピソードに過ぎず、現在進行中の感染症イベントではないため対象国は該当なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: UP Rabies Scare: Can Curd Or Other Dairy Products Actually Spread Rabies?
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Gorakhpur district in Uttar Pradesh vaccinated about 450 people after charanamrit made from milk of a cow suspected of rabies sparked concern in Dadi Khas and nearby Govindpur. The cow, possibly bitten by a stray dog, died on October 20; rabies was not confirmed. About 50 people were vaccinated at a community health center, with roughly 400 more vaccinated at a village camp. Rabies spreads mainly through infected saliva via bites, scratches, or contact with mucous membranes; there is no established evidence that milk or dairy products transmit rabies to humans. Heat can inactivate the virus, so proper heating or pasteurization reduces risk, but dairy prepared from milk of a suspected rabid animal should be avoided. India’s National Rabies Control Programme notes no evidence-based reports of human rabies from consuming dairy; post-exposure vaccination may be advised, along with wound washing.

triage.headline_ja: UP狂犬病騒動：カード（凝乳）や乳製品は本当に狂犬病を媒介するのか？
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病疑いの牛からの乳製品摂取により450人が予防接種を受けた事例だが、狂犬病自体は未確定であり、乳製品を介したヒトへの感染は科学的根拠がないため公衆衛生上の深刻度は限定的。地域内の予防的対応として注視が必要。
triage.notes: 牛の狂犬病感染は未確認。乳製品を介したヒト感染の科学的証拠はないが、地域住民の不安から大規模な予防接種が実施された。続報で牛の検査結果やヒト感染事例の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Falling child vaccination rates raise concern as Hong Kong flu deaths rise
article.articleSummary: Influenza continues to spread in Hong Kong as of 24 October 2026, with the summer flu season stretching since June and showing no signs of easing. Authorities report a higher risk of influenza infection amid falling vaccination rates among children, following the death of a second unvaccinated child from the virus. Dr. Edwin Tsui Lok-kin, Controller of the Centre for Health Protection, warned of sustained transmission and potential changes in how the virus spreads. The warning underscores the public health need to boost vaccination coverage to protect children and vulnerable groups. Officials are monitoring epidemiological shifts after two consecutive summer flu seasons, as the city weighs measures to curb outbreak intensity.

triage.headline_ja: 香港でインフルエンザ死者増加、子供のワクチン接種率低下が懸念材料に
triage.triage_reason: 香港で異例に長期化する夏季インフルエンザ流行があり、未接種児童の死亡例が続いていることから、重症度・持続曝露・流行しやすさの観点でWPRO基準に複数該当し、社会的・行政的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 香港は中国の特別行政区のため、China(1814991)に統合して記載。季節性インフルエンザだが、夏季流行の長期化と子供のワクチン接種率低下が異例な要素として注目される。

article.articleHeadline: Tick-Borne Diseases Growing Concern
article.articleSummary: Tick-borne diseases (TBDs) are a growing concern in India, with Tamil Nadu an important endemic region. In Tamil Nadu, vectors Haemaphysalis intermedia, H. bispinosa and Rhipicephalus sanguineus transmit zoonoses such as Kyasanur Forest Disease (KFD), Indian tick typhus, and Lyme disease (Nilgiris). Nationally, over 125 tick species exist; notable zoonoses include Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever (CCHF), KFD, Indian tick typhus, Lyme disease, and Q fever, with outbreaks in Karnataka, Gujarat, Rajasthan, Himachal Pradesh and Tamil Nadu. Seroprevalence of Borrelia burgdorferi reaches 19.9% in parts of Karnataka and 18% in Arunachal Pradesh; CCHF outbreaks have caused human fatalities in Gujarat and Rajasthan. A unified One Health surveillance platform is urged to coordinate human, animal and environmental monitoring. Acaricide resistance in Rhipicephalus microplus and Hyalomma anatolicum reaches 68–78%, with residues contaminating milk, meat and the environment. Most tick burden originates in cattle sheds; improved shed management and vaccines are proposed.

triage.headline_ja: ダニ媒介性疾患が深刻化する懸念
triage.triage_reason: インド全土でダニ媒介性疾患（CCHF、KFD等）の流行が報告されているが、本記事は総説的な内容であり、新規アウトブレイクや急性の公衆衛生緊急事態を示すものではない。CCHFの過去の死亡例は懸念材料であり続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事はインド国内のダニ媒介性疾患の疫学的概況・研究レビューであり、特定の新規アウトブレイクの速報ではない。CCHF（致死例あり）やKFDは重症度が高いため継続的なモニタリングが望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Restores Traveller Locator Forms and Tightens Border Controls Amid Ebola Investigation
article.articleSummary: Uganda reinstituted traveller locator forms for all arrivals and barred DRC-linked travelers as it tightens border controls amid an Ebola investigation. A Ugandan national tested positive for Bundibugyo Virus Disease (Ebola) while in Nigeria; it is unclear when symptoms began, and investigations are underway to determine the infection timeline and origin. Uganda is collaborating with Nigerian authorities to reconstruct the traveler's itinerary, movement records, and available genomic data. Enhanced infection prevention and control measures are in place at points of entry and health facilities, with nationwide surveillance ongoing. Uganda will deny transit for travelers who recently passed through the DRC; unlawful border crossings may trigger enforcement under the Public Health Act. Authorities urge communities to report illegal border movements; officials stress Uganda remains Ebola-free and call for hand hygiene and compliance with screening.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ調査の最中に渡航者位置情報申告書を復活させ国境管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダ人のエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）陽性例がナイジェリアで確認され、ウガンダがDRC関連渡航者の入国制限や国境管理強化を実施しており、国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクが明確である。
triage.notes: 感染確認はナイジェリア、感染経路調査はウガンダ・ナイジェリア間で実施。DRCは渡航制限の対象国として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため対象国リストに該当する確定発生地は特定できない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya records second Ebola death as outbreak continues
article.articleSummary: Kenya records a second Ebola death, a 65-year-old woman in quarantine after contracting the virus from a close family member; the first victim was a man who travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo and died in Nairobi on Oct 5. Eight total cases are reported in one cluster, with seven others in two isolation facilities; no evidence of community transmission. Affected individuals include three relatives of the first victim, three health workers, and a hospital cleaner. Kenya has strengthened border and airport screening; travellers from DR Congo and nine other high-risk countries must complete a digital surveillance form and present a QR code on arrival. Ebola symptoms include fever, vomiting, and diarrhoea, with severe cases causing organ failure and bleeding. Nigeria says its single confirmed case is genetically related to a Kenyan strain; no evidence the Kenyan patient travelled to Nigeria, with investigations linking possible contacts via Entebbe International Airport in Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱の2人目の死亡者、アウトブレイクが継続
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のヒト-ヒト感染クラスターが発生し、関連株がナイジェリアでも検出されるなど国際的拡大の兆候があり、ケニアは国境・空港での渡航制限措置を強化しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域にDRCが含まれるが、記事はDRCから渡航した個人を感染源とする言及のみでDRC国内でのアウトブレイクを示すものではないため、対象国リストに該当する発生国はなしと判断。実際の発生国はケニア（対象国リスト外）であり、ナイジェリア・ウガンダも関連国として言及されるが対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Nigeria's Detection Gap Raises Preparedness Questions
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola Virus (BEV) detections in Nigeria followed two travellers who arrived Oct 3: a Kenyan businessman ill on arrival tested positive Oct 6 and died that day, while a Nigerian woman developed symptoms Oct 7, sought care Oct 11, and was confirmed Oct 20, making Nigeria the first West African country to detect Ebola in 2026. The Kenyan import quickly triggered confirmation; Nigeria’s confirmation lagged 17 days after arrival and nine days after care-seeking. Nigeria's NCDC says steps to strengthen preparedness include early detection, isolation, lab diagnosis, IPC, contact tracing, and protection of healthcare workers; 44 contacts are being monitored. The incubation period is 2–21 days, with travel/exposure history crucial. Context recalls Nigeria’s 2014 Zaire Ebola response and containment; by Oct 19, 2026 DRC BEV outbreak: 9,637 cases, 4,646 deaths; Kenya: 9 cases, 1 death; Nigeria is the fifth country to detect BEV.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ナイジェリアの検知ギャップが備えへの疑問を提起
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行がケニア・ナイジェリアへ越境拡大し、ナイジェリアでは検知までに17日間のラグが生じるなど、国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が確認されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC発のエボラ流行がケニア・ナイジェリアへ輸入された事例。対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当し、ナイジェリア・ケニア・アンゴラは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Records Second Ebola Death As Cases Rise To Nine
article.articleSummary: Kenya records second Ebola death as Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak grows to nine confirmed cases, with seven patients in two isolation facilities. A 65-year-old woman died in Nairobi while receiving treatment; she was the third confirmed case and a close family member and direct contact of Kenya's first Ebola patient, a man who died Oct 5 after traveling from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) via Uganda. The woman developed symptoms on Oct 13 while in quarantine and was admitted to an infectious disease unit, receiving supportive care before her death. No evidence of community transmission; all confirmed cases linked to a single cluster of known contacts. Authorities have traced 135 contacts and placed them under quarantine; burial arrangements are being coordinated. WHO calls for strengthened surveillance, contact tracing and preparedness, recommending no travel or trade restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラによる2人目の死亡者、症例数は9人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウウイルス）のアウトブレイクがケニアで拡大し死亡例も発生しており、国境を越えた感染連鎖（DRC→ウガンダ→ケニア）が確認されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例はケニア（首都ナイロビ）で発生し、感染源は第一症例がDRCからウガンダ経由で渡航した事実に基づくが、記事はDRCまたはウガンダでの新規発生を報じていないため、対象国リストに該当する国として確認できるものはない。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Hải Phòng, xuất hiện chùm ca bệnh sốt xuất huyết trong gia đình
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hai Phong reports a family cluster of dengue fever cases.
article.articleSummary: Three members of a single family in Hai Phong City, Vietnam were diagnosed with dengue fever on October 22 at Hai Duong Tropical Disease Hospital. P.V.T., 46; N.T.T., 42; and P.T.S., 15, from Trịnh Xuyên hamlet, Vĩnh Lại commune, presented with fever, myalgia, and petechiae, and were admitted with warning signs. The husband fell ill first; his wife and son developed symptoms about three days later. Local authorities in Vĩnh Lại, with Hai Phong City CDC and Ninh Giang CDC, initiated rapid control: epidemiological investigation, environmental disinfection in 30 households in Trịnh Xuyên, and intensified surveillance, vector control, larval source reduction, and public education. Dengue is mainly transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; dangerous phase typically days 3–7 from onset, with caution against self-medication and delayed care if warning signs appear. Separately, Thanh Hoa Province’s Ha Thanh Ward is also undertaking containment and insecticide spraying to curb a dengue cluster.

triage.headline_ja: ハイフォンで家族内デング熱クラスターが発生
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はベトナムで流行性の風土病であり、家族内クラスターは通常の公衆衛生対応範囲内で、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地元CDCによる迅速な封じ込め対応（環境消毒、媒介蚊対策、サーベイランス強化）が行われており、通常の季節性デング熱対応の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Reports Second Ebola Death - Business Today Kenya
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a second Ebola death, with nine confirmed cases and two fatalities, and no evidence of community transmission as of 24 October 2026. The deceased is a 65-year-old woman, the third confirmed case; she developed symptoms on 13 October and was admitted to an infectious disease unit. A safe and dignified burial will be conducted under public health protocols.
