Kenya's first Ebola case this month involved a man who travelled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and died in Nairobi on 5 October; authorities have traced and quarantined 135 contacts, of whom nine tested positive. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids, contaminated objects, or infected wildlife. The article notes six Ebola types—Sudan, Bundibugyo, Zaire, Reston, Bombali, Tai—with Sudan, Bundibugyo and Zaire driving major outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで2人目のエボラ死亡者を報告
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでエボラウイルス病の確認症例・死亡者が発生し、DRCからの越境事例であることから国際的拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 発端症例はDRCからの渡航者だが、確認された9症例・2死亡はいずれもケニア国内で発生しており、DRC国内でのアウトブレイクという記述はないため、対象国リストにおけるverified_locationsは空配列とした（ケニアは対象国リストに含まれない）。地域拡大の実態把握のため続報を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄登革熱境外移入+3 皆赴東南亞旅遊返國發病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three more imported dengue fever cases in Kaohsiung; all had traveled to Southeast Asia and became ill after returning.
article.articleSummary: Three new imported dengue fever cases in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, bring 2026’s total to 35. Case 33: a 38-year-old Taiwanese man who traveled to the Philippines Oct 8–18; upon return he developed fever, headache and myalgia; rapid test was positive and PCR confirmed dengue type 2. Case 34: a 43-year-old Japanese man visiting Thailand Oct 3–17; fever and arthralgia; entered Kaohsiung Oct 17 and was diagnosed Oct 20; dengue type 2 by PCR. Case 35: a 48-year-old Taiwanese woman who vacationed with her husband in Da Nang, Vietnam Oct 4–21; around Oct 18 she developed fever, nausea, poor appetite, knee pain and leg rash; NS1 rapid test and PCR positive; hospitalized; husband asymptomatic with negative PCR. Health authorities conducted targeted prevention in affected residences and venues. Travelers returning from Southeast Asia within 14 days with fever-like symptoms should report symptoms and undergo NS1 screening to prevent local transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄で登革熱の輸入症例3件追加、いずれも東南アジア旅行後に発症
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄における輸入性デング熱症例であり、現時点では局所的な散発例にとどまるが、東南アジア渡航者からの継続的な輸入リスクがあり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 台湾(高雄)は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。症例の感染源国（フィリピン・タイ・ベトナム）のみverified_locationsに記載。台湾当局は対象住居・施設での防疫対応を実施済みで、管理体制は国内で対応可能と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya reporta segunda muerte por ébola en brote histórico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya reports the second Ebola death in a historic outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Kenya has recorded its second Ebola death. A 65-year-old woman died after quarantine; she was a relative of the first fatality, a man who fell ill in September after travelling from DRC. Seven patients remain under treatment in two isolation facilities, all infections in a single cluster with no evidence of community transmission. Since the outbreak was confirmed in the DRC in May, more than 4,000 deaths have occurred in Africa. Case developed symptoms Oct 13; the first death occurred Oct 5 after treatment in DRC hospitals en route to Nairobi. Remaining patients include three relatives of the first fatality, three healthcare workers, a cleaner. Bundibugyo ebolavirus has no approved vaccine or treatment; trials are ongoing, and Kenya has implemented enhanced travel health checks for arrivals from DRC and nine high-risk countries. US and neighboring countries are monitoring travel.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、歴史的流行におけるエボラ出血熱による2人目の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5月に確認されたエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行がケニアに越境し死者が発生、承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく国際的な渡航監視も行われているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの死亡例だが、感染源・流行の起点はDRC（2026年5月確認、アフリカ全体で4,000人超の死者）であるため、対象国リストに含まれるDRCを発生地域として記載。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Roundup: Ebola's cross-border spread tests Africa's defenses as vaccine trial begins
article.articleSummary: A concise summary of the Bundibugyo Ebola cross-border outbreak across Africa as of Oct. 20, 2026. The outbreak has spread to five countries, with the DRC in Ituri reporting 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths across eight of 26 provinces. Kenya records its second Ebola death, a 65-year-old Nairobi resident; nine confirmed cases linked to the initial traveler from the DRC via Uganda, 135 contacts traced, and no evidence of community transmission. Nigeria confirms its first case in Abuja on Oct. 20; genomic sequencing shows the virus highly similar to Kenya's initial case (one mutation difference) and travel history remains unresolved. Uganda tightens transit restrictions for DRC-travelers and reinstates locator forms; WHO does not advise travel bans. A Phase 2/3 vaccine trial against Bundibugyo begins in Bunia, Ituri, with the first participant vaccinated under an adaptive platform design.

triage.headline_ja: まとめ：エボラ出血熱の国境を越えた拡散がアフリカの防疫体制を試す中、ワクチン治験開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCを起点としたエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がケニア・ナイジェリアなど複数国へ国境を越えて拡散し、死亡者数も多く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州）を起点とした感染拡大を主題としているが、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCの感染状況（9,704症例、4,687死亡）が中心的な内容であり、対象国としてDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Dia Mundial da Poliomielite: entenda os principais riscos da doença e como se prevenir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Polio Day: Understand the Main Risks of the Disease and How to Prevent It.
article.articleSummary: Poliomyelitis (polio) poses paralyzing risks in Brazil and globally. As World Polio Day on 24 October highlights, non-immunized children and adults remain susceptible to infection, which is transmitted mainly by the fecal–oral route and is favored by poor sanitation. In Brazil, wild poliovirus has not circulated since 1990, but vaccination coverage has fallen below the 95% target since 2016. Complete childhood immunization now relies on the inactivated poliovirus vaccine (VIP), with doses at 2, 4, and 6 months and a booster at 15 months, a policy in effect since November 2024. Most infections are asymptomatic; when present, symptoms include fever, malaise, headache, body pains, vomiting, diarrhea, neck stiffness and muscle spasms. In severe cases, the poliovirus can affect motor nerves and cause permanent paralysis. There is no cure; prevention relies on vaccination and hygiene. The Pan American Health Organization notes about 1 in 200 infections can progress to permanent paralysis.

triage.headline_ja: 世界ポリオデー：病気の主なリスクと予防法について理解する
triage.triage_reason: これは世界ポリオデーに関する啓発記事であり、ブラジルでは1990年以降野生株ポリオの流行はなく、実際の症例報告や発生事例ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン接種率低下への注意喚起を含む一般的な啓発コンテンツであり、実際のポリオ発生事例の報告ではないため対象国への発生確認は該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: ЕБОЛАТА СЕ ШИРИ ВО КОНГО - Вирусот стигнал до осма провинција, расте хуманитарниот притисок
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Spreads in Congo - The Virus Has Reached the Eighth Province, Humanitarian Pressure Is Mounting.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached its eighth province, heightening concern among health and humanitarian actors amid difficult conditions for delivering care. The World Food Programme warns that food shortages may complicate ongoing treatment and the functioning of health services. Current estimates indicate around 3.5 million people in the affected areas are facing crisis-level food insecurity. The convergence of an infectious disease, poverty, and limited access to essential services further undermines the response. The article notes that only by reviewing the latest official epidemiological data can the precise counts of new cases and deaths be determined, as of 2026-10-24.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴで拡大 - ウイルスが第8州に到達、高まる人道的圧力
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC国内で8州に拡大し、食料危機と医療アクセス困難が重なることで対応が困難化しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際支援が必要な状況と判断される。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数・死亡者数は記事内で不明。WFPが食料不安と対応能力への影響を警告している。

article.articleHeadline: В РАН допустили распространение хантавируса Андес по всему миру
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Russian Academy of Sciences allowed the Andes hantavirus to spread worldwide.
article.articleSummary: Andes hantavirus, cause of hantavirus pulmonary syndrome, could spread globally after an outbreak on the cruise ship MV Hondius, according to virologist Sergei Netesov of Novosibirsk State University at an International Environmental Student Conference. He warned that hantaviruses are no longer purely exotic and may disseminate due to international tourism, including trips to South America, polar cruises, and contact with natural reservoirs. Vaccine development is projected to take about 1.5 years. In May, Academician Gennady Onishchenko noted Andes hantavirus is mutating, though hantaviruses remain low-virulence and low-contagious. Brazilian researchers analyzing 10 years of data report Brazil has the highest incidence; mortality is highest among ages 15–19; 89.7% of patients required hospitalization, with an overall fatality rate around 33.3%.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア科学アカデミー、アンデス・ハンタウイルスが世界的に拡大する可能性を指摘
triage.triage_reason: 現時点では具体的な新規アウトブレイク発生の報告ではなく、専門家によるクルーズ船感染を契機とした将来的な世界拡散リスクに関する見解表明であるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は国際学会での専門家発言を基にした将来的リスク警鐘であり、クルーズ船（MV Hondius）での発生地点やコロンビア・ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジルは過去10年のハンタウイルス発生率データが言及されているため含めたが、現在進行中の新規アウトブレイクではない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Roundup: Ebola's cross-border spread tests Africa's defenses as vaccine trial begins
article.articleSummary: On Oct. 24, 2026, Ebola outbreaks across Africa test cross-border defenses as Kenya reports a second Ebola death and uncertainties over the source of Nigeria's first infection complicate containment. A major Ebola vaccine trial launched Friday in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), offering fresh hope for rapid protection and outbreak control. The evolving spread underscores the need for strengthened regional surveillance, timely laboratory confirmation, and swift vaccination deployment to curb transmission and prevent further exports. Nigeria’s ambiguous infection source and Kenya’s continuing fatalities highlight gaps in tracing and response, while the DRC trial represents a pivotal step in expanding tools against the virus and reducing broader spread.

triage.headline_ja: まとめ：エボラ出血熱の越境拡大がアフリカの防疫体制を試す中、ワクチン治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が複数国（ケニア、ナイジェリア、DRC）で発生し国境を越えた拡大が確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCでのワクチン治験開始が記事の主題の一部として明記されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: تجربة سريرية للقاح جديد ضد إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Clinical trial of a new Ebola vaccine in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: The World Health Organization-led first clinical trial of a new Ebola vaccine began in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the first participants receiving Tomaini, a vaccine whose Swahili name means 'hope.' The current outbreak—the worst in DRC history—has surpassed 9,700 cases and 4,600 deaths. The trial, conducted in Bunia, adopts a ring vaccination approach targeting contacts, with pregnant women and children aged 12 years and older included; the first Ervebo dose was administered in Bunia to assess cross-protection against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the strain driving this outbreak, noting that no vaccines or therapies are yet approved for Bundibugyo. Tomaini seeks safety, immunogenicity, and cross-protective efficacy. Two additional Bundibugyo-targeted vaccines are in early-stage trials: an Oxford University candidate and a Moderna-developed mRNA vaccine. Global efforts aim to curb this Ebola surge.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で新規エボラワクチンの臨床試験開始
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪規模（症例9,700超、死亡4,600超）のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行に対し、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない中でWHO主導の新規ワクチン臨床試験が開始されたことは公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性を示し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 現行のブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行はDRC史上最悪とされ、WHO主導の新規ワクチン（Tomaini）臨床試験がBuniaで開始された。承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع وفيات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 4,687 وتسجيل إصابات في كينيا ونيجيريا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to 4,687, with cases reported in Kenya and Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, the World Health Organization reports the Ebola outbreak in Bondibojio, Democratic Republic of the Congo, has reached 9,704 confirmed infections and 4,687 deaths (case fatality 48.3%). The epidemic has spread across 66 districts in eight provinces, with sustained transmission at high levels. Most deaths occur outside treatment centers, indicating challenges in early detection and timely access to care. In Kenya, WHO confirmed nine Ebola cases, including one death, after the first imported case from the Democratic Republic of the Congo; the remaining eight infections occurred among contacts of the index case. Laboratory confirmation continues to support surveillance and response activities, including case finding, isolation, and contact tracing to interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ死者数4,687人に増加、ケニアとナイジェリアでも感染確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（9,704人感染、死亡4,687人、致死率48.3%）が継続し66地区に拡大、さらにケニアへの越境伝播と二次感染が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ケニアおよびナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCでの流行が主題であり継続的な拡大とケニアへの越境感染が確認されているため、フルRRAによる詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hơn 40.000 ca tay chân miệng tại TP.HCM, cảnh báo nguy cơ biến chứng nguy hiểm ở trẻ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 40,000 hand, foot, and mouth disease cases in Ho Chi Minh City, warning of the risk of dangerous complications in children.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) outbreaks in Vietnam surged in 2026, with Ho Chi Minh City reporting over 40,000 cases since January and 40,446 through week 41, and Hanoi recording over 6,000 cases across 126 wards/communes. HFMD is caused by enteroviruses, notably EV71, and can progress rapidly to severe neurologic and cardiopulmonary complications, including encephalitis, meningitis, myocarditis, pulmonary edema, hypertension, heart failure, and shock, potentially fatal without timely care. In Ho Chi Minh City, week 41 incidence rose 32.2% versus the four-week average, signaling ongoing transmission in childcare settings. Typical progression begins with fever, fatigue, sore throat, and poor appetite, followed by mouth ulcers and vesicular rashes on hands and feet; severe signs include fever ≥39°C, dehydration risk, lethargy, vomiting, rapid breathing, or seizures. Precautionary guidance emphasizes hydration, soft foods, hygiene, and prompt medical evaluation; Vietnam licensed an EV71 vaccine in 2026 to bolster prevention.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市で手足口病が4万件超、子どもの重篤な合併症リスクに警戒
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでEV71関連の手足口病が急増し、重篤な合併症（脳炎、心筋炎等）のリスクが指摘されており、WPRO基準の重症度・流行しやすさ・曝露継続に該当し社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 手足口病はベトナムで季節性に発生する疾患だが、2026年の症例数が例年より急増しており、EV71による重症化事例が報告されている。ワクチン導入など政府対応も進んでいるため、続報の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis bacteria found in waterways, soil -- UP researchers
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-24, two peer-reviewed UPD-CS and Philippine Genome Center studies show Leptospira, the bacteria that cause leptospirosis, are present in urban waterways and soil, not only floodwaters. In Estero de Paco, a Metro Manila waterway, soil and water samples were collected from five sites and Leptospira were detected at all locations, indicating contamination across the entire system rather than a single hotspot. Senior author Windell Rivera notes that an entire connected waterway may function as a reservoir, requiring system-wide surveillance and interventions. The work also found Philippine Leptospira strains genetically distinct from previously sequenced strains. In a second study, researchers report the first genetic sequencing of Leptospira yasudae from the Philippines, representing only the 10th global sequence for the species and adding a Philippine reference to its genetic record.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ菌が水路や土壌から検出 -- UP研究者
triage.triage_reason: 研究報告であり、新規の症例増加や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではないため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究（環境中のレプトスピラ菌の存在と遺伝子解析）に関するものであり、疾病の流行や症例報告ではない。公衆衛生上の緊急対応を要する内容ではないが、都市水路が病原体リザーバーとなりうる点は今後の疾病監視の参考情報として留意。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تُحذّر من اتساع انتشار الوباء الكونغو الديمقراطية تسجل 4687 وفاة بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of the widening spread of the outbreak as the Democratic Republic of the Congo records 4,687 Ebola deaths.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns of widening Ebola virus disease outbreak as the Democratic Republic of the Congo tallies 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths (case-fatality rate 48.3%), with transmission ongoing at high levels. The outbreak spans 66 districts across eight provinces in DRC and has spread to other African countries, including Kenya and Nigeria. Most deaths have occurred outside treatment centers, indicating challenges in early detection and access to care. In Kenya, nine cases have been reported, including one fatality, linked to an imported case from the DRC; eight additional infections are among contacts of the index case. Nigeria has also reported cases, though the report provides no specific figures. The situation highlights ongoing, expanding transmission and the need for strengthened surveillance, case finding, isolation, and care.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱の流行拡大を警告、コンゴ民主共和国で死者4,687人を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（症例9,704件、死者4,687人、致死率48.3%）が継続・拡大しており、他国への越境伝播も確認されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数を満たす。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアへの症例拡大が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが主たる発生地であり流行の中心。

article.articleHeadline: Главные новости дня | пятница: Западный берег, Судан, Эбола, Йемен
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Top headlines of the day | Friday: West Bank, Sudan, Ebola, Yemen
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, UN briefings report Ebola continuing to spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo across eight provinces with nearly 10,000 cases and about half of patients dying. Yemen has displaced more than 268,000 people since August as fighting persists, with Taiz suffering fuel, medicine, and food shortages and humanitarian access blocked. In Sudan, UN OHCHR chief Volker Türk condemns escalating drone strikes, with at least 306 fatalities and hundreds injured in the first three weeks of October, attributed to both the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces. The West Bank is under heavy Israeli restrictions; house demolitions and possible Palestinian displacement in Hebron are reported, with a call for an immediate end to violence.

triage.headline_ja: 本日の主要ニュース｜金曜日：ヨルダン川西岸、スーダン、エボラ、イエメン
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラが8州に拡大し、約1万人の症例・致死率約50％と報じられており、規模・重症度ともに異常かつ深刻な公衆衛生事象に該当するため、フルリスク評価への移行を検討すべき。
triage.notes: 記事は複数国情勢をまとめたダイジェスト形式で、エボラに関する記述は簡潔。報告された症例数（約1万人）は過去のDRCエボラ流行と比較して異例に大きく、情報源の信頼性・正確性について追加確認が必要。イエメン・スーダン・西岸地区は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 奈及利亞：境內伊波拉病例與肯亞首例病毒株存在基因關聯
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria: Domestic Ebola cases are genetically linked to Kenya's first Ebola virus strain.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirmed its first Ebola virus disease (EVD) case on October 20, and genome sequencing shows the virus is closely related to the strain identified in Kenya’s first case, providing the first genetic link between the two outbreaks. The patient is a Nigerian female diplomat who had traveled to Uganda; there is currently no evidence that Kenya’s first case traveled to Nigeria or had direct contact with the Nigerian case. Nigeria now reports one confirmed EVD case, with contact tracing, isolation, and testing underway; some results are negative, others pending. Since the Democratic Republic of Congo declared a large outbreak in May, the virus has spread to several African countries, including Uganda, which reports no current Ebola cases as of yesterday but continues to enhance preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア：国内のエボラ症例はケニアの最初のウイルス株と遺伝的関連性がある
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の複数国（DRC発端、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア）にまたがる遺伝的連鎖が確認され、国際的拡大と重篤性の観点からIHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは本アウトブレイクの発端地として記事中で言及されているため含めた。続報でDRC国内の新規症例動向や各国の渡航制限措置の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Nigerijoje Ebolos virusas nustatytas Šveicarijos pilietei: kontaktą turėjo su 44 asmenimis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Nigeria, Ebola virus detected in a Swiss citizen: she had contact with 44 people.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-24, Nigeria reports its first Ebola case of the Congo outbreak: a Swiss citizen, wife of a Swiss embassy employee in Abuja, has been diagnosed with Bundibugyo ebolavirus. She recently traveled from Uganda to Abuja and developed symptoms; she has been treated in a private Abuja clinic for about a week. A total of 44 people who had contact with the patient have been identified. The Swiss foreign ministry says the patient’s husband is in isolation but asymptomatic; other embassy staff are reportedly well. The case unfolds as the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak, officially declared in mid-May, has reached over 9,000 infections and more than 4,380 deaths; cases have also been reported in Uganda, Kenya and elsewhere. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, muscle pain, and diarrhea; severe cases include internal bleeding and organ failure. Nigeria last faced Ebola in 2014.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでエボラウイルスがスイス人女性から検出：44人と接触
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ(DRC)で継続中の大規模エボラ流行（感染9,000人超、死亡4,380人超）がナイジェリアへ初めて輸入され、新規国への国際的拡大が確認されたため、IHR基準複数該当でフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア(Abuja)での輸入症例だが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。背景として記されているDRCの大規模流行（9,000人超感染）が本イベントの発生源であり、対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に採用した。ウガンダ・ケニアも言及されているが対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية : بدء أول تجربة سريرية للقاح ضد إيبولا في الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine begins in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization announced the first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine to address the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In Bunia, Ituri province, the trial began with the first participant receiving a vaccine named Tomaini, meaning 'hope' in Swahili. This is the worst outbreak in DRC history, with more than 9,700 infections and over 4,600 deaths. The trial includes a large-scale test of the Ervebo vaccine to see if it provides cross-protection against Bundibugyo virus, while a parallel study will evaluate cross-protection from any candidate vaccines against Bundibugyo. The ring vaccination approach will vaccinate contacts at highest risk, including pregnant individuals and children from 12 years and older. Preparations are underway to enroll two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines, one developed at Oxford University and another from Moderna using mRNA technology.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチンの初の臨床試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪とされるエボラ(Bundibugyo種)アウトブレイク（感染9,700超、死亡4,600超）に対し、WHO主導で新規ワクチンの臨床試験が開始されており、公衆衛生上の深刻性と異常性が確認されるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はBundibugyoエボラウイルス種による大規模アウトブレイクへの対応として、Ervebo・Oxford開発・Moderna mRNAワクチン等複数候補の臨床試験開始を報じている。既存アウトブレイクの継続事案であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限の具体的記述はないため当該項目は不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: 36 bebês morrem em hospital e polícia investiga casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 36 babies die in hospital and police investigate cases
article.articleSummary: 36 mothers who lost their infants are contacting authorities over deaths at Hospital Salvalus in Mooca, eastern São Paulo. As of 24 October 2026, the 8th Police District (Brás) is formally investigating six cases, with access to 16 death certificates. Families report hospital-acquired infections and complications such as sepsis and septic shock during or after admission, with some infants failing to survive. The Civil Police investigation includes interviews with healthcare professionals and witnesses and review of medical records to determine circumstances and potential responsibility. Hapvida, which operates Hospital Salvalus, states that patients presented with distinct, serious conditions and received continuous multidisciplinary care, with individualized treatments, and maintains dialogue with families. Causes of deaths and any accountability remain under police inquiry.

triage.headline_ja: 病院で36人の乳児が死亡、警察が捜査
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロの病院で36人の乳児が死亡し、院内感染・敗血症性ショックが疑われ警察が正式捜査を開始しており、異常性・重大性・社会的関心が高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 原因病原体や感染症としての確定診断は不明。院内感染・敗血症による乳児死亡クラスターとして警察が捜査中。感染症起因が確認された場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Zweiter Ebola-Todesfall in Kenia - sieben Patienten isoliert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second Ebola death in Kenya - seven patients isolated.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola deaths in Kenya; 65-year-old woman died Friday evening, a family member of the first Kenyan case, who was under quarantine when symptoms developed in mid-October. Kenya’s health ministry said nine people in the country had been infected, with seven more patients now in two isolation facilities; all confirmed cases belong to a cluster of known contacts, with no evidence of broader community transmission in Kenya. The first Ebola case in Kenya was registered on 6 October: a man infected in the Democratic Republic of Congo who traveled overland to Uganda and then flew to Kenya, where he died in hospital. The DRC outbreak began in mid-May in the eastern DRC and has since recorded over 9,700 cases and more than 4,700 deaths; Africa CDC calls it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで2人目のエボラ死亡例 - 7人の患者を隔離
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ出血熱がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境し死亡例・感染者が報告されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はケニア・ウガンダでの感染拡大を主眼としているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため、発生源であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載した。DRCの流行は2026年5月以降9,700例超・死亡4,700人超と報告され、Africa CDCは史上最速の拡大と評価している。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo avança nas Américas e preocupa o Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles advance in the Americas and worry Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Measles advances in the Americas and Brazil amid vaccination gaps. In the United States, 4,410 confirmed cases and 3 deaths have been reported through Oct 15; Pennsylvania records about 1,400 cases, 5 deaths, 198 hospitalizations by Oct 5, and New York has declared an emergency after 108 cases. PAHO notes the US, Guatemala, Mexico, Peru and Canada account for over 95% of confirmed measles cases in the region this year. In Brazil, São Paulo reports 40 cases this year, 30 of which lacked vaccination or had incomplete schedules. Hesitancy and low coverage fuel spread; vaccination remains critical. The 95% coverage target set by the Ministry of Health and WHO aims to interrupt transmission. The measles vaccine (MMR) is given at 12 months and 15 months; infants 6–11 months may receive an extra dose, and adults should verify records before international travel at least 15 days prior.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹が米州で拡大し、ブラジルも懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち『異常・予想外』『国際的拡大リスク』の2点が該当し、WPRO基準でも複数該当（異常性・曝露継続・流行しやすさ）するため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（サンパウロ州40例、ワクチン未接種が主因）を主軸に、米州全体（米国・グアテマラ・メキシコ・ペルー・カナダ）の麻疹流行状況を伝えている。対象国リストに該当するのはブラジルのみ。米国などの深刻な死亡例・入院例は地域全体の文脈として言及されているが、ブラジル国内の重症度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 影／遊越南發燒吞藥、返台仍確診！高雄增3例境外登革熱
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video: While traveling in Vietnam, developed a fever and took medication; back in Taiwan, still diagnosed with dengue fever. Kaohsiung reports 3 more imported dengue fever cases.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-24, Kaohsiung City, Taiwan reported three additional imported dengue fever cases, bringing the yearly total to 35. A 48-year-old Kaohsiung woman from Sanmin District who travelled to Da Nang, Vietnam (early–late October) developed fever, nausea and a leg rash, self-medicated, and was hospitalized after returning; her husband, who travelled with her, has no symptoms and tested negative. The second case is a 43-year-old Japanese man who toured Thailand and, after arriving in Kaohsiung, tested positive for dengue virus type 2. The third case is a 38-year-old man from Renwu District who travelled to the Philippines and returned with dengue virus type 2. Authorities report community exposure prior to confirmation; enhanced surveillance around residences and high-risk sites. Travelers from dengue-endemic areas should report travel history and symptoms and cooperate with NS1 testing. After the typhoon, standing water may increase mosquito breeding; inspect and eliminate water within 48 hours.

triage.headline_ja: 動画：ベトナム旅行中に発熱し薬を服用、台湾帰国後にデング熱と確定診断！高雄市で輸入性デング熱症例がさらに3例確認
triage.triage_reason: 台湾（対象国外）における輸入症例（渡航者の海外感染後の帰国後診断）の定例報告であり、対象国における感染症発生や地域的流行を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 本事例は台湾・高雄市で確認された輸入性デング熱症例（ベトナム、タイ、フィリピンへの渡航歴あり）に関する定例報告。感染発生地は台湾であり対象国リストに含まれないため、渡航先国（ベトナム・タイ・フィリピン）での感染症発生・流行を示すものではなく、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : des mesures de prévention contre Ebola bravées dans une marche à Kisangani - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: Ebola prevention measures defied during a march in Kisangani - ACP
article.articleSummary: During a Saturday march in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo province in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola virus disease prevention measures were defied as authorities continue the outbreak response. By October 21, 2026, Tshopo had recorded 76 confirmed Ebola cases and more than 30 deaths. The demonstration occurred despite public-health warnings to avoid large gatherings and to uphold barrier measures and other health guidance to curb transmission. The episode underscores ongoing challenges in adherence to infection-prevention protocols amid an active response. Health authorities reiterate the need for the population to follow prevention recommendations and to cooperate with response teams to slow the spread, stressing that community vigilance remains essential in the province’s Ebola control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州：キサンガニでのデモ行進でエボラ出血熱予防対策が無視される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国チョポ州で確認例76件・死者30人超のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続中で、公衆衛生対策の不遵守（大規模集会）も報告されており、国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率は約40%（30/76）と高く、住民の予防対策不遵守（大規模集会の実施）が感染拡大リスクを増大させている。既存のアウトブレイク対応下での事案であり、継続的なモニタリングとWHO等の支援状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Rotary Club International en la lucha contra la Polio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rotary International in the Fight Against Polio
article.articleSummary: Poliomyelitis (polio) is a highly contagious viral infection that mainly affects children under five. It spreads mainly by fecal-oral contamination and, less often, by respiratory droplets. About 70–75% of infections are asymptomatic or mild; fewer than 1% develop paralytic poliomyelitis, causing irreversible paralysis and, if respiratory muscles are involved, death. There is no cure; prevention relies on vaccines—bivalent oral polio vaccine and the inactivated polio vaccine. Global eradication efforts, led by Rotary International with WHO, UNICEF, and CDC through the Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI), emphasize wastewater surveillance, more stable oral vaccines, and reaching children in conflict zones and remote areas. Endemic transmission remains in Pakistan and Afghanistan. Circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus (cVDPV) outbreaks have occurred in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Nigeria, Somalia, and parts of Asia, prompting rapid vaccination responses. Rotary’s role is foundational: mass vaccination in the Philippines and, since 1988, funding billions for vaccines, labs, and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ロータリー・インターナショナル、ポリオ撲滅への取り組み
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はロータリーのポリオ撲滅活動に関する一般的な啓発・背景解説記事であり、新規の発生事例や急性のアウトブレイク情報を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は啓発目的の総括記事で、パキスタン・アフガニスタンの風土病的流行や、DRC・ナイジェリア・ソマリアでのcVDPV発生、フィリピンでのロータリーの過去の集団接種活動などを概観的に紹介しているのみ。新規イベントの速報性はなく、対象国の中では既知の継続的状況としてDRCのみ言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية": أول تجربة سريرية للقاح ضد "إيبولا" في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 24 October 2026, the World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, underway in Bunia, Ituri Province. The inaugural participant received a vaccine named Tomaini (meaning 'Hope' in Swahili). This outbreak is the worst in DRC history, with over 9,700 cases and more than 4,600 deaths. The Tomaini framework will test safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity of several vaccines against Ebola, using a ring vaccination approach targeting the most exposed contacts. In parallel, Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV), approved for the Zaire lineage, will undergo a large trial to assess cross-protection against the Bundibugyo lineage, for which no vaccines or treatments are currently approved. The trial will include pregnant women and children aged 12 and older. Two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are being prepared for inclusion: one from Oxford University and another from Moderna using mRNA technology.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国で初のエボラワクチン臨床試験
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最悪規模（症例9,700件超、死亡4,600人超）のエボラ流行が継続中であり、IHR基準の複数該当とWHOによる国際的な臨床試験介入が報告されているため。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が発表した大規模臨床試験（Tomainiフレームワーク、Ervebo、Oxford・Modernaの新規ワクチン）であり、国際的な研究・支援体制が構築されている点からも継続的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل ثاني وفاة جراء الإصابة بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records second death from Ebola virus infection
article.articleSummary: Kenya records its second Ebola virus disease death, a woman who was a relative of the first fatal case. The Kenyan Health Ministry said the country now has three confirmed cases; she became symptomatic while in quarantine on October 13. The country’s tally stands at nine confirmed infections and two deaths, with seven patients still receiving care in isolation facilities. The first Kenyan case was linked to travel from the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreaks have reached more than 9,700 confirmed cases and around 4,700 deaths. The patient was a man who had been ill for weeks and received care at several facilities in the DRC before traveling by road via Uganda and by air from Entebbe to Nairobi on October 3. These events highlight the cross-border risk associated with the DRC outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラウイルス感染による2人目の死者を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続くエボラ流行（確定9,700例超、死亡約4,700例）がケニアへ越境し、死亡例・隔離患者が発生しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのエボラ流行（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）が感染源として明記されているためDRCのみ記載。

article.articleHeadline: Nhiều trẻ mắc viêm não Nhật Bản biến chứng nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many children with Japanese encephalitis develop severe complications
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Thanh Hoa National Children’s Hospital in Vietnam reports multiple pediatric Japanese encephalitis cases with severe complications. The Infectious Diseases Ward has admitted seven children since early October; several arrive in coma or with seizures, and some develop focal paralysis or require intubation and mechanical ventilation. One 10-year-old patient is severely ill with Japanese encephalitis, brain edema and pneumonia, under intensive care and respiratory support; improvement is ongoing but brain swelling persists. Doctors note that most affected children are not fully vaccinated against Japanese encephalitis. There is no specific antiviral treatment; vaccination remains the most effective preventive measure. Parents are urged to vaccinate on schedule, and to seek prompt medical care for high fever, headache, vomiting, seizures, neck stiffness or altered consciousness to reduce mortality and long-term neurological sequelae.

triage.headline_ja: 多くの小児が日本脳炎に罹患し重篤な合併症を発症
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの一病院で日本脳炎による重症小児例が報告されているが、地方の単一医療機関からの報告に留まり、感染拡大や公的な緊急対応の情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 日本脳炎はワクチンで予防可能な媒介蚊感染症で、ベトナムでは季節性に発生する既知の疾患。本記事は単一病院（タインホア国立小児病院）からの重症例報告であり、ワクチン未接種が主な要因とされている。全国的な流行状況や公衆衛生当局の対応については情報が不足しているため、フルリスク評価には至らずWATCHとした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Uganda restricts transit for travellers from DRC
article.articleSummary: Uganda bars travellers with a history of travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo from transiting through the country while it investigates a traveller who tested positive for Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Nigeria. The policy accompanies the reinstatement of traveller locator forms to aid follow-up and contact tracing. The ministry said the traveller did not show symptoms on departure from Uganda; investigations aim to determine the timing of symptom onset and exposure, with Nigeria seeking full travel history and, where available, genomic sequencing results. Uganda remains Ebola-free; it had earlier declared a Bundibugyo outbreak over in August after 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths, linked to importations from the DRC. As of 20 October, the DRC reported 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths. Nigeria’s genomic finding links the virus to Kenya’s first imported case; both patients travelled through Entebbe on 3 October, and Kenya now reports 9 cases, 2 deaths, with eight linked to the first patient.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ウガンダ、DRCからの渡航者の通過を制限
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,704例・4,687死亡の大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョ）流行が継続中で、ナイジェリア・ケニアへの国際的な感染拡大が確認され、ウガンダが渡航制限措置を実施するなどIHR基準を複数満たす重大な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで継続中のエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス病）流行とその国際的拡大（ナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダ）。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCの大規模流行（9,704例・4,687死亡）が今回の国際拡大の根本原因であり対象国に該当するため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: 肯尼亚再添伊波拉死亡病例 刚果（金）开始疫苗临床试验
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya reports another Ebola death; DR Congo begins vaccine clinical trials.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports the second death in the current Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak: a 65-year-old woman who was a close contact of the first case; Kenya totals 9 confirmed infections and 2 fatalities, with seven patients in isolation; all cases linked to a single known contact and no evidence of community transmission. Uganda confirms a Nigerian traveler who transited through Uganda before returning to Nigeria tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola; authorities are tracing travel history, routes, and contacts and have strengthened measures, including barring transit through Uganda for people with Congo travel history. DR Congo has begun vaccine clinical trials, with Ervebo tested for cross-protection against Bundibugyo virus under the Tumaini program; the first participant was vaccinated in Bunia, Ituri Province. As of Oct 20, 2026, outbreak totals stand at 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths, and the World Health Organization notes the trial could provide crucial evidence to guide response.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ死亡例が再度報告、コンゴ民主共和国がワクチン臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がDRCから複数国（ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア）に拡大しており、IHR基準4項目すべて該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として緊急のリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC発のエボラアウトブレイク（累計9,704症例、4,687死亡）がケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアに国際的に拡大している状況を報告。ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、国際的拡大の主要因であるDRCでの状況（Ituri州Bunia市でのワクチン臨床試験開始含む）は対象国として該当。WHOによるワクチン試験評価が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Les prestataires de la riposte contre Ebola en grève à Nia-Nia pour
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola response providers on strike in Nia-Nia.
article.articleSummary: Strike by Ebola response field workers in the Nia-Nia health zone, Mambasa territory, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, began on Friday, October 23, 2026, as they suspend all activities until nearly three months of prime arrears are paid. The personnel, involved in Ebola surveillance, risk communication and community engagement (CREC), and infection prevention and control (IPC), say primes have not been paid since August. The spokesperson, Dr. Willy Ngeleza, says the dry, indefinite strike stems from exposure risks on the ground and demands full payment. The action takes place amid ongoing Ebola transmission in health areas on the outskirts of central Mambasa, potentially disrupting surveillance, community outreach and IPC activities. Authorities' response was not available at publication’s time. The situation threatens outbreak control efforts in the affected area.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州ニア・ニアでエボラ対応従事者がストライキ
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対応要員が未払い手当を理由にストライキに入り、サーベイランス・感染予防・地域連携活動が停止するおそれがあり、アウトブレイク制御に重大な支障をきたす可能性が高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は致死率が高く国際的懸念が強い疾患であり、現地対応要員のストライキにより監視・感染制御活動が中断するリスクが高いため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。当局の対応状況は記事執筆時点で不明。

article.articleHeadline: World Polio Day 2026: Why the virus still survives in two countries? EXPLAINED
article.articleSummary: Wild poliovirus type 1 remains endemic in Afghanistan and Pakistan as World Polio Day 2026 underscores. Afghanistan recorded the highest global cases in 2026, with most clustered along the Pakistan border in eastern and southern provinces where cross-border movement hinders control. In Pakistan, transmission is largely confined to southern Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, with porous borders enabling continued spread between the two nations, which function as a single epidemiological block. Contributing factors include weak or interrupted vaccination coverage, Taliban resistance and attacks on health workers, disrupted supply chains, access limitations, and distrust of campaigns. Vaccination remains the sole defense, as there is no cure. Globally, polio has been eliminated in over 125 countries since 1988, and India has been polio-free since 2011. The article notes declining 2026 cases versus 2025 and emphasizes coordinated immunisation drives, surveillance, and political commitment to interrupt transmission in hotspot areas.

triage.headline_ja: 世界ポリオデー2026：なぜウイルスは2カ国でまだ存続しているのか？解説
triage.triage_reason: 野生株ポリオウイルスの常在国はアフガニスタンとパキスタンであり、対象国リストに含まれない。インドは「2011年以降ポリオフリー」の例として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため対象国での新規イベントに該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は世界ポリオデーに関する啓発的な解説記事であり、常在流行国はアフガニスタン・パキスタン（いずれも対象国リスト外）。インドはポリオ根絶の成功例として言及されているだけで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Palermo, sospetto caso di Ebola all'ospedale Civico: paziente isolato, esami negativi. Allarme rientrato
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Palermo, suspected Ebola case at Civico Hospital: patient isolated, tests negative. Alarm abated.
article.articleSummary: Palermo’s Civico Hospital treated a man from Congo as a suspected Ebola case after he presented with fever, triggering high‑risk infectious disease protocols. Regional health surveillance promptly activated containment measures, and a blood sample was collected and handled under bio-containment. The specimen was transported to Rome by a 118 emergency helicopter for microbiological analysis. Within hours, laboratory results ruled out Ebola, lifting the alarm and confirming the patient was not infected. The patient remained isolated in the infectious diseases ward as investigations concluded. The episode also served as a functional drill for Sicily’s health system, with summer training having prepared staff to manage similar emergencies. The incident underscored the importance of rapid surveillance, strict biosafety procedures, and preparedness to detect and prevent potential outbreaks, even when a suspected case is ultimately negative.

triage.headline_ja: パレルモ、チヴィコ病院でエボラ疑い例：患者隔離、検査結果は陰性。警戒解除
triage.triage_reason: イタリア・パレルモでの疑い例は検査により陰性が確定し、感染は認められなかったため、公衆衛生上の懸念は解消されている。
triage.notes: 疑い患者はコンゴ出身者だが、発症・診療・検査はすべてイタリアで行われ、エボラ感染は否定された。コンゴ（DRC）での実際の感染事例発生を示す記述はないため対象国には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in DR Congo rises to 4,687; cases reported in Kenya, Nigeria
article.articleSummary: As of 24 Oct 2026, Ebola in Bundibugyo, DR Congo, has 9,704 laboratory-confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths (case-fatality rate 48.3%), with transmission across 66 localities in eight provinces and ongoing high transmission; most deaths occur outside treatment centers, indicating barriers to early detection and access to care. In Kenya, nine Ebola cases have been confirmed, including one death; the initial case was imported from the DRC and eight additional cases were contacts of that patient. Nigeria reports its first imported Ebola case, arriving from Uganda to Abuja, currently isolated with investigations underway to identify the infection source. The World Health Organization stresses strengthened cross-border surveillance, rapid detection, and regional preparedness, and does not recommend travel or trade restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ死者数が4,687人に増加、ケニアとナイジェリアでも症例報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際的拡大）し、複数国（DRC、ケニア、ナイジェリア）への越境伝播が確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし越境伝播の重要な証拠として国際的拡大リスクの判定に使用した。WHOは渡航・貿易制限を推奨していない旨が明記されている。CFR48.3%と致死率が高く、治療施設外での死亡が多いことから早期発見・アクセスの障壁が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Uji coba vaksin Ebola baru dimulai di Republik Demokratik Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola vaccine trials begin in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: New Ebola vaccine Tumaini began trial in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with first participants receiving the vaccine. The trial targets contacts of laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and aims to evaluate efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a variant for which no vaccine is yet approved. Trials are coordinated by CEPI and supported by WHO, the DRC Ministry of Health, and partners. In August, DRC received 70,000 doses of Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) from global stock for outbreak response, though Ervebo is approved for Zaire ebolavirus. As of 24 October 2026, Africa CDC reports over 9,700 confirmed Ebola cases in DRC and more than 4,690 deaths, across eight provinces: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, South Ubangi, North Ubangi. Cross-border spread complicates control; Kenya has nine confirmed cases (two deaths); Nigeria reports first cases linked to DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で新型エボラワクチンの試験開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,700例超・死者4,690人以上の大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、既にケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境伝播が確認されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内（Ituri州Bunia）での新規ワクチン（Tumaini）臨床試験開始を主題としているが、背景情報としてDRC全体で8州にわたる大規模流行（確認9,700例超、死亡4,690人超）およびケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境伝播が報告されている。ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: В Кении зафиксировали второй случай смерти от Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kenya, the second Ebola death has been recorded.
article.articleSummary: Second Ebola death confirmed in Kenya amid its first outbreak. A 65-year-old woman, a close relative of the first victim, died after quarantine; seven other Ebola patients are in two isolation units. All cases are in a single cluster with no evidence of community transmission. The first victim, a man who fell ill in September in Democratic Republic of Congo, traveled to Nairobi and died there. Among those still being treated are three relatives of the first patient, three health workers, and a hospital cleaner. The outbreak has caused more than 4,000 deaths across Africa since May. Kenya has intensified screening for travelers from DRC and nine high-risk countries (Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Burundi, Angola, Zambia, Ethiopia, South Sudan, Central African Republic). Nigeria reports a confirmed case linked to a Kenyan strain; investigations into cross-border exposure via Entebbe, Uganda. Uganda bans transit through its airports for travelers to DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラによる2人目の死亡例が確認される
triage.triage_reason: ケニア初のエボラアウトブレイクで死亡者が発生し、ナイジェリアへの関連症例や国境を越えた渡航制限など国際的拡大・対応の動きが見られるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生国はケニアだが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。最初の感染者はDRCで発症しており、アフリカ全体で5月以降4000人以上の死者が出ている進行中のDRC由来アウトブレイクが背景にあるためDRCを含めた。ザンビア等は高リスク国としてスクリーニング対象に挙げられているのみで実際の発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Число умерших от Эболы возросло до 4 757 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll has risen to 4,757.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 9,816 confirmed Ebola cases, with 2,635 recoveries and 4,757 deaths. Outbreak response measures continue across eight provinces and 66 medical districts, with contact tracing rate at 89.1%. The figures are from a statement issued by the country’s Ministry of Communications and Media. The update underscores ongoing transmission and sustained surveillance and public-health measures to contain spread in the affected regions. Separately, Kenya’s Ministry of Health reported yesterday a second Ebola death, a 65-year-old woman.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱による死者数が4,757人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,816例・死者4,757人という大規模なエボラ流行が継続中であり、ケニアへの波及も報告されていることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニアでの死亡例報告があるが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCの流行は8州66医療地区に及び、接触者追跡率89.1%と大規模な公衆衛生対応が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Уганда запретила транзит через страну посещавшим ДРК из-за Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda bans transit through its territory for those who have visited the DRC because of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Uganda has temporarily banned transit for travelers who recently visited the Democratic Republic of Congo to prevent spread of Ebola caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. It restored mandatory contact-data forms for all arrivals and tightened border and health-facility surveillance, with penalties for noncompliance. The move follows an investigation into a woman infected with Bundibugyo ebolavirus after she traveled from Uganda to Nigeria; she was asymptomatic at departure, and authorities are tracing her movements and potential source. Uganda says it remains Ebola-free with no new cases. The DRC outbreak began in May 2026; WHO reported over 9,700 cases and about 4,700 deaths by Oct 20. Kenya and Nigeria have reported imported cases; Uganda’s May–June cluster included 20 cases and two deaths, with the outbreak in Uganda declared over by August.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ流行のためコンゴ民主共和国訪問者の国内通過を禁止
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（症例9,700超、死亡約4,700）が継続し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境症例やウガンダの渡航制限措置が発生しており、国際的拡大と公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域にナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアが含まれるが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。主因であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل ثاني حالة وفاة بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records second Ebola death
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second Ebola death as of Oct 24, 2026. A 65-year-old woman, a direct contact of the first case and in isolation, developed symptoms on Oct 13. Kenya now has nine confirmed cases, with seven active infections in two isolation facilities; all cases are part of a single outbreak cluster and there is no evidence of community transmission. The first case was a Kenyan man who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo and returned home. The United States warned travelers to Kenya after the country recorded its eighth Ebola case. In the region, the Congo outbreak, ongoing since May 2026, has more than 9,700 cases and over 4,700 deaths. Uganda reported about 20 cases and two deaths, mostly among people from DRC, and was declared Ebola-free in August. Nigeria reported its first case—the wife of a Swiss embassy employee in Abuja who had returned from Uganda—with genetic testing showing the virus similar to Kenya’s strain.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱による2人目の死亡者を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当する大規模なエボラアウトブレイクで、複数国（ケニア、DRC、ウガンダ、ナイジェリア）にまたがる国際的拡大と渡航制限（米国の渡航警告）が確認されており、DRCでは依然として大規模な感染が継続中。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダでのエボラ感染拡大だが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは2026年5月以降継続中の大規模アウトブレイク（9,700例超、死者4,700人超）の震源地として記事内で言及されており、対象国として該当するため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Woman, 65, becomes second patient to die of Ebola in Kenya
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola outbreak with a second death: a 65-year-old woman, relative of the initial patient, who died after symptoms emerged in quarantine on 13 October. The first death, a man who had traveled from the DRC, occurred 5 October after treatment at Kenyan hospitals. Seven more patients remain in two isolation facilities within one cluster; no evidence of broader transmission. Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain is identified; it is rare and has no approved vaccine or treatment, though trials are ongoing. Regional vigilance has intensified: the United States warns against travel to Kenya; Uganda, Ethiopia, and Somalia have raised alert levels. Kenya has enhanced screening for travelers from the DRC and nine high-risk countries, with digital forms and QR codes and reinforced aircraft screening. DRC outbreak shows 9,500+ cases and 4,000+ deaths; Nigeria has a Kenyan-strain-linked case; Uganda probes via Entebbe and bans DRC transit.

triage.headline_ja: 65歳女性、ケニアで2人目のエボラ死亡例に
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初のエボラ出血熱発生とDRCでの大規模流行（9,500例以上、4,000人以上死亡）が関連し、複数国で渡航警告・警戒レベル引き上げなど国際的対応が取られているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの初のエボラ発生（対象国リスト外）だが、背景として言及されているDRCでの大規模流行（9,500例以上、4,000人以上死亡）は進行中の実際のイベントであり対象国のため記載。ケニア自体は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Strategi agresif tekan kasus tuberkulosis - Infografik ANTARA News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aggressive strategy to curb tuberculosis cases - ANTARA News infographic
article.articleSummary: Indonesia has reported a reduction in estimated tuberculosis (TB) cases over the past two years, attributed to the aggressive rollout of screening and case-finding by the Ministry of Health (Kemenkes). The ANTARA News infographic highlights intensified efforts to identify TB infections and trace contacts, enabling earlier diagnosis and treatment to curb transmission. No specific numerical counts are provided in the article. The development underscores the impact of proactive public health measures on TB control in Indonesia, with the strategy centered on widespread screening and robust contact tracing across the country. The report, published as an infographic, emphasizes progress in national TB mitigation as of 2026-10-24.

triage.headline_ja: 結核症例抑制のための積極戦略 - ANTARAニュース・インフォグラフィック
triage.triage_reason: 既存疾患である結核に対する政府の対策進捗を報じる内容であり、異常事態や新規の公衆衛生リスクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア保健省によるTB症例減少の成果を伝える内容で、スクリーニング強化策の広報的側面が強く、緊急シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تطلق أول تجربة سريرية للقاح جديد ضد إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization launches the first clinical trial of a new Ebola vaccine in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization launches the first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the first participant receiving the experimental vaccine Tomaini in Bunia, Ituri province, the outbreak’s epicenter. The current outbreak is the worst in DRC history, with over 9,700 cases and more than 4,600 deaths. Tomaini is a unified ring-vaccination platform designed to test safety and immunogenicity of multiple vaccine candidates against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the lineage driving the epidemic. The study also evaluates the currently approved Ervebo vaccine (against Zaire ebolavirus) for potential cross-protection against Bundibugyo, though no licensed vaccines or therapies exist for this strain. Two additional Bundibugyo vaccines are in early trials—one from the University of Oxford and another from Moderna using mRNA technology—alongside the ring vaccination approach that includes pregnant women and children aged 12 and older.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）、コンゴ民主共和国で新型エボラワクチンの初の臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪とされるエボラ流行（症例9,700超、死者4,600超）に関する報道であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的な対応（新規ワクチン臨床試験）が進行中であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・イトゥリ州ブニアで実施されるエボラ（ブンディブギョ種）に対する新規ワクチン（Tomaini）の臨床試験開始を報じたもの。流行は既に大規模化しており、フルリスク評価の対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue caem em 2026, mas combate ao mosquito continua essencial
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Cases Drop in 2026, but Mosquito Control Remains Essential.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, Brazil, reports a 2026 dengue decline with 57 cases through October 19, down from 212 in 2025 and 584 in 2024. Chikungunya reaches 27 cases in 2026 by Oct 19, vs 61 in 2025 and 20 in 2024; Zika records drop from 16 in 2024 to 5 in 2025, with no 2026 cases logged to date. Aedes aegypti remains a concern: the May–June 2026 2nd Rapid Indices survey (LIRAa) classifies Porto Velho as medium risk for infestation, signaling continued vigilance but no imminent outbreak. Semusa and municipal leadership reiterate prevention and vector-control measures, stressing home-level actions such as securing water tanks, cleaning gutters, preventing standing water, and disposing of containers. Residents with fever, body aches, headache, or red skin rash should seek medical evaluation promptly to ensure proper diagnosis and treatment; community participation is essential.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年、デング熱症例は減少するも蚊対策は依然として不可欠
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱はいずれも前年比で減少しており、異常な増加や重症化、国際的拡大の兆候は見られない。中リスクの蚊生息指数も通常の注意喚起レベルであり、既存の対策で管理可能と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は症例数の減少傾向と通常の蚊媒介対策の継続を報じるルーチン報告であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Porto Velho registra queda nos casos de dengue e mantém alerta contra o Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Porto Velho Records a Drop in Dengue Cases and Remains Vigilant Against Aedes aegypti
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, the capital of Rondônia, Brazil, reports 57 dengue cases in 2026 through 19 October, down from 212 in 2025 and 584 in 2024. Chikungunya totals reach 27 in 2026 (vs 61 in 2025 and 20 in 2024), while Zika shows 16 in 2024 and 5 in 2025 with no 2026 cases recorded so far. The 2nd Rapid Indices for Aedes aegypti (LIRAa) survey (May–June 2026) classifies the city as medium-risk for infestation, signaling ongoing preventive measures without an imminent outbreak. Mayor Léo Moraes stresses community collaboration to eliminate breeding sites; actions include keeping water tanks covered and cleaning gutters. Health Secretary Sandra Cardoso advises seeking a health unit if fever, body pains, headache, or red rash appears, highlighting early diagnosis for appropriate treatment and complication prevention. Vector-control teams continue year-round vigilance, with intensified focus during the rainy season when standing water facilitates Aedes breeding.

triage.headline_ja: ポルトベーリョ市、デング熱症例数が減少、ネッタイシマカへの警戒は継続
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱いずれも前年比で症例数が減少しており、中リスクの蚊インフェスタ評価にとどまる。異常な増加や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められず、通常の季節的な予防活動の報告である。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とする。症例数は前年より減少傾向であり、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Tây Ninh ghi nhận 10 ca tử vong do bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tay Ninh records 10 deaths due to rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Tay Ninh Province, Vietnam, as of 24 October 2026, shows 9 dog rabies cases across 7 communes/wards and 10 human rabies deaths across 10 communes/wards (Lương Hòa, Hưng Điền, Mỹ Hạnh, Đức Lập, Mỹ An, Lộc Ninh, Hòa Khánh, Truông Mít and the wards Thanh Điền, Gò Dầu). In the past week, one additional dog case was recorded, bringing canine infections to 9, while no new human deaths occurred this week; however the cumulative mortality underscores ongoing risk. Preventive measures emphasize full vaccination of dogs and cats, and strict animal management to avoid roaming. After dog or cat bites or scratches, promptly wash the wound with soap under clean water and seek medical care for timely rabies vaccination; avoid unproven treatments. Rabies remains deadly once symptoms appear, highlighting the need for vaccination and proper post-exposure management.

triage.headline_ja: タイニン省で狂犬病による死亡10例を記録
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病はベトナムで地方流行的に発生しており本件も既知のリスクパターンに該当するが、累積10名の死亡と継続的な曝露リスクがあるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はヒト-ヒト感染がなく国際的拡散リスクは低いが、動物由来感染症として継続的な予防接種・暴露後対応の必要性が指摘されている。地方自治体レベルの対応で管理可能とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: el brote de la rara variante Bundibugyo se expande por África y se acerca a su hito más sombrío
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the outbreak of the rare Bundibugyo variant is spreading across Africa and approaching its bleakest milestone
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo variant Ebola outbreak, the 17th in the DRC, was declared May 15 in Ituri province, eastern DRC. This rare strain, with no approved vaccine, has spread to eight provinces and across borders to Nigeria (Abuja case from Uganda), Kenya (first case earlier this month; nine total), and Uganda (two deaths after Congo outbreak). Uganda was previously declared Ebola-free by the WHO. As of 24 October 2026, the outbreak has caused about 4,600 deaths and 9,500 infections, with a case fatality near 50%. It is the most geographically extensive and fastest-spreading outbreak on record, and may surpass the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic (11,000 deaths). Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids; 70% of new cases lack known contact, and 60% of deaths occur outside treatment centers. Oxford vaccine trials began in July.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：希少型ブンディブギョ変異株の流行がアフリカ各地に拡大、史上最悪の節目に迫る
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が複数国に越境拡大し、死者数・感染者数が急増、国際的拡大と重症度の観点からIHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダへの越境拡大が報じられているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRC(イトゥリ州)が発生源かつ対象国であるため含めた。致死率約50%、史上最大規模の流行である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Ασταμάτητος ο Έμπολα: Σχεδόν 4.700 νεκροί στο Κονγκό - Κρούσματα σε Κένυα και Νιγηρία
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unstoppable Ebola: Nearly 4,700 dead in Congo - Cases in Kenya and Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports 9,704 confirmed Ebola (Bundibugho) cases and 4,687 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of October 20, 2026 (case fatality 48.3%). The outbreak covers 66 health zones in eight provinces, with many deaths occurring in communities outside formal care facilities, underscoring gaps in prompt diagnosis, isolation, and treatment. Since Oct 8, 482 deaths: 307 in communities, 175 in treatment centers. As of Oct 20, Kenya reports nine cases (one death) with eight linked to known contacts; first lab-confirmed imported case on Oct 6, traveler from DRC via Uganda; no evidence of wider community transmission. Nigeria confirms an imported case in Abuja, traveler from Uganda, in isolation while authorities trace movements. Disease presents with fever, weakness, myalgia, vomiting, diarrhea, and sometimes hemorrhagic complications. Transmission is via contact with blood or bodily fluids, not airborne. WHO urges sustained surveillance, border monitoring, and joint public health actions; no travel/trade restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: 止まらないエボラ出血熱：コンゴで死者ほぼ4,700人、ケニアとナイジェリアでも症例確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（致死率48.3%）に加え、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的な症例波及が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアでの症例は輸入例であり、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCの流行は66保健区・8州に及び、地域社会内での死亡が多い点が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Ebola Case Genetically Linked to Kenya's First Infection
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports one confirmed Ebola infection, a woman who travelled through Uganda before arriving in Abuja. Lab analyses by the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Redeemer's University show the Bundibugyo virus in Nigeria closely resembles Kenya's first Ebola case, differing by one mutation, though no epidemiological link is established. The patient developed symptoms four days after arrival and is in isolation in Abuja; infection source remains under investigation as of Oct 23, 2026. Forty-four contacts have been identified; some tested negative, with results pending. An emergency response with contact tracing, testing, surveillance, and infection-prevention measures is under way; hospitals instructed to promptly identify suspected cases. Kenya reports nine confirmed cases linked to a patient who travelled from the DRC through Uganda, including one death; no evidence of transmission outside the cluster. The DRC remains the center of the wider Bundibugyo outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ症例、ケニアの初発症例と遺伝的に関連
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）がDRCを起源として複数国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）に拡大しており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダでの感染だが、これらは対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは『より広いブンディブギョウアウトブレイクの中心』と明記されているため含めた。複数国にまたがる国際的な感染連鎖であり、IHR通知相当の事案。

article.articleHeadline: Kenija pranešė apie antrą mirties nuo Ebolos viruso atvejį
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya reports second Ebola virus death.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak linked to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has spread to Uganda and Nigeria. By 6 October 2026 Kenya reported its first imported case when a returning Kenyan from DR Congo died, prompting a second Ebola death in the country. DR Congo’s outbreak—the 17th Ebola event since May—has registered more than 9,000 cases, with Africa seeing over 15,000 deaths in five decades. The Kenyan victim is a 65-year-old woman who had direct contact with the first patient’s family and developed symptoms after being quarantined on 13 October 2026. Kenya records seven active cases, all in two isolation centers, with nine confirmed cases and two deaths overall. The Kenyan cluster is described as a single outbreak with no confirmed community transmission. Uganda reports 20 infections and two deaths; Uganda had been Ebola-free in August. The U.S. advised against travel to Kenya following the eighth case.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラウイルスによる2人目の死亡例を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクがウガンダ、ナイジェリア、ケニアへ国際的に拡大しており、死亡者数増加と渡航制限（米国のケニア渡航勧告）も発生しているため、IHR基準を複数満たす重大事案と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでの死亡例を中心に報じているが、アウトブレイクの起源はDRCであり、同国は対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に記載。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・米国は対象国リスト外のため除外。DRCの流行は5月以降17回目のエボラ事例で9,000例超と大規模であり、地域的な公衆衛生上の脅威として継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 衞生署HIV測試服務網站疑遭冒用 發訊息稱收件人有感染愛滋病風險
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Health HIV Testing Service website suspected of being impersonated; messages claim recipients are at risk of HIV/AIDS infection.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-24, Hong Kong's Department of Health said the HIV Testing Service email accounts were allegedly impersonated, sending messages that recipients are at risk of HIV/AIDS and must seek urgent testing. Ongoing checks with outsourced service providers found no data loss or leakage to date. The HIV Testing Service website will be suspended from today pending a full cybersecurity review by security experts. During suspension, the public may call the AIDS Hotline for free, anonymous, confidential HIV antibody testing. The department stresses the messages are not from the Department; recipients should not click links or provide personal data, and should contact police if suspicious. The agency notes continued cybersecurity risk assessments and has reported the incident to the Police and the Digital Policy Office.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生署HIV検査サービスのウェブサイトが悪用された疑い、受信者がHIV/AIDS感染リスクがあるとのメッセージが送信される
triage.triage_reason: 本件はHIV感染症の発生ではなく、サイバーセキュリティ・なりすましメールに関する行政対応の事案であり、公衆衛生上の感染症シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はHIV検査サービスのなりすましメール・サイバーセキュリティ事案であり、実際のHIV感染拡大や公衆衛生イベントではない。感染症疫学的シグナルとしては非該当。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola Vaccine Trial in Bunia Explained
article.articleSummary: Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, hosts the Tumaini Ebola vaccine trial, a Phase 2/3 adaptive platform evaluating safety, immunogenicity and efficacy of candidates against Bundibugyo virus. The study uses ring vaccination of contacts and other high-risk individuals, aligning with active outbreak conditions rather than mass vaccination. The first candidate is Ervebo, Merck’s vaccine for Zaire ebolavirus, to test potential cross-protection against Bundibugyo, though protection is not guaranteed. Two Bundibugyo-specific candidates are expected to join, with CEPI-supported development including an Oxford-Serum Institute candidate and a Moderna Bundibugyo vaccine; exact products and timelines remain to be disclosed. Coordinated by Congo’s INRB with the University of Antwerp and support from WHO and the Congolese Ministry of Health, the registry is ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07842107 and plans to include pregnant women and children. There is no approved Bundibugyo vaccine yet, and traditional outbreak controls—early detection, isolation, contact tracing—remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・ブニアで実施中のエボラワクチン治験について解説
triage.triage_reason: DRC・イツリ州ブニアにおいてBundibugyoウイルスによる活動的なエボラアウトブレイクを背景にリング接種を伴うワクチン治験（Tumaini試験）が実施されており、エボラ自体が国際的な公衆衛生上の重大疾患であるためIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン治験の解説が主題だが、'active outbreak conditions'という記述からBundibugyoウイルスによる進行中のエボラアウトブレイクが示唆されており、フルリスク評価で詳細確認が必要。WHO・INRB・アントワープ大学が関与し国際的な注目度も高い。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: بدء أول تجربة سريرية للقاح ضد إيبولا في الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine begins in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization launches the first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine amid the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In Bunia, capital of Ituri Province in northeast DRC, the first participant received the new vaccine Tomaini, meaning 'hope' in Swahili, as part of a trial to assess cross-protection against Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The trial will run alongside a large-scale study of the existing Ervebo vaccine, approved for Zaire ebolavirus, to determine whether it offers protection against the Bundibugyo strain. The approach uses ring vaccination, targeting contacts of cases and expanding to pregnant women and children aged 12 and older. Preparations are also underway for two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines, one developed at Oxford University and another by Moderna using mRNA technology, in earlier, more limited trials.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチンの初の臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに関連し、WHOが新規ワクチンの臨床試験を開始したことを報じており、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的関心の高い既存アウトブレイクに関する続報であるためPICKUPと判定。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・イツリ州ブニアで進行中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに対するWHO主導のワクチン臨床試験開始を報じたもの。既存の公衆衛生危機の一部であり、感染拡大・国際支援の継続的必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya reports second Ebola death
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second Ebola death after a 65-year-old woman, a relative of the first Kenyan case, died on 24 Oct 2026. She had been in quarantine and receiving treatment since mid-October after developing symptoms. Seven people are currently in isolation for Ebola in Kenya, and authorities say there are no indications the virus is spreading further among the population. Kenya recorded its first case on 6 Oct 2026, when a man contracted Ebola in neighboring Congo and returned to Kenya, where he died in hospital. The Congo outbreak, detected in May, has surpassed 9,700 cases and more than 4,700 deaths, with the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention calling it the fastest-growing outbreak in history.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで2人目のエボラ死亡例を報告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最速ペースの拡大とされるエボラ流行（9700例超、4700人超死亡）が既に隣国ケニアへ越境伝播しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの2人目の死亡例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。流行の震源地であり記事内で詳述されているコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のみを対象国として計上した。アフリカCDCが『史上最速の拡大』と評する大規模流行であり、越境伝播も確認済みのため優先度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Symptoms, Transmission and How Nigeria Contained the 2014 Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms new Ebola case, a woman arriving from Uganda; she is in isolation after hospital care, with 44 contacts identified. Ebola is a severe virus with 2–21 day incubation; early symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain and weakness, followed by vomiting, diarrhea and abdominal pain, with bleeding. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids or contaminated objects; prompt diagnosis and supportive care improve survival. Nigeria contained its 2014 Ebola outbreak through surveillance and tracing; WHO declared a PHEIC in May over outbreaks in DRC and Uganda. In July 2014, Patrick Sawyer arrived in Lagos infected; transmission halted within three months. An Ebola Incident Management Centre was established July 23; 894 contacts identified, Lagos tracing complete; Port Harcourt 99.8%. A treatment unit was set up within two weeks; about 2,000 caregivers were trained and 19,000 home visits conducted; polio-era emergency structures and Lagos EOC supported the response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：症状、感染経路、そしてナイジェリアが2014年の流行をどう封じ込めたか
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダから入国した女性のエボラ新規感染がナイジェリアで確認され、44人の接触者が特定されており、越境感染および致死性の高い疾患であることからIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（非対象国）での新規エボラ症例であり、感染者はウガンダから渡航。DRCは過去のPHEIC宣言の文脈で言及されているのみで、今回のイベントの発生国ではないため、対象国リストに該当する地域はなし。内容は主に2014年ナイジェリア対応の回顧記事であり、今回の新規症例に関する詳細情報（重症度、死亡者数、拡大状況等）は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Moradabad News: पोलियो वायरस दोबारा जिंदा नहीं होने देने की प्रतिज्ञा जगमगाई
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Moradabad News: The vow to prevent the poliovirus from reviving shines.
article.articleSummary: On World Polio Day, 24 October 2026, Moradabad held an awareness program at Polio Chowk in Civil Lines. Doctors and attendees lit candles to illuminate the fight against the poliovirus and to honor contributors to the eradication campaign. District Immunization Officer Dr. Saurabh Singh urged vaccination for all children up to five years old as part of the polio eradication drive, stressing vigilance, vaccination, and public participation as essential to prevent poliovirus resurgence and to shield children from paralysis. The event highlights ongoing community engagement in Moradabad to safeguard polio elimination efforts. The report does not include any case counts or laboratory confirmations.

triage.headline_ja: モラダバードニュース：ポリオウイルスを二度と蘇らせないという誓いが輝く
triage.triage_reason: 世界ポリオデーの啓発活動に関する記事であり、実際の症例報告や発生情報はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は啓発イベントの報告であり、実際の症例や発生に関する情報は含まれていないため、対象国としての発生事実が確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: Unusual lipid pattern emerges in patients with Brucella spondylitis
article.articleSummary: Brucellosis patients, especially those with Brucella spondylitis, show a distinct lipid pattern in a multicenter cross-sectional study conducted in Inner Mongolia at two infectious disease hospitals in Hohhot and Xing’an League from May 2022 to March 2024. Of 702 brucellosis patients, 296 (42.2%) had spondylitis. HDL-C levels were positively associated with Brucella spondylitis (OR 1.992; 95% CI 1.229–3.228). Three derived lipid–inflammation indices were negatively associated: monocyte-to-HDL ratio (MHR) OR 0.298; atherogenic index of plasma (AIP) OR 0.446; and atherogenic index (AI) OR 0.819. Associations were linear on restricted cubic spline analysis and consistent across age, sex, disease stage, and comorbidities. Sensitivity analysis with multiple imputation supported robustness. Calibration curves and decision-curve analysis suggested lipid-derived indices could aid risk stratification for spinal involvement in brucellosis, though causality cannot be established due to the cross-sectional design; prospective validation is needed.

triage.headline_ja: ブルセラ脊椎炎患者に特異な脂質パターンが確認される
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は臨床研究(脂質プロファイルとブルセラ脊椎炎の関連性)であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性やアウトブレイクの兆候は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は内モンゴルの医療機関で実施された横断研究の結果報告であり、新規アウトブレイクやサーベイランス上の異常事象を報告するものではないため、対象国としても計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Judy, polio-affected chimpanzee who defied the odds, dies after three decades at Ol Pejeta
article.articleSummary: Judy, a polio-affected chimpanzee rescued from wildlife trafficking, died after more than 30 years at Ol Pejeta Conservancy's Sweetwaters Chimpanzee Sanctuary in Kenya. Born in 1983 and believed to have originated from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, she was rescued at about age 10 and arrived with lifelong effects of polio on her right foot. Despite disability, she adapted using her strong front limbs to move and lived among other chimpanzees and caregivers. Judy was a devoted mother to Oscar (born 1997) and spent her later years with companions Alley and Poco. Veterinary staff described her as a symbol of resilience, strength, and kindness, highlighting the importance of sanctuaries in providing lifelong care to trafficked chimpanzees. Her story underscores ongoing need for protection of wildlife and rescued animals.

triage.headline_ja: ポリオを患ったチンパンジーのジュディ、30年以上生きてOl Pejetaで死去
triage.triage_reason: ポリオに感染したチンパンジー個体の死亡に関する動物福祉の話題であり、公衆衛生上のリスクや人への感染拡大の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は1983年生まれのチンパンジー個体の過去の病歴と死亡に関する動物福祉の話題であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクではないため対象国の該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Second Ebola victim buried under strict safety protocols
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Kenya: a 65-year-old woman who died on Oct 23 has been buried under infection prevention measures to balance Muslim burial customs with safety. She is believed to be the mother of Kenya’s index patient, underscoring familial links in the outbreak linked to the DRC. Burial was conducted by trained personnel in PPE; the body disinfected, placed in a designated body bag, and transported to the burial site with mourners prohibited from direct contact. For Muslim rites, staff attempted to honor practices within safety limits, including wrapping in a kafan; ritual washing (ghusl) may be omitted if unsafe. All handlers were trained; single-use PPE discarded, reusable equipment disinfected. Kenya Red Cross, under the Ministry of Health, supports safe dignified burials and psychosocial assistance. Exposed individuals should seek medical care if fever, sore throat, or abdominal pain, and those with travel-related exposure to the DRC outbreak should report to a hospital.

triage.headline_ja: 2人目のエボラ感染者、厳格な安全対策のもとで埋葬
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ outbreak がケニアに波及し、家族内感染・死亡例が発生しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）を複数満たすためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでの2人目のエボラ死亡例（指標患者の母親）とその葬儀対応に焦点を当てており、DRCは感染源として言及されるのみで、ケニア・DRCともに今回の対象国リストに該当する実発生地としては確認できないため、verified_locationsは空とした。ケニア国内での家族内感染拡大・接触者管理の状況は続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Baixa vacinação deixa Brasil em alerta para novos surtos de sarampo | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Low vaccination rates put Brazil on alert for new measles outbreaks | Radio Itatiaia
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak risk in Brazil rises due to low vaccination. In 2026, no state reached 95% coverage for two doses of the measles-mumps-rubella vaccine, and national second-dose coverage remains below 80%. As of 19 October 2026, Brazil had 61 confirmed measles cases across São Paulo, Amazonas, Rio de Janeiro and Acre, with 44 linked to active outbreaks and 17 to outbreaks already closed. The threat grows amid regional outbreaks and imported cases; the United States reports the highest annual measles burden in over 35 years in 2026, with over 90% of cases among unvaccinated or unknown-status individuals. OPAS notes the US, Guatemala, Mexico, Peru and Canada account for most cases this year. Brazil recertified measles elimination in November 2024 after a 2019 interruption. The free SUS vaccine schedule – first dose at 12 months, second at 15 months – offers ~93% protection after one dose and ~97% after two. Symptoms include fever, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, and a rash starting on the face; surveillance and catch-up vaccination are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: 低いワクチン接種率がブラジルを麻疹の新たな流行の警戒態勢に置く
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹排除認定後にブラジルで複数州にまたがる活動的な流行が発生しており、ワクチン接種率の低さと国際的な輸入例の増加により拡大リスクが懸念されるため。
triage.notes: 記事は主にブラジル国内の麻疹流行とワクチン接種率低下を扱っており、米国・グアテマラ・メキシコ・ペルー・カナダは地域的な麻疹流行の文脈で言及されているのみで、対象国リストに該当しないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Жена швейцарского дипломата заболела Эболой в Нигерии
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wife of a Swiss diplomat contracted Ebola in Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Nigeria: The Swiss Foreign Ministry confirmed that a 42-year-old Ugandan woman living in Abuja tested positive for Ebola on 20 October 2026, becoming Nigeria’s first confirmed Ebola case in more than a decade.
