In self-isolation, she carries the Bundibugyo strain; initial malaria suspicion led to visits at several clinics, with the Ebola test conducted on 19 October after 13 days of symptoms. Nigerian authorities say the infection was likely acquired during a trip to Uganda, though the exact source remains unidentified, and no Ebola cases have been reported among the Swiss embassy staff. The ongoing outbreak began in May in the Democratic Republic of Congo and has since spread to Uganda and Kenya; Congo reports about 9,500 infections and over 4,600 deaths. Ebola transmits through close contact with infected bodily fluids; the current outbreak is less active than the 2016 surge. Earlier reports noted that the spread in North Kivu province, DRC, had been out of control.

triage.headline_ja: スイス人外交官の妻がナイジェリアでエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで10年以上ぶりのエボラ確定例が発生し、コンゴ民主共和国で続く大規模流行（感染約9500人、死者4600人超）がウガンダ・ケニアに続き拡大したことを示す事例であり、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの新規エボラ例だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア・スイスは対象国リストに含まれない。流行の起点かつ最大の被害国として言及されているDRCのみを対象国として計上した。

article.articleHeadline: वाराणसी के मंगलपुर में संद‍िग्‍ध हालात में हो रही मौतें, अब बीमारी की जांच करने पहुंची टीम
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deaths under suspicious circumstances in Mangalpur, Varanasi; a team has arrived to investigate the illness.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, in Mangalpur village, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, a month-long spike in malaria, dengue, and typhoid deaths prompted a joint health, sanitation, and local governance response. Door-to-door surveys, anti-larva spraying, and fogging were conducted; 100+ blood samples were collected from a 7,000-population with results pending. Four deaths are detailed: Gulam Rabbani (70) with dengue and liver inflammation; Zulekha alias Maddar (53) with fever; Jamaluddin (33) with confirmed dengue and two dengue-positive children; Ayisha (50) with fever and low blood pressure. Nearest government hospitals are 12–14 km away, complicating emergency transport. Residents demand on-site temporary health camps and regular fogging while investigators work to identify infection sources and whether cases are linked.

triage.headline_ja: ヴァラナシ県マンガルプルで不審な状況下での死亡が相次ぐ、疾病調査チームが現地入り
triage.triage_reason: 単一村落内でのデング熱・マラリア・腸チフスによる死亡集積事例だが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、現時点では情報不足のため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 単一村落(人口約7000人)での1ヶ月間のデング熱・マラリア・腸チフスによる死者集積事例。血液検査結果待ちで感染源・関連性は未確定。医療アクセス(最寄り病院12-14km)の問題も指摘されている。国レベルでの深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えないが、地域の対応能力や感染拡大の可能性を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'Ouganda renforce les contrôles frontaliers avec la RDC et appelle au calme - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Uganda strengthens border controls with the DRC and calls for calm - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports no confirmed Ebola cases and tightens border controls with the Democratic Republic of Congo while urging calm. Permanent Secretary Dr. Diana Atwine, visiting the Mpondwe-Lhubiriha border crossing near Kasindi, stressed that Uganda is Ebola-free and urged residents and visitors to strictly follow screening procedures. The measures come amid questions about the source of an Ebola infection diagnosed in Nigeria in a woman who arrived in Abuja on 3 October after a stay in Uganda. Africa CDC Director General Dr. Jean Kaseya said investigations are ongoing to determine the infection’s origin, noting the patient came from Uganda but transmission may have occurred there, in Kampala, or elsewhere. Ugandan authorities reinforced border screening as cross-border movement with DRC—where Ebola continues to circulate—persists. Uganda had declared the end of its Ebola outbreak in July 2026, but vigilance remains high at borders.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ウガンダがコンゴ民主共和国との国境管理を強化し、冷静な対応を呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ流行が継続する中、ナイジェリアでウガンダ滞在歴のある女性の感染確認を受け、国境を越えた感染拡大・越境対策強化という国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が生じているため。
triage.notes: 主な記事主題はウガンダの国境管理強化だが、ウガンダ・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでエボラが継続流行しているとの記述に基づきDRCのみ含めた。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يربط نيجيريا وكينيا جينيًا.. ومسار انتقال العدوى غامض - أخبار ليبيا 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola genetically links Nigeria and Kenya, and the transmission route remains unclear - Libya News 24
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease shows a genetic link between Nigeria and Kenya, with Nigeria confirming a single case and Kenya reporting its first case. Genetic analysis indicates a close match between the virus from the Nigerian patient and the strain involved in Kenya’s initial case, providing genetic evidence of a link but not proving the transmission route or how the virus reached either country. Nigerian authorities continue extensive contact tracing, quarantine of contacts, and diagnostic testing, with some results negative and others pending; the Nigerian patient had recently traveled to Uganda. Kenyan first-case travel ties to Nigeria are not established. Uganda, currently Ebola-free, tightens border controls to prevent cross-border spread, reintroducing traveler location forms for all arrivals and barring transit of travelers who have been to the Democratic Republic of Congo. Ongoing epidemiological investigations are needed to clarify exposure pathways and transmission dynamics across the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがナイジェリアとケニアを遺伝学的に結びつける…感染経路は依然不明 - アフバール・リビア24
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がナイジェリアとケニアで遺伝学的に関連する症例として確認され、感染経路が不明なまま国境を越えた拡大の懸念があり、ウガンダが渡航制限を強化していることからIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダでのエボラ関連事案であり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは『ウガンダがDRC渡航者の通過を禁止』という渡航制限の文脈でのみ言及されており、DRC自体での症例発生は記載がないためverified_locationsには含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Rabies, Ratusan Hewan di Kediri Divaksin Gratis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Rabies: Hundreds of Animals in Kediri Vaccinated for Free.
article.articleSummary: On 24 October 2026, in Kediri, East Java, Indonesia, PDHI Jawa Timur X provided 300 free rabies vaccine doses during a pet health check and vaccination event. The drive aimed at preventing rabies transmission from animals to humans, offered vaccination for pets including cats, and included free veterinary health examinations. By promoting routine vaccination and health monitoring, the initiative seeks to reduce rabies risk and raise public awareness about pet health and vaccination needs among pet owners in Kediri and surrounding communities. This vaccination effort is presented as a key step in ongoing rabies control and community health protection. Public education components accompanied the event.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病予防のため、クディリで数百匹の動物に無料ワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンの報道であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の発生報告ではなく、予防的な無料ワクチン接種イベントの紹介である。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية تطلق تجربة سريرية لأول لقاح ضد سلالة نادرة من فيروس إيبولا بالكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization launches a clinical trial for the first vaccine against a rare strain of the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization launches the first clinical trial of a vaccine against Bundibugyo Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of 24 October 2026, the outbreak has recorded over 9,700 confirmed infections and more than 4,600 deaths, the worst in DRC’s Ebola history for geographic spread and fatalities. The Phase I study, named Tomaini (Swahili for Hope), started in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province in northeastern DRC, testing the Ervebo vaccine (Zaire ebolavirus) for potential cross-protection against Bundibugyo. The trial employs ring vaccination of contacts of confirmed cases and includes pregnant women and children aged 12 and older. Two additional Bundibugyo-focused vaccines are slated for later phases, including candidates from Oxford University and Moderna, aiming to accelerate a durable preventive solution for Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、コンゴ民主共和国で稀なエボラウイルス株に対する初のワクチン臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのBundibugyoエボラ流行は9,700人以上の感染、4,600人以上の死亡という大規模・異常な流行であり、国際的注目とWHOによるワクチン試験開始という重大な公衆衛生イベントであるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: DRC史上最悪規模とされるBundibugyoエボラ流行における大規模な死亡・感染数、WHO主導の国際的ワクチン試験開始という点で、フルリスク評価の対象とすべき重大シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة ضحايا فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو إلى 4757
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 4,757.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 4,757 deaths and 9,816 infections, with 2,635 recoveries, according to the Ministry of Information and Communications. The ministry says the response remains active across eight provinces and 66 areas, indicating the outbreak's wide geographic footprint. Seventeen more recoveries were recorded in Ituri and North Kivu, and no new infections have been reported recently. The update provides the latest totals and confirms ongoing government efforts to combat the disease across affected regions, as reported by official agencies. These numbers come from the ministry's update and other agencies compiling daily outbreak data.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱による死者数が4,757人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC8州66地域に拡大し死者4,757人・感染9,816人と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中アウトブレイクだが、死者数・感染者数が高水準で8州66地域に拡大しており継続的なリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل ثاني حالة وفاة بفيروس إيبولا وسط إجراءات احترازية مشددة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records second Ebola virus death amid stringent preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second death from Ebola virus disease (EVD) amid Africa's first Ebola outbreak in the country. A 65-year-old woman, a close relative of the first victim, died after developing symptoms on Oct 13 and being placed in quarantine. The initial fatality involved a man who had traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo and sought care at several DR Congo hospitals before arriving in Nairobi, where he died days later. Health authorities say the outbreak is confined to a single cluster, with seven other patients in two isolation facilities; there is no evidence of community transmission. Kenya has stepped up preventive measures and monitoring as it grapples with its first Ebola outbreak in history as of Oct 24, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラウイルスによる2人目の死亡例を記録、厳重な予防措置の中で
triage.triage_reason: ケニア史上初のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで死亡例が発生しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 主な発生国はケニアだが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。初発患者はDRCから渡航した男性で、DRCの複数病院を受診していたことから、DRCでの感染暴露の可能性が示唆されるためDRCを含めた。ただしDRC国内でのアウトブレイク発生は明記されていない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: V DR Kongo začeli klinično preizkušanje cepiva proti eboli, v Keniji druga smrtna žrtev
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DR Congo, a clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine has begun; in Kenya, a second fatality.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola vaccine clinical trial launched in the Democratic Republic of Congo amid what WHO calls the worst Ebola outbreak on record, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The announcement was made from Kinshasa on 24 October 2026, marking a milestone as vaccine testing begins during an ongoing emergency. In Kenya, Nairobi reports a second fatality connected to the outbreak, indicating continued cross-border transmission. The excerpt provides no exact case counts, laboratory confirmation details, or vaccine efficacy results. The report underscores international collaboration and rapid evaluation of vaccine candidates as part of the response to a severe Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo with regional implications for East Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチンの臨床試験開始、ケニアでは2人目の死者
triage.triage_reason: WHOが「記録上最悪」と評価するDRCのエボラアウトブレイクが継続中で、ケニアへの越境伝播による死亡例も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア(Nairobi)での死亡例が報告されているが、ケニアはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主要な発生国であるDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Arranca ensaio clínico de vacina contra Ébola na RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola vaccine clinical trial kicks off in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) escalates as a large-scale vaccine trial begins. The Bundibugyo-ebola outbreak has killed over 4,600 people and surpassed 9,700 cases, making it the deadliest Ebola event in the country’s history. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo variant. In Bunia, the Tumaini trial—Swahili for ‘hope’—launches to test whether Ervebo, an approved vaccine against the Zaire ebolavirus, can provide cross-protection against Bundibugyo. The World Health Organization notes the trial’s primary aim is to determine cross-strain protection. First participants were vaccinated on Friday. This follows the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak, underscoring urgent public health implications and the potential for broader vaccine applicability.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチンの臨床試験開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最悪規模（死者4,600人超、症例9,700件超）のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続しており、承認ワクチン・治療法が存在しないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン臨床試験（Tumaini試験）開始を主題としているが、背景として現行のエボラ流行がDRC史上最悪規模である点が重要な情報。ブンディブギョ株には承認済みワクチンがなく、既存のErvebo（ザイール株用）のクロスプロテクション効果を検証する段階。

article.articleHeadline: The last two countries with polio: Why Pakistan and Afghanistan are struggling to eliminate it
article.articleSummary: World Polio Day 2026 shows Pakistan and Afghanistan remain the last polio-endemic places, with Afghanistan reporting 42 wild poliovirus type 1 cases in 2026 (twice 2025) and Pakistan 6 (down from 31); total 48 this year versus 52 in all of 2025. Environmental samples show ongoing circulation despite few paralytic cases. The Global Polio Eradication Initiative warns that political commitment, access, and trust gaps fuel transmission in insecure, mobile populations. Since 1988, eradication efforts reduced wild poliovirus by over 99%; types 2 and 3 have been eliminated, leaving type 1. The goal remains to certify eradication by end-2027, with over $3 billion spent in Afghanistan and Pakistan in the past decade. The article cites India's Pulse Polio success (1995 onward) as a model: house-to-house vaccination, 2.3 million vaccinators, 209 million households, reaching 170 million children under five, and community-led trust initiatives. Civil society and transit vaccination are also key.

triage.headline_ja: ポリオが残る最後の2カ国：パキスタンとアフガニスタンが根絶に苦戦する理由
triage.triage_reason: 記事はアフガニスタン・パキスタンにおける野生株ポリオウイルスの流行状況を扱っており、インドは過去の根絶成功事例として言及されているのみで、現在インドで感染が発生しているわけではないため対象国に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はWorld Polio Day特集であり、アフガニスタン・パキスタンの流行状況の解説記事。インドは1995年以降のPulse Polioプログラムの成功事例として歴史的に引用されているのみで、現在の感染発生国ではないため対象国リストに該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: У Кенії зафіксували другу смерть від вірусу Еболи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kenya, a second death from the Ebola virus has been recorded.
article.articleSummary: Kenya records a second Ebola virus disease death; a 65-year-old woman, a close relative of the first victim, died after quarantine. Seven more Ebola patients remain in two isolation centers; all cases are within a single cluster with no evidence of community transmission. Since May, when the outbreak was confirmed in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Africa has reported over 4,000 deaths, making this the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak in history. The most recent death followed symptom onset on October 13; the first death, a man who fell ill in September and was treated in DRC hospitals before arriving in Nairobi, occurred on October 5. Ongoing cases include three relatives of the first victim, three healthcare workers, and a hospital cleaning staff member. WHO has warned of bed shortages for Ebola patients in the DRC; transmission is by contact with infected bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラウイルスによる2人目の死亡者が確認された
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生した史上2番目に死者数の多いエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが隣国ケニアへ拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの死亡例だが、アウトブレイクの発生源・主要被害地はDRCであり、対象国リストにはケニアが含まれないためDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。WHOはDRCでの病床不足を警告しており、国境を越えた感染拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia : Lavushimanda Vaccinates 7,013 Domestic Animals Against Anthrax
article.articleSummary: Anthrax vaccination drive in Lavushimanda District, Muchinga Province, Zambia, has immunized 7,013 domestic animals out of a 9,000-target for this quarter, representing 96.91% of the vaccination coverage per district officials. The vaccinated breakdown is 4,616 cattle, 1,618 goats, and 369 sheep. The district received 6,000 doses initially; additional vaccines were available, and the exercise remains underway with officials saying vaccination is over 90% complete. The drive was discussed at a District One Health Technical Working Group meeting held at the District Health Office. Senior One Health Officer Albertina Moraes of ZNPHI urged multi-agency coordination and attendance verification. Metrologist Thomas Maunda from the Ministry of Green Economy emphasized the group’s role in disaster planning and risk response, noting it includes health, council, ZANIS, Livestock and Fisheries, Disaster Risk Management, Chamber of Commerce, and traditional leaders.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア:ラブシマンダ地区、炭疽病予防のため家畜7,013頭にワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: 家畜への予防的ワクチン接種活動に関する記事であり、ヒトの感染症発生や異常事態の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は家畜への予防的炭疽ワクチン接種活動の進捗報告であり、ヒトまたは動物の炭疽症の発生事例は報告されていない。One Health体制下の平常業務として実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola -RDC: le gouvernement renforce la riposte épidémiologique face à la hausse des cas - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the government strengthens the epidemiological response amid rising cases - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo remains active across 8 provinces as of 24 October 2026, with 66 of 78 health zones affected. Rising case numbers prompted a strengthened epidemiological response. Mandima, Ituri province, and North Kivu are highlighted as priority areas where interventions have been intensified to contain transmission and safeguard progress elsewhere. The strategy emphasizes enhanced community surveillance, upstream vaccination, prompt diagnosis and treatment, and sustained human, logistical, and financial resources. The response has expanded the laboratory network and now includes over 26 treatment centers. Notably, 12 health zones have not reported cases for 42 days, while 5 zones have remained without cases for more than 21 days. The report also notes cholera cases declining in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 - コンゴ民主共和国：症例増加を受け政府が疫学的対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC東部8州66保健地区に拡大し症例増加中であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際拡大リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染のおそれがあるためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: コレラについても言及があるが「地域で減少傾向」とされており、主題はエボラ出血熱の拡大・対応強化。

article.articleHeadline: Second Ebola victim buried under strict safety protocols
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola deaths have occurred in Kenya, including a 65-year-old woman who died on Oct 23 and is believed to be the mother of the index patient. She was buried on Oct 24 under strict infection prevention measures to balance Muslim burial traditions with safety. Trained personnel in PPE disinfected the body, placed it in a designated body bag, and transported it to the burial site with mourners prohibited from direct contact. For Muslim rites, wrapping in a kafan is allowed when safe, and ritual washing (ghusl) may be omitted if unsafe. The Kenya Red Cross, under ministry guidance, supports safe and dignified burials and provides psychosocial support. Authorities urge anyone exposed or who traveled to/from a country with an outbreak (e.g., DRC) to seek medical care if fever, sore throat, or abdominal pain develops.

triage.headline_ja: 2人目のエボラ出血熱犠牲者、厳格な安全対策の下で埋葬
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでエボラ出血熱による死亡例が複数発生し（人人感染が疑われる家族内感染）、国際的拡大リスクやDRCの流行地域との関連も示唆されており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの死亡例と埋葬対応であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。DRCは渡航歴リスクの文脈でのみ言及されており、本記事の発生地点ではないため除外。ただしDRCのエボラ流行との関連性が疑われる重要な国際拡散シグナルである点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Abate de perus, estado de emergência e isolamento: o que se sabe sobre o caso de Doença de Newcastle em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Turkey Culling, State of Emergency and Isolation: What Is Known About the Newcastle Disease Case in Santa Catarina
article.articleSummary: Newcastle Disease case detected in a Nova Itaberaba turkey farm in western Santa Catarina led to the slaughter of about 6,000 birds and four municipalities declaring a zoosanitary emergency for 60 days (Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, Nova Erechim). Confirmation followed active surveillance; samples were collected Sept 21, with a preliminary indication Oct 14 and confirmation Oct 18. Authorities monitor a 10 km radius, with nine Cidasc teams inspecting about 1,600 rural properties; around 133 of these properties are expected to require additional culling. The outbreak triggered disinfection and a vet check, and the site has environmental approval. Export suspensions: Mexico and Malaysia halted purchases of Brazilian poultry; Chile, Saudi Arabia, and China restrict products of Santa Catarina origin (e.g., fertile eggs, SPF eggs, day-old chicks, ornamental birds, fresh meat, and processed poultry). Newcastle Disease is a contagious viral infection of birds; human consumption remains safe under official inspection.

triage.headline_ja: 七面鳥の処分、非常事態宣言、隔離措置：サンタカタリーナ州のニューカッスル病感染事例について分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の七面鳥農場でニューカッスル病（家禽の感染症）が確認され、複数国が貿易制限を課しているが、人への健康影響は報告されておらず（食用は安全とされる）、人獣共通感染症としてのリスクは低いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（七面鳥）のニューカッスル病であり、人への健康影響は確認されていない（記事内で人の消費は安全と明記）。複数国（メキシコ、マレーシア、チリ、サウジアラビア、中国）がブラジル産鶏肉・卵製品の輸入を制限しているが、これは動物衛生・貿易上の措置であり、人のアウトブレイクではない。発生地域リストに中国・マレーシア・チリ・サウジアラビア・メキシコが含まれるが、これらは輸入停止国であり発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Launches Trial of New Ebola Vaccine
article.articleSummary: DR Congo launches a clinical trial of Tumaini, an experimental Ebola vaccine targeting Bundibugyo strain, as the outbreak continues and spills into Kenya and Nigeria. The first volunteer received Tumaini in Bunia, Ituri, marking a phase to assess protection among contacts of confirmed cases. No vaccine is approved specifically for Bundibugyo; Ervebo, approved for the Zaire strain, arrived 70,000 doses in August to aid the response. The trial is coordinated by CEPI with WHO and DR Congo's Ministry of Health. The Bundibugyo strain was identified in DR Congo in May. Africa CDC reports over 9,700 confirmed cases and more than 4,690 deaths in DR Congo across eight provinces: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, South Ubangi, North Ubangi. Cross-border transmission continues, with Kenya reporting nine cases and two deaths; Nigeria has a suspected imported case linked to the outbreak. The study will follow ethical standards.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、新たなエボラワクチンの治験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行が継続し、9,700例超の感染、4,690人超の死亡が報告され、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境伝播も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ケニア（9例、死亡2）、ナイジェリア（疑い輸入例1）への越境伝播が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。CEPI・WHO・DRC保健省が共同で新規ワクチン（Tumaini）の治験を開始しており、国際的な支援体制が構築されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola kills ANOTHER victim as woman becomes Kenya's 2nd fatal case of outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola kills another victim in Kenya, bringing the country’s fatalities to two. A 65-year-old woman, a close relative of the first victim, died after developing symptoms while quarantining in Nairobi; the death follows a 40-year-old Kenyan man who died in Nairobi on Oct 5 after travelling from the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Ebola has killed more than 4,000. The latest patient began showing symptoms about 10 days ago and was treated at an infectious-disease unit in Nairobi; she died Friday evening. Seven Ebola patients remain in two isolation facilities; no new infections reported, and all cases are in one cluster with no evidence of community spread. The Oct 5 case prompted contact tracing: about 135 contacts identified, 118 quarantined, eight tested positive (including the latest victim, four health workers, and three relatives). Borders are on high alert as the DR Congo outbreak continues; France and Nigeria have reported cases connected to travel, with Africa CDC noting that Kenya’s and Nigeria’s first patients travelled through Entebbe, Uganda on Oct 3.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがまた犠牲者を出す、ケニアで2人目の死亡例に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ流行がケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスへ国際的に拡大しており、IHR基準の複数項目（国際的拡大、渡航制限）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入例による二次感染死亡だが、ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは流行源として継続的に言及されており対象国リストに該当するため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Inician ensayo clínico de vacuna contra el ébola en territorio congoleño
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine begins in Congolese territory.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) vaccine trial launched in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, at the epicenter of the outbreak. The World Health Organization began the first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine in Congo, vaccinating first participants with Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV). The trial aims to assess cross-protection against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the strain driving the current epidemic in the Congolese territory. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus highlighted that the initiative seeks answers to save lives. Since May, the DRC has reported more than 9,700 cases and over 4,600 deaths in what is its seventeenth and deadliest outbreak. The outbreak has spread to four nations across eastern, central, and western Africa. WHO activated the second-highest alert level under the Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ領内でエボラワクチンの臨床試験開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの史上最多・最致死のエボラ流行（9700例超、4600人超死亡）が4カ国に拡大しWHOがPHEIC相当の警戒レベルを発令しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・イツリ州ブニアでのエボラワクチン臨床試験開始を報じており、流行自体は既にPHEIC級の重大事案として進行中。拡大先の4カ国の具体名は記事内に記載されていないため、対象国リストに含まれる国としてはDRCのみを検証対象とした。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Uji Coba Vaksin Ebola Tumaini Hadapi Varian Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kongo Ebola Vaccine Tumaini Trial Faces Bundibugyo Variant
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo launches Ebola vaccine Tumaini trial to counter the Bundibugyo variant. WHO confirms the first participant was vaccinated in Bunia, Ituri Province, on 24 October 2024. Tumaini, Swahili for 'hope', is designed specifically against Bundibugyo; no approved vaccine exists for this variant since its May emergence in the Congo. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus calls the trial a crucial step to assess efficacy. The study enrolls contacts of confirmed cases and is coordinated by CEPI with support from the Congo Ministry of Health and WHO. Cross-border spread challenges the epidemic: Kenya reports nine confirmed cases and two deaths; Nigeria confirms its first case this week, suspected to originate from Congo. In August, Congo received 70,000 doses of Ervebo for the Zaire variant, underscoring the need for Tumaini.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、ブンディブギョ変異株に対抗するエボラワクチン「トゥマイニ」の治験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ発のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ変異株）がケニア・ナイジェリアへ越境拡大し死亡例も報告されており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。承認済みワクチンが存在しない新変異株であり、WHO・CEPIが治験を主導している点でも注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲伊波拉疫情蔓延　肯亞通報第2起死亡病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading in Africa; Kenya reports a second death.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second Ebola virus disease death, a 65-year-old woman who developed symptoms during isolation and is a close relative of the first fatal case. The outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo and has spread to Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. The most severe phase remains in the DRC, with nearly 10,000 confirmed cases and over 4,600 deaths. Kenya confirmed its first case earlier this month: a man who traveled from the DRC to Nairobi and died on October 5 at a Nairobi hospital. Since then, authorities have traced 135 contacts and isolated all of them; Kenya now has nine confirmed cases. As of October 24, 2026, the evolving spread highlights ongoing transmission linked to cross-border movement, with ongoing surveillance and isolation of contacts to curb further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ流行拡大、ケニアで2人目の死亡例を報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCからウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへ越境拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（重大性、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが発生源かつ最も深刻な地域として対象国リストに該当するため含めた。越境拡大の動向は引き続き注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola vaccine trial offers hope amid deadly DRC outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the DRC has surpassed 9,500 cases and 4,600 deaths across eight provinces, with Ituri as the epicentre and Nord Ubangi the latest affected province. The Tumaini vaccine trial in Kinshasa is about to begin, with first doses this week; Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus) will be tested initially, while two Bundibugyo-specific candidates could be added in November. Ervebo is a single-dose Merck vaccine for ages 12 months+, but its effectiveness against Bundibugyo is unproven and WHO is assessing potential cross-protection. Imported/exported cases are being investigated: Nigeria reports a traveler from Uganda; Kenya records nine cases and one death linked to DR Congo work; Uganda's outbreak, with 20 cases and two deaths, was declared over at the end of August. Trials of MBP134 and remdesivir enroll over 600 patients; WHO emphasizes surveillance and safe care amid security constraints.

triage.headline_ja: エボラワクチン治験、DRCの致死的アウトブレイクに希望をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが9,500症例・4,600死亡と大規模化し、複数国への越境拡大も報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダへの越境症例が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。主要な発生地はDRCの8州（イトゥリ州が震源地、ノール・ウバンギ州が最新）。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲伊波拉疫情蔓延　肯亞通報第2起死亡病例 - 國際新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading in Africa; Kenya reports its second death.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second Ebola death as Africa-wide outbreak linked to the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread. The 65-year-old woman who died during isolation is a close relative of the first fatal case in Kenya. Kenya has confirmed 9 Ebola cases to date, all stemming from a man who traveled from the DRC to Nairobi and died October 5 in a Nairobi hospital. Since the initial case, authorities have traced 135 contacts and isolated them all. The outbreak began in the DRC and has spread to Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. The DRC has nearly 10,000 confirmed cases and over 4,600 deaths. As of 24 October 2026, Kenya maintains active surveillance and isolation measures to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ出血熱が拡大、ケニアで2人目の死亡例を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ出血熱がウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへ国際的に拡大し、DRCでは約1万人の感染・4600人超の死亡という深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリアでの発生が記事の主題だが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。アウトブレイクの起源であるDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل حالتي وفاة بفيروس إيبولا مع تشديد الإجراءات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records two Ebola virus deaths as measures tighten.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola virus disease deaths in Kenya, with the outbreak confined to a single transmission cluster and no evidence of community spread. The first death occurred on October 5 in a man who had recently traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and had treatment in several DRC hospitals before arriving in Nairobi, where he showed symptoms in September. The second death is a 65-year-old woman, a relative of the initial case, who developed symptoms on October 13 and died shortly after while in quarantine. In total, seven additional patients are receiving care in two designated isolation facilities. Health authorities report all confirmed cases linked to one hotspot and are intensifying quarantine, surveillance, and border/entry controls to curb further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラウイルスにより2人死亡、対策強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病による死亡例が確認され、クラスター内で複数の隔離患者も発生しており、国境・検疫対策が強化されていることから、IHR基準に複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアで確認されたエボラ死亡例であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。最初の症例はDRCから渡航しDRCの病院で治療歴があるとされるが、記事はDRC国内での発生を主題としていないためDRCも除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : les prestataires de Rwampara et Kasenyi menacent de suspendre leurs activités
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: service providers from Rwampara and Kasenyi threaten to suspend their activities.
article.articleSummary: Ebola response staff in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, threaten to suspend activities at Rwampara (Bunia area) and Kasenyi Ebola Treatment Center in the Tchomia health zone over 77 days of unpaid allowances and communications fees at Rwampara, and missing payments for May, June, August, and September 2026 at Kasenyi. In a memorandum to the Ituri governorate and health authorities, they allege payroll irregularities, including fictitious names, and demand a joint commission to audit payrolls and ensure funds reach field workers. They also note a pay disparity with Ugandan colleagues at the same center who reportedly receive regular salaries. The ultimatum gives 48 hours to regularize pay; failure could disrupt the Ebola response and patient care in Ituri, the epicenter of the outbreak, with authorities yet to respond publicly.

triage.headline_ja: イツリでのエボラ出血熱対応：ルワンパラおよびカセニィの医療従事者が活動停止を警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクの治療センターにおいて、未払い賃金問題により対応活動が停止する恐れがあり、患者ケアおよび流行対応に深刻な支障をきたすリスクがあるため。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ治療センター職員の賃金未払いによるストライキ警告が主題だが、背景にあるのはイツリ州（流行震源地）での継続中のエボラアウトブレイクであり、対応活動の中断は公衆衛生上重大なリスクとなる。ウガンダ・ルワンダは国境近接地域として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Thoothukudi Corporation intensifies dengue preventive measures following rains
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Thoothukudi Corporation intensified dengue prevention following intermittent rainfall. A total of 212 Domestic Breeding Checkers (DBC) are conducting door-to-door inspections across 60 wards to locate dengue mosquito larvae in water storage tanks, drums, flower pots, coconut shells, discarded tyres and potential breeding sites. Larvicides are being applied and mosquito control activities underway. In addition to routine cleaning, intensive operations target stagnant rainwater, garbage and breeding sources in vacant plots, parks and public spaces. Fogging is carried out across all wards with four vehicle-mounted foggers and 20 handheld pulse fogging machines. Areas with higher fever incidence are identified, with special medical camps for fever screening and treatment. Fines under the Public Health Act are imposed for open-space littering and water stagnation. Public urged to clean and cover drinking-water tanks twice weekly and to seek hospital care for fever; cooperate with DBC staff.

triage.headline_ja: トゥートゥクディ市当局、降雨を受けてデング熱予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 定例的な予防対策の強化に関する報道であり、異常な流行拡大や重症例急増の報告はなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による季節性のデング熱予防・対策活動の報道であり、通常の公衆衛生業務の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ernakulam witnesses decline in influenza cases
article.articleSummary: Ernakulam district, Kerala, reported a decline in influenza activity in October 2026, with 335 cases recorded through October 23. Dengue cases surged in October, totaling 588 (168 confirmed, 420 suspected), while leptospirosis stood at 31 cases (24 confirmed, 7 suspected) with two deaths. Health officials attributed the influenza dip to its seasonal pattern and rising population immunity, suggesting a possible resurgence only remains at a baseline level through the northeast monsoon; travel could spark out-of-season spikes. Authorities emphasized intensifying dengue- and other monsoon-disease precautions via source-reduction measures. While influenza severity has eased, there is an uptick in viral infections such as hand, foot and mouth disease and respiratory syncytial virus. Vaccination and hygiene are urged to help prevent influenza transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エルナクラムでインフルエンザ症例が減少
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザは季節的な減少傾向で、デング熱・レプトスピラ症も地域内の季節性疾患として通常の監視範囲内であり、国際的拡大や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はケララ州エルナクラム地区の季節性感染症（インフルエンザ減少、デング熱増加、レプトスピラ症）に関する地域保健報告であり、通常の季節的動向の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تُسجل ثاني وفاة بفيروس إيبولا وسط إجراءات مشددة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records second death from Ebola amid tightened measures.
article.articleSummary: Kenya has recorded its second Ebola-related death in its first documented outbreak, with seven other patients under treatment in two isolation facilities. The deceased is a 65-year-old woman who was a close contact of the first case and died after being quarantined. The index patient had traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Nairobi and reportedly sought care at several DR Congo hospitals before arriving in Kenya. The first case was confirmed on October 5, and authorities say all infections are linked to a single outbreak cluster with no evidence of community transmission. The second death follows isolation on October 13. Ongoing surveillance and tightened public health measures remain in place to contain the cluster.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラウイルスによる2人目の死亡を記録、厳戒態勢強化
triage.triage_reason: ケニア初のエボラ出血熱発生で2例目の死亡が確認され、DRCからの越境感染事例であることからIHR基準を複数満たし、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 指標患者はDRCから渡航しケニアで発症・死亡に至ったが、DRC国内での発生自体は記事に明記されていないため、対象国リストに該当する発生国なしと判断した（ケニアは対象国リストに含まれない）。

article.articleHeadline: Buxar News: पोलियो से बचाने के लिए नियमित टीकाकरण जरूरी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Buxar News: Regular vaccination is essential to prevent polio.
article.articleSummary: On World Polio Day (2026-10-24) in Buxar, India, an awareness program was held at the Sabit Khidmat Foundation & Hospital located in the sugar mill area of Abhiyan Nagar. Dr. Dilshad Alam, foundation director and former Rotary Club president, urged parents to ensure regular vaccination and administration of polio doses to children, highlighting the role of routine immunization in preventing poliomyelitis. He noted India’s last polio case was in 2011 and that the World Health Organization declared South Asia polio-free in 2014, with commendation for health workers, government, community volunteers, and Rotary International. Caution was raised about ongoing poliovirus circulation in Pakistan and Afghanistan. Attendees pledged to raise public awareness to build a polio-free society; banners promoted vaccination. No polio case counts were reported in the event."

triage.headline_ja: ブクサールニュース:ポリオから子どもを守るために定期予防接種が重要
triage.triage_reason: 実際のポリオ症例報告ではなく、世界ポリオデーの啓発イベントに関する記事であり、インドは2011年以降症例なし。公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ビハール州ブクサールでの世界ポリオデー啓発活動を報じるもので、実際の感染事例ではない。パキスタン・アフガニスタンでの野生株流行に言及があるが対象国リストに含まれず、インドも症例なしのため検証対象地域には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Air Tercemar E. Coli, Warga Serpong Lagoon Tangsel Tuntut Ganti Rugi Rp 539 Juta ke Pengelola WTP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Water contaminated with E. coli, Serpong Lagoon residents in South Tangerang demand Rp 539 million in damages from the Water Treatment Plant operator.
article.articleSummary: Water contaminated with Escherichia coli in the Serpong Lagoon area’s clean-water supply has prompted residents of Serpong Lagoon, Keranggan, Setu, South Tangerang, Banten, to seek Rp 539,885,394 in damages for medical costs from the local water treatment plant operator. The provisional total, calculated as of Oct 23, 2026, reflects claims across all blocks; not all victims submitted receipts, and some could not provide proof. Documentation was collected over only two days, limiting totals. Residents set a deadline to the WTP operator to respond with a reimbursement scheme by the following Tuesday, following mediation led by Deputy Mayor Pilar Saga Ichsan. If no progress, they will pursue civil suits with lawyers ready. In RW 007, 96 households filed claims, with per-person amounts varying and focused on medical costs.

triage.headline_ja: E.coli汚染水問題、南タンゲラン・セルポンラグーン住民が水道事業者に5億3900万ルピアの損害賠償を要求
triage.triage_reason: 単一地域の水道汚染による健康被害・損害賠償請求事案であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念はないが、住民多数への健康影響と社会的関心（訴訟・補償交渉）が見られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 水道水のE.coli汚染による住民健康被害と損害賠償請求に関するローカルニュース。公衆衛生危機というより水質管理・消費者補償問題の色合いが強い。重症度や感染拡大の情報は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Nigeria: One Confirmed Case, Open Questions, and Why Calm Accuracy Matters
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Nigeria reports one laboratory-confirmed imported case of Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease in Abuja, not a nationwide outbreak. The patient is a Ugandan-born Swiss national married to a Swiss Embassy staff member; she arrived from Uganda on 3 October, developed symptoms on 7 October, and tested positive on 20 October. The case is under investigation, with the patient isolated and care ongoing; Nigeria's NCDC activated its incident-management system. The infection source remains unclear; Uganda cited a possible exposure in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), while Switzerland said the patient and husband traveled to Uganda but did not visit the DRC; WHO has not confirmed a DRC visit. Nigeria had identified 44 contacts by 20 October with monitoring ongoing. The DRC outbreak began on 15 May 2026, making Nigeria the fifth country detected; WHO emphasizes rapid containment and avoidance of travel bans, with no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo virus disease and ongoing support for the TUMAINI vaccine trial in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでエボラ:確定症例1件、残る疑問、そして冷静かつ正確な対応が重要な理由
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ・アウトブレイクに関連する輸入症例がナイジェリアで確認され、国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクを伴うIHR基準に複数該当するため、フルリスク評価へ進むべきシグナルと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（アブジャ）での輸入症例だが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源とされるDRCで5月から継続中のアウトブレイクが背景にあるためDRCを verified_locations に含めた。ウガンダ・スイスは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Vanesa Britos internada en Brasil con 40 de fiebre y sospecha de dengue: "Me agarró un virus bastante jodido"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vanesa Britos hospitalized in Brazil with a fever of 40°C and suspected dengue: "I've been hit by a pretty nasty virus"
article.articleSummary: Uruguayan singer Vanesa Britos is hospitalized in Brazil with a three-day fever reaching 40°C as doctors evaluate a viral illness. Initial tests detected a bacterial presence, and clinicians are investigating the possibility of dengue, though a definitive diagnosis has not been confirmed and further exams are planned. Britos, who resides in Brazil with her husband, Flamengo footballer Nicolás de la Cruz, is receiving intravenous fluids and multiple medications. She announced the cancellation of planned shows in Uruguay, including dates in Sauce, with plans to reprogram later. In a hospital message, she expressed disappointment at not fulfilling commitments but emphasized that health comes first and apologized to fans and organizers. The ongoing diagnostics aim to determine the fever’s source, with no confirmed dengue diagnosis at this time.

triage.headline_ja: ヴァネサ・ブリトス、ブラジルで40度の発熱とデング熱疑いで入院「かなりやっかいなウイルスにやられた」
triage.triage_reason: 個人の有名人に関する単一症例報道であり、デング熱の確定診断もなされておらず、公衆衛生上の広がりや異常性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: ウルグアイ人歌手がブラジルで入院し、デング熱の疑いがあるが未確定の個人症例。公衆衛生イベントとしての重大性は認められない。ウルグアイは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática do Congo testa vacina contra ebola - 24/10/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo tests an Ebola vaccine - 24 October 2026
article.articleSummary: On Oct 23, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo launched the first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine for the Bundibugyo outbreak. The Tumaini study, meaning 'hope' in Swahili, tests whether the Ervebo vaccine (rVSV-ZEBOV) approved for Zaire ebolavirus offers cross-protection against Bundibugyo. Initiated in Bunia, capital of Ituri province—the outbreak's epicenter—the trial uses ring vaccination, targeting high-risk contacts. The DR Congo has logged over 9,700 Ebola cases and more than 4,600 deaths to date. Two Bundibugyo-specific candidates are also being prepared for early-stage trials: the ChAdOx1 adenoviral vector vaccine (Oxford) and a Moderna mRNA vaccine. The effort aims to broaden protection against Bundibugyo and enhance outbreak containment, with laboratory-confirmed evaluation of cross-immunity and potential future vaccine deployment strategies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラワクチンの臨床試験を開始 - 2026年10月24日
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクは既に9,700例超・死者4,600人超に達しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的な対応（複数のワクチン候補の臨床試験）が確認されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はイトゥリ州ブニアを中心としたエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに対する複数ワクチン（Ervebo, ChAdOx1, Moderna mRNA）の臨床試験開始を報じている。累計症例数・死亡者数が非常に大きく、既存の大規模アウトブレイクとしてフルリスク評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: У Кенії зафіксували другу смерть від Еболи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kenya, the second Ebola death has been recorded.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Kenya reports its second Ebola death in the country’s first outbreak. The patient was a 65-year-old woman, a close relative of the initial case—a man who fell ill in September after treatment in DR Congo and arrived in Nairobi. Symptoms appeared 13 October while in quarantine. Seven others are under care: three relatives of the first casualty, three healthcare workers, and a hospital cleaner; authorities say all cases stem from one transmission cluster with no confirmed domestic spread. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which no approved vaccines or specific treatments exist, though drug trials are ongoing. Since May, Africa’s DR Congo outbreak has claimed over 4,000 lives, the second-deadliest on record. The US warns against travel to Kenya; Kenya has heightened entry screening and digital monitoring for arrivals from DR Congo and nine high-risk countries. Uganda, Ethiopia, Somalia declared high alert; Uganda banned transit for travelers from DR Congo. Nigeria reports its first Ebola case and is investigating possible contact with the Kenyan patient during transit via Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで2人目のエボラ出血熱による死者を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がDRCからケニアへ国際的に拡大し、複数国が渡航制限・高度警戒を発令するなど国際的関心が極めて高い事例であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する。
triage.notes: 本事例の主たる発生地はケニアだが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、感染源であり5月以降4000人超の死者を出しているDRCの大規模流行が記事の重要な主題として明示的に扱われているため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含めた。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・エチオピア・ソマリア・米国も言及されているが対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: UGM Kembangkan Sistem Berbasis AI untuk Prediksi Dini Wabah Demam Berdarah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UGM Develops AI-Based System for Early Prediction of Dengue Fever Outbreaks
article.articleSummary: In Sleman, Yogyakarta, Indonesia, researchers from Universitas Gadjah Mada's Center for Tropical Medicine (PKT) are developing ExplainDengue, an AI-driven platform to predict dengue fever outbreaks. The system integrates diverse data sources—case data from health facilities, weather and climate information, and rainfall—into a single framework to forecast future transmission risk by region. By identifying areas likely to experience rising cases, ExplainDengue aims to strengthen early warning and enable proactive public health actions. The project also incorporates monitoring data from Electronic Medical Records in the Emergency Department to capture initial patient conditions. This approach leverages the link between environmental changes and the Aedes aegypti mosquito, the primary dengue vector, to improve risk assessment and guide early preventive measures. Published 2026-10-24.

triage.headline_ja: UGM、デング熱流行の早期予測のためAIベースシステムを開発
triage.triage_reason: 記事はデング熱の実際の流行発生ではなく、大学による早期予測AIシステムの研究開発に関する内容であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の研究・技術開発に関するものであり、具体的な症例数や流行状況の報告ではないため、イベントとしてのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Thanh Hóa quyết liệt ngăn chặn dịch tả lợn Châu Phi lây lan diện rộng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thanh Hoa Province takes decisive action to curb the widespread spread of African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever control actions in Thanh Hoa Province, Vietnam: In response to a nationwide ASF resurgence, Thanh Hoa issued Directive 08/CĐ-UBND (Oct 23, 2026) mandating aggressive containment: surveillance down to hamlet level; rapid culling of infected/dead or suspected animals; slaughterhouses and farms must dispose accordingly; 16 border communes reinforced with border guards to curb illegal pig movement and pig-product trafficking. Nationwide, ASF outbreaks total 1,294 in 3,541 hamlets across 31 provinces, with 167,755 pigs culled. In Thanh Hoa, ASF has affected 463 households in 162 hamlets across 26 communes, with 8,585 pigs culled (543,126 kg). The province holds about 1.3 million pigs, with high risk due to prevalence of small-scale, low-biosecurity farms. The plan includes a sanitation month (cleaning, disinfection with lime and chemicals), strict restocking rules, and compulsory reporting. Authorities emphasize accountability of local leadership and support affected farmers, plus public education to prevent environmental contamination.

triage.headline_ja: タインホア省、アフリカ豚コレラの拡大防止へ断固たる対策を実施
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）は豚のみに感染し人獣共通感染症ではないため、公衆衛生上の直接的な脅威とはならず、IHR基準・WPRO基準のいずれにも明確に該当しない。
triage.notes: ASF（アフリカ豚コレラ）は人には感染しない動物疾患であり、本件は畜産・経済・環境分野の問題として扱われる。全国規模での再流行（31省・1,294件・167,755頭殺処分）という規模の大きさから畜産当局・農業分野では注視すべき事案だが、公衆衛生（ヒト感染症）の枠組みでのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Un essai de vaccin contre Ebola débute en RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola vaccine trial begins in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola outbreak—the worst recorded there—has reached about 9,700 cases and over 4,600 deaths. The first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine in the outbreak framework began, testing the Ervebo vaccine (licensed for Zaire Ebola) for cross-protection against Bundibugyo, the strain responsible for this outbreak. The Tumaini trial in DRC is a platform that can evaluate several vaccines for safety and efficacy and will eventually include two Bundibugyo-specific candidates progressing in earlier-stage trials: a ChAdOx1 adenoviral vector vaccine from Oxford and an mRNA vaccine from Moderna. The effort aims to determine whether Ervebo or other vaccines can prevent Bundibugyo, addressing the lack of approved vaccines or treatments for this Ebola species.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチン治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおける過去最悪規模のエボラ流行（約9,700症例、4,600人超の死亡）であり、未承認株（Bundibugyo）に対するワクチン治験が国際的に開始されるなど、深刻性・異常性・国際的関与が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は主にワクチン治験（Tumaini trial、Ervebo、Oxford・Moderナ候補）に焦点を当てているが、背景として過去最大規模のエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）が進行中であり、フルリスク評価が妥当と判断。

article.articleHeadline: LUCKNOW NEWS: डेंगू अब तेजी से पसार रहा पांव, सात दिन में ही 20% मरीज बढ़े
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: LUCKNOW NEWS: Dengue is now spreading rapidly, with 20% more patients in just seven days.
article.articleSummary: Dengue is spreading rapidly in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, driven by post-monsoon waterlogging from heavy rains. In the second week of October, 69 new dengue cases were reported; Mon–Fri of this week added 90 more. Over two weeks, Indiranagar has 38 cases and Chandernagar 36, with Sarojininagar, Chinhat and Tudiyanj also affected. In Indiranagar, cases rose from 14 in week one to 24 in week two; Chandernagar from 13 to 23; Aliganj from 13 to 17. Health authorities have mobilized daily survey teams and mobile units to test and distribute medicines. Dengue wards have been expanded: Balrampur Hospital (20 beds); Bhau Rao Deoras Civil Hospital (10 beds + fever desk); Lokbandhu Hospital (6 beds); Indiranagar Municipal Community Health Center (3 beds). Control room: 0522-2622080. Preventive measures urged: eliminate standing water, wear long sleeves, use nets, dispose of waste, and seek early testing.

triage.headline_ja: ラクナウ・ニュース:デング熱が急速に拡大、わずか7日間で患者が20%増加
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域（ラクナウ）での季節性デング熱の増加であり、地方当局が対応中。IHR基準の該当は明確ではないが、流行継続の可能性があり経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: モンスーン後の水たまりによる蚊の繁殖が主因とされる季節性のデング熱増加。地元保健当局が病棟拡充・啓発活動などで対応しており、現時点で重症度や国際的波及に関する情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Konfirmasi Kasus Pertama Ebola, Identik dengan Kenya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria Confirms the First Ebola Case, Identical to Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case, a Bundibugyo strain infection, with genomic analysis revealing a near-identical lineage to Kenya’s index patient identified earlier this month. Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate said genome results tie the Abuja patient—a wife of a Swiss embassy staff member who had returned from Uganda on 3 October—to the Kenyan case, but there is no confirmed travel link between Kenya and Nigeria. Swiss authorities clarified the patient did not visit Congo, the outbreak’s epicenter, resolving initial Uganda-origin reports. Nigerian authorities and CDC Africa are tracing the transmission chain, with airport contact suspected between the two cases. Nigeria becomes the fourth African country drawn into the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, after Congo, Uganda, and Kenya. The Congo-originating outbreak, first reported in May, has spread to Uganda (20 confirmed cases, 2 deaths), and as of 20 October WHO tallies over 9,700 cases and 4,690 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラ出血熱の初症例を確認、ケニアの症例と酷似
triage.triage_reason: コンゴを起源とするブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱がウガンダ・ケニアを経てナイジェリアにまで拡大し、WHO集計で9,700例以上・死亡4,690人に達する大規模な国際的アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生国はナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダ・コンゴだが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。アウトブレイクの起源地としてDRCを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Venezuela reafirmó su cerco epidemiológico soberano en el Día Mundial contra la Poliomielitis - MPPS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Venezuela reaffirmed its sovereign epidemiological cordon on World Polio Day - MPPS.
article.articleSummary: World Polio Day highlights Venezuela’s reaffirmed sovereign epidemiological cordon and ongoing free, timely vaccination to keep poliomyelitis out of the country. MinSalud, under Minister Carlos Alvarado and the General Directorate of Immunizations, maintains a dual preventive schedule with Inactivated Poliovirus Vaccine (IPV) intramuscular in early infancy and the Oral Bivalent Poliovirus Vaccine (bOPV) across public vaccination posts nationwide. The campaign followed the Andean Border Vaccination Week, conducted with Colombian health authorities and ORAS-CONHU, during which thousands of polio doses were administered to children in indigenous communities and rural areas of Amazonas, Apure, Táchira, Zulia, and Bolívar. Through Fundación Misión Barrio Adentro and ASIC, Venezuela reinforces active home-by-home epidemiological surveillance, ensuring high-quality vaccines and upholding the constitutional right to child health, preventing poliovirus transmission across the national territory.

triage.headline_ja: ベネズエラ、世界ポリオデーに主権的な疫学封鎖を再確認 - MPPS
triage.triage_reason: 実際の症例報告ではなく、ベネズエラ政府による世界ポリオデーの啓発・予防接種キャンペーンに関する広報記事であり、対象国（ブラジル等）での発生事実は確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事はベネズエラでの予防接種活動・国境地域での予防接種週間に関する広報であり、症例発生の報告ではない。発生地域にBrazilが含まれているが、記事主題はベネズエラであり対象国リスト該当国での発生事実はないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 麻疹卷土重来，疫苗仍是终极防线！市疾控中心提醒→
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles on the rebound; vaccines remain the ultimate defense! City CDC reminds →.
article.articleSummary: Measles rebound in Qingdao, China prompts warnings from the City CDC that vaccination remains the ultimate defense. Measles is a highly contagious acute respiratory infection caused by the measles virus, with environmental viability limited by sunlight and heat but capable of persisting under cold conditions; winter–spring remains peak season. Two-dose measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination provides the best protection and also safeguards against mumps and rubella, underpinning the National Immunization Program. Vaccination coverage has driven down incidence, but boosters remain essential. For children, the schedule requires one dose at 8 months and a second at 18–24 months; adults over 18 may vaccinate voluntarily and at their own expense with informed consent. Citizens are urged to trust vaccines, complete the immunization program, and protect infants from infection.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹が再流行、ワクチンが依然として最終防衛線！市疾病予防管理センターが注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 青島市で麻疹の再流行がみられ市CDCが注意喚起しているが、具体的な症例数や重症度等の定量データが不明なため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は予防啓発・ワクチン接種呼びかけが主体で、具体的な患者数・流行規模の記載なし。麻疹は高い伝播性を持つためWPRO基準上は複数該当するが、社会的関心度や深刻性の定量情報が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mambasa : les décès communautaires favorisent la propagation de l'épidémie (Médecin chef de zone) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mambasa: Community Deaths Fuel the Spread of the Outbreak (District Medical Officer) - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, in Mambasa Health Zone, Ituri Province, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola has 61 confirmed cases, 38 deaths and 23 recoveries. Community deaths and handling of bodies are identified as key drivers of transmission, generating high‑risk contacts and fueling the outbreak. Dr. Yunga Abedi, the District Medical Officer for the area, urged strict adherence to infection prevention measures and called for dignified, safe burials to reduce new infections. He also urged the community to heed health workers’ guidance and seek care promptly at the onset of suspect symptoms. The statement underscores collective responsibility and close collaboration between residents and health teams, noting that despite ongoing efforts, the disease continues to spread and claim lives without coordinated action.

triage.headline_ja: マンバサのエボラ出血熱：地域社会での死亡が流行拡大を助長(地区保健医療責任者)
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定症例61例、死亡38例というアウトブレイクが継続中であり、コミュニティでの埋葬慣行が感染拡大を助長しているため、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く(38/61)、地域医療責任者が公的声明で危機感を表明している。コンゴ民主共和国のエボラアウトブレイクは致死率が高く国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態の既往があるため、フルリスク評価が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria's Ebola Virus Genetically Linked To Kenya Strain - FG
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reported a confirmed Ebola case in the Federal Capital Territory, with genomic analysis linking the Nigerian strain to one identified in Kenya; whether the cases are epidemiologically linked remains under investigation. Coordinating Minister Prof. Muhammad Pate cautioned that genetic similarity does not confirm transmission. Ugandan authorities clarified that a woman who traveled via Uganda after a business trip to eastern DRC in early October had no symptoms in Uganda and that transit does not establish the infection location; Uganda was declared Ebola-free in July 2026. The Nigerian analysis was conducted by the NCDC and Redeemer's University’s Institute of Genomics and Global Health, led by Prof. Christian Happi. Some contacts tested negative; others pending. Nigeria is boosting surveillance, laboratory capacity, case management, risk communication, and IPC; HCWs to be trained; daily NCDC updates will begin Oct 24, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラウイルス、ケニア株と遺伝的に関連 - 連邦政府発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国境を越えた遺伝的関連が確認され、感染経路（DRC・ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア）が複数国にまたがる可能性があり、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻性が高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 確定症例はナイジェリアで発生しているが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源として東部DRCへの出張歴が言及されており、DRCが感染地として疑われているため含めた。ケニア株との遺伝的関連やウガンダ経由の渡航歴は感染経路調査中であり、疫学的リンクは未確定。続報での感染源確定情報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Four-year-old boy from Tiruppur district dies of dengue
article.articleSummary: Four-year-old Tamil boy from Kungumapalayam village, Palladam Block, Tiruppur district, died of dengue, confirmed by the Health Department as of 24 October 2026. He was diagnosed with Dengue Shock Syndrome combined with sepsis and Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation (DIC) at Coimbatore Medical College Hospital after being referred from a private clinic. Admitted with after-effects of two epileptic attacks and low blood pressure, he received normal saline bolus and vasopressors (noradrenaline/adrenaline). He developed respiratory failure and was placed on life-support. Despite attempts to normalize blood pressure, circulatory failure occurred, and he died of cardiac arrest on Friday night. Blood products and resuscitative efforts were provided. The report details the clinical course but does not include information on the infection source or additional cases.

triage.headline_ja: ティルプール県の4歳男児、デング熱で死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドで単発の重症デング熱死亡例が報告されているが、他症例や流行状況の情報がなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な拡大を示す証拠は不足している。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの流行地域で季節的に発生する疾患であり、本記事は単一の重症死亡例の臨床経過を報告しているのみで、集団発生や地域的拡大の情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: وفاة ثانية بفيروس إيبولا في كينيا وسط مخاوف من تفشي المرض
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second Ebola death in Kenya amid fears of an outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Kenya reports a second Ebola death: a 65-year-old woman who was a relative of the first Kenyan case. The Ministry of Health said she died Friday evening after being isolated and treated since mid-October when she developed Ebola symptoms. Seven people remain in isolation with Ebola treatment in Kenya, with authorities noting no evidence of further transmission. Kenya’s first case involved a man who contracted Ebola in neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo and returned home, where he died in hospital. The Congo outbreak, identified in May, has surpassed 9,700 cases and more than 4,700 deaths, described by the Africa CDC as one of the worst Ebola outbreaks in history and the fastest-growing in history.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱による2人目の死亡、流行拡大への懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模とされるエボラ流行が続く中、国境を越えてケニアへの伝播が確認され死者も発生しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの2例目の死亡だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、感染源であるDRCの流行（9,700例以上、4,700人以上死亡、史上最速拡大とAfrica CDCが指摘）が詳細に記述されており、対象国であるDRCをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: У жены дипломата в Нигерии обнаружили лихорадку Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The wife of a diplomat in Nigeria was diagnosed with Ebola fever.
article.articleSummary: Swiss embassy employee's wife in Nigeria diagnosed with Ebola fever on 20 October, potentially after exposure during a trip to Uganda. She receives treatment at a private clinic in Abuja; her husband is asymptomatic and in isolation. The couple had not visited the Democratic Republic of Congo, per TASS. Uganda's health minister had stated no Ebola outbreak in Uganda, while authorities later barred transit of travelers who recently visited DRC due to transmission risk. The Ebola outbreak in the DRC, declared in May 2026, has surpassed 9,700 cases and about 4,700 deaths as of 20 October, with cases also detected in Kenya and Nigeria. Nigeria had previously reported its first Ebola case; DRC authorities reported more than 9,400 cases since May. Russia has tightened border controls to prevent entry of the virus."

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで外交官の妻がエボラ出血熱と診断される
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2026年5月に宣言されたエボラ流行が9,700例・4,700人死亡規模に拡大し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへも波及、外交官家族を通じた国際的な感染拡大や渡航制限（ロシアの国境管理強化、ウガンダの通過制限）も発生しており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの外交官妻の感染事例だが、背景にあるのは2026年5月に宣言されたDRCでのエボラ大流行（9,700例超・死亡4,700人超）であり、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大や国際的な渡航制限措置を伴う重大イベント。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダ・スイス・ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外し、流行の発生源であるDRCのみを計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Swissinfo: жена сотрудника посольства Швейцарии в Нигерии заразилась Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swissinfo: Wife of a Swiss embassy staff member in Nigeria contracted Ebola
article.articleSummary: Wife of a Swiss embassy staff member in Nigeria diagnosed with Ebola on Oct 20, likely after exposure during a trip to Uganda. She is treated in a private clinic in Abuja; husband is asymptomatic and in isolation. The couple did not visit the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Uganda’s health minister Kris Baromunsi said there is no outbreak in Uganda, and authorities temporarily barred transit through Uganda for travelers who recently visited DRC. The Ebola outbreak in DRC, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, was declared in May 2026. By Oct 20, WHO reported over 9,700 cases and about 4,700 deaths in DRC, with further detections in Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths, including a 65-year-old woman who died on Oct 23) and Nigeria. In Uganda, 20 cases with two deaths occurred from May–June, with the outbreak declared over by late August.

triage.headline_ja: Swissinfo：ナイジェリア駐在スイス大使館職員の妻がエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（9700例超、4700人超死亡）が複数国へ拡大し、渡航制限措置も発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC発のエボラ（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）アウトブレイクの国際拡大。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCの大規模流行（9700例超、致死率約48%）がWHOにより公表されており、複数国での二次感染例・渡航制限が発生している点で国際的関心が非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Caso de Ebola na Nigéria Está Ligado Ao Vírus Encontrado no Primeiro Caso do Quênia, Diz Ministro da Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Case in Nigeria Linked to Virus Found in Kenya's First Case, Says Health Minister.
article.articleSummary: Genomic sequencing links Nigeria's lone Ebola case to Kenya's first reported case, establishing a genetic connection between the two outbreaks, though Nigerian authorities say there is no evidence of direct contact or travel between the patients. The Nigerian case concerns a traveler who had visited Uganda. Contact tracing is underway, with quarantining and testing of contacts; some results are negative and others pending. Uganda notes it remains Ebola-free, despite its proximity to the Democratic Republic of Congo and past outbreaks, and is reinforcing precautions. Uganda has reinstated traveler-location forms for all arrivals, regardless of origin, to bolster surveillance and strengthen international health monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ症例、ケニアの最初の症例で見つかったウイルスと関連 ― 保健相が発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラという重篤な疾患がナイジェリア・ケニア間で遺伝学的に関連していることが判明し、国境を越えた拡大の可能性が示唆されるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダでの症例であり、対象国リストに含まれるDRCは過去の流行地・近隣国として言及されているのみで、現時点での実際の発生国としては確認できないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Autoridades apuram possível origem de caso de Ebola na Nigéria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Authorities probe possible origin of an Ebola case in Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria investigates how a woman diagnosed with Ebola contracted the virus. The Nigerian-born wife of a diplomat in Abuja traveled across Africa, with Entebbe airport in Uganda considered as a possible exposure site on the same day as the first Ebola case in Kenya, though no link is confirmed. Swiss authorities say she likely contracted Ebola during a trip to Uganda; Uganda has suggested she may have passed through eastern Democratic Republic of Congo before Uganda, but the WHO and Africa’s main health body have not confirmed this. Investigators also consider a possible link to the Kenyan patient who died after arriving in Nairobi; the two may have been at Entebbe in early October, but there is no evidence yet that passengers or airport staff were infected. The WHO continues the probe, and Nigeria is reconstructing her movements to determine where exposure occurred.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ症例、感染経路についてナイジェリア当局が調査
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の症例がナイジェリア・ケニアで確認され、ウガンダ・DRCを含む複数国にまたがる国際的な感染拡大・曝露経路が疑われており、WHOも調査に関与する重大事案であるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダでのエボラ症例及び曝露経路調査であり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）は患者の移動経路として言及されているが、WHO及びアフリカ疾病対策センターにより確認されていない推測段階の情報であるため、verified_locationsには含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: La crise alimentaire s'aggrave dans les zones touchées par Ebola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The food crisis is worsening in Ebola-affected areas in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo drives a regional food crisis, with about 3.5 million people in Ebola-affected areas facing severe hunger (IPC phase 3+); 97% of those directly affected still need food assistance. The World Food Programme reports disruption of markets and livelihoods, restricting access to food amid treatment and isolation measures. WFP has provided over 744,000 hot meals across 59 treatment and isolation centers and distributed more than 3,000 tonnes of food; in the next six months, dry rations will be handed to more than half a million relatives of patients and suspected cases. A funding gap of $214 million threatens these operations. Nigeria reports an imported Bundibugyo case in a woman who had recently traveled from Uganda, marking the fifth country affected after DRC, Uganda, France, and Kenya. In the DRC, 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths as of 21 October 2026 across eight provinces and 66 health zones. No vaccine specific to Bundibugyo exists; emergency centers operate in Ituri and Nord-Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ被災地域で食糧危機が悪化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行は9,704例・4,687死亡に達し、8州66保健地域に拡大、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア・フランスへの国際拡散も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）流行とそれに伴う食糧危機が主題。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア・フランスへの輸入症例も報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ワクチン未確立で資金不足(2.14億ドル)が対応の課題。

article.articleHeadline: V DR Kongu začeli klinično preizkušanje cepiva proti eboli. V Keniji druga smrtna žrtev.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, a clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine has begun. In Kenya, a second fatality.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo launched the first clinical trial of a vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, enrolling participants in Bunia as the country confronts more than 9,700 cases and over 4,600 deaths—the most severe outbreak to date. Africa CDC has described the DR Congo outbreak as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak to date. The Tumaini trial will assess safety and efficacy of multiple candidates, starting with Ervebo, the vaccine licensed for Zaire ebolavirus, to determine protection against Bundibugyo. Future arms will include two vaccines specifically developed for Bundibugyo: an Oxford University adenovirus-vector vaccine and Moderna’s mRNA candidate, with WHO support for the DR Congo effort. In Kenya, nine Ebola infections have been confirmed, including two fatalities and seven patients in two isolation units; the latest death was a 65-year-old woman who was a relative of the first confirmed Kenyan patient. The index case, diagnosed Oct 6, contracted the disease in DR Congo and traveled via Uganda to Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチンの臨床試験開始、ケニアでは2人目の死者
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模・最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が続き、ケニアへの国境を越えた感染拡大・死亡例が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニアおよびウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし越境感染の事実はエボラ流行の国際的拡大リスクとしてIHR評価に反映した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le bilan arrêté au 22 octobre 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the final tally as of October 22, 2026.
article.articleSummary: Final Ebola tally in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) as of October 22, 2026: 9,816 confirmed cases and 4,757 deaths, according to the Ministry of Communication and Media. By Oct 22, 2026, the ministry also reports 1,130 patients in isolation or hospitalized. Infections added between October 18 and October 22 could not be dated individually. Response activities span 66 health zones. Surveillance progress rose by 4.3 percentage points since the previous day, with an objective of 95%. Awareness campaigns reached 37,555 people. The ministry notes that figures may be adjusted after consolidation, validation, and harmonization.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：2026年10月22日時点の最終集計
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48%、確定症例9,816例・死亡4,757例という大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 政府（通信・メディア省）が定期的に集計値を公表しており、66の保健区域で対応が継続中。サーベイランス進捗や啓発活動の数値も報告されているが、国際的な波及の具体的事例については記事内に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: وفاة ثانية بفيروس "إيبولا" في كينيا وسط مخاوف من تفشي المرض
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A second death from the Ebola virus in Kenya amid fears of an outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Kenya reports a second Ebola death, a 65-year-old woman who was a relative of the first Kenyan case. She died Friday evening after being in quarantine and receiving treatment since mid-October following symptom onset. Seven people remain in isolation and under treatment for Ebola, with no current signs of wider transmission. The initial Kenyan case involved a man who contracted Ebola in the neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo and died after returning to Kenya. The DRC outbreak, detected in May, has reported over 9,700 cases and more than 4,700 deaths; Africa CDC calls it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラウイルスによる2人目の死者、流行への懸念広がる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ流行（9,700例超、死者4,700人超、史上最速の拡大ペース）がケニアへの国際的感染拡大を引き起こしており、IHR基準の複数（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の直接の主題はケニアでの2例目の死亡だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ただし感染源であるDRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（史上最速拡大）が記事の中核的内容として詳述されているため、DRCを verified_locations に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Reports Second Ebola Casualty As Cases Rise To 9; Everything You Need To Know
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second Ebola death from Bundibugyo strain, pushing cases to nine. A 65-year-old woman—close contact of Kenya’s first patient—died in Nairobi after developing symptoms Oct 13; she is the third confirmed Bundibugyo case. The initial patient, a Kenyan who had lived in the DRC, traveled through Uganda on Oct 3 and died after testing positive. Seven other infections remain in two isolation facilities; no new cases were reported Oct 23. All cases are linked to a single contact cluster; 135 contacts are under quarantine, with the first group due to leave Oct 25. Three health workers (ages 29, 32, 35) are among cases. There are no travel restrictions; flights from affected countries receive enhanced screening, and an emergency hotline is available. The Bundibugyo strain lacks approved vaccines or treatments; supportive care only. Outbreak began in DRC in May 2026 and has spread to Congo, Uganda, Kenya, Nigeria.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱による2人目の死者、感染者数9人に拡大 ― 知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がDRCを起点にウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへ国境を越えて拡大しており、死亡例・医療従事者感染・ワクチン未承認など公衆衛生上の深刻なリスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの感染拡大だが、ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため、発生起点であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Indian American physician Navin Shah commits $525,000 to infectious disease program in Pune
article.articleSummary: Indian American physician Dr. Navin C. Shah commits $525,000 over five years to establish the Navin C. Shah Infectious Disease Program at BJ Government Medical College in Pune, Maharashtra, in collaboration with Johns Hopkins University. The initiative funds research, medical education, faculty and student exchanges, and patient care, with a patient care fund and a focus on tuberculosis, HIV, and antibiotic-resistant infections affecting economically disadvantaged communities. The program builds on a 2003 Johns Hopkins–BJ partnership, including early HIV mother-to-child transmission research with nevirapine. Four Johns Hopkins faculty visits to India and two BJ faculty visits to the United States are planned, plus an annual seminar starting December 4. BJ Medical College-affiliated hospital has about 1,800 beds, highlighting the program’s aim to expand activities beyond conventional grants and strengthen Indo-U.S. collaboration in infectious disease care and training.

triage.headline_ja: インド系アメリカ人医師ナヴィン・シャー氏、プネーの感染症プログラムに52万5000ドルを寄付
triage.triage_reason: 慈善的な寄付・研究協力プログラムの発表であり、感染症の発生やアウトブレイクに関する情報ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核・HIV・薬剤耐性感染症研究プログラムへの寄付発表であり、特定の発生イベントではないため対象国の実発生とは見なさない。

article.articleHeadline: Жена сотрудника посольства Швейцарии в Нигерии заразилась Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wife of a Swiss embassy employee in Nigeria contracted Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola has been confirmed in the wife of a Swiss embassy employee in Nigeria. She likely contracted the virus during a trip to Uganda about two weeks before diagnosis, with laboratory confirmation on 20 October. The patient is now receiving treatment at a private clinic in Abuja, Nigeria, and remains under medical surveillance. The husband, also quarantined, shows no symptoms so far. Officials note the couple did not visit the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Ebola is reported, and the case is thus considered imported to Nigeria via travel-related exposure in Uganda. The report cites Swissinfo's account of the Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs. No further details on symptom onset or exposure are provided beyond the Uganda travel link.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア駐在スイス大使館員の妻がエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: エボラという重篤な感染症の国際的な渡航関連感染（ウガンダ由来、ナイジェリアで発症）であり、外交官家族という社会的注目度の高い症例であるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にDRCが含まれるが、記事はDRCへの渡航はなかったと明記しており、感染源はウガンダ・発症地はナイジェリアとされる。いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。スイス人配偶者を介した国際的な輸入症例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクの観点から監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Records Second Ebola Death
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second Ebola death in its first outbreak: a 65-year-old woman who was a close relative of the first victim; her symptoms appeared on 13 October while in quarantine. The first fatality was a man who fell ill in September and arrived in Nairobi from the Democratic Republic of the Congo on 5 October after treatment there. Seven more patients are under care—three relatives of the first victim, three healthcare workers, and a hospital cleaner—within a single cluster with no documented community transmission. The Bundibugyo strain drives the outbreak; there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments, though drug trials are ongoing. The US warns against travel to Kenya; Kenya tightens border controls and digital monitoring for travelers from the DRC and nine high-risk countries. Nigeria records its first Ebola case, under investigation for exposure possibly via Kenya’s patient in Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱による2人目の死者
triage.triage_reason: ケニア初のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで死者が発生し、ナイジェリアでも初症例が確認されるなど国際的拡大の兆候があり、渡航制限措置も既に取られているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 主な発生地はケニア（対象国リスト外）およびナイジェリア（対象国リスト外）だが、最初の患者がDRCで治療を受けた後にケニアへ渡航しており、DRCも感染拡大の関連国として言及されているため対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみ列挙。ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: A Glass of Milk, 450 Rabies Shots: What Triggered Alarm in Uttar Pradesh?
article.articleSummary: Gorakhpur district, Uttar Pradesh, India, launched precautionary rabies vaccination campaigns after a cow in Dadi Khas/Govindpur died following illness and unusual behavior and milk from the animal was used to prepare charanamrit served during Durga Puja. About 50 people were vaccinated on Oct 20, and a further ~400 on Oct 21, bringing the total to roughly 450 as a precaution amid public concern that milk intake could transmit rabies. No laboratory confirmation of rabies in the cow was reported; investigators cited dog exposure as a possible source but did not establish a confirmed diagnosis. WHO guidance states rabies transmission through milk or dairy products is unproven, and the Indian National Rabies Control Programme mirrors this, advising PEP only for actual exposure, such as bites or scratches. Vaccination access remained available, with officials urging consultation and caution about consuming milk from a suspected rabid animal.

triage.headline_ja: 牛乳一杯で450本の狂犬病ワクチン接種：ウッタル・プラデーシュ州で何が警戒を引き起こしたのか？
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の疑いがある牛のミルクを介した感染への懸念から地域住民約450人に予防的ワクチン接種が実施される異例の事態となり、住民・当局の関心が高まっているため。ただし検査による確定診断はなく、WHO見解でも乳汁感染は未証明。
triage.notes: 牛における狂犬病の検査確定はなく、乳汁を介した感染経路は科学的に証明されていない。住民の誤解・不安に基づく予防的大量ワクチン接種という社会的現象としての側面が強く、実際の感染症アウトブレイクとは異なる可能性が高い。続報で確定診断や二次感染の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Sundargarh farmer dies of scrub typhus after hospital discharge
