article.articleSummary: 63-year-old Harihar Patta of Ujjwalpur village, Tangarpali block, Sundargarh district, Odisha, died around 1:30 pm at a private hospital after treatment for scrub typhus. He had tested positive for scrub typhus at Sundargarh district headquarters hospital (DHH) on Oct 21 and was treated there before discharge. He was reportedly bitten by an infected mite while working in his field. His family said he fell ill after returning from the farm and was initially taken to Sargipali Community Health Centre, then referred to the DHH for advanced care. After discharge, his condition worsened at home and he was readmitted to a private Sundargarh hospital on Friday. Attempts to contact Sundargarh CDMO were unsuccessful. This represents a confirmed scrub typhus death in Sundargarh, with the infection linked to a mite bite during fieldwork.

triage.headline_ja: サンダルガルの農夫、退院後にツツガムシ病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単発の個人症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常な拡大やアウトブレイクを示す情報はなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも明確に該当しない。
triage.notes: ツツガムシ病（Scrub Typhus）はダニ媒介性の感染症でヒト-ヒト感染はなく、インド・オリッサ州における単発の死亡例。バングラデシュは発生地域に含まれているが記事主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Uruguay suspendió el ingreso de aves y productos avícolas de Brasil por un foco de enfermedad de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uruguay suspended imports of birds and poultry products from Brazil due to a Newcastle disease outbreak
article.articleSummary: On 24 October 2026, Uruguay’s Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries (MGAP) suspended entry and transit of birds and poultry products from Brazil after confirmation of a Newcastle disease outbreak at a facility in Santa Catarina state. The temporary ban covers products produced after 6 September, with exemptions for certain goods that meet required sanitary treatments. Newcastle disease can cause respiratory, digestive, and nervous signs and increased mortality in poultry. Uruguay reports no avian Newcastle virus cases in domestic poultry since 1984. Authorities urge producers to reinforce biosecurity and promptly report any suspected infections. triage.headline_ja: ウルグアイ、ブラジルでのニューカッスル病発生によりブラジル産の鳥類・鶏肉製品の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: 家禽の動物疾患（ニューカッスル病）であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の重大な影響は報告されておらず、貿易制限も既に実施済みで管理可能な事案であるため見送りとする。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nigeria et au Kenya: les deux patients se sont-ils croisés en Ouganda?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Nigeria and Kenya: did the two patients cross paths in Uganda?
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Nigeria and Kenya: two patients show genetic similarity in the virus but no proven direct transmission. Both patients had ties to Uganda, with Africa CDC noting they may have been at Entebbe airport on Oct 3 around the same time. The Kenyan patient died two days after travel; the Nigerian case involves a Ugandan-origin woman residing in Abuja who had returned from Uganda and reportedly did not travel to the DRC, contrary to earlier Ugandan claims. Nigeria is conducting contact tracing; some tests are negative, others pending. Uganda maintains it remains Ebola-free as investigators verify movements and coordinate with Nigerian authorities; claims about a DRC trip are not substantiated per Swiss authorities and Africa CDC. triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ナイジェリアとケニアの２人の患者はウガンダですれ違ったのか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重篤な疾患が複数国（ナイジェリア・ケニア）で確認され、ウガンダの空港を介した国際的な感染拡大の可能性が指摘されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダでの発生であり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）は患者の渡航歴として言及されているが、記事内でウガンダ側の主張は『裏付けなし』と否定されているため、実際の発生地域としては確認できず verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 24 ottobre World Polio Day: il Rotary si mobilita per debellare la poliomelite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: October 24 World Polio Day: Rotary mobilizes to eradicate poliomyelitis
article.articleSummary: World Polio Day, October 24, 2026, highlights Rotary International’s ongoing drive to eradicate poliomyelitis. The PolioPlus update (WHO synthesis dated October 21, 2026) shows WPV1 with 6 new Afghanistan cases (2026 total: 42) while Pakistan reports no new cases (2026 total: 6). Circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus (cVDPV) adds 11 new cases, mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Sudan, and Nigeria. The WHO SAGE recommends switching to three doses of inactivated poliovirus vaccine (IPV) in a hexavalent formulation, increasing immunity by about 18%. Rotary’s PolioPlus Society District 2110 (Sicily and Malta) underscores sustaining vaccination in hard‑to‑reach areas to protect every child. Poliomyelitis is preventable and can cause acute flaccid paralysis and death; there is no cure. The article includes vaccination basics and quotes President Ynka Babalola reflecting frontline vaccination efforts in Nigeria.

triage.headline_ja: 10月24日世界ポリオデー：ロータリーがポリオ撲滅に向けて行動
triage.triage_reason: DRCを含む複数国でcVDPV（ワクチン由来ポリオウイルス）の新規症例が継続報告されており、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）に複数該当するため、フルリスク評価の検討対象とする。
triage.notes: 本記事はイタリア・シチリア地方紙による世界ポリオデー啓発記事で、WHO/ロータリーのPolioPlus最新データ（2026年10月21日時点）を引用。アフガニスタン・パキスタンのWPV1、DRC・南スーダン・ナイジェリアのcVDPVに関する既知の継続的流行状況の要約であり、新規の突発的イベントではない。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ（アフガニスタン・パキスタン・ナイジェリア・スーダンは対象国リスト外）。既存のポリオ根絶活動の一環としての定例報告である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Kwilu : suspicion de choléra à Djuma et Sia après 6 décès de la diarrhée avec déshydratation... des échantillons prélevés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kwilu: Suspected cholera in Djuma and Sia after 6 deaths from diarrhea with dehydration... samples collected.
article.articleSummary: Cholera suspected in Kwilu Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, specifically in Djuma and Sia health zones. Six deaths among 19 patients presenting diarrhea with severe dehydration, cases reported since Monday Oct 19, with samples collected for laboratory analysis to confirm diagnosis and origin. In Sia (Bagata territory), 11 cases with 3 deaths; in Djuma (Bulungu territory), 8 cases with 3 deaths. Adults only affected. Patients have received care; epidemiological surveillance reinforced and prepositioned supplies activated to respond to potential escalation. Context is endemic: since the start of the year, 323 cholera cases and 38 deaths in Kwilu. Ongoing concerns include limited access to potable water, with some communities drinking the Kwilu River water. Additional affected health zones cited include Bandundu, Kikongo, Mokala, and Ipamu among Kwilu’s 24 zones.

triage.headline_ja: クウィル州：下痢と脱水症による6人の死亡後、ジュマとシアでコレラの疑い…検体採取
triage.triage_reason: コレラ疑い例で致死率が約31.6%(6/19)と高く、流行地域内での急激な死亡集積がみられるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: クウィル州は年初来323例・38死亡の流行地域であり、今回の報告(19例中6死亡)は致死率が高く注意を要する。飲料水アクセスの制約（クウィル川水の使用）が継続的曝露要因として指摘されている。検体の検査結果待ちで確定診断は未了。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia eboli. Ruszyły testy nowej szczepionki
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic: Trials of a new vaccine have begun.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo begins clinical trials of a new Ebola vaccine targeting Bundibugyo strain in Bunia, Ituri, with INRB and WHO support. The TUMAiNi trial seeks to evaluate candidate vaccines among people exposed to confirmed Ebola cases. The ongoing outbreak has surpassed 9,000 cases and about 4,500 deaths in DRC since mid-May; Kenya reports 9 cases and 1 death, Nigeria records its first case this week, while Uganda was declared free of Ebola in August after 20 cases and 2 deaths. Bundibugyo Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals, with an incubation of 2–21 days (usually 8–10). Symptoms include fever, vomiting, and diarrhea; severe cases can involve internal and external bleeding. In Nigeria, a patient born in Uganda, wife of a Swiss diplomat in Abuja, did not travel to DRC; infection suspected during a Uganda visit with her husband, contradicting earlier Uganda-linked travel reports.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：新ワクチンの治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,000例超・死者約4,500人の大規模エボラ流行が継続し、既にケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア）での新規エボラワクチン治験が主題。ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの感染拡大も報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: أول تجربة سريرية للقاحات ضد "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First clinical trial of Ebola vaccines
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization launches the first large-scale clinical trial of vaccines against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, amid an ongoing outbreak with over 9,700 cases and more than 4,600 deaths. The first participant received a dose in Bunia, the northeastern Ituri province capital and outbreak epicenter. The trial, named Tomaini (Swahili for 'hope'), will assess safety and efficacy of candidate vaccines, including Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) licensed for Zaire ebolavirus, to determine cross-protection against Bundibugyo. Tomaini uses a unified framework to compare vaccines and will apply ring vaccination—immunizing contacts and high-risk groups—to gauge protection within case rings. Eligible participants include children aged 12 and older and pregnant women. Two additional Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are in early-stage trials and may be included in the evaluation later.

triage.headline_ja: エボラワクチンの初の臨床試験
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で9,700例・4,600人以上の死者を出すエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行が継続中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOによるエボラワクチンの大規模臨床試験開始を報じているが、背景として9,700例超・4,600人超の死亡を伴う大規模流行が進行中であることが示されており、既存の進行中アウトブレイクとしてフルRRAの継続的な注視対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: After suspected dengue death, Pune Municipal Commissioner reviews preparedness
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak in Pune, with 2,291 cases Jan–Oct 20 and a suspected dengue death of an eight-year-old in Lohegaon. Pune Municipal Commissioner Naval Kishore Ram reviewed containment measures at Dr Naidu Hospital in Baner. Public hospitals offer capacity: private sector 4,409 beds including 670 ICU; municipal hospitals 333 beds including six ICU. Dr Naidu Hospital has reserved 50 dengue beds, 35 vacant; treatment there is free. Rapid diagnostic kits are free at municipal dispensaries; free confirmatory tests at Dr Naidu, Dr Kotnis and Kamala Nehru. Factors include weather, construction, water storage during power cuts, and stagnant water in plant pots. Civic teams have inspected about 1.4 million homes and 28.3 lakh water-storage containers; Aedes larvae were found in 18,885 containers across 13,000 homes. Notices to 2,664 properties; fines Rs 6.3 lakh. Fogging and awareness campaigns are underway; citizens are urged to cover water tanks, prevent accumulation, and observe a weekly dry day.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱死亡疑いを受け、プネー市長が対応体制を見直し
triage.triage_reason: プネーでのデング熱流行（季節性）であり、地方行政が通常の対応措置（病床確保・媒介蚊対策）を実施中。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、症例数・死亡例があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: インド・プネー市における季節性デング熱流行で、地方自治体による通常の媒介蚊対策・医療体制強化が報じられている。国際的懸念や渡航制限の兆候はなく、現時点ではフルRRAの必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana successfully ends type 2 poliovirus outbreak, maintains over 95% immunisation coverage - GHS
article.articleSummary: Ghana closed its type 2 poliovirus outbreak in August 2026, the Ghana Health Service (GHS) announced on World Polio Day, 24 October 2026. The achievement followed sustained immunisation campaigns, strengthened surveillance and coordinated outbreak response, confirmed through Outbreak Response Assessments (OBRA). Ghana collaborated with WHO, UNICEF, Gavi, Rotary International and the US CDC, joining Burundi, Guinea-Bissau, the Republic of Congo and Uganda as countries that also closed type 2 outbreaks in August 2026. Since introducing Inactivated Polio Vaccine (IPV) in 2018 and adding a second dose in 2024, Ghana has maintained immunisation coverage above 95%. The GHS cautions against complacency and emphasizes continued vaccination and surveillance to prevent new outbreaks. Polio can cause lifelong paralysis but is preventable; World Polio Day 2026 theme: One Day, One Focus: Ending Polio for Good. Dr Samuel Kaba Akoriyea leads ongoing efforts to sustain a polio-free Ghana.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ、2型ポリオウイルスアウトブレイクを終息、予防接種率95%以上を維持 - GHS
triage.triage_reason: ガーナにおける2型ポリオアウトブレイクの終息を報告する内容であり、新規発生や拡大のリスクはなく、ポジティブな公衆衛生成果の報告のため、シグナルとしての対応は不要。
triage.notes: 記事はガーナにおけるアウトブレイク終息の成功報告。DRC（コンゴ共和国と記載の可能性あり、要確認）やブルンジ、ギニアビサウ、ウガンダも同様に終息を報告しているが、対象国リストにはDRC（203312）のみ該当。他国（ブルンジ、ギニアビサウ、ウガンダ、米国）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ начала испытания вакцины против Эболы в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO began Ebola vaccine trials in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO launched the first clinical trials of Ebola vaccines in the Democratic Republic of Congo amid a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in Ituri Province, with Bunia as the epicenter. In Bunia, participants were vaccinated with Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV), approved against Zaire ebolavirus, to assess cross-protection against Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The Tumaini trial—Swahili for 'hope'—is a ring-vaccination framework evaluating safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity across multiple vaccine candidates. The study plans to include two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines at earlier development stages: a viral vector ChAdOx1 vaccine and an mRNA vaccine. The WHO Emergency Director, Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu, said the trial aims to generate robust data on whether participating vaccines can protect high-risk contacts and strengthen response to the outbreak in northeastern DRC."

triage.headline_ja: WHOがDRコンゴでエボラワクチンの臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴ・イトゥリ州でのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行を背景にWHOがワクチン臨床試験を開始しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア語メディアによる報道だが、WHOがDRコンゴ・イトゥリ州ブニアでブンディブギョ種エボラに対するリング・ワクチン接種試験（Tumaini試験）を開始したことを報じており、既存の流行への対応強化策である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: 11 municípios de Minas Gerais registram casos de sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 11 municipalities in Minas Gerais report cases of human scabies
article.articleSummary: Scabies outbreaks were reported in 11 municipalities in Minas Gerais, Brazil, including Alfenas, Belo Horizonte, and São Gonçalo do Pará. The State Health Secretariat (SES-MG) announced on 20 October 2026. Scabies (Sarcoptes scabiei) is a skin disease transmitted mainly by prolonged direct skin contact, less often via shared clothing or bedding. It is not a nationally notifiable disease; outbreaks are monitored by municipalities. A defined outbreak is cases in a geographic area. Prevention includes hand hygiene, regular bathing, laundering of clothes and linens, and avoiding sharing items until control measures are in place. Washable items should be cleaned in hot water and ironed; non-washables can be sealed in plastic bags for at least three days. Treatment uses topical creams or prescribed medications; transmission generally stops about 24 hours after starting treatment, though itching can persist weeks. Seek a Basic Health Unit if symptoms appear, especially with others who are itchy.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州の11自治体でヒゼンダニ症（疥癬）の症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は軽症の皮膚疾患であり、国際的拡大リスクや重篤性は低く、国家届出対象疾患でもないため、IHR・WPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 疥癬は直接皮膚接触で感染する一般的な皮膚疾患で、地域保健当局により監視・管理されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とはみなされない。

article.articleHeadline: el ébola supera los 4.600 muertos y se extiende a otros países africanos | HSB Noticias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola surpasses 4,600 deaths and spreads to other African countries | HSB Noticias
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 9,500 cases and 4,600 deaths as of 24 October 2026, spanning eight provinces with Ituri accounting for 72.9% of cases. The case fatality rate is 48.2%, with 2,550 recoveries and 937 patients currently hospitalized or isolated, marking the deadliest outbreak in DRC history and raising international concern due to cross-border spread. Kenya has confirmed nine cases linked to the Congo outbreak, with no evidence of community transmission and eight patients improving. Nigeria reports an imported case in Abuja, a woman who arrived from Uganda; she is isolated and receiving care, and contact tracing has identified 44 contacts. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or approved treatment. The United States has advised reconsidering travel to Kenya amid health risks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱による死者が4,600人を超え、他のアフリカ諸国にも拡大 | HSB Noticias
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最悪規模（9,500例超・死者4,600人超、致死率48.2%）のエボラ流行が継続し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大や渡航制限勧告も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが主たる発生国として唯一該当。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Confirms First Bundibugyo Ebola Case as Outbreak Tops 9,700 Cases, While CDC Keeps U.S. Risk Low
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Bundibugyo Ebola case, a woman in Abuja who traveled from Uganda; lab confirmation on Oct 20 after arriving Oct 3 and developing symptoms Oct 7; 44 contacts monitored and an incident management system activated. The Bundibugyo outbreak widens Ebola geography, while the DRC outbreak remains largest with 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths; CDC totals 9,735 cases and 4,690 deaths as of Oct 21. Kenya reports nine cases linked to a man who died in Nairobi; Uganda has no active cases. The U.S. risk is low; travel rules restrict entry for those in the DRC within 21 days, with a CDC order renewed Oct 11 and, from Nov 3, attestation required for all international arrivals. Bundibugyo lacks an approved vaccine or targeted treatment (unlike Zaire); transmission is via contact with blood or body fluids, with symptoms 2–21 days after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアが初のブンディブギョ型エボラ症例を確認、流行は9,700例を超える一方、CDCは米国リスクを低いと評価
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がウガンダを起点に複数国へ拡大し、DRCでは既に大規模流行（9,704例、4,687死亡）が継続中であり、国際的拡大と渡航制限措置が確認されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダ発のブンディブギョ型エボラのナイジェリア・ケニアへの拡大およびDRCの大規模流行であるが、対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれる。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: В Нигерии заявили о генетической связи занесенного вируса Эболы со штаммом в Кении
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Nigeria, officials announced a genetic link between the imported Ebola virus and a strain in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first Ebola case on Oct 20, a woman who arrived by air from Uganda. Genome analyses by Nigeria's CDC and Redeemer's University in Ede, Osun, show the case is genetically linked to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant circulating in Kenya; authorities say there is no evidence the strain was imported from Kenya, though the link is evident. Ugandan authorities say the traveler had no symptoms at departure. The finding occurs amid a broader Ebola situation: the Bundibugyo variant caused the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak declared in May 2026, with WHO data by Oct 20 totaling over 9,700 cases and about 4,700 deaths. Kenya has nine cases and two deaths, including a 65-year-old woman who died Oct 23. Uganda’s May–June outbreak reported 20 cases and two deaths and was declared over by the end of August.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで、輸入されたエボラウイルスがケニアの株と遺伝的関連性があると発表
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアへの国際的な空路によるエボラ輸入例が確認され、DRCでの大規模流行（9700症例超、4700人死亡）と遺伝的関連があることが判明。IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大、渡航制限リスク）に該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダの輸入例とDRCでの大規模流行だが、対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれる。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダは本イベントの重要な要素だが、提示された対象国リストには含まれていないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Farmer From Sundaragada Dies Of Scrub Typhus
article.articleSummary: A 63-year-old farmer, Harihar Patta of Ujjwalpur village in Tangarpali block (Sundaragada/Sundargarh district), died from scrub typhus. He was bitten by an infected mite while working in his farmland and fell ill after returning from the field. He first sought care at Sargipali CHC, then was shifted to Sundargarh District Headquarters Hospital, where he tested positive for scrub typhus on October 21. After preliminary treatment he was discharged, but his condition worsened at home. He was rushed to a private hospital in Sundargarh, where he died around 1:30 pm on Friday, October 23. Officials said further verification is underway. The report documents a fatal scrub typhus case with laboratory confirmation, linked to a mite bite in farming activity, with no broader outbreak details provided.

triage.headline_ja: サンダルガダ出身の農夫、ツツガムシ病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単発の確定死亡例であり、アウトブレイクの拡大や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報がなく、国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: ツツガムシ病はヒト-ヒト感染せず、ダニ媒介による散発例。インドのオディシャ州サンダルガダ地区での単一の死亡例であり、アウトブレイクの詳細は報告されていない。バングラデシュの地名も発生地域に含まれるが、記事内容はインドの事例のみを扱っているため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Un essai de vaccin contre Ebola débute en République démocratique du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola vaccine trial begins in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo faces its 17th Ebola outbreak, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with about 9,700 cases and more than 4,600 deaths. No vaccine or treatment is licensed for Bundibugyo, but the WHO has launched a large Tumaini vaccine trial in Bunia, Ituri province. Tumaini tests safety and efficacy and plans to include two Bundibugyo-specific candidates: a ChAdOx1 adenoviral-vector vaccine from Oxford and a Moderna mRNA vaccine, both CEPI-funded. The study will enroll pregnant women and children aged 12 and up, and is conducted with affected communities and health authorities to produce robust data to curb the outbreak and strengthen future preparedness. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever; the May 17 WHO PHEIC highlights insecurity in northern and eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチン治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで第17次エボラ流行（約9,700症例、死亡4,600人超）が継続中でWHOがPHEICを宣言しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するフルRRA対象の重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事自体はワクチン治験開始を報じるものだが、背景にある第17次エボラ流行（Bundibugyo型、PHEIC宣言済み）は既にフルリスク評価対象の重大イベントである。

article.articleHeadline: Jamshedpur Alert: मलेरिया और जेई के दोहरे संक्रमण ने ली बच्‍ची की जान, डेंगू के 5 नए मरीज मिले, स्वास्थ्य विभाग में हड़कंप
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jamshedpur Alert: A double infection of malaria and JE claimed a child's life; five new dengue cases reported, health department in a tizzy.
article.articleSummary: Malaria, dengue, and Japanese encephalitis (JE) are intensifying in Jamshedpur’s East Singhbhum district. MGM Medical College Hospital reported a six-year-old girl died from a dual malaria and JE infection after presenting with high fever, headache, and vomiting; she developed multiorgan failure and could not be saved. In the hospital’s pediatric ICU, five other children with malaria are in serious condition, one on ventilator support. Separately, five new dengue cases were confirmed in the district: two from Sundernagar, one each from Baridih and Telco, and another from Gamharia. Civil Surgeon Dr. Sahir Pal ordered heightened vigilance across government hospitals and CHCs, ensuring lifesaving drugs, and accelerating fogging and larvicidal spraying in affected areas to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: Jamshedpur警報：マラリアと日本脳炎の二重感染で女児死亡、デング熱新規5例、保健局に緊張走る
triage.triage_reason: インド東シングブーム県で複数の媒介蚊感染症（マラリア・JE・デング熱）が同時流行し死亡例も出ているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、地域的な公衆衛生対応事案として続報を注視すべき。
triage.notes: グアテマラの地域情報はBluedotの誤付与と判断し除外。記事はインド・ジャールカンド州ジャムシェドプールに限定された季節性媒介蚊感染症の流行報告であり、地方保健当局の対応範囲内と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : Ndayishimiye et Africa CDC envisagent un sommet africain face à l'urgence sanitaire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Ndayishimiye and Africa CDC are considering an African summit amid the health emergency.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo persists, with 4,687 deaths and 9,704 confirmed cases across eight provinces as of Oct 20, 2026, led by Ituri and North Kivu amid insecurity and limited access. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is driving the epidemic, and there is no specifically licensed vaccine. Cross-border spread is evident: Kenya reports nine infections and Nigeria confirms its first case on Oct 20; Uganda had been affected earlier. In Burundi, President Évariste Ndayishimiye (AU chair) and Africa CDC Director Dr. Jean Kaseya discussed stronger continental mobilization, including a possible heads-of-state summit, though no date is set. A June plan by Africa CDC and WHO seeks roughly $518 million to bolster surveillance, patient care, and prevention across the continent."

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ンダイシミエ大統領とアフリカCDCが公衆衛生緊急事態を受けてアフリカ首脳会議を検討
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が継続・拡大し、死者4,687人・感染9,704人に達し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大も確認されている。IHR基準に複数該当し、アフリカ連合レベルでの緊急対応（首脳サミット検討）が進行中であることから社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事ではケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ブルンジへの言及があるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが主要な発生地であり、Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株による大規模流行が継続中。ワクチンが未承認である点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle: 84 granjas têm exames negativos em MT
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle Disease: 84 farms have negative tests in Mato Grosso.
article.articleSummary: 84 Mato Grosso poultry farms tested negative for Newcastle disease in 2026; Indea-MT and Famato reinforced biosafety after a Newcastle focus at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, on October 18. Newcastle is highly contagious, causing respiratory and neurological signs, reduced egg production, and mortality; prevention centers on restricted access, hygiene, and avoiding contact with wild birds. In Mato Grosso, samples from 84 farms this year were negative for Newcastle and avian influenza; producers are urged to notify the official veterinary service for unusual mortality or respiratory/neurological symptoms, with 136 veterinary units and 240 veterinarians supporting surveillance and contingency planning. In Santa Catarina, Mapa declared a 60-day zoosanitary emergency in Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim; culling ended October 20; disinfection and surveillance continue; officially inspected products remain safe. Mexico and Malaysia suspended imports of certain Brazilian poultry products as of October 21, with restrictions on Santa Catarina goods from China, Saudi Arabia, and Chile. Mexico accounted for 1.59% of Mato Grosso’s shipments (1,437 tons January–September 2026); Mato Grosso exported 90,120 tons of chicken meat in the first nine months, mainly to Saudi Arabia, Hong Kong, China, and UAE.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病：マトグロッソ州の84農場で検査陰性
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽のみに感染する動物疾病で、ヒトへの感染報告はなく、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性もないため、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての重要性は低い。
triage.notes: 本事例はブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の商業用七面鳥農場で発生したニューカッスル病（家禽疾病）で、マトグロッソ州は監視強化のみ。人への健康影響は報告されておらず、動物衛生・貿易（輸入制限）の問題にとどまる。鳥インフルエンザも疾患名リストに含まれるが、本記事内容はニューカッスル病に特化しており、鳥インフルエンザの発生は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola investigations link Kenya and Nigeria cases to Uganda transit hub
article.articleSummary: Ebola investigations link Kenya and Nigeria cases to Uganda transit hub. Kenya’s first confirmed Ebola patient died in Nairobi on 5 October after travelling from the DRC through Uganda, passing Entebbe International Airport on 3 October. Nigeria reports an imported Ebola case in Abuja: a woman who travelled to East Africa developed symptoms on 7 October, was lab-confirmed on 11 October, with 44 identified contacts. Swiss authorities dispute that the Nigerian patient visited the DRC, saying she is a Ugandan-origin Swiss national; WHO and Africa CDC have not confirmed travel to the DRC. Uganda says it has no active Ebola infections and is strengthening screening at points of entry. Kenya is seeking a Ugandan national contact of the deceased, known by name and passport number but unreachable via a South Sudanese phone. Africa CDC will hold an extraordinary virtual meeting of national health officials on 28 October.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ調査、ケニアとナイジェリアの症例をウガンダの中継拠点に関連付け
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ患者がウガンダ経由でケニア・ナイジェリアに越境し死亡・感染確認が起きており、IHR基準の複数該当とAfrica CDCの緊急会合開催など国際的対応が必要な事案のため。
triage.notes: 感染源はDRCとされ、ウガンダを経由してケニア（死亡例）・ナイジェリア（輸入例、44名の接触者）に拡大。スイス当局はナイジェリア患者のDRC渡航歴に異議を唱えており、情報に矛盾あり。Africa CDCが10/28に緊急会合を予定。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Beyond case management: Why dengue prevention needs stronger vector-management systems
article.articleSummary: India approved its first dengue vaccine in July 2026, with the Union Health Ministry backing vaccine rollout alongside vector-control and case management. Dengue prevention now hinges on Integrated Vector Management (IVM), targeting Aedes aegypti before illness occurs. The mosquito bites early morning and late afternoon, breeds in and around homes, and eggs can survive eight months; hatching occurs in 7–10 days. Delhi reported by early October 2026 more than 3.18 crore home visits and breeding in over 1.89 lakh homes, illustrating data-driven prioritization. Dengue case counts show 289,235 in 2023; 121,824 in 2025; 23,952 in the first half of 2026. Pupae counts help identify productive containers; resistance to DDT documented in 2023 Indian studies, guiding insecticide choices. IVM combines source reduction, larvivorous fish, larvicides, fogging, and Indoor Residual Spraying; construction sites, Mumbai laws, and Ahmedabad inspections highlight cross-sector responsibility to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ケース管理を超えて：デング熱予防になぜより強固な媒介生物管理システムが必要か
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインドにおけるデング熱予防政策・ベクター管理戦略に関する解説記事であり、新規の異常な発生や急増を報告するものではない。症例数はむしろ減少傾向（2023年28.9万→2025年12.2万→2026年上半期2.4万）であり、シグナルとして取り上げる緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: インドはデング熱流行国であり、本記事は政府の媒介生物対策・ワクチン導入に関する政策解説。症例数は減少傾向にあり、急性の公衆衛生危機を示すものではないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Boy dies of dengue in Coimbatore Medical College Hospital
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever death of a four-year-old boy from Tirupur, Tamil Nadu, at Coimbatore Medical College Hospital (CMCH). The child first sought care at Sri Ragamani Clinic in Palladam on Oct 20 for fever; initial tests showed normal platelet and white blood cell counts and he was treated as an outpatient. Fever persisted; he returned Oct 21 for IV fluids, and on Oct 22 developed vomiting with a sharp decline in white blood cells and platelets (platelets 66,000). A dengue test was positive and he had seizures before transfer to CMCH. Admitted to CMCH at 1:18 am on Oct 23 with circulatory failure, he subsequently developed respiratory failure and required ventilatory support and blood products. He died at 7:35 pm on Friday. The patient was a resident of Tirupur, treated across Palladam clinics before CMCH admission.

triage.headline_ja: コインバトール医科大学病院でデング熱により少年死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一の散発的な小児デング熱死亡例であり、インドでは流行地域として既知の疾患であるため、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 単発の死亡例報告であり、地域的なアウトブレイクや異常な感染拡大を示す情報は記事中に見られない。デング熱はインドで季節的に流行する既知の疾患。

article.articleHeadline: Mulher de 86 anos morre após levar picada de mosquito: 'Ela não tinha problemas de saúde'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An 86-year-old woman dies after being bitten by a mosquito: 'She had no health problems'.
article.articleSummary: An 86-year-old woman, Granada Romero Ruiz, died in Seville, Spain, in July 2024 after contracting West Nile virus from a mosquito bite, spending nine days hospitalized. She reportedly had no prior health problems. The La Puebla del Río municipality condemned the death and urged reinforced mosquito control and public-health measures. West Nile virus is transmitted mainly by Culex mosquitoes, with birds as natural reservoirs. Infections are often mild or asymptomatic: about 80% asymptomatic, ~20% flu-like, and fewer than 1% progress to severe neurological disease such as meningitis, encephalitis, or spinal involvement. Elderly individuals are at higher risk. There is no antiviral treatment or licensed human vaccine; prevention centers on reducing mosquito exposure (repellents, screens, protective clothing) and eliminating standing water. The virus circulates across Europe, Africa, and the Americas; Brazil has reported human infections.

triage.headline_ja: 86歳女性、蚊に刺された後に死亡：『彼女には健康上の問題はなかった』
triage.triage_reason: 本件はスペイン・セビリアで2024年7月に発生した単発の西ナイルウイルス死亡例であり、対象国での発生ではない。ブラジルへの言及は一般的な流行地域の説明に過ぎず、同国での具体的な発生事例ではないため対象外。
triage.notes: 発生地域はスペイン（セビリア、アンダルシア、カナリア諸島）であり対象国リストに含まれない。ブラジルは西ナイルウイルスの流行地域として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題となる発生事例ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: DA targets 117,000 pets for rabies shots
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination drive in Eastern Visayas targets about 117,000 dogs and cats, with the Department of Agriculture distributing 12,000 anti-rabies vaccine vials for six provinces and five cities for free vaccination. Vaccines, syringes, and needles will be provided to local veterinary officers and agricultural technicians to run free services. Province allocations: Southern Leyte 2,215; Leyte 1,909; Samar 1,893; Eastern Samar 1,790; Northern Samar 895; Biliran 557. City allocations are 500 vials each for Tacloban, Ormoc, Catbalogan, Calbayog, and Borongan to support citywide campaigns. The program aims to strengthen public health protection and promote responsible pet ownership. Spay-and-neuter kits were also turned over to local governments to enable free sterilization, helping curb stray populations and reduce rabies transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: 農業省、ペット11万7000匹を対象に狂犬病予防接種を実施へ
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病予防接種の通常の公衆衛生活動であり、異常な発生や症例急増の報告はなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事はフィリピン東ビサヤ地方における予防的なペット向け狂犬病ワクチン接種キャンペーンを報じるもので、ヒトの症例発生や異常事態の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DR Congo rise to 9,816, death toll reaches 4,757
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DR Congo) has reached 9,816 confirmed cases as of 24 October 2026, with 2,635 recoveries and 4,757 deaths, according to the DR Congo Ministry of Communications and Media. Response measures continue across eight provinces and 66 health districts, with a contact-tracing rate rising to 89.1%. The latest figures underscore persistent regional public health challenges as authorities maintain surveillance and response operations for exposed individuals. In neighbouring Kenya, the Ministry of Health reported a second Ebola-related death — a 65-year-old woman — highlighting cross-border risk and ongoing monitoring. The report notes authorities are sustaining response efforts and monitoring contacts to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の感染者数が9,816人に増加、死者数は4,757人に達する
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱が大規模化（症例9,816件、死亡4,757件）し、隣国ケニアへの越境感染（死亡例）も報告されているため、国際的拡大リスクが明確でフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ケニアでの死亡例報告は越境感染リスクを示すが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cai em Porto Velho, mas risco do mosquito exige atenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue falls in Porto Velho, but the risk from mosquitoes requires attention.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Porto Velho, Rondônia, reached 57 cases from January to October 19, 2026, per Semusa, down from 212 in 2025 and 584 in 2024. Despite the decline, Aedes aegypti control must continue, as the second LIRAa (May–June 2026) rated Porto Velho as medium risk for infestation. Chikungunya totals: 20 cases in 2024, 61 in 2025, and 27 in 2026 (through Oct 19); Zika: 16 in 2024, 5 in 2025, with zero cases in 2026 up to Oct 19. While not signaling an imminent outbreak, authorities emphasize ongoing vigilance. Municipal Health Secretary Sandra Cardoso urged community participation: eliminate standing water, seal water tanks, clean gutters, add sand to plant pots, store containers protected from rain, dispose of tires and unused items, and check yards and drains. Seek medical care for fever, body aches, headache, or red rash to distinguish dengue from other arboviruses.

triage.headline_ja: ポルトベーリョでデング熱が減少するも、蚊のリスクには引き続き注意が必要
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱いずれも前年より症例数が減少傾向にあり、当局も「差し迫った流行の兆候はない」としている通常の公衆衛生モニタリング報告であるため。
triage.notes: 蚊媒介性感染症（デング・チクングニア・ジカ）の年次推移報告であり、いずれも減少傾向。地域の定期的な公衆衛生監視活動の一環で、特段の異常や拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Weekly Health Update | Ebola Reaches Nigeria; Africa CDC Chief Criticizes Vaccine Research Gap
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak spreads across three African regions, with DR Congo reporting more than 9,700 confirmed cases and 4,690 deaths as of Oct 23, 2026; Ituri, North Kivu and Haut-Uélé are hardest hit. Nigeria confirms its first Bundibugyo case since 2014 after a traveler from Uganda arrived in Abuja; 44 close contacts identified; source under investigation. Kenya reports nine cases and one death in Nairobi; Uganda records 20 cases and two deaths. Africa CDC convenes a virtual ministers’ meeting for Oct 28 to assess cross-border spread and seeks emergency funding for Nigeria, DR Congo and Kenya amid vaccine gaps. No approved vaccine for Bundibugyo; Ervebo (Zaire strain) used under a protocol, efficacy against Bundibugyo unproven; several candidates in early trials. Africa CDC aims to speed vaccine production in Africa, strengthen coordination, and boost domestic funding. AU validated a continental health data governance framework on Oct 22; RTS,S malaria vaccine price reduced ~40% to €5.50 per dose.

triage.headline_ja: 週次保健アップデート：エボラ出血熱がナイジェリアに到達、アフリカCDC長官がワクチン研究の遅れを批判
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9700人超の感染・4690人死亡という重大なエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が、ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダへ越境拡大しており、IHR基準の深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大の複数に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダへのエボラ拡大が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCのみ対象国として該当。承認ワクチンがない点、Africa CDCが緊急資金調達と閣僚級会合を招集している点から管理可能性にも懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana closes type 2 Polio outbreak as it marks World Polio Day 2026
article.articleSummary: Ghana closed its type 2 poliovirus outbreak in August 2026, announced as the country marked World Polio Day 2026. Outbreak Response Assessments (OBRA) confirmed the effectiveness of the response, with sustained immunisation coverage above 95% since the introduction of the Inactivated Polio Vaccine (IPV) in 2018 and a second dose added in 2024. The effort involved the Ministry of Health, Ghana Health Service (GHS), WHO, UNICEF, Gavi, Rotary International and the US CDC. Ghana was one of five African countries that closed type 2 poliovirus outbreaks in August 2026, along with Burundi, Guinea-Bissau, the Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Authorities urge continued vaccination, routine immunisation, surveillance and community mobilisation to prevent future transmission. Poliovirus can cause permanent paralysis; there is no cure, but vaccination provides protection. Parents are advised to vaccinate every eligible child.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ、世界ポリオデー2026にあわせてタイプ2ポリオのアウトブレイク終息を発表
triage.triage_reason: アウトブレイク終息（ポジティブなニュース）を報告する内容であり、新規の公衆衛生リスクや異常事態は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はタイプ2ポリオアウトブレイクの終息（成功事例）を報じるもの。地域リストにRepublic of the Congo（コンゴ共和国）とDemocratic Republic of the Congo（コンゴ民主共和国）の混同の可能性があるが、対象国リストのDRC(203312)として扱った。Burundi、Guinea-Bissau、Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil activa controles por virus newcastle en el sector avícola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil activates controls for Newcastle disease in the poultry sector
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease, a viral infection of birds, was detected at a Santa Catarina facility in Brazil, triggering intensified surveillance across 133 farms in the area. The Ministry of Agriculture, led by Minister André de Paula, confirmed the case and launched biosecurity, epidemiological monitoring, and movement controls to contain the virus and define the outbreak’s reach. While officials note not all monitored establishments have ill birds, the 133 sites remain under precautionary surveillance. The episode raises concerns about production losses and potential restrictions on Brazil’s poultry exports, given the country is the world’s largest creator of chicken meat. Technical reports are being prepared for major trading partners; decisions on imports depend on epidemiological results and bilateral sanitary agreements. Regionalization could limit measures to affected zones. China, a key market, is closely watched, reflecting past restrictions on Rio Grande do Sul in 2024.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、家禽セクターにおけるニューカッスル病ウイルスに対する管理体制を発動
triage.triage_reason: 家禽への感染確認を受け、ブラジル国内133農場で監視強化と移動制限が実施され、主要輸出市場（中国等）への貿易制限リスクが明示されているため、IHR基準（国際的拡大リスク・渡航貿易制限リスク）に2つ該当する。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（鳥類）の疾病であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響は報告されていない。主たる懸念は家禽産業・国際貿易（特に中国市場）への影響であり、人獣共通感染症としてのリスクは低いが、貿易制限リスクの観点からWATCH以上の注視が妥当。中国は貿易相手国として言及されているのみで、発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, le vaccinazioni nella Repubblica Democratica del Congo dove già sono morte 4.700 persone
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola vaccinations in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where 4,700 people have already died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, driven by Bundibugyo virus (BDBV), has caused about 4,600–4,700 deaths among roughly 9,600–9,700 confirmed cases. The epidemic, the largest Bundibugyo outbreak and the second-largest Ebola outbreak to date, was declared on May 15, 2026 as a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern. As of Oct 21, 2026, 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths were reported in the DRC. Vaccination efforts began in Bunia at a Tumaini Foundation medical center, with the first participant enrolled on Oct 23, 2026, as part of a government-led response. The two-stage vaccination program is a Phase 2/3 study to test candidate vaccines against BDBV, including Ervebo (EBOV). No BDBV-approved vaccine exists. Tumaini will work with communities, health authorities, and partners to gather evidence on safety, immunogenicity, and efficacy to contain the outbreak and strengthen future preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、すでに4,700人が死亡したコンゴ民主共和国でワクチン接種開始
triage.triage_reason: WHO PHEIC宣言済みで致死率が極めて高く、史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済みの大規模アウトブレイク。約9,600人感染、4,700人死亡と致死率約48%と極めて高い。BDBV承認ワクチンが存在せず、Phase2/3試験としてワクチン接種が開始された段階。既にWHO通知済みの可能性が高いため、フルRRAによる最新状況確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Raj to vaccinate 92.83 lakh children against polio on Nov 22
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination drive in Rajasthan, India: about 92.83 lakh children under five in 32 districts will receive oral polio vaccine on Nov 22 as part of a Sub-National Pulse Polio Immunization campaign, prompted by polio cases in neighboring Pakistan (6 in 2026) and Afghanistan (36). India was polio-free since 2014; last Indian case in Jan 2011, with Rajasthan reporting no cases since 2009. Pilgrims from polio-affected countries, including Pakistan, visit Rajasthan for Ajmer Urs, sustaining cross-border transmission risk and underscoring the need for continued immunisation. On day one, vaccine drops will be at 54,349 booths, with house-to-house follow-up over the next two days for those missed. A total of 69,516 teams (5,934 transit, 7,607 mobile) are deployed to reach residents, bus stands, railway stations, remote settlements, and mobile populations.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州、11月22日にポリオ予防接種を928.3万人の子どもに実施
triage.triage_reason: インドは2014年以降ポリオフリーであり本記事は予防的な定期ワクチン接種キャンペーンの告知だが、隣国パキスタン・アフガニスタンでの症例増加と巡礼者による越境感染リスクが指摘されており、継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ラジャスタン州における定期的な予防接種キャンペーンの告知であり、インド国内に実際のポリオ症例は報告されていない（インドは2014年以降ポリオフリー、ラジャスタン州は2009年以降症例なし）。実際の症例報告国であるパキスタン・アフガニスタンは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 河内一名经理飞西贡约会女大学生，10·20刚见完面，第二天双双感染HIV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Hanoi manager flew to Saigon to date a female college student; after just meeting on Oct. 20, the next day both were infected with HIV.
article.articleSummary: A Hanoi-based manager and a university student in Ho Chi Minh City were diagnosed with HIV within 24 hours after meeting on Oct 20. Both tested HIV-positive at a Ho Chi Minh City prevention clinic on Oct 21 following unprotected sex over their year-long relationship. The student reported fatigue and lymphadenopathy; rapid tests were confirmed by follow-up testing. The manager disclosed he has a wife and daughter in Hanoi, raising concern about potential exposure to family. Health authorities stress honest discussions of sexual health, regular testing, and protection. The article advises consistent condom use for vaginal or anal sex, routine testing after high-risk behavior, and HIV prevention options such as PEP (started within 72 hours of exposure) and PrEP for at-risk individuals, alongside vaccination and prompt medical care for symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイの男性管理職がサイゴンで女子大学生とデート、10月20日に会った翌日、2人ともHIVに感染
triage.triage_reason: 個別事例の性感染報道であり、公衆衛生上の異常性・国際的拡大リスク・社会的関心の高まりは認められないため、シグナルとして取り上げる基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 個人の性感染事例を扱ったゴシップ性の高い記事であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての意義は乏しい。

article.articleHeadline: 65-Year-Old Second Ebola Patient Buried Under Strict Safety Measures
article.articleSummary: 65-year-old woman dies of Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease in Nairobi, Kenya, Oct 24, 2026, becoming Kenya's third confirmed case and second Ebola-related death. She had been quarantined as a close contact of the first patient and developed symptoms on Oct 13; she was admitted to an infectious disease unit the same day and died after deterioration despite supportive care. Burial followed strict infection-prevention protocols to minimize transmission while accommodating Muslim practices. Ebola can spread through direct contact with blood or bodily fluids, including after death; trained burial teams with PPE were used and mourners were advised to avoid handling the body. Kenya's nine confirmed Ebola cases include seven other patients in two isolation facilities; the first patient, a Kenyan man who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo, died earlier in October after arriving in Nairobi via Uganda. No evidence of community transmission; hotline 719 for guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 65歳の第2のエボラ患者、厳格な安全対策のもとで埋葬
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の地域内感染が確認され、死亡例・新規症例が継続発生しており、国境を越えた移動歴もあることから国際的拡大リスクが懸念されるため。
triage.notes: 発生国はケニアであり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列。初発患者はDRC在住歴がありウガンダ経由でケニアに入国したが、発生自体はケニア国内で確認されているためDRCは含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Жена швейцарского дипломата в Нигерии заразилась Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wife of a Swiss diplomat in Nigeria contracted Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease case in Nigeria: A Swiss woman, wife of a staff member at the Swiss embassy in Abuja, has been diagnosed with Ebola and is receiving care in a private clinic after onset around October 20, 2026. The Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs says infection is suspected to have been acquired during a trip to Uganda about two weeks earlier. The couple had not been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The patient’s husband is in isolation but asymptomatic. The report provides no further details on laboratory confirmation beyond the diagnosis, nor on additional cases or local transmission in Nigeria at this time. This incident highlights a travel-associated exposure linked to Uganda rather than confirmed ongoing transmission within Nigeria.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでスイス人外交官の妻がエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の輸入症例であり、スイス外交官家族を介した国際的な接触・渡航歴が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 患者はナイジェリア（アブジャ）で診断されたが、感染源はウガンダ滞在中とされ、DRCへの渡航は明確に否定されている。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・スイスはいずれも対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Kolkata sees surge in hand, foot and mouth disease in children
article.articleSummary: Hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) is surging in Kolkata, with scores of children affected and some adults ill. Hospitals report four children in the last fortnight. Physicians note a shift in symptoms this year: extremely itchy rashes spreading to the body and lower back, recurring after apparent recovery. Lesions appear on hands, palms, elbows, underarms, back, hips, knees, feet, and inside the mouth; some cases resemble chickenpox. Most cases are self-limiting and resolve in about a week, with fever, mouth ulcers and painful eating common. Management is supportive: paracetamol for fever/pain, adequate fluids, and antihistamine lotions or IV fluids for dehydration. Preventive advice includes hand hygiene, cleaning surfaces, and keeping infected children at home; seek care for dehydration, persistent fever, drowsiness, or worsening symptoms. Surge observed over the past 10 days; Aug cases earlier.

triage.headline_ja: コルカタで子供の手足口病が急増
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病の症例増加が報告されているが大半が軽症・自然軽快であり、重篤例や国際的拡大の情報はないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: コルカタ(西ベンガル州)での小児を中心とした手足口病(HFMD)の局地的増加。症状にやや非典型的な痒みを伴う発疹拡大が見られるが、大半は1週間程度で自然軽快する軽症例。重症化・国際的拡大の兆候なし。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Launches First Ebola Vaccine Trial in Congo's Bunia
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Bunia in Ituri province, northeast DR Congo, hosts the first Ebola vaccine trial amid the worst outbreak in the country's history, with over 9,700 cases and more than 4,600 deaths. The World Health Organization launched the Tomayni trial, named for 'hope' in Swahili, to evaluate multiple vaccine candidates against the Bundibugyo Ebola virus; the first dose of Ervebo—the vaccine approved for the Zaire strain—was administered in Bunia, alongside parallel testing of Ervebo for potential cross-protection against Bundibugyo. Tomayni employs a ring vaccination design, vaccinating contacts at high risk, and will include pregnant women and children aged 12 and older. Preparations are underway to add two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines in development (Oxford and Moderna mRNA). With no approved vaccines or treatments against Bundibugyo, Tomayni represents the first step in assessing protective options.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのブニアで初のエボラワクチン治験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで同国史上最悪規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続しており、症例9,700件超・死者4,600人超と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない異常事態であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株に対する承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、リング接種方式での治験（Tomayni試験）が開始された段階。WHOが主導する国際支援が行われており、周辺国への越境拡大リスクについては記事内に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Congo, a Bunia parte il test del primo vaccino contro l'Ebola Bundibugyo: 9.700 casi e 4.600 morti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: In Bunia, the trial of the first vaccine against Bundibugyo ebolavirus begins — 9,700 cases and 4,600 deaths.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo (Bunia, Ituri) launches the Tumaini trial—the first human test against Bundibugyo ebolavirus—administering vaccines to contacts of Ebola patients. Tumaini is a phase 2/3 adaptive ring-vaccination study targeting high‑risk contacts, including pregnant women and youths 12+, using Merck’s Ervebo (Zaire strain) initially, with Oxford and Moderna mRNA candidates to follow, funded by Cepi. The outbreak has surpassed 9,700 cases and 4,600 deaths, the largest in Congo’s history, with WHO declaring an international emergency. Kenya reports a second death (65-year-old in quarantine) amid 9 confirmed cases and 118 of 135 contacts in isolation, with no proven community transmission; the first Kenyan patient was a 40-year-old resident in Congo who arrived Oct 3 via Uganda. Nigeria confirms a case (Oct 20, Abuja) in a Uganda-born woman who arrived Oct 3, with 44 contacts monitored. Uganda ended its outbreak in August (20 cases, 2 deaths). Bundibugyo had appeared in 2012 (Isiro, DRC) and 2007–2008 (Uganda).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：ブニアでスンダビルブ型エボラウイルスに対する初のワクチン試験開始——感染者9,700人、死者4,600人
triage.triage_reason: WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言した、コンゴ民主共和国史上最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクであり、既にケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダでも症例が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。アウトブレイクの主な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州ブニア）であり、WHOは既に国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: AIIMS-Nagpur gets ₹30cr NCDC sanction for BSL-III lab to strengthen infectious disease surveillance, research
article.articleSummary: AIIMS-Nagpur secures Rs 30 crore from NCDC to establish a Biosafety Level-III laboratory in Nagpur, Maharashtra, to strengthen detection and investigation of emerging and high-risk infectious diseases; expected to be operational in about a year and aimed at reducing dependence on NIV Pune for advanced testing. In parallel, AIIMS-Nagpur is converting its Virus Research and Diagnostic Laboratory into an Infectious Disease Research and Diagnostic Laboratory (IRDL) at Rs 17 crore, funded by ICMR-DHR, expanding bacteriology, mycology, parasitology and virology testing and broadening infection coverage; it should be functional within three months. The upgrades reflect concerns over rising human-animal interfaces due to deforestation and climate change. Emphasis is on integrating syndromic and genomic surveillance, including whole-genome sequencing, for early detection of mutations and emerging pathogens. AIIMS-Nagpur’s microbiology department already contributes to national surveillance and has helped grant PCR-testing status to more than 250 labs.

triage.headline_ja: AIIMS-Nagpurが新興感染症サーベイランス・研究強化のためBSL-3実験室設立にNCDCから3000万ルピーの承認を取得
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、検査施設整備に関するインフラ強化の報道であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 疾患名にNipahが付与されているが、記事本文はNipahを含む新興感染症全般への検査体制強化に関する内容であり、具体的な発生事例の報告ではない。インフラ投資ニュースのため対象国としての発生事例に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Carrapato com uma estrela nas costas pode ameaçar cães e gatos; veja como identificar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A tick with a star on its back may threaten dogs and cats; learn how to identify.
article.articleSummary: Lone star tick (Amblyomma americanum) poses a risk to dogs and cats in North America, and may be mistaken for Brazilian star-tick species such as Amblyomma sculptum. Identification is challenging; the adult female’s white star-like dorsal mark aids recognition but is not definitive, and local tick species in Brazil can differ in disease transmission. The tick can transmit Ehrlichia ewingii, associated with ehrlichiosis in dogs, while some star-tick species in Brazil are linked to Rocky Mountain spotted fever in humans. Regular post-outdoor inspection of pets is advised, focusing on ears, head, between toes, armpits, groin, abdomen, neck, and around the collar, and bedding. If found, remove with fine-tipped tweezers by pulling firmly without twisting or squeezing; monitor for signs such as apathy, loss of appetite, fever, or swelling and seek veterinary care if symptoms emerge. Prevent year-round with veterinarian-recommended antiparasitics and environmental maintenance.

triage.headline_ja: 背中に星模様のあるダニは犬や猫を脅かす可能性がある；見分け方を解説
triage.triage_reason: 北米のマダニ（ロンスタータイマダニ）に関する一般的なペットの健康・予防啓発記事であり、ブラジルでの実際の感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は主に北米のロンスタータイマダニに関する一般啓発情報であり、ブラジルの在来種（Amblyomma sculptum）との識別に触れているのみで、ブラジル国内での具体的な感染事例や発生報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 infecta 108 detentos na CPP de Rio Verde - Fala Canedo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 Infects 108 Inmates at Rio Verde's CPP - Fala Canedo
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 outbreak at Rio Verde's Provisional Prison (CPP) in southwestern Goiás, Brazil, has infected 108 inmates among 531 detainees and 28 staff. Response includes isolating positive and symptomatic individuals, reinforcing mask use, hand hygiene, and ventilation, and updating vaccination for inmates and staff. Visiting rights are temporarily suspended. First cases were confirmed after two testing rounds: 15 October saw 79 positives of 160 tested; 16–20 October added 29 positives from Lacen-GO testing, totaling 108, per SES-GO. The outbreak was notified on 14 October to the Strategic Information and Response Center in Vigilance (CIEVS Goiás), coordinating testing and care with the Southwest II Regional Health Team. Authorities are evaluating antiviral treatment needs and maintaining daily case monitoring. No deaths or hospitalizations due to severe respiratory illness have been reported; surveillance continues and visits will resume only after sanitary conditions are reassessed.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19がリオ・ヴェルデの刑務所(CPP)で108人の受刑者に感染 - Fala Canedo
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内での局地的なCOVID-19集団感染で、死亡・入院例なく、既存の公衆衛生対応で管理されており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 密集した刑務所環境での感染拡大は流行しやすい条件に該当するが、既に地域保健当局(SES-GO、CIEVS Goiás)により管理されており、死亡・重症化例なし。国際的関心やフルRRAの必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Canicatti Web Notizie -Caso sospetto di ebola a Palermo, scatta il protocollo risolto in appena cinque ore
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Canicatti Web News - Suspected Ebola case in Palermo, protocol activated and resolved in just five hours.
article.articleSummary: On 24 October 2026, Palermo activated its Ebola protocol after a Congo-arrived patient with high fever reached the Civico hospital emergency department. The suspected Ebola case was immediately isolated in the infectious diseases unit, with blood drawn for diagnosis. The sample was sealed in biosafety containment and transported to Rome by helicopter (118), escorted by police, a containment ambulance, and the Nbcr firefighters unit. Containment equipment was provided by the Istituto Zooprofilattico, under Francesca Gaudio. The operation was overseen by Health Department head Gigi Scalzo and regional contact Antonio Cascio, with ongoing oversight by Health Assessor Marcello Caruso. Training in high biosafety containment funded by the Fondazione Human Biosafety Health, led by Francesco Bongiorno, supported the response. Ebola was ruled out; diagnosis achieved in under five hours, contrast to a prior Sardinia case that required ~36 hours.

triage.headline_ja: カニカッティ・ウェブ・ノティツィエ - パレルモでエボラ疑い例、プロトコル発動もわずか5時間で解決
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ帰りの発熱患者がパレルモでエボラ疑い例としてプロトコルに基づき隔離・検査されたが、5時間以内にエボラは否定された。実発生なし。
triage.notes: イタリア・パレルモでの疑い例であり、エボラは陰性と判明。コンゴ（DRC）自体での発生を示す記述はなく、患者の渡航歴に言及されているのみのため、DRCもverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Uruguay suspendió ingreso de aves y productos de Brasil por foco de enfermedad Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uruguay suspended imports of birds and products from Brazil due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Uruguay suspended temporary entry and transit of birds and related products from Brazil after Newcastle disease was detected in Nova Itaberaba and confirmed on 18 October 2026, with notification to the OIE on 20 October. The measure, issued by the MGAP’s Dirección General de Servicios Ganaderos, targets animals susceptible to Newcastle and their products entering or transiting Uruguay, but includes exemptions for certain goods meeting OMSA (OIE) requirements and for treated products with international veterinary certification produced after 6 September 2026. The affected establishment—a turkey fattening facility—was interdicted, and bird movements were halted as Brazil implements containment and eradication; epidemiological investigation and surveillance continue. Uruguay has not reported Newcastle in poultry since 1984. Producers are urged to strengthen biosecurity to prevent contact between domestic and wild birds. Newcastle is a viral avian disease causing respiratory, digestive, or nervous signs and possibly sudden mortality; reporting is mandatory.

triage.headline_ja: ウルグアイ、ブラジルでのニューカッスル病発生によりブラジルからの鳥類・鳥類産品の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（ニューカッスル病）であり人の公衆衛生への直接影響は報告されておらず、貿易制限は発生しているがヒトの感染症シグナルとしてのIHR/WPRO基準該当は低い。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽疾病（動物衛生）に関するもので、ヒトの感染症事例の報告はない。IHR基準の国際拡大・貿易制限は該当するが、人の公衆衛生への深刻な影響は認められないためDISMISSと判断。ウルグアイは対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、発生国であるブラジルのみをverified_locationsに記載。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo begins trial of Ebola vaccine against Bundibugyo strain
article.articleSummary: DR Congo launched on Oct 23 the Tumaini trial in Bunia, Ituri Province to test whether an existing Ebola vaccine protects against Bundibugyo during the May 2026 outbreak, which has surpassed 9,700 cases and 4,600 deaths. By Oct 21, the outbreak stood at 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths. The first participant received Ervebo, licensed for the Zaire strain, though its Bundibugyo protection is unproven. Tumaini is an adaptive, ring-vaccination trial designed to speed evidence on safety, immune response and effectiveness, with WHO support. It will enroll high-risk contacts, pregnant women, and children aged 12 and older. Two additional Bundibugyo-specific candidates—Oxford/Serum Institute and Moderna vaccines—are expected to join after early testing; CEPI funds support their development. The Bundibugyo outbreak is the largest on record; transmission is via contact with infected fluids, with symptoms including fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headaches.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、ブンディブギョ株に対するエボラワクチンの治験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 過去最大規模のブンディブギョ株エボラ流行（9,700例超、死亡4,600例超）が継続中で、WHO支援下でのワクチン治験開始という重大な動きがあり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本件は過去最大規模のブンディブギョ株エボラ流行の継続事案であり、既に国際的な注目と支援（WHO、CEPI、Oxford/Serum Institute、Moderna）が集まっている。国境を越えた拡大リスクについては記事中に明記がないため不明と評価したが、流行規模と病原体の性質から警戒継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Жена швейцарского дипломата заболела Эболой в Нигерии
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The wife of a Swiss diplomat contracted Ebola in Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: 42-year-old Ugandan citizen living in Abuja, Nigeria, tested positive for Ebola on October 20. She is the wife of a Swiss diplomat, confirmed by the Swiss Foreign Ministry. She is in self-isolation, with the Bundibugyo strain confirmed. Initial illness symptoms led to multiple malaria tests; the Ebola test was conducted on October 19, 13 days after symptom onset. Swiss authorities believe she contracted the virus during a trip to Uganda, though the exact source remains undetermined. The Swiss mission in Nigeria reports no Ebola cases among staff. The current outbreak began in May in Congo and has since spread to Uganda and Kenya; in Congo alone, about 9,500 people have been infected and more than 4,600 have died. Ebola spreads by close contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals, and this outbreak is less active than the 2016 epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: スイス人外交官の妻がナイジェリアでエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: 進行中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（DRC起源、ウガンダ・ケニアに拡大）に関連し、スイス外交官家族という国際的な人物への感染が確認されたため、国際的拡大リスクが高くIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（スイス外交官夫人の感染）だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア・スイスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは今回のアウトブレイクの起源地であり、約9,500人感染・4,600人死亡という重要な被害状況が記載されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Over 150 Dengue Cases Reported In A Week In Howrah
article.articleSummary: Howrah reports over 150 dengue cases in Howrah Municipal Corporation (HMC) and nearby areas during Oct 14–20, with 47 cases inside HMC; Howrah city has recorded 350 dengue cases in the past seven months. Bankra 1 gram panchayat accounts for at least 19 infections, with Mondalpara, New Mondalpara and Uttarpara also affected. Of those infected, 94 with health complications were admitted to Howrah District Hospital, and one patient is critically ill and referred to RG Kar Medical College and Hospital in Kolkata. Authorities cite garbage-clogged drains and waterlogging as dengue breeding grounds. A vector-control team has been dispatched, with mosquito repellent oil sprayed and emergency waste clearance by panchayat, district and state authorities. District health officials say dengue prevention is being undertaken on a war-footing; some sources allege management issues tied to the appointment of a homeopathic doctor as OSD.

triage.headline_ja: ハウラー市で1週間に150件以上のデング熱症例が報告
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州ハウラー市における季節性のデング熱局地的増加であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、媒介蚊対策状況や重症例の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの風土病であり季節的増加は例年見られる現象。ハウラー市の局地的な症例急増であり、全国的・国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、排水不良や行政対応の問題が指摘されており、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Polio: Rotary Urges Parents To Immunise Children, Ogun Monarchs Join Campaign
article.articleSummary: World Polio Day, 24 October 2026, saw Rotary International District 9112 launch a polio immunisation campaign in Ijebu-Igbo, Ogun State, Nigeria, urging parents to vaccinate children to prevent paralysis or death from poliomyelitis. Led by the Orimolusi of Ijebu-Igbo, Oba Lawrence Jaiyeoba Adebajo, and seven other traditional rulers, the drive aims to reinforce public confidence in vaccination and reach households through grassroots influence. Abdul-Aziz noted that the global eradication effort began after a 1979 Philippines vaccination project and expanded since 1988, reducing wild poliovirus from endemic in more than 120 countries to just Pakistan and Afghanistan remain endemic. The campaign emphasizes immunisation of children under public health guidelines and counters misconceptions that hinder vaccination, leveraging royal endorsement to overcome resistance.

triage.headline_ja: ポリオ：ロータリークラブが親に予防接種を呼びかけ、オグン州の伝統的君主も啓発活動に参加
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はナイジェリア・オグン州でのポリオワクチン接種啓発キャンペーンに関する内容であり、新規の発生・流行報告ではない。フィリピンやパキスタン・アフガニスタンへの言及も歴史的背景説明にとどまる。
triage.notes: 記事は世界ポリオデーに合わせたナイジェリアでのワクチン接種推進キャンペーンの報道。フィリピンは1979年の過去のワクチン接種事業の文脈で言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。対象国リストにナイジェリア・パキスタン・アフガニスタンは含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: OMS inicia testes de vacina contra cepa do Ebola, responsável por surto no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO begins vaccine trials against an Ebola strain responsible for the outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization has begun the first clinical trial of vaccines against the Bundibugyo Ebola strain driving the current outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The Bundibugyo outbreak has surpassed 9,700 cases and 4,600 deaths, with WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. First doses were administered on Oct 23, 2026 in Bunia, Ituri province, the epidemic’s epicenter. The Tumaini trial tests three candidates: Ervebo (approved for the Zaire strain), ChAdOx1 from Oxford, and Moderna’s mRNA vaccine. The study will run in three phases to assess safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity, and will include pregnant women and children from age 12. CEPI funds ChAdOx1 and Moderna. If effective, vaccines could provide cross-protection against Bundibugyo and guide vaccination strategies in DRC and other affected countries such as Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. Transmission occurs via contact with blood and bodily fluids; no approved vaccine yet for this variant.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴでの流行の原因であるエボラ株に対するワクチン試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでPHEIC宣言済みのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)大規模流行(9,700例超・死者4,600人超)に対しWHOがワクチン臨床試験を開始しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: PHEIC宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行であり、既にフルRRA対象となっている可能性が高い。ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは「他の影響国」として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため、またはDRC以外での実際の発生は記載なしのためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Polymicrobial Bile Infections Linked to Sepsis Risk and Antibiotic
article.articleSummary: Polymicrobial infection in acute biliary infection is linked to higher SIRS and sepsis risk and greater antimicrobial resistance, reported from the General Hospital of Ningxia Medical University in Yinchuan, China. In a retrospective study of 208 patients treated with ERCP or PTGD (Aug 2020–Aug 2023), 61 (29.3%) had polymicrobial bile cultures versus monomicrobial infections. Escherichia coli was the most common pathogen overall, with polymicrobial cases showing a higher proportion of Gram-positive organisms. Multivariate analysis found polymicrobial infection independently predicted both SIRS and sepsis, while antimicrobial resistance was more frequent in the polymicrobial group—driven largely by E. coli resistance, though resistance did not independently drive SIRS/sepsis. A history of biliary surgery emerged as an independent risk factor for polymicrobial infection, suggesting early risk stratification and empirical therapy considerations. Limitations include retrospective, single-center design and bile-culture–based sampling.

triage.headline_ja: 多菌性胆道感染症が敗血症リスクと抗菌薬耐性に関連
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設の後ろ向き臨床研究であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は胆道感染症患者208名を対象とした臨床研究報告であり、感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の脅威に関するものではない。ERCP/PTGD施行患者における院内感染対策の知見に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola : l'extension régionale relance le débat sur l'efficacité de la riposte | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola: Regional spread rekindles the debate over the effectiveness of the response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola regional spread tests surveillance systems as cross-border threat. From a Congolese epicenter to cross-border transmission, the outbreak challenges African surveillance. As of 20 October 2026, the World Health Organization reports 9,704 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,687 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), across eight provinces. Kenya reports nine cases and one death; Nigeria confirms an imported Bundibugyo strain case on 20 October. The Bundibugyo lineage, the same strain behind the DRC epidemic, underscores regional transmission challenges. Financially, Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya notes that of 962 million dollars announced as disbursed for the DRC response, only about 200 million has been traced to partner institutions in a verification exercise; over 700 million remains insufficiently traceable. While not asserting misappropriation, transparency remains essential: each partner should explain received funds, expenditures, and results.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：地域的拡大が対応の有効性を巡る議論を再燃させる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,704症例・4,687死亡という大規模アウトブレイクが続き、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境伝播が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境伝播が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。資金の透明性問題（96.2億ドル中7億ドル超が追跡不能）も対応能力への懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Aumenta la alerta internacional por avance del Ébola en África Central y Este | HSB Noticias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International alert rises as Ebola advances in Central and East Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak escalates in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Kenya reporting a second Ebola death; no signs of uncontrolled community transmission to date. UN health agencies have issued alerts and are testing experimental vaccines in high-risk transmission zones while boosting epidemiological surveillance, diagnostics, and cross-border monitoring. Rapid-response teams are tightening contact tracing, case isolation, and early detection in neighboring countries. International partners requested supplies including personal protective equipment, medical devices, treatment infrastructure, and funding to keep isolation centers operational. Communities are urged to cooperate with health brigades and seek care for suspected symptoms. The trajectory depends on how quickly responses are mobilized, resource availability, and regional coordination. No details on exact case counts in DRC or infection sources provided.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカおよび東アフリカでのエボラ拡大により国際的な警戒が高まる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したエボラ出血熱がケニアにも拡大し死者が報告され、国連機関が警戒を発出し国境を越えた監視体制が強化されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・モザンビークは発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCでの正確な症例数は記事内で明らかにされていない。

article.articleHeadline: احتقان الأنف والصداع.. كيف تفرق بين تأثير تقلبات الطقس والعدوى الفيروسية؟ - الوطن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nasal congestion and headache: How to tell the difference between the effects of weather changes and a viral infection?
article.articleSummary: Weather changes do not directly introduce respiratory viruses; in India, seasonal shifts influence the environment, behavior, and exposure to respiratory viruses, according to Dr. Samir Bhatia in the Times of India. Temperature fluctuations between outdoors and air-conditioned spaces can dry the nose and throat, while changes in humidity and air quality may irritate airways, causing mild congestion, throat itch, or headaches. Allergens such as pollen or dust can trigger allergic rhinitis with sneezing, runny nose, and congestion. Signs suggesting a viral infection include fever, chills, body aches, fatigue, worsening sore throat, or a persistent cough, and recent contact with a sick person is an important clue; however, symptoms alone cannot confirm the cause, as some viral infections (including influenza) can occur without fever.

triage.headline_ja: 鼻づまりと頭痛…気候変動とウイルス感染の影響をどう見分けるか？
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の気候変化と呼吸器症状の見分け方に関する一般的な健康情報記事であり、特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はインフルエンザ等ウイルス感染と気象変化の症状の見分け方に関する一般的な医療啓発記事であり、具体的な感染症の発生・流行報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: KGMU starts 24/7 platelet processing amid dengue surge
article.articleSummary: Lucknow’s King George’s Medical University (KGMU) has started 24/7 platelet processing to meet rising dengue-related needs, with the blood bank now processing donations received after 5pm overnight. In the past week, KGMU supplied 1,260 platelets. Doctors decide on dengue-related platelet transfusion based on bleeding and other clinical indicators, not all patients require it. Dengue activity remains elevated in the city, which reported 22 new cases on Saturday, bringing the 2026 total to 622; nearly 300 cases occurred in September. Chief medical officer Dr NB Singh urged fever patients to get tested, noting that dengue testing and treatment are free at government hospitals. He also advised residents to prevent water stagnation around homes to curb mosquito breeding, signaling ongoing dengue transmission in Lucknow for the 2026 season.

triage.headline_ja: KGMU、デング熱急増を受け24時間体制の血小板処理を開始
triage.triage_reason: インドのラクナウにおける季節性デング熱の増加に関する国内医療対応の報道であり、異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航貿易制限の懸念は認められず、現地医療機関（KGMU）が自力で対応できている。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで毎年季節的に発生する風土病であり、本記事はラクナウの医療機関による通常の季節対応（血小板供給体制強化）を報じたものに過ぎない。全国的・国際的な異常事態の兆候は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Propolis Shows Antimicrobial Promise for Companion-Animal Skin Infections
article.articleSummary: Propolis shows in vitro antimicrobial activity against canine skin pathogens—Staphylococcus spp., Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Malassezia spp. and dermatophytes—but no controlled clinical trials exist for canine pyoderma, leaving its clinical value unproven as an antibiotic substitute. Across 18 studies, most work was laboratory-based; few small clinical assessments exist. Antimicrobial prescribing is high in companion animals: 29.2% of 2,599 dogs/cats across 52 practices received antibiotics; 25.7% of dog and 32.9% of cat consultations involved systemic therapy. S. pseudintermedius dominates canine pyoderma (~92% of cases), with up to 60% methicillin-resistant. External otitis isolates include P. aeruginosa (30.7%), S. pseudintermedius (25.1%), E. coli (19%); 47% are multidrug-resistant. Propolis composition is geography-dependent (Romania, Brazil, Argentina, Baltic region, Portugal, Turkey, Iraq); deep-eutectic-solvent extracts can be more potent than ethanolic, with MICs ~100–1,000 μg/mL vs 500–5,000 μg/mL. Active components include flavonoids and phenolic acids affecting membranes and efflux pumps.

triage.headline_ja: プロポリス、伴侶動物の皮膚感染症に対する抗菌作用の可能性を示す
triage.triage_reason: 動物（犬猫）の皮膚感染症に対するプロポリスの抗菌活性に関する実験室研究であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や人への感染拡大リスクを示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は伴侶動物（犬猫）の皮膚感染症治療に関する基礎研究レビューであり、ヒトの感染症イベントではない。発生地域リストはプロポリスの産地（ルーマニア、ブラジル等）を指しており、感染症の発生地ではないため対象国はいずれも該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: PMC seeks explanation from hospital for 8-yr-old girl's death due to suspected dengue
article.articleSummary: PMC issued a notice to Ruby Hall Clinic seeking explanation for alleged failure to promptly report a suspected dengue-positive case in an eight-year-old girl who died on Oct 18 in Pune. The hospital must submit all case papers and justify why it did not inform the civic body; the positive sample will be sent to the National Institute of Virology for retesting. Preliminary information suggested autoimmune disorders and asthma; a medical committee will determine if death was dengue-related. Ruby Hall Clinic’s Dr Vivek Lal said the matter is being reviewed. Civic body commissioner Naval Kishore Ram visited Dr Naidu Hospital for Infectious Diseases in Baner to assess dengue measures, bed availability, and vector-control coordination, urging war-footing action to prevent Aedes breeding. Dengue cases in PMC jurisdiction: 4,908 (2024), 2,391 (2025), 2,291 (Jan–Oct 20, 2026). Notifiable disease; ELISA used for official reporting; NS1/RT-PCR and IgM/IgG aid diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: PMC、デング熱疑いで死亡した8歳女児の件で病院に説明を求める
triage.triage_reason: プネー市におけるデング熱の個別死亡例と行政対応に関する報道であり、地域の流行状況（年間数千件）を示すが、国際的拡大や異常事態とまでは言えず、続報・推移を注視すべき段階。
triage.notes: プネー市（マハーラーシュトラ州）での地域的なデング熱流行と行政対応に関する記事。毎年数千件の症例が報告されており、季節性の風土病的状況と考えられる。国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態には該当しないが、地域の発生動向として継続的な監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Carla Visi, ex-Cheiro de Amor, é internada com infecção em Lisboa: 'Sem previsão de alta'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Carla Visi, former Cheiro de Amor member, hospitalized with infection in Lisbon: 'No expected discharge date'.
article.articleSummary: Carla Visi, 56, former Cheiro de Amor lead singer, is hospitalized in the Infectology Ward at Hospital Santa Maria, Lisbon, Portugal, after being diagnosed with a bacterial infection. She has been admitted since Monday following fever spikes near 40°C after performing Femininaxé at Brazil Origem Week in Lisbon. The infection is described as bacterial; no additional symptoms are reported, and there is no estimated discharge date. Allergies complicate treatment, with the medical team seeking the best therapy given her sensitivities. Visi has a cancer history, diagnosed with a malignant breast tumor in 2017, for which she underwent surgery, chemotherapy, and radiotherapy, with discharge in October 2022. She stated that further health updates will be shared via her social channels. Background notes her long-term public awareness efforts related to her cancer experience.

triage.headline_ja: 元Cheiro de Amorのカルラ・ヴィジ、リスボンで感染症のため入院『退院の見込み立たず』
triage.triage_reason: 個人の著名人に関する単発の細菌感染症入院事例であり、公衆衛生上の異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はポルトガル・リスボンでの個人の入院事例であり、対象国（ブラジル等）は発生地域として無関係。公衆衛生イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Single Amino Acid Contact Drives Assembly of Newcastle Disease Virus
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease virus (avian paramyxovirus type 1) assembly of inclusion bodies hinges on a single contact: glutamine 370 in nucleoprotein binds serine 254 in phosphoprotein. Li et al. (Shandong Academy of Agricultural Sciences; China; Belarus) map this motif, suggesting a target for antivirals. Using TEM, immunofluorescence, viral titration, co-immunoprecipitation and structural modeling, the study analyzes velogenic F48E9 and lentogenic LaSota strains, which form inclusion bodies in chicken embryo fibroblasts, mouse embryonic fibroblasts and HeLa cells, with virions visible in chicken cells. Replication occurs in all three cell types; mouse cells show lower levels, and F48E9 yields more inclusion bodies in mouse cells. In HeLa cells, inclusion bodies nucleate near the nucleus at ~6 hours post-infection, grow by 12 hours, and fuse by 24 hours; sizes are small (<3 μm^2), medium (3–8 μm^2), and large (>8 μm^2). DF-1 transfection identifies the minimal viral components required for assembly.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病ウイルスの単一アミノ酸接触が複製工場アセンブリを駆動する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究論文（ニューカッスル病ウイルスのタンパク質相互作用の分子メカニズム解明）であり、現在進行中の疾病アウトブレイクイベントではない。影響カテゴリが「animals」（動物）で公衆衛生上の具体的な発生報告ではなく、IHR基準もWPRO基準も該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は基礎研究論文（分子ウイロロジー）の学術報道であり、実際の疾病発生イベントではない。Shandong省とBelarusが発生地域として付与されているが、記事サマリーに具体的な発生報告・臨床的アウトブレイクの記述はなく、実験室研究のみを対象としている。シグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Doença em granja de Santa Catarina pode impactar exportações de frango de MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Disease at a Santa Catarina poultry farm could affect Mato Grosso do Sul's chicken exports.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed at a commercial poultry farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, triggering export restrictions on Brazilian poultry. Mato Grosso do Sul has no reported cases, but faces market impacts: Mexico and Malaysia have restricted Brazilian poultry products, while China, Chile, and Saudi Arabia restricted imports specifically from Santa Catarina. From January–September 2026, Mato Grosso do Sul exported about 6,000 tonnes of chicken to Mexico, valued at roughly US$12.6 million; the ultimate economic impact depends on the duration of restrictions and potential redirection to other markets. Newcastle disease is a viral avian illness causing respiratory, digestive, and neurological symptoms, with high mortality in some outbreaks.
