In Mato Grosso do Sul, Iagro is maintaining vigilant surveillance and biosafety measures under MAPA and the Avian Influenza and Newcastle Disease Surveillance Plan, including active serology and passive notification to protect local poultry competitiveness.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリナ州の養鶏場での疾病発生がマットグロッソ・ド・スル州の鶏肉輸出に影響する可能性
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリナ州の養鶏場でニューカッスル病（家禽の家畜疾患）が確認された事例であり、ヒトへの感染症ではなく公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは認められない。影響は貿易・経済面に限定される。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽に影響するウイルス性疾患でヒトへの感染症ではない。記事は家禽輸出市場への経済的影響に焦点を当てており、公衆衛生イベントとしての緊急性は低い。発生地域リストに含まれるChile, Malaysia, Saudi Arabia, Mexico, Chinaは輸入制限を課した国であり、疾病発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: un essai vaccinal démarre en RDC alors que l'épidémie dépasse les 4.600 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: a vaccine trial begins in the DRC as the outbreak surpasses 4,600 deaths.
article.articleSummary: During the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a Tumaini vaccine trial began in Bunia, Ituri province, with the first participant vaccinated on October 23. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo virus, and there is currently no vaccine approved specifically for this strain. The first vaccine tested is Ervebo, approved for the Zaire ebolavirus, but its effectiveness against Bundibugyo remains unproven. The World Health Organization notes that as of October 20, the DRC had 9,704 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,687 deaths, making this the deadliest outbreak in months. The trial signals an early step toward diversification of countermeasures, though the Bundibugyo strain poses additional challenges until vaccine efficacy data are established.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国での死者数が4,600人を超える中、ワクチン治験開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が9,704症例・4,687死者に達し、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株による流行であり、既存承認ワクチン（Ervebo）が有効か不明なため、ワクチン効果データの推移を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana Finally Closes Type 2 Polio Outbreak as World Polio Day 2026 Is Marked
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-24 World Polio Day, Ghana reportedly closed its Type 2 polio outbreak, marking progress in its public health response. The article notes no case/death counts. Emphasizes vaccination campaigns, surveillance, and public health education to protect children under five. Polio is highly infectious; there is no cure for paralysis, but vaccination prevents disease. Closure underscores the need for sustained immunisation and surveillance to prevent re-emergence. Authorities urge parents to ensure children receive vaccines and seek medical advice as needed. Continued cooperation among health workers, government agencies, communities, and international partners is essential to maintain polio-free status and reach underserved communities.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ、世界ポリオデー2026を迎え、ついに2型ポリオのアウトブレイクを終息
triage.triage_reason: アウトブレイク終息を発表する内容であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常事態ではないため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はアウトブレイク終息の発表であり、新規感染拡大や異常事態の報告ではない。継続的なサーベイランスの重要性を強調する啓発的内容。

article.articleHeadline: بدء أول تجربة سريرية للقاح إيبولا بالكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine begins in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization launches the first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 25 October 2026. The inaugural dose of Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) was administered in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province in northeastern DRC, the outbreak’s epicenter. The trial uses ring vaccination, vaccinating contacts and others at highest risk, including pregnant women and children aged 12 years and older. Preparations are underway to add two vaccines specifically designed for the Bundibugyo strain, currently in more limited, early-stage clinical testing. This marks a key step in outbreak response, aiming to protect those most exposed and broaden variant-specific options as trials progress.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチンの初の臨床試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対しWHOがリングワクチン接種の臨床試験を開始しており、重篤な感染症の継続的発生と国際的な対応（WHO主導）が示唆されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン臨床試験開始の報告であり、新規感染者数や流行規模に関する具体的データは記載されていないため、詳細はフルリスク評価で確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு காய்ச்சல்: பல்லடத்தில் சிறுவன் உயிரிழப்பு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever: a boy dies in Palladam.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, a 4-year-old boy named Tamil in Palladam, Tiruppur district, Tamil Nadu, died from dengue fever. He was the son of Praveenkumar and Haripriya and studied at a private school in Palladam. He had fever for several days; following testing at a Palladam hospital, he was diagnosed with dengue fever. He was then referred for higher care to the Government Medical College Hospital, Coimbatore, where he died on Friday night. Palladam area medical officer confirmed the dengue diagnosis and said the child had been receiving treatment at Palladam's hospital before transfer. The exact cause of death will be known after the medical examination report is released.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：パラダットで少年が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単発のデング熱による死亡例であり、インドでは地域的に流行している疾患のため異常性は低いが、小児の死亡例として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 単一症例の報告であり、地域的な流行状況や他の症例数についての情報が記事にないため、継続的な情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: South Africa Readies 36 Hospitals for Ebola
article.articleSummary: South Africa has designated 36 hospitals (24 public, 12 private) to receive suspected Ebola patients, aiming to keep such cases out of ordinary wards; as of 24 October 2026, no confirmed Ebola case has been reported in the country. Health Minister Motsoaledi announced the plan in July 2026; NICD is on high alert with port health screening conducted by the Border Management Authority. The Bundibugyo strain is responsible for the ongoing outbreak in the region, with the DRC reporting over 8,600 confirmed cases and 4,148 deaths by 4 October 2026, and Kenya reporting an imported case on 6 October; WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern. No vaccine or specific treatment exists; care relies on isolation and supportive therapy. From 3 November 2026, all international air passengers to the US must sign an attestation not to have been in the DRC in the prior 21 days; Johannesburg stopovers do not by themselves trigger restrictions, but travelers from South Sudan or Uganda face entry limits, and US citizens who visited those countries have designated screening routes.

triage.headline_ja: 南アフリカ、エボラ対応のため36病院を準備
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが8,600例・4,148死亡に達し、WHOがPHEICを宣言。ケニアへの輸入例や国際的な渡航制限措置も発生しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクとそれに対する南アフリカ・米国等の対応・渡航制限であり、実際の発生地はDRC。南アフリカ・ケニア・ウガンダ・米国・南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Comienza el ensayo técnico de la vacuna contra el ébola en el este del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The technical trial of the Ebola vaccine begins in eastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, eastern city Bunia hosts a crucial Ebola vaccine trial targeting the Bundibugyo strain amid the country’s largest recorded outbreak (9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths as of Oct 20, per the World Health Organization). The first participant received Merck’s Ervebo vaccine, approved for Zaire ebolavirus, in Bunia. Moderna may test an experimental Bundibugyo-specific vaccine, while an Oxford University/Serum Institute of India candidate could be evaluated as part of the study. Experts warn that traditional containment may be insufficient given the outbreak’s wide spread and ongoing transmission; armed groups and instability hinder recruitment and follow-up. WHO reports about 80% of over 30,000 contacts traced in the last 24 hours, below the 95% target. If efficacy is shown, scalable production is anticipated; Serum reportedly produced over 600,000 doses of the Oxford asset in nine days after material receipt.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でエボラワクチンの技術的試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（確定9,704例、死亡4,687例）が継続しており、接触者追跡率も目標未達で、武装勢力による不安定化が封じ込めを阻害している。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的なワクチン開発機関も関与する重大事案。
triage.notes: 国内最大規模のエボラアウトブレイクが継続中で、Merck、Moderna、Oxford/Serum Instituteなど複数機関がワクチン開発・試験に関与。接触者追跡率が目標(95%)を下回る80%に留まり、武装勢力の影響で封じ込めが困難な状況が継続している。既にWHO notificationされている可能性が高い案件だが、新たな技術的トライアル開始という進展情報として重要。

article.articleHeadline: OMS confirma ensayo para evaluar vacunas contra el virus Bundibugyo del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO confirms trial to evaluate vaccines against the Bundibugyo Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo spurred a WHO/CEPI-led vaccine trial. In Bunia, capital of Ituri Province, the first participants were vaccinated on Friday with Tumaini, an Ebola vaccine candidate targeting Bundibugyo. There is currently no approved vaccine against Bundibugyo, the strain driving the ongoing outbreak in the DRC. The trial aims to evaluate several candidate vaccines and will enroll people who have had contact with Ebola patients to assess safety and potential protection. As the study progresses, two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are slated to be added: a Oxford University–Serum Institute (India) candidate and Moderna’s messenger RNA vaccine. The effort, announced by the World Health Organization and CEPI, seeks to determine whether these vaccines can work against Bundibugyo ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱のブンディブギョ株に対するワクチン治験を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCでブンディブギョ株によるエボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが継続中であり、WHO/CEPI主導のワクチン治験開始という重大な公衆衛生対応が報じられているため、フルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部（イトゥリ州ブニア）で発生中のブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスに対するワクチン治験開始を報じたもの。インドはオックスフォード大学/インド血清研究所のワクチン製造元として言及されているのみで、発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Quênia registra segunda morte por ebola - 24/10/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records second Ebola death - 24/10/2026.
article.articleSummary: Kenya recorded its second Ebola death on Oct 23, raising confirmed deaths to two among nine cases in the outbreak that began in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The 65-year-old woman, in quarantine, was a close relative of a Kenyan who died earlier in October. Since Kenya's first identified case—a man who traveled from DRC to Nairobi and died Oct 5—authorities have traced 135 contacts, all quarantined. Seven of the nine confirmed patients remain in two isolation units; no community transmission detected in Kenya. The outbreak has spread to four African countries across East, Central and West Africa—the widest geographic spread of Ebola in Africa to date. The U.S. advised reconsidering travel to Kenya; Nigeria reported a case on Oct 20. In DRC, the outbreak has infected nearly 10,000 and killed over 4,600; the current Ebola strain has no approved treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで2人目のエボラ死亡例を記録 - 2026年10月24日
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラがケニア・ナイジェリアなど4カ国に拡大し、米国が渡航再検討を勧告するなど国際的懸念が高まっており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの死亡例報告だが、発生源・主要被害地はDRCであり、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ケニア、ナイジェリア、モザンビークは対象国リスト外のため除外。ワクチン・治療法未承認の株であることも重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄增３例境外登革熱 足跡入社區
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung reports three more imported dengue fever cases as the virus enters the community
article.articleSummary: Three more imported dengue fever cases were confirmed in Kaohsiung City, Taiwan, on 24 October 2026. Case 33 is a 38-year-old Taiwanese man who traveled to the Philippines from 8–18 October; he developed fever, headache and muscle pain, and was PCR-confirmed with dengue virus type 2 after a rapid test. Case 34 is a 43-year-old Japanese man who visited Thailand from 3–17 October; after arriving in Kaohsiung on 17 October and a hospital visit on 20 October, PCR confirmed dengue virus type 2. Case 35 is a 48-year-old Taiwanese woman from Sanmin District who toured Da Nang, Vietnam with her husband from 4–21 October; she had fever, nausea, loss of appetite, knee pain and a rash, NS1 rapid test and PCR positive, and she was hospitalized; her husband had no symptoms and a negative PCR. The Health Bureau conducted residence and venue inspections and intensified surveillance at nearby high-risk sites to prevent local transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄で輸入性デング熱症例が3件増加、ウイルスが地域に侵入
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄で輸入デング熱症例が増加し地域侵入の懸念があるが、台湾は対象国に含まれず、感染源国（フィリピン・タイ・ベトナム）での具体的な流行状況は不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は台湾高雄市での輸入デング熱症例報告であり、感染は渡航先（フィリピン、タイ、ベトナム）で成立したとみられるため、これらを発生国として記載。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Mango Compound Mangiferin Shows Multi-Stage Activity Against Toxoplasma
article.articleSummary: Mangiferin, a mango-derived C-glucosylxanthone, shows multi-stage activity against Toxoplasma gondii. In work from Henan Medical University in Xinxiang, China, published in Frontiers in Microbiology, mangiferin inhibits parasite growth in cultured human foreskin fibroblasts, rapidly alters tachyzoite morphology, and prolongs survival of mice infected with virulent RH strain. In vitro, host cell viability remained >90% at 320 μM (10–320 μM tested); plaque assays showed no plaques at 320 μM and reduced plaque numbers/areas at 160 μM (significant differences vs vehicle; p=0.0006 for plaque count; p=0.0013 for plaque area; Dunn’s test mainly vs control at 320 μM). Extracellular tachyzoites rounded within 30 minutes, with more pronounced effects at higher concentrations; SEM after 2 hours confirmed rounding and spherical forms at 320 μM. This is initial evidence rather than a therapeutic breakthrough. Toxoplasma gondii is an obligate intracellular parasite causing toxoplasmosis, posing higher risk to immunocompromised and pregnant individuals; current therapy (pyrimethamine+sulfadiazine) is limited by toxicity.

triage.headline_ja: マンゴー由来化合物マンギフェリン、トキソプラズマに対する多段階活性を示す
triage.triage_reason: これは実験室レベルの基礎研究（in vitro/マウス実験）に関する報告であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は創薬・基礎研究に関する科学ニュースであり、トキソプラズマ症のアウトブレイクを報告するものではないため、サーベイランス対象イベントとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya reports second death from Ebola
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a second death from Ebola linked to an outbreak that began in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The Daily Monitor (Uganda) article, published 24 October 2026, notes the DRC-origin outbreak has been reported in four. The piece provides no further figures or clinical details in the brief. It cites Monitor Uganda via monitor.co.ug as the source. No information on laboratory confirmation, specific locations within Kenya, timing, or transmission chains is included. This update confirms Kenya's second Ebola-related fatality tied to the DRC-origin outbreak as of 24 October 2026, with the Ugandan outlet serving as the reporting source.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラによる2人目の死亡者
triage.triage_reason: DRC起源のエボラアウトブレイクがケニアに拡大し、複数国での死亡例が確認されている。国際的拡大リスクが明確で、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでのエボラ死亡例を報じているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCはアウトブレイクの起源国として明記されているため含めた。詳細な臨床情報・検査確認・感染経路等は不明であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue em Goiás aumentam 17% e Secretaria da Saúde reforça combate ao mosquito - O Maior Portal de Notícias de Goiás
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of dengue in Goiás rise by 17% and the Health Department strengthens the fight against mosquitoes - Goiás' Largest News Portal.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-24, Goiás state reports 108,673 confirmed dengue cases this year (up 17% vs. 2025) and 11,311 chikungunya cases (up 343%). The Health Secretariat (SES-GO) intensifies Aedes aegypti control with risk-area surveillance, insecticides/larvicides, municipal-team training, and tech-assisted vector reduction. Ovitrampa traps (5,736) deployed across 104 municipalities and larvicida-dissemination stations (3,278 units; 2,000 to Caldas Novas). Wolbachia-based suppression is expanding: Valparaíso and Luziânia have received the bacteria; Anápolis began in October; Aparecida de Goiânia and Trindade are preparing. Vaccination with Qdenga is offered via SUS for 10-14-year-olds in two doses 3 months apart; 402,915 first doses (54.84% coverage); 39.91% of the target are overdue for the second dose. Residents are urged to eliminate standing water, keep water tanks closed, clean gutters, and discard containers.

triage.headline_ja: ゴイアス州でデング熱症例が17%増加、保健局が蚊対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ゴイアス州における季節性のデング熱・チクングニア熱症例増加の報告であり、チクングニア熱の343%増は注目に値するが、既存の対策（Wolbachia、ワクチン接種等）が機能しており新規性・国際的拡大の兆候は乏しい。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内の地方ニュースであり、州保健局が主体的に蚊媒介対策（Wolbachia、ワクチン接種、ラルバトラップ等）を実施中。チクングニア熱の343%増加は顕著だが、記事内に重症度・死亡率データの記載はなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念材料は確認できない。季節性流行として経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: DRC launches TUMAINI trial to test Ebola vaccines against Bundibugyo strain
article.articleSummary: In Bunia, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, vaccinations have begun as part of the TUMAINI study to test Ebola vaccines against the Bundibugyo virus. The trial, led by Congolese health authorities with World Health Organization support, evaluates existing vaccine candidates for safety, efficacy, and immune response, including Ervebo, the vaccine licensed for the Zaire strain, though its effectiveness against Bundibugyo remains uncertain. A shared research framework enables simultaneous assessment of multiple candidates. The launch follows a May Ebola outbreak with more than 9,700 infections and over 4,600 deaths, and the WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern. Results are expected to inform which vaccine options deserve further development and potential deployment against Bundibugyo, while WHO cautions the trial is not proof Ervebo protects against Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、ブンディブギョ株に対するエボラワクチンを試験するTUMAINI治験を開始
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言した大規模エボラ流行（感染9,700人超、死亡4,600人超）を背景に、新規ワクチン治験が開始されており、公衆衛生上の深刻性・異常性・国際的関心のいずれも高い。
triage.notes: 本記事は5月から継続中の大規模エボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）に対するワクチン治験開始の報道であり、既にWHOによりPHEICが宣言されている。既存流行の継続としてフルリスク評価の対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: OMS inicia ensayo clínico con vacuna Ervebo contra el ébola en El Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO begins clinical trial of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: WHO begins clinical trials of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine in Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, to test cross-protection against the outbreak’s current variant. The biomedical study involves inoculating volunteers to evaluate the immune response of candidate vaccines against the mutation driving the emergency. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus affirmed the trials aim to assess immunogenicity and potential to curb transmission. As of 24 October 2026, epidemiological reports tally more than 9,700 Ebola virus disease cases and about 4,600 deaths, with the outbreak escalated to a Public Health Emergency of International Concern after reaching four neighboring countries. The effort reflects a coordinated strategy to contain Ebola within the African continent.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチン「エルベボ」の臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ出血熱流行はPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）に指定され、症例9,700超・死者4,600人規模かつ4か国に拡大しており、IHR基準の複数に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みで、近隣4か国に拡大していると記載されているが、具体的な国名は本文に明示されていないためDRCのみを確定国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Poliomielite em 2026, vacinação e vigilância no Brasil | Newslab
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Poliomyelitis in 2026, Vaccination and Surveillance in Brazil | Newslab
article.articleSummary: On World Polio Day (October 24), Brazil emphasizes vaccination and surveillance to maintain polio-free status; the last Brazilian case was in 1989, and the Americas achieved interruption of indigenous wild poliovirus transmission in 1994. In 2026, Brazil updated its schedule: since August 3, a second inactivated poliovirus vaccine (VIP) booster at age 4, yielding a five-dose IPV regimen for children under five. Global circulation persists: wild poliovirus type 1 remains endemic in Afghanistan and Pakistan; six additional WPV1 cases in Afghanistan in Aug–Sep 2026 bring the 2026 total to 42 as of Oct 21. Circulating vaccine-derived polioviruses have been detected in Chad, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Nigeria and South Sudan. Poliomyelitis is fecal-oral; most infections are asymptomatic, but 1 in 200 can cause paralysis with 5–10% mortality among those with paralysis; no cure. Suspect acute flaccid paralysis in under-15s and collect stool within 14 days for laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年のポリオ：ブラジルにおけるワクチン接種と監視
triage.triage_reason: 世界ポリオデーに際したブラジルのワクチン接種・監視体制に関する定例啓発記事であり、ブラジル国内での新規発生はない。言及されているDRC等でのVDPV検出も既知の継続状況であり、新規シグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルにおける世界ポリオデーの啓発・ワクチン接種スケジュール更新に関する内容で、ブラジル自体は1989年以来ポリオフリーを維持しており新規発生なし。アフガニスタン・パキスタン（野生株流行）、チャド・ナイジェリア・南スーダン・DRC（VDPV検出）は世界的状況の背景説明として言及されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。いずれも既知の継続的状況であり新規イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: أول تجربة سريرية للقاح ضد إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine to address the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In Bunia, the capital of Ituri province, the first participant received the Tomaini vaccine, meaning 'hope' in Swahili. The outbreak is the worst in DRC history, with more than 9,700 cases and over 4,600 deaths. The trial uses a ring vaccination approach and will evaluate multiple vaccines, including Ervebo, within a unified experimental framework called Tomaini to determine safety, efficacy, and potential cross-protection against the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain driving the outbreak. Pregnant women and children aged 12 and older will be enrolled. Preparations also include adding two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines developed by Oxford and Moderna (mRNA) currently in early-phase trials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で初のエボラワクチン臨床試験
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模（症例9,700超、死亡4,600超）のエボラ流行が継続しており、新規ワクチン臨床試験開始という重大な公衆衛生上の動きがあるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 本記事はDRCにおける史上最大規模のエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）とそれに対するWHO主導のワクチン臨床試験開始を報じるもの。既存の進行中アウトブレイクに関する続報であり、フルRRAでの詳細評価が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: THEWILL EDITORIAL: The Ebola Invasion
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus has entered Nigeria again through importation, echoing the 2014 Lagos outbreak. The 2014 case traced to Liberian Patrick Sawyer; Nigerian physician Stella Adedevoh died containing the spread. The current invasion involves a traveler—a woman from Uganda or Kenya—who arrived at Murtala Muhammed International Airport, proceeded to Abuja’s hospital, where Ebola was detected. She reportedly had contact with 44 people; the health status of these contacts is unknown. The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) alerted authorities; the Senate moved to amend the 100-year-old Quarantine Act, and questions were raised about border screening. There is no approved Ebola vaccine yet; meanwhile, the Democratic Republic of Congo has begun a Phase 2/3 vaccine trial for Bundibugyo virus. As of now, only the hospitalized traveler is confirmed; all other contacts are under investigation. International support is urged.

triage.headline_ja: THEWILL社説：エボラの侵入
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアへのエボラ輸入例が確認され、44名の接触者の健康状態が不明であることから国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでのエボラ輸入例であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。DRCについては同国で進行中のBundibugyoウイルスに対する第2/3相ワクチン治験への言及であり、本イベント（ナイジェリアでの輸入症例）とは別の文脈のため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Virologists urge Nigerians to embrace hygiene as current strain defies treatment
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms one imported Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease case in the Federal Capital Territory, the fifth country to detect the virus since the outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of the Congo on May 15, 2026. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo; a Zaire-strain vaccine exists but not Bundibugyo. Nigeria’s NCDC activated its incident management system; high-risk contacts are quarantined and contact tracing is underway. Preventive measures include early detection, isolation, strict infection prevention, PPE for health workers, and handwashing. The Bundibugyo fatality rate is about 32.8%. Symptoms prompting care include fever, severe headache, sore throat, muscle pains, and diarrhoea. Experts urge targeted surveillance and protection of frontline workers; avoid panic and follow public health guidance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:ウイルス学者らがナイジェリア国民に衛生対策の徹底を呼びかけ、現行株が治療に抵抗性
triage.triage_reason: DRC起源のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが既に5か国に拡大し、致死率約32.8%、有効なワクチン・治療法が存在しないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大イベント。
triage.notes: ナイジェリアは輸入症例の確認国であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。アウトブレイクの発生源であるDRCのみを計上した。ブンディブギョ株に対する承認ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しない点が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: The return of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola re-emerges in Nigeria after Ituri Province, DRC outbreak prompts confirmation of one case in Abuja FCT as of Oct 20. The patient, a 42-year-old Ugandan-born woman married to a Swiss diplomat, traveled to Uganda and returned to Abuja on Oct 3; she was admitted to a private clinic, tested positive on Oct 20, and is isolated with a stable, improving condition after multi-organ complications. Nigeria’s NCDC and FCT Health Services Secretariat, with WHO coordination, have initiated aggressive contact tracing for 44 contacts across healthcare workers, patients, caregivers and travel connections, with travel restrictions to curb spread. Oct 6 advisory warned of import risk after a Kenyan case; Oct 18 ECDC reports 9,552 Congo cases and 4,602 deaths across eight provinces; Kenya: 9 cases (1 death) as of Oct 20; Uganda: 20 Bundibugyo Ebola cases May–June, 15 imported from DRC, 5 locally acquired. Lagos 2014 lessons cited; border surveillance to remain heightened until contained.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの再来
triage.triage_reason: DRC(イトゥリ州)由来のエボラ流行がウガンダ・ケニアを経てナイジェリアの首都アブジャで確認され、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的拡大と渡航制限が生じているため。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアでの症例も記載されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRC（イトゥリ州）が震源地であり9,552例・4,602死亡の大規模流行が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: OMS inicia ensayo clínico de vacuna contra el Ébola en R. D. del Congo | HSB Noticias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO begins a clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine in the Democratic Republic of the Congo | HSB Noticias
article.articleSummary: Ebola vaccine trial begins in Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, as part of outbreak response. The World Health Organization is administering Ervebo doses to volunteer participants to assess protection against the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, a variant distinct from the Zaire lineage for which the vaccine was originally developed. The study seeks to determine whether a Zaire-formulated vaccine can confer cross-protection against Bundibugyo; efficacy will be determined by clinical results. The effort runs alongside protections for health and frontline workers, contact tracing, and care for exposed individuals, with ongoing epidemiologic surveillance, triage centers, and protocols to identify and limit transmission. International funders are urged to sustain supplies of medical equipment and logistics, and to strengthen surveillance in densely populated areas with clear community communication. Outcomes will inform future outbreak response strategies.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチンの臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイク対応としてワクチン臨床試験が実施されており、国際的拡大リスクや管理可能性の観点から継続的な注視が必要なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラのブンディブギョ株によるアウトブレイクに対するワクチン臨床試験開始を報じており、既存のアウトブレイク対応の一環。感染者数・死亡者数等の規模に関する情報は記事中に明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: DEALING WITH THE EBOLA THREAT
article.articleSummary: 600 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda by May, with 139 suspected deaths. WHO classed the outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern, not a pandemic, with high national/regional but low global risk. Nigeria established a Presidential Task Force on Ebola Preparedness and released 10 billion naira in emergency funding. One imported case has been confirmed in Federal Capital Territory (FCT): a woman who arrived from Uganda; she is in isolation, with 44 close contacts identified. Authorities urge protocols in markets, churches, mosques, and other venues. Ebola symptoms resemble malaria—fever, sore throat, headache, vomiting—with incubation 2 days to 3 weeks; transmission via close contact with blood and bodily fluids or exposure to infected animals like fruit bats. The DRC outbreak involves Bundibugyo strain, for which no vaccine or treatment exists. Nigeria’s 2014 outbreak killed about 11,300; Lagos helped Nigeria become Ebola-free by 20 Oct 2014.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの脅威への対応
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICに分類したDRC・ウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクに加え、ナイジェリアへの輸入症例が確認されており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ナイジェリアも記事の主題だが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCのバンディブギョ株には現時点でワクチン・治療法が存在しない点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: China Faces New COVID Surge Amid Smog and Winter Chill
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 infections rise across China in October 2026, driven by Omicron NB.1.8.1 sublineages. Elderly and immunocompromised remain at higher risk; circulating variants are highly contagious but generally cause mild symptoms in healthy, vaccinated adults. Severe air pollution blankets northern cities like Beijing and Baoding with PM2.5, worsening respiratory symptoms. Hospitals brace for winter with potential triple epidemic of COVID-19, influenza, and RSV; China CDC data show ongoing spread. Immunity from prior infections wanes. Public health responses include updated masking guidelines, air purifiers and medical-grade air filters, fortified antivirals and fever meds stocks, and reinforced indoor ventilation. Authorities urge vulnerable populations to get updated vaccines immediately. Routine genomic sequencing continues to rapidly detect new mutations.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で新たなCOVID感染拡大、スモッグと冬の寒さが重なる
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19/インフルエンザ/RSVの「トリプル流行」懸念だが、症状は概ね軽症で異常性・国際拡大の明確な兆候はなく、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 季節性の感染症流行（COVID-19/インフル/RSV）で、高齢者・免疫不全者以外は軽症傾向。大気汚染が呼吸器症状を悪化させている点が特徴的だが、IHR基準には該当せず、WPRO基準の一部（長期曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当するのみ。中国CDCによる監視・ワクチン接種推奨など国内対応は継続中。

article.articleHeadline: 事关流感，中疾控最新发布
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza in Focus: China CDC Releases Latest Update.
article.articleSummary: Weather cools and influenza activity rises in parts of China, signaling the peak season is November to March and the best time to vaccinate. China CDC Weekly (Oct 22, 2026) reports circulation since July: influenza A accounts for 66.1% of positives and influenza B for 33.9%; among A, H3N2 represents 80.6% and H1N1pdm09 19.4%; all B detections are Victoria lineage. Since March 2020, B/Yamagata has not been monitored. WHO will not recommend Yamagata for 2026–2027 vaccines, so vaccines are now three-valent. In China, three-valent vaccines (split, subunit) for 6 months+, and a three-valent live attenuated for 3–17 years, are available; dosages include 0.25 and 0.5 mL for inactivated vaccines, 0.2 mL for the live vaccine. Four-valent vaccines offer no additional protection given current strains. Protective effect takes 2–4 weeks. High-priority groups: infants ≥6 months, elderly ≥60, pregnant individuals, chronic disease or obesity, immunosuppressed; plus those with high exposure risk (students, healthcare workers).

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザに関して、中国疾病予防コントロールセンターが最新情報を発表
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行シーズン情報とワクチン接種に関する公衆衛生広報であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの流行株（H3N2優位）とワクチン推奨に関する通常の公衆衛生情報であり、異常な感染拡大や重症化の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Garantizan insumos para el control de la malaria en municipios selváticos de Amazonas - MPPS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They guarantee supplies for malaria control in the jungle municipalities of Amazonas - MPPS
article.articleSummary: Malaria-control supplies and vaccines were distributed on Oct 24 to the jungle municipalities of Autana, Alto Orinoco, Atabapo, Manapiare, Maroa, and Río Negro in Amazonas state, Venezuela, to sustain malaria prevention, diagnosis and treatment in hard-to-reach communities. The joint operation by the State Health Directorate (DES Amazonas), the Ministry of Health (MinSalud), the Environmental Health Directorate (DESA), and the Malaria Elimination Program replenished rapid diagnostic tests, diagnostic materials, and antimalarial medicines, and provided resources to reinforce care in Río Negro and the Mavaca parish of Alto Orinoco with vaccines and immunization staff to broaden coverage. The effort strengthens coordination between environmental health teams and local health personnel, ensuring stocked diagnostic and treatment posts for timely malaria care in the most remote areas. Authority Joskany La Rosa, with backing from Governor Miguel Rodríguez, emphasizes ongoing commitment to sustaining health services for Amazonas families.

triage.headline_ja: アマソナス州のジャングル自治体でマラリア対策物資を確保 - MPPS
triage.triage_reason: ベネズエラ・アマソナス州における通常のマラリア対策物資配布に関する行政活動の報告であり、異常な発生や急増を示す情報はなく、対象国リストにも該当国がない。
triage.notes: 記事はベネズエラ・アマソナス州での定常的なマラリア対策物資配布に関するもので、流行や異常事態を示す記述はない。対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない（Bluedotの発生地域にBrazilが含まれるが、記事主題はベネズエラであり除外）。

article.articleHeadline: Cantora Carla Visi é internada com infecção | A TARDE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Singer Carla Visi is hospitalized with an infection | A TARDE.
article.articleSummary: Bahian singer Carla Visi is hospitalized in the Infectology ward of Hospital Santa Maria in Lisbon, Portugal, after presenting with a bacterial infection on Saturday, October 24, 2026. CNN reported that her team confirmed the admission and noted a fever around 40°C. As of the report, doctors have not established a diagnosis; the illness is under investigation. There is no estimated discharge date, and updates will be shared on her Instagram. Visi rose to fame with Cheiro de Amor from 1996 to 2000 and later pursued a solo career. She lives in Lisbon with her family and is an environmental advocate and a doctoral candidate in Human Ecology at Universidade Nova de Lisboa.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Turkey culling and a zoosanitary emergency: what is known about the Newcastle disease case in Santa Catarina.

triage.headline_ja: 七面鳥の処分と動物衛生緊急事態：サンタカタリーナ州のニューカッスル病感染について分かっていること

article.articleHeadline: How China Tracks COVID-19 Cases and Outbreaks
article.articleSummary: China's COVID-19 monitoring has shifted from zero-COVID mass testing to risk-based testing and routine respiratory surveillance. As of August 2026, China reported 771,000 confirmed COVID-19 cases, 640 severe cases, and six deaths, noting these figures do not capture all infections. National guidance no longer mandates universal nucleic-acid screening; testing is guided by symptoms, exposure, setting, and risk, with weekly testing in elder-care and social-welfare facilities during outbreaks and prompt testing for fever or respiratory symptoms. China CDC's sentinel acute respiratory-infection system now includes SARS-CoV-2 in its panel, testing outpatient, emergency, and hospitalized patients for influenza-like illness and severe acute respiratory infection to track COVID-19 alongside other pathogens. The current framework relies on targeted testing and surveillance rather than widespread isolation, and historical zero-COVID rules (the 20 Measures and 10 Measures) should not be treated as current nationwide requirements.

triage.headline_ja: 中国はどのようにCOVID-19の症例とアウトブレイクを追跡しているか
triage.triage_reason: 中国の監視体制の説明記事であり、新規の異常事態や急増を示す内容ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は中国のCOVID-19サーベイランス体制の説明であり、症例数も既存の報告範囲内（重症640、死亡6）で新たな公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola makes a return
article.articleSummary: Ebola has returned to Nigeria after 14 years, linked to a Nigerian traveler, a woman whose identity is undisclosed. The disease, Ebola haemorrhagic fever, originated in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with a fearsome outbreak in the DRC ongoing for months. Unlike the 2014 Lagos import via a Liberian vectored Ebola, this instance is an imported case into Nigeria. The episode underscores that, had the index traveler’s passport history been carefully perused and established that she had been to Congo before travelling to Uganda, she would have been quarantined in Abuja before trouble reared its head. Now the country is scrambling to manage what it could have prevented. Some social media voices frame the return as a political ploy, but health authorities face an imported Ebola case requiring careful handling.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが再来
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで14年ぶりにエボラ輸入症例が確認され、感染源であるDRCでは数か月にわたるアウトブレイクが継続中。IHR基準複数該当（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大リスク）でフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアへのエボラ輸入症例（渡航者経由）だが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であり現在も進行中のアウトブレイクが発生しているDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。ウガンダ・リベリア・ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: En Mendoza piden reforzar la vacunación contra el sarampión ante la alerta sanitaria internacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Mendoza, they call for strengthening measles vaccination amid the international health alert.
article.articleSummary: Measles risk in South America is deemed 'very high' by OPS as Argentina prepares for Pope León XIV's November visit. Between Jan 4 and Oct 3, 2026, 55,792 cases and 77 deaths were reported in 17 countries, 4.8-fold higher than 2025. Despite vaccination efforts, regional coverage remains uneven; OPS urges at least 95% two-dose MMR coverage. Argentina's first-dose coverage was 83.6% in 2025, second-dose 54.8%. Mendoza province shows 97.1% first dose and 91% second dose. Weekly alerts of suspected cases on flights linked to Brazil highlight cross-border risk. Measles is a highly contagious Morbillivirus spread by respiratory droplets; symptoms include fever, runny nose, conjunctivitis, cough, Koplik spots, and rash. Severe complications include pneumonia, encephalitis, seizures, blindness, and death. Vaccination is free at public centers; children born after July 1, 2024 receive first dose at 12 months and second at 15 months; adults born since 1965 should have two doses.

triage.headline_ja: メンドーサ州、国際保健警報を受けて麻疹ワクチン接種強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 南米地域全体で麻疹症例が前年比4.8倍に急増し、77人が死亡、国際保健機関（PAHO/OPS）がリスクを「非常に高い」と評価しており、国際的拡大の懸念がある。ただし発生主体はアルゼンチンであり対象国には該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチン・メンドーサ州における麻疹ワクチン接種強化の呼びかけであり、ブラジルは航空便を通じた越境リスクの文脈でのみ言及されている。両国とも対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。ただし南米地域全体の麻疹流行は国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項であり、今後ブラジルなど対象国への波及がないか継続監視が望まれる。

article.articleHeadline: L'Ouganda interdit le transit aux voyageurs ayant séjourné en RDC afin d'endiguer la propagation du virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda bans transit for travelers who have stayed in the DRC to curb the spread of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Uganda bans transit for travelers who have recently stayed in the Democratic Republic of Congo to curb Ebola spread, according to the health ministry. The policy follows cases of travelers who transited Uganda and were later confirmed in Nigeria (one case on arrival) and Kenya (early October). Under the new rules, all travelers must complete location forms to enable contact tracing, with strengthened surveillance at entry/exit points and health facilities nationwide. Officials warned that entry via unauthorized routes could incur public-health violation penalties. Uganda states it remains Ebola-free to date. Previously, the country reported 20 confirmed Ebola cases and 2 deaths before the outbreak was officially declared over by the World Health Organization and Africa CDC on 27 August after 42 days without new cases.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラウイルスの拡散を食い止めるためコンゴ民主共和国(DRC)滞在歴のある渡航者のトランジットを禁止
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ出血熱がナイジェリア・ケニアで確認され、ウガンダが渡航制限を導入するなど国際的拡大と渡航制限の両方が確認されるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC発のエボラ出血熱の国際的拡大（ナイジェリア・ケニアでの確認例、ウガンダの渡航制限）。ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、国際的拡大の重要な文脈として記載。
